tenka.note.onigawara_rin_breath: Restore up to 15 existing fatigue. Next paid single-target sword attack gains +0.25x damage; signature blade refunds 4 fatigue. +6 melee defense while held; expires at the end of the next normal turn.
tenka.note.onigawara_rin_heavy: Breath plus great cut costs only 5 AP, leaving a 4 AP basic attack. The first damaging paid enemy attack each round deals 40% less damage. Hasso separately enables counters and protects adjacent allies.
tenka.note.onigawara_rin_guard: Defense until the next normal turn: +12 melee defense (+8 for Mary); Rin also grants adjacent allies +6 melee defense. Counter missed paid single-target melee attacks, at most twice per round shared with vanilla Riposte. Final fatigue cost: 6 per counter (5 for Mary).
tenka.note.kikakujo_mary_nerve: After at least 5 HP damage to a bleedable, debuffable target, reduce melee and ranged attack by 10% until its next normal turn ends. Immune targets still take the piercing attack.
tenka.note.kikakujo_mary_lunge: Move up to 3 tiles to engage; spearwalls are checked each step and the attack requires arrival. Add up to +0.40x damage from initiative at impact. Shares the once-per-round footwork allowance. The owner's blade reduces the next Nerve Thrust's fatigue by 4.
tenka.note.kikakujo_mary_guard: Defense until the next normal turn: +12 melee defense (+8 for Mary); Rin also grants adjacent allies +6 melee defense. Counter missed paid single-target melee attacks, at most twice per round shared with vanilla Riposte. Final fatigue cost: 6 per counter (5 for Mary).
tenka.note.tamaba_satori_feint: Different paid single-target sword techniques build a chain even on a miss. Repetition or changing targets resets it to one. Gain +10 melee defense against the observed target.
tenka.note.tamaba_satori_chain: Requires and consumes 2 chain stacks on this target. Three strikes deal 0.85x, 0.95x and 1.05x sword damage; only the final strike halves shield defense. Recheck life and range each strike. Signature blade reduces fatigue by 4.
tenka.note.tamaba_satori_guard: Defense until the next normal turn: +12 melee defense (+8 for Mary); Rin also grants adjacent allies +6 melee defense. +10 melee defense against the observed enemy.
tenka.note.hanasaka_warabi_leap: Advance up to 3 tiles and attack for 2 AP; shares the round's footwork allowance. +10 melee and ranged defense until the next normal turn after moving. The owner's blade reduces the next basic cut's fatigue by 4 this round.
tenka.note.hanasaka_warabi_dance: Strike three consecutive adjacent tiles beginning with the selected tile, including allies. Add +0.15x sword damage against enemies adjacent to another ally.
tenka.note.hanasaka_warabi_bear: Bear strike: 100–120 ordinary physical damage, 130% armor damage, 15% penetration and owner melee attack minus 10; excludes equipment and damage perks. A hit grants +15 accuracy to the sword strike. Stop if the bear kills the target.
tenka.note.inaba_tsukuyo_dash: Advance up to 3 tiles along a legal path and strike. Shares the round's footwork allowance and respects entering spearwalls. First paid single-target sword attack each round gains +0.35x damage, consumed even on a miss.
tenka.note.inaba_tsukuyo_iaido: The first sword attack each round can deal 2.70x damage. Readiness costs 0 AP, so a 5 AP iaido and a 4 AP basic attack can retain defense. Counters never refresh first-strike or cooldown budgets.
tenka.note.inaba_tsukuyo_guard: Defense until the next normal turn: +12 melee defense (+8 for Mary); Rin also grants adjacent allies +6 melee defense. Counter missed paid single-target melee attacks, at most twice per round shared with vanilla Riposte. Final fatigue cost: 6 per counter (5 for Mary).
tenka.note.onigawara_rin_weapon: Any properly armed wielder may use it. Rin gains +5 percentage points penetration and may consume Aun Breath.
tenka.note.kikakujo_mary_weapon: Any properly armed wielder may use it. After Mary's hit, her next paid single-target sword attack against that target gains +8 accuracy this round, consumed on attempt.
tenka.note.tamaba_satori_weapon: Two strikes at 0.80x damage each. Satori gains +10 extra accuracy on the second strike. The whole technique builds only one chain stack.
tenka.note.hanasaka_warabi_weapon: After the cut, automatically retreat to an adjacent empty tile, preferring lower threat. Warabi ignores only the struck enemy's leaving attack; other enemies still react. While rooted, attack without retreat.
tenka.note.inaba_tsukuyo_weapon: Strike two consecutive adjacent tiles, including allies. A hit grants Tsukuyo one 0.80x short counter, sharing the 2-per-round limit with Readiness, which takes priority. First-strike applies only to the selected first tile.

valkyrie.c_c.background.name: The Witch of Contracts

valkyrie.c_c.trait.name: The Immortal Witch
valkyrie.c_c.trait.description: Supports one partner through a contract and disrupts enemies with intrusive memories. Her promise remains unfinished.
valkyrie.c_c.trait.tooltip: A contract support Valkyrie. Identity skills grant her abilities; skins only change appearance.
skin.c_c_skin.name: C.C. Original Attire
skin.c_c_skin.description: Green hair, amber eyes and a white restraint outfit: the witch of contracts from Code Geass.
skill.c_c_immortal_witch.name: The Immortal Witch
skill.c_c_immortal_witch.description: +30 maximum HP and immunity to charm. At the first normal turn each round, heal 8% maximum HP (rounded down, minimum 1). Survive the first lethal hit each battle with 40% maximum HP (rounded up), without repairing armor or cleansing injuries. Then halve direct attack damage until the next normal turn begins; that turn loses 4 AP. Waiting and extra turns do not refresh healing or consume this protection or AP penalty.
skill.c_c_accomplice.name: Proof of Complicity
skill.c_c_accomplice.description: Start with 2 Seals, maximum 6. Once per round, gain 1 when the partner damages enemy HP or armor with a paid direct attack, and 1 when C.C. loses HP to an enemy paid direct attack. No Seals from DOT, follow-ups, counters, opportunity attacks, friendly fire or self-damage. An active contract works at any distance. Waiting and extra turns do not reset the limits.
skill.c_c_geass_contract.name: Make a Contract with Me
skill.c_c_geass_contract.description: 3 AP, 12 Fatigue, cast at 1–4 tiles, 2-round cooldown. Bind one roster ally: +15 Melee/Ranged Skill, +20 Resolve, +20% HP and armor damage on paid direct attacks, and recover 10 extra Fatigue at the first normal turn each round. No maintenance range. Charm pauses the contract; death or leaving battle ends it. Switching cancels the old contract and oath without refunding resources or uses. Cannot recast on the same ally or stack contracts.
skill.c_c_shock_image.name: Intrusive Memories
skill.c_c_shock_image.description: 4 AP, 18 Fatigue, adjacent enemy, 2-round cooldown. No weapon hit roll: -20 Melee/Ranged Skill, -15 Resolve and -30 Initiative until the target finishes its next normal turn. First make one negative morale check at -10 difficulty using pre-debuff Resolve. Deals no direct damage. Undead, constructs and explicitly mind-immune targets are invalid. Does not stack; waiting and extra turns do not expire it.
skill.c_c_unfinished_contract.name: Our Contract Is Not Over
skill.c_c_unfinished_contract.descriptio: 6 AP, 30 Fatigue, 4 Seals, once per battle; target the current partner within 4 tiles. Immediately recover 20 Fatigue and gain +25% paid direct attack damage, adding to the contract for +45% total. Survive one lethal hit with 30% maximum HP; C.C. pays 20% maximum HP (rounded up, cannot fall below 1). This cost triggers no damage reactions or Seals. The rescued ally then takes half direct attack damage until their next normal turn. Expires at the start of round r+2 after casting in round r. No maintenance range. Charm pauses benefits but not time; switching or leaving battle ends the oath.
effect.c_c_contract.name: Geass Contract
effect.c_c_contract.description: +15 Melee/Ranged Skill, +20 Resolve, +20% paid direct attack HP and armor damage, and recover 10 Fatigue at the first normal turn each round. Unlimited maintenance range. Paused by charm; removed on death, leaving battle or switching partners.
effect.c_c_contract.oath: Accomplice Oath: +45% total paid direct attack damage. Rounds remaining:
effect.c_c_shock.name: Mental Disarray
effect.c_c_shock.description: -20 Melee/Ranged Skill, -15 Resolve and -30 Initiative until the next normal turn ends. Waiting and extra turns do not expire it.

valkyrie.morgan.name: Morgan
valkyrie.morgan.background.name: Queen of Faerie Britain
valkyrie.morgan.background.description: Morgan, queen of Faerie Britain, is a calculating and imperious mage beneath a silver mane and black crown. Her holy lances pierce enemy lines, the lake's grace shapes the pace of battle, and Roadless Camelot devastates clustered foes. Her spells roll against Ranged Skill and scale with current Resolve, without requiring a weapon.
valkyrie.morgan.trait.name: Queen of Britain
valkyrie.morgan.trait.description: A resolute queen who defends her realm through sorcery and command.
valkyrie.morgan.trait.tooltip: Resolve +25, Ranged Skill +15, maximum Fatigue +20 and Ranged Defense +10.
skin.morgan_skin.name: Morgan — Faerie Queen
skin.morgan_skin.description: Silver hair, a black crown and a white, black and blue gown. Includes a distinct battlefield bust and an animated royal-court dossier background.
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.name: From the World's End
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.description: Accumulate mana to sustain the queen's lances and Noble Phantasm, and survive one lethal hit per battle.
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.tooltip.man: Maximum 6 mana; start combat with 2 and gain 1 at each normal turn start. Holy Lance hits grant 1, up to twice per round; Lake's Grace grants 2. Waiting, extra turns, Camelot and curse damage grant no additional mana.
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.tooltip.gut: Once per battle, survive lethal damage at 30 HP, capped by maximum HP. Subsequent direct attack damage is halved until your next normal turn begins.
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.tooltip.spe: Battle continuation has been spent this battle.
skill.morgan_from_worlds_end.tooltip.pro: Battle continuation: direct attack damage received is reduced by 50%.
skill.morgan_holy_lance.name: Holy Lance — Endless Winter
skill.morgan_holy_lance.description: Conjure a holy lance against one enemy, inflicting Endless Winter and building mana.
skill.morgan_holy_lance.tooltip.damage: Base damage = 80 + 50% of current Resolve; 150% armor damage and 35% armor penetration. Independent of weapon damage; strikes the body.
skill.morgan_holy_lance.tooltip.target: Range 1–6, +25 Ranged hit chance. Ignores shield defense and distance penalties; requires line of sight and a successful hit roll.
skill.morgan_holy_lance.tooltip.winter: On hit: direct attack damage reduced by 15% for 2 complete normal turns of the target. Gain 1 mana on hit, at most twice per round.
skill.morgan_lake_grace.name: Lake's Grace — Charisma of Yearning
skill.morgan_lake_grace.description: The queen strengthens nearby allies and restores the action points and fatigue of one ally or herself.
skill.morgan_lake_grace.tooltip.charisma: All allies within 4 tiles of Morgan, including herself, deal 20% more direct attack damage for 2 complete normal turns each. Reapplication refreshes duration, without stacking.
skill.morgan_lake_grace.tooltip.grace: Select an ally or yourself within 0–4 tiles: restore 4 AP up to the cap and remove 30 Fatigue. Morgan gains 2 mana. Costs are paid first; finished turns are not reopened.
skill.morgan_lake_grace.tooltip.cooldown: Cooldown: 3 rounds. For example, used in round 1, available again in round 4.
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.name: Roadless Camelot
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.descriptio: Spend six mana to call the queen's lances down upon the enemy formation. Usable once per round and repeatedly within a battle after recharging.
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.tooltip.da: Center and adjacent tiles: base damage = 160 + 60% of current Resolve. Second ring deals 70% damage. 200% armor damage, 40% penetration; strikes the body.
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.tooltip.ta: Target an enemy 2–7 tiles away. Strike enemies within radius 2 (up to 19 tiles), rolling separately with +40 Ranged hit chance. No friendly fire; ignores shield and distance penalties, but terrain line of sight still applies.
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.tooltip.cu: Hits inflict Endless Winter and a curse dealing 15 fixed HP damage at each of the target's next 2 normal turn starts. The curse is not amplified by Lake's Grace.
skill.morgan_roadless_camelot.tooltip.un: Requires 6 mana and no previous Camelot cast this round.
effect.morgan_winter.name: Endless Winter
effect.morgan_winter.description: Direct attack damage reduced by 15% for 2 complete normal turns. Extra turns do not consume duration; reapplication refreshes it.
effect.morgan_charisma.name: Charisma of Yearning
effect.morgan_charisma.description: Direct attack damage increased by 20% for 2 complete normal turns. Extra turns do not consume duration; reapplication refreshes it.
effect.morgan_curse.name: Curse of Camelot
effect.morgan_curse.description: Lose 15 fixed HP at each of your next 2 normal turn starts, ignoring armor and without triggering further attack effects.
morgan.hub.active.name: Holy Lance / Lake's Grace / Camelot
morgan.hub.active.description: Charge mana and weaken foes with lances, restore AP and strengthen allies with the lake's grace, then break enemy formations with an area Noble Phantasm. Spells require no weapon.
morgan.hub.lance: Holy Lance: 4 AP, 18 Fatigue, range 1–6, +25 hit chance. Damage 80 + 50% Resolve, 150% armor damage, 35% penetration. Hits reduce direct damage by 15% for 2 complete normal turns and grant 1 mana, at most twice per round.
morgan.hub.grace: Lake's Grace: 2 AP, 15 Fatigue, 3-round cooldown. Allies within 4 tiles gain +20% direct damage for 2 complete normal turns each. One ally or yourself gains 4 AP and loses 30 Fatigue; Morgan gains 2 mana. Does not reopen completed turns.
morgan.hub.camelot: Camelot: 6 AP, 40 Fatigue, 6 mana, once per round. Range 2–7, radius 2 around an enemy, separate rolls at +40 hit chance. Center and inner ring: 160 + 60% Resolve damage; outer ring 70%; 200% armor damage, 40% penetration, no friendly fire. Hits inflict Endless Winter and 15 fixed HP curse damage over each of 2 normal turns.

test_origin.name: Battle Valkyries Test Company
test_origin.description:
A development origin based on A New Company. You begin with three mercenaries, 3,000,000 crowns, five nearby legendary locations, and a revealed champion camp guarded by five brigand champions, useful for testing summons, equipment, and Valkyrie combat behavior quickly.

[color=#bcad8c]Test Origin:[/color] Start with three men and 3,000,000 crowns.
[color=#bcad8c]Nearby Locations:[/color] Spawn legendary sites such as the Black Monolith, Goblin City, and Unhold Graveyard, plus a camp with five brigand champions near your company.
[color=#bcad8c]Based On:[/color] A New Company.
test_origin.founder_0: {You saved %name%'s life in a battle against brigands, and he returned the favor in an alley ambush by thieves. Given that common criminals are a few levels beneath brigands, you often joke with him that he is still a little behind on the 'saving each other's asses' debt.}
test_origin.founder_1: {Whatever is wrong with %name% you hope he never fixes it. A character with a particular taste for battling, whoring, gambling, singing, dogfighting, skirt chasing, weirdly dish washing, vomiting and, of course, drinking, he has always been a gift to have around. He also just happens to be an excellent fighter in his own right.}
test_origin.founder_2: You crossed paths with %name% a number of times prior to his joining the company. First time you were both simple laborers. The second time you were sellswords. And now is the third go of it with him joining your company. If all goes well, he'll finally stick around this time and you'll both find the riches you seek.
test_origin.extra_bro: {%name% joined this test company so the captain could quickly verify new Battle Valkyries summons, appearances, and combat behavior.}

valkyrie.saber.name: Saber
valkyrie.saber.background.name: Valkyrie Saber
valkyrie.saber.background.description: Saber's true name is Artoria Pendragon, the legendary King of Knights who takes the field as a sword-bearing Heroic Spirit with Excalibur in hand. Calm, disciplined, and bound to her vows, she places the duty to protect her people above her own heart.
valkyrie.saber.trait.name: Saber Trait
valkyrie.saber.trait.description: The King of Knights brings a dragon's vitality, peerless swordsmanship, and unwavering royal authority to the front line.
valkyrie.saber.trait.tooltip: Hitpoints +20, Melee Skill +15, Melee Defense +10, Resolve +25.
skill.saber_invisible_air.name: Invisible Air
skill.saber_invisible_air.description: Compressed wind conceals Excalibur's reach while Saber gathers Mana through direct offense and defense.
skill.saber_invisible_air.tooltip.attack: Ordinary active melee weapon attacks gain +10 chance to hit. Their entire area ignores shield defense; Riposte and Attacks of Opportunity ignore shields without the +10 bonus.
skill.saber_invisible_air.tooltip.shield: Strike Air and Excalibur use their own hit bonuses and still ignore shield defense.
skill.saber_invisible_air.tooltip.mana: Starts battle with 1 Mana. Once per round, the first ordinary active melee weapon action to hit grants 1 Mana, and the first enemy direct attack to deal at least 1 HP or armor damage grants 1 Mana. Maximum 4.
skill.saber_strike_air.name: Strike Air
skill.saber_strike_air.description: Release Invisible Air as a crushing wind hammer through every enemy in a straight line.
skill.saber_strike_air.tooltip.hit: Requires a melee weapon; see the Mana cost below. Select an enemy on a visible straight line at range 1-4; each enemy is attacked separately with +25 chance to hit, no distance penalty, and ignored shield defense.
skill.saber_strike_air.tooltip.damage: Deals 100% weapon damage and 200% armor damage to each enemy, resolving farthest to nearest.
skill.saber_strike_air.tooltip.control: Each surviving hit target is pushed directly away from Saber by up to 2 tiles and Dazed for 1 turn. Failed or immune pushes still attempt Daze.
skill.saber_strike_air.tooltip.not_ready: Requires enough Mana and a melee weapon; see the Mana cost above.
skill.saber_excalibur.name: Sword of Promised Victory
skill.saber_excalibur.description: Spend full Mana to release Excalibur's true name as a once-per-battle wide beam of golden light.
skill.saber_excalibur.tooltip.hit: Requires 4 Mana and a melee weapon. Select an enemy on a visible straight line at range 1-8; each target gains +50 chance to hit, no distance penalty, and ignored shield defense.
skill.saber_excalibur.tooltip.damage: Deals 200% weapon damage, 200% armor damage, and adds 30 percentage points of armor penetration.
skill.saber_excalibur.tooltip.fixed: Each weapon-hit survivor takes fixed HP damage equal to 50 plus 25% of Saber's Resolve snapshot, rounded down. Weapon kills receive no fixed followup.
skill.saber_excalibur.tooltip.beam: Hits enemies on the center line and within 1 tile of it, only in front of Saber and no farther than the main target; snapshots targets and resolves nearest to farthest without harming allies.

valkyrie.jeanne.bond.trait.description: Records Jeanne's trust as she stops carrying the saint's duty alone and chooses to raise her banner together with you. Each battle victory grants 4 Bond. At 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 Bond, a two-page story reveals a permanently highlighted personal challenge.
valkyrie.jeanne.bond.trait.tooltip.max: Bond is complete. Beneath this banner, no one must walk alone again.

event.jeanne_bond.20.title: A Prayer After the Fire
event.jeanne_bond.20.text:
When night smothers the noise after battle, Jeanne remains beside the fire, tightening a bandage around a wounded mercenary's arm. The man curses God for the comrades he lost. She offers neither rebuke nor the authority of a saint, only moves the waterskin a little closer.

After he falls asleep, she studies the prayer token blackened by smoke in her palm and leaves her fingers open.

%SPEECH_ON%People believe a saint can answer suffering. Yet so many prayers I heard were never answered. Captain, if someone can no longer believe in God, what can I give them so they may stand again?%SPEECH_OFF%

You tell her that perhaps an answer is not always needed. Someone willing to remain and hear the fear to its end can be an answer in itself. Firelight settles in her blue eyes, and for once she does not immediately bow her head to pray.
event.jeanne_bond.20.reveal:
Before dawn, soot on the token's back reveals an old road leading to a burned chapel occupied by brigands. They have piled stolen keepsakes among the ashes and imprisoned several refugees still waiting for help.

At the ruin Jeanne drives her ash-stained banner into the earth. You brace the lower shaft with one hand, and she does not pull away.

%SPEECH_ON%Then this time I will not answer in God's place. I will only make certain they know that, at their most frightened, someone will still come to stand beside them.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.jeanne_bond.20.option: Steady the sacred banner in her hands.
event.jeanne_bond.reward.challenge_20: Defeat the Ashen Chapel to claim Jeanne's exclusive weapon, Standard of Presence — Eternal Radiance, and unlock one morale rescue per battle for each low-morale ally in her aura.
event.jeanne_bond.40.title: A Night Without Revelation
event.jeanne_bond.40.text:
Rain bows the command tent low. Scouts bring two conflicting reports: villagers under siege in one direction, goblins perhaps waiting in ambush in the other. Jeanne studies the map again and again, but the revelation that normally sounds in her heart remains silent.

%SPEECH_ON%What if I heard wrongly? What if revelation was only my wish to always be right?%SPEECH_OFF%

Her grip on the banner is tighter than it ever is in battle. You do not choose for her. You move the candle toward the village and ask what she herself wishes to do when no voice gives an order.
event.jeanne_bond.40.reveal:
She closes her eyes, then opens them almost at once. There is no holy light and no bell, only rain against canvas.

%SPEECH_ON%I want to save them. Not because I was commanded, but because I cannot leave people calling for help in the rain.%SPEECH_OFF%

Following the route she draws herself, you find a goblin nest. Its shaman has used stolen bells to counterfeit an oracle and lure villagers into an ambush. Jeanne levels the banner toward the trees. This time, her decision comes before revelation.
event.jeanne_bond.40.option: Trust the choice she made herself.
event.jeanne_bond.reward.challenge_40: Defeat the Grove of the Silent Oracle to increase Jeanne's starting Revelation from 2/4 to 3/4.
event.jeanne_bond.60.title: A Banner for Two
event.jeanne_bond.60.text:
After a long march, a narrow tear opens along the sacred banner. Jeanne sits alone beneath the lamp, forcing a needle through the heavy cloth until blood marks her fingertips. You reach for the other edge, but she reflexively draws the banner back against herself.

%SPEECH_ON%It has carried too many people's wishes. I should repair it alone.%SPEECH_OFF%

You do not argue. You leave the needle and thread where she can see them. Much later, she unfolds the cloth again and gently passes half of it to you. Your two shadows rest close together across the banner.
event.jeanne_bond.60.reveal:
Silver thread caught in the tear points toward a barbarian altar where broken standards hang above prisoners forced to haul stone until the drums exhaust them.

Jeanne and you take the shaft at the same time. Its weight does not lessen, yet for the first time her shoulders are no longer rigid.

%SPEECH_ON%It was not the duty that needed sharing, but the weariness I refused to admit. Captain, from this day onward, please raise it with me.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.jeanne_bond.60.option: Take the weight on the banner's other side.
event.jeanne_bond.reward.challenge_60: Defeat the Altar of Broken Banners to increase aura Fatigue recovery from 5 to 8.
event.jeanne_bond.80.title: The Name Beyond the Saint
event.jeanne_bond.80.text:
A village you saved kneels before the saint and asks for blessings. Jeanne patiently lifts each child to their feet. Only after the last lamp goes dark does she walk alone to the river and loosen her silver ornament, letting the water reflect a girl without a crown.

%SPEECH_ON%I can discern an enemy's true name, yet I do not know whom others see when they look at me. If the banner breaks and revelation falls silent one day, will you still call me Jeanne?%SPEECH_OFF%

You say her name once, without saint, Ruler, or any title. She remains still for a long moment, then places the blue ribbon she carries into your palm.
event.jeanne_bond.80.reveal:
The ribbon bears the smell of orcish iron. Raiders have dragged prisoners into a fighting pit and force them to judge one another by name, creed, and blood.

You tie the ribbon beneath the sacred banner. Jeanne fastens her ornament again, but no longer lets it hide her smile.

%SPEECH_ON%An enemy may fear the saint or challenge the arbiter. But you know Jeanne. So long as that name can still reach you, I will not lose myself.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.jeanne_bond.80.option: Call her name clearly once more.
event.jeanne_bond.reward.challenge_80: Defeat the Iron Court to make the first Divine Judgment hit each normal turn refund 1 Revelation.
event.jeanne_bond.100.title: This Banner Stands With You
event.jeanne_bond.100.text:
Before sunrise, Jeanne stands in the quiet command tent wearing a wedding gown remade from the language of her sacred banner: ivory skirts patterned like silver armor, a deep-blue veil falling from her shoulders, and pale golden lilies woven along her waist and long hair. She has not hidden the warrior she is; a silver bracer remains at her wrist. Only now a clearly shining ring rests on the fourth finger of her left hand.

She holds that hand to her heart, as though confirming the vow and making certain you can see her choice.

%SPEECH_ON%Once I would have burned away my life for everyone without ever asking what Jeanne wished to keep. Now I have one selfish wish: when the fighting ends, I still want to return to you.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.jeanne_bond.100.reveal:
You straighten her veil. She takes your hand, then lays her ringed left hand over it upon the sacred banner. The ring flashes clearly in the morning light, illuminating both her ivory, silver, and deep-blue wedding gown and every old wound in the cloth.

%SPEECH_ON%This is not revelation, nor a saint's promise to the world. It is the choice I make in the name of Jeanne. I love you. I wish to stand beside you, and to let you hold this banner when I grow weary.%SPEECH_OFF%

Far across the wastes, a sanctuary guarded by ancient dead appears. Within it echoes the old command that the saint must sacrifice herself alone once more. Jeanne does not release your hand. Together, you will silence the final echo.
event.jeanne_bond.100.option: Hold tight to her ringed hand.
event.jeanne_bond.reward.challenge_100: Defeat the Sanctuary of the Eternal Vow. Luminosite will retain 1 Revelation and each Holy Maiden's Blessing heal will increase to 15.

skill.jeanne_alter_dragon_witch.descript: Jeanne Alter's successful melee weapon attacks inflict Black Flame and relentlessly hunt cursed enemies.
Against Black Flame targets, melee weapon attacks gain +15 chance to hit, +20% weapon damage, and +10 percentage points of armor penetration.
A successful melee weapon hit applies or refreshes Black Flame.
skill.jeanne_alter_la_grondement_du_hain: Once per battle, Jeanne Alter strikes a visible enemy 2 to 6 tiles away and every enemy adjacent to it with her melee weapon.
Costs 5 AP and 30 Fatigue. Each target takes a separate attack with +30 hit chance, 150% weapon damage, and 200% armor damage.

Targets that were already cursed when the area was selected instead receive +45 hit chance, 180% weapon damage, +10 penetration points, and 40 fixed hitpoint damage on hit. Every living hit target loses registered temporary buffs, gains or refreshes Black Flame, then receives Strengthening Lockout.
Already used this battle, or Jeanne Alter has no melee weapon equipped.
effect.jeanne_alter_black_flame_curse.de: Jeanne Alter's black flame has marked this target for execution.
effect.jeanne_alter_black_flame_curse.to: For two complete turns: before acting, takes 10 fixed hitpoint damage that ignores armor; maximum AP -2, Melee and Ranged Defense -10, Resolve -15.
effect.jeanne_alter_buff_block.name: Strengthening Lockout
effect.jeanne_alter_buff_block.descripti: Jeanne Alter has cut off this target from registered temporary strengthening effects.
effect.jeanne_alter_buff_block.tooltip.d: Registered temporary positive effects cannot be applied for 2 turns.
valkyrie.jingliu.name: Jingliu
valkyrie.jingliu.background.name: Valkyrie Jingliu
valkyrie.jingliu.background.description: Jingliu was once the sword champion of the Xianzhou Luofu, one of the High-Cloud Quintet, and Jing Yuan's master. After falling to mara, she veils her eyes to restrain herself and brings a moon-cold sword intent burdened by centuries of guilt.
valkyrie.jingliu.trait.name: Jingliu Trait
valkyrie.jingliu.trait.description: Jingliu's stainless sword heart increases Resolve by 10, Melee Skill by 5, Melee Defense by 5, and Initiative by 10.
skill.jingliu_cold_moon_sword_heart.name: Cold Moon Sword Heart
skill.jingliu_cold_moon_sword_heart.desc: Jingliu's sword intent gathers moonlight with every clean strike. Each successful attack grants one stack of Moonlight, up to 3 stacks.
skill.jingliu_cold_moon_sword_heart.tool: Each hit on an enemy grants 1 stack of Moonlight, up to 3 stacks. Each stack grants +5% damage and +5% melee armor penetration.
At 3 stacks, Jingliu gains +10 chance to hit and restores 4 AP whenever she kills an enemy.
effect.jingliu_moonlight.name: Moonlight
effect.jingliu_moonlight.description: Moonlight gathers around Jingliu's blade, sharpening each following strike.
effect.jingliu_moonlight.tooltip.full: At full Moonlight, attacks gain +10 chance to hit.
effect.jingliu_moonlight.tooltip.kill_ap: At full Moonlight, killing an enemy restores 4 AP.
skill.jingliu_moonflower_birth_and_death: Jingliu releases a moon-cold finishing slash. This attack can be used once per battle, costs no AP or Fatigue, deals 200% weapon damage, and restores AP to maximum if it kills the target.
Can be used once per battle and costs no AP or Fatigue.
If this attack kills the target, Jingliu's AP is restored to maximum.
valkyrie.skirk.name: Skirk
valkyrie.skirk.background.name: Valkyrie Skirk
valkyrie.skirk.background.description: Skirk is a mysterious swordswoman from the edge of the Abyss who trained Tartaglia after he fell into its depths. Laconic and severe, she respects only strength capable of crossing the borders between life, death, and worlds.
valkyrie.skirk.trait.name: Skirk Trait
valkyrie.skirk.trait.description: Skirk's abyssal discipline increases Melee Skill by 15, Melee Defense by 10, Initiative by 20, and Resolve by 15. She is effectively immune to mental fear attacks.
valkyrie.skirk.trait.tooltip.mental: Effectively immune to mental fear attacks.
skill.skirk_serpents_subtlety.name: Serpent's Subtlety
skill.skirk_serpents_subtlety.descriptio: Begin each battle with 2 Serpent's Subtlety, up to 6. Active melee weapon attacks that hit grant 1 point, at most twice per round.
skill.skirk_serpents_subtlety.tooltip.st: Starts each battle with 2 Serpent's Subtlety and stores up to 6.
skill.skirk_serpents_subtlety.tooltip.ga: A hit from an active melee weapon attack gains 1 point, up to 2 points each round. Counterattacks and follow-ups cannot gain it.
skill.skirk_serpents_subtlety.tooltip.sh: All melee weapon attacks, counterattacks and attacks of opportunity ignore shield defense.
effect.skirk_serpents_subtlety.name: Serpent's Subtlety
effect.skirk_serpents_subtlety.descripti: Abyssal combat resource used by Skirk's Havoc techniques.
effect.skirk_serpents_subtlety.tooltip.g: Does not decay. Normal active melee hits can gain at most 2 points per round.
skill.skirk_havoc_warp.name: Havoc: Warp
skill.skirk_havoc_warp.description: Enter Seven-Phase Flash while holding at least 1 Serpent's Subtlety and a melee weapon.
skill.skirk_havoc_warp.tooltip.phase: Costs 2 AP and 10 Fatigue. The stance does not spend a resource itself; each empowered weapon attack spends 1.
skill.skirk_havoc_warp.tooltip.unusable: Requires a melee weapon, at least 1 Serpent's Subtlety, and no existing Seven-Phase Flash.

effect.skirk_seven_phase_flash.tooltip.c: Each eligible active melee weapon attack costs 2 less AP and 10 less Fatigue, to a minimum of 0, and spends 1 Serpent's Subtlety.
effect.skirk_seven_phase_flash.tooltip.a: Empowered attacks gain +15 chance to hit, +40% weapon damage, at least 2 tiles of range, no distance penalty, and ignore shields.
effect.skirk_seven_phase_flash.tooltip.e: The final empowered attack is resolving; Seven-Phase Flash ends afterwards.

skill.skirk_havoc_ruin.tooltip.damage: Targets 1-4 tiles away and their adjacent enemies. Deals 100% weapon damage plus 30% per stored point, with 150% armor damage and +30 chance to hit.
skill.skirk_havoc_ruin.tooltip.resource: Each spent point grants +5% armor penetration and 5 fixed hitpoint damage after a surviving target is hit. At 6 points: 280% weapon damage, +30% penetration and 30 fixed damage.
skill.skirk_havoc_ruin.tooltip.unusable: Requires a melee weapon and at least 3 Serpent's Subtlety.
valkyrie.jinhsi.name: Jinhsi
valkyrie.jinhsi.background.name: Valkyrie Jinhsi
valkyrie.jinhsi.background.description: Jinhsi is the Magistrate of Jinzhou and a Resonator bound to the Sentinel Jue. Gentle and composed in manner, she carries the fate of a city and the weight of time itself on shoulders far younger than her office suggests.
valkyrie.jinhsi.trait.name: Jinhsi Trait
valkyrie.jinhsi.trait.description: Jinhsi's resonance with Sentinel Jue grants Melee Skill +15, Resolve +20, maximum Fatigue +15, and Ranged Defense +10.
valkyrie.yae_miko.name: Yae Miko
valkyrie.yae_miko.background.name: Valkyrie Yae Miko
valkyrie.yae_miko.background.description: Yae Miko is the Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine, familiar of the Electro Archon, and editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Clever, playful, and fond of schemes, she hides a kitsune's thousand-year insight behind teasing smiles.
valkyrie.yae_miko.trait.name: Yae Miko Trait
valkyrie.yae_miko.trait.description: Yae Miko's kitsune wit grants Ranged Skill +5, Initiative +20, Resolve +10, and Ranged Defense +5.
valkyrie.chisaki.name: Chisaki
valkyrie.chisaki.background.name: Valkyrie Chisaki
valkyrie.chisaki.background.description: Chisaki, born Kuchiba Chisaki, is a composed Ashihara student of the Stellareum Academy who was once rescued by the Rover from Honami City. Her ties to the Black Shores and the late flower-bearer Sumika leave quiet memories of loss and responsibility beneath her calm.
valkyrie.chisaki.trait.name: Chisaki Trait
valkyrie.chisaki.trait.description: Chisaki's black-shore edge grants Melee Skill +15, Initiative +20, Fatigue +10, and Resolve +10.
valkyrie.kafka.name: Kafka
valkyrie.kafka.background.name: Valkyrie Kafka
valkyrie.kafka.background.description: Kafka is a core member of the Stellaron Hunters, skilled in Spirit Whisper and mental control, and one of the first hands to set the Trailblazer's fate in motion. Elegant, fearless, and unhurried, she often delivers the most dangerous scripts in the gentlest voice.
valkyrie.kafka.trait.name: Kafka Trait
valkyrie.kafka.trait.description: Kafka's Spirit Whisper grants Resolve +20, Ranged Skill +10, Initiative +10, and +20 resistance to mental morale checks.
valkyrie.ye_shunguang.name: Ye Shunguang
valkyrie.ye_shunguang.background.name: Valkyrie Ye Shunguang
valkyrie.ye_shunguang.background.descrip: Ye Shunguang is a disciple of Yunkui Summit and Ye Shiyuan's younger sister, bearer of the Qingming Sword that can sever filth at the cost of memory. After the battle with the Creator, she was named Void Hunter, carrying a gentle face and a will strong enough to forget herself for family.
valkyrie.ye_shunguang.trait.name: Ye Shunguang Trait
valkyrie.ye_shunguang.trait.description: Ye Shunguang's Qingming sword discipline grants Melee Skill +15, Melee Defense +15, Resolve +20, and Initiative +15.
valkyrie.himeko.name: Himeko
valkyrie.himeko.background.name: Valkyrie Himeko
valkyrie.himeko.background.description: Himeko is the navigator and owner of the Astral Express, the scientist who repaired the abandoned train and began a journey among the stars. Mature, dependable, and endlessly curious, she guides her companions with a scholar's calm and a traveler's romance.
valkyrie.himeko.trait.name: Himeko Trait
valkyrie.himeko.trait.description: Himeko's command of astral arms grants Melee Skill +10, Ranged Skill +10, Resolve +15, Initiative +10, and Ranged Defense +5.
valkyrie.feixue.name: Feixue
valkyrie.feixue.background.name: Valkyrie Feixue
valkyrie.feixue.background.description: Feixue, also known as Hiyuki, is a Glacio sword Resonator from Ashihara whose white kagura-like robes and red cords hide a razor-cold edge. Bound by a long connection to the Threnodian, she is courteous and quiet until her blade falls like snow stained crimson.

valkyrie.feixue.trait.description: Feixue's snow-swift blade grants Initiative +25, Melee Skill +15, Melee Defense +10, and maximum Fatigue +15.
valkyrie.feixiao.name: Feixiao
valkyrie.feixiao.background.name: Valkyrie Feixiao
valkyrie.feixiao.background.description: Feixiao is the Merlin's Claw of the Xianzhou Yaoqing, a general of the Arbiter-Generals with both foxian and borisin blood. Bold, decisive, and hungry for battle, she offers her sharpest edge to the Hunt even while haunted by Moon Rage.

valkyrie.changli.background.name: Valkyrie Changli
valkyrie.changli.background.description: Changli is counselor and mentor to Jinzhou's Magistrate, wearing a relaxed smile over a mind built for strategy. She knows the cost of fire and of reading people's hearts, and is willing to make even herself a piece on the board for Jinzhou and Jinhsi.
valkyrie.changli.trait.name: Changli Trait
valkyrie.changli.trait.description: Changli's clear-sighted command grants Melee Skill +15, Melee Defense +10, Resolve +15, and Initiative +15.
valkyrie.raiden_shogun.name: Raiden Shogun
valkyrie.raiden_shogun.background.name: Valkyrie Raiden Shogun
valkyrie.raiden_shogun.background.descri: The Raiden Shogun is Inazuma's Electro Archon, born from both Raiden Ei and the puppet ruler she created. She once sealed her nation in the name of eternity, but through loss and reflection learned again what it means to protect her people.
valkyrie.raiden_shogun.trait.name: Raiden Shogun Trait
valkyrie.raiden_shogun.trait.description: The Raiden Shogun's eternal thunder grants Melee Skill +10, Resolve +20, Melee Defense +10, and Initiative +5.
valkyrie.yixuan.name: Yixuan
valkyrie.yixuan.background.name: Valkyrie Yixuan
valkyrie.yixuan.background.description: Yixuan is the thirteenth High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit, a hidden master of the Outer Ring and teacher to disciples such as Ju Fufu. Wise and steady, she once shielded civilians from Hollow disaster and still enters danger herself despite ether corruption gnawing at her body.
valkyrie.yixuan.trait.name: Yixuan Trait
valkyrie.yixuan.trait.description: Yixuan's mastery of Yunkui Mountain grants Hitpoints +25, Melee Skill +10, Melee Defense +10, and Resolve +15.
valkyrie.xilian.name: Xilian
valkyrie.xilian.background.name: Valkyrie Xilian
valkyrie.xilian.background.description: Xilian is a central figure of the Amphoreus tale, once accompanying the Trailblazer as the memosprite Mem and preserving the world's memories through countless cycles. Gentle yet unbreakable, she turns love and remembrance into the force that can break a closed loop.

valkyrie.xilian.trait.description: Xilian's watch over memory grants Resolve +20, Hitpoints +10, Ranged Defense +10, and Initiative +10.
valkyrie.xilian.bond.trait.name: Xilian Bond
valkyrie.xilian.bond.trait.description: Tracks the bond Xilian builds while fighting beside you. Each victory grants 4 Bond. Special events trigger at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100 bond; if Xilian dies and is summoned again, the bond starts over.
valkyrie.liuying.name: Liuying
valkyrie.liuying.background.name: Valkyrie Liuying
valkyrie.liuying.background.description: Liuying, known as Firefly, is a Stellaron Hunter and the surviving Glamoth Iron Cavalry pilot behind the SAM armor. Soft-spoken on the outside, she carries entropy loss syndrome and a life forged as a weapon, yet still searches fiercely for what it means to live.
valkyrie.liuying.trait.name: Liuying Trait
valkyrie.liuying.trait.description: Liuying's Glamoth armor discipline grants Hitpoints +15, Fatigue +20, Melee Skill +10, and Melee Defense +10.
valkyrie.cartethyia.name: Cartethyia
valkyrie.cartethyia.background.name: Valkyrie Cartethyia
valkyrie.cartethyia.background.descripti: Cartethyia is Rinascita's Blessed Maiden, a Resonator tied to the Sentinel Imperator, with another self connected to Fleurdelys. Gentle and sacred without being fragile, she answers heavier fate with the bearing of a gathering storm.
valkyrie.cartethyia.trait.name: Cartethyia Trait
valkyrie.cartethyia.trait.description: Cartethyia's blessed storm grants Hitpoints +20, Melee Skill +10, Ranged Skill +10, Initiative +20, and Resolve +10.
valkyrie.tilixibiesi.name: Tilixibiesi
valkyrie.tilixibiesi.background.name: Valkyrie Tilixibiesi
valkyrie.tilixibiesi.background.descript: Tilixibiesi carries a blue coordinate book said to map the shore between life and the far bank. On the battlefield she reads those sacred coordinates aloud, folding distance itself to place ally or enemy exactly where fate opens.
valkyrie.tilixibiesi.trait.name: Underworld Coordinates
valkyrie.tilixibiesi.trait.tooltip: Initiative +40. No Melee Skill or Ranged Skill penalty.
valkyrie.yuno.name: Yuno
valkyrie.yuno.background.name: Valkyrie Yuno
valkyrie.yuno.background.description: Yuno is the priestess of the Tetragon Temple in Septimont, charged with delivering prophecies to the people. Elegant and mysterious, she seems able to see endings others have not yet reached through the mist of fate.
valkyrie.yuno.trait.name: Moon Oracle Priestess
valkyrie.yuno.trait.description: Yuno plans each action through prophecy, gaining +3 maximum Action Points, +15 Resolve, +15 Initiative, and +10 Ranged Defense.

event.xilian_bond.20.title: Shard of Light
event.xilian_bond.20.text:
The camp does not immediately fall quiet when the battle ends. The smith hammers dents from armor, wounded men groan behind canvas, and the quartermaster sorts Crowns, weapons, and ownerless keepsakes into pile after pile.

Xilian slips around the commotion and kneels beside a broken shield. From the mud she retrieves a cracked bronze coin. It is worthless, yet its edge has been polished bright by years in someone's palm. When her fingertip touches the fracture, a thread of light wakes across its face; a laugh, the sound of rain, and the ghost of an inaudible farewell briefly pass through her eyes.

Rather than return the coin to the spoils, she asks you with complete seriousness: %SPEECH_ON%If an object still remembers its owner, but its owner is gone... should it be counted as a relic, or as a witness?%SPEECH_OFF%You hand her the old ledger and suggest that, for tonight, she begin with the names of everyone who came back alive.
event.xilian_bond.20.reveal: %SPEECH_ON%Tomorrow will not remember today for us. If I ever forget, remind me.%SPEECH_OFF%Xilian places the coin in your palm. Its light is faint, yet it feels like a marker that can never be extinguished.
event.xilian_bond.40.title: Old Shadows by the Fire
event.xilian_bond.40.text:
Night settles low, yet the campfire is louder than it was by day. Men argue over who fled first, wager the last piece of cheese, and sing badly with absolute conviction. Xilian does not join them. She remains just beyond the firelight, turning over a little wooden name token—the gift of a guard rescued earlier that day.

She tells you that she has seen similar faces in countless tomorrows that never reached their destination. Some died before a city gate, some vanished in the snow, and some waited for help that never came. After enough memories overlap, names become little more than different ways to die. Yet the token's owner had just complained that the company's bread could serve as a shield, and that trivial detail feels more vivid than every ending she remembers.

Listening to the distant laughter, Xilian murmurs: %SPEECH_ON%I used to think that remembering a person's ending meant remembering them. Perhaps it is precisely these meaningless moments that truly let someone remain.%SPEECH_OFF%She closes her hand around the token and, for the first time, does not immediately turn away from the fire.
event.xilian_bond.40.reveal: %SPEECH_ON%I remember many people, and now I am beginning to remember this place too. You will not become only an ending.%SPEECH_OFF%Sparks rise between the memory petals in her hand. For the first time, she is not a distant witness, but a companion sitting beside you.
event.xilian_bond.60.title: White Flower in Rain
event.xilian_bond.60.text:
Rain has fallen all day. The road has become mud, and damp has warped the crates holding the herbs. The infirmary tent is crowded with coughs, fevered muttering, and the smell of wet wool. The company's youngest mercenary cannot shake his fever and keeps apologizing to a distant mother in his sleep.

Xilian remains from dusk until midnight. She changes soaked bandages, helps the wounded man swallow bitter medicine, and moves the only windproof lamp beside his bed. Whenever a gust lifts the tent flap, tiny white flowers of memory drift from her fingers and turn the freezing rain aside. She works so quietly that it seems she is afraid to wake anyone.

When you urge her to rest, she carefully tucks the blanket back beneath the mercenary's shoulder. %SPEECH_ON%I cannot make him forget the pain, and I cannot promise tomorrow will be better. But tonight, I can at least keep this night from growing colder.%SPEECH_OFF%Thunder rolls beyond the canvas. She raises the lamp and chooses to remain until dawn.
event.xilian_bond.60.reveal: %SPEECH_ON%Memory is not only a chain. It can also be a shelter. On some nights, if one person remains awake, everyone else can sleep more peacefully.%SPEECH_OFF%She looks back at you, gentle but resolute.%SPEECH_ON%This time, I want to keep watch until dawn.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.xilian_bond.80.title: A Night That Will Not Repeat
event.xilian_bond.80.text:
A storm drives the company into an abandoned stone tower. Its roof has long since collapsed, and the broken circular mosaic resembles a loop that can never quite close. When you spread out the map, every route Xilian has marked—no matter how it turns—ends at the same ruin, as though some unseen conclusion were patiently waiting for you to repeat it.

Xilian sits in the center of the broken ring and braces an old banner against a gap in the wall. She has witnessed too many similar dawns and evenings: fires burned cold, ledgers left unopened, banners fallen in the rain. The images resemble one another so closely that she can no longer always tell whether the choice before her leads toward tomorrow or merely becomes another note beneath the previous loop.

The wind snaps the edge of the banner. Looking back at you, she asks: %SPEECH_ON%If tomorrow brings us back here again, will you still believe today's choice mattered?%SPEECH_OFF%You sit beside her and tell her that the answer is not waiting at the end of the map, but in who chooses to walk the road with her this time.
event.xilian_bond.80.reveal: %SPEECH_ON%This time, I want to choose tomorrow with my own hands. If I ever begin to forget, call my name first.%SPEECH_OFF%The reflections recede and morning light enters through the break in the stone circle. You speak her name and promise she will not cross beyond the loop alone.
event.xilian_bond.100.title: The First Page of Tomorrow
event.xilian_bond.100.text:
Before dawn, Xilian asks you to come alone to the command tent. The old ledger from that first night lies open on the table. Its pages are filled with names, dates, and wounds, but also arguments by the fire, songs sung out of tune, and half a loaf someone tried to hide. Together, those insignificant details prove that the company truly lived through a stretch of time that will never repeat.

Instead of her familiar battle attire, she wears a bridal gown of white lace, pale-violet crystal, and ice-blue flowers. Morning light falls through her veil and pink hair, illuminating the hand that rests upon the final blank page—and the violet crystal ring upon her finger. She places a flower of memory in the corner and raises the quill, yet hesitates before making the first mark.

Xilian has always written only after things ended, as though loss alone could prove a moment had existed. Today, she looks upon a page that has not yet been written and whispers: %SPEECH_ON%I want to write down today before it begins. Not because I am afraid of forgetting, but because I finally believe we truly have another page.%SPEECH_OFF%She writes the first stroke, then raises her eyes to you.
event.xilian_bond.100.reveal: Morning light falls across white lace. Xilian sets down the quill and extends her ringed hand toward you, her expression more solemn than any battlefield oath. %SPEECH_ON%If the world begins to repeat again, let us rewrite it from the moment we stood together. Will you write tomorrow with me?%SPEECH_OFF%She smiles and waits for your answer, placing every yesterday and tomorrow in your hands.

item.xilian_bond_crystal.tooltip.use: Right-click or drag onto a character with a Valkyrie Bond trait or onto Olga. Not consumed for an unsupported target or when the relevant value is already full.

skill.jinhsi_era_of_unity.description: Jinhsi gathers Incandescence from her company's coordinated attacks, preparing Sentinel Jue's judgment.
skill.jinhsi_era_of_unity.tooltip.ally: Each other roster ally's first active attack in each combat round that damages hitpoints or armor grants 1 Incandescence.
skill.jinhsi_era_of_unity.tooltip.cap: At most 3 Incandescence can be gained from allies per combat round; contributor records reset at the next round, and the maximum is 6.
skill.jinhsi_era_of_unity.tooltip.ready: At 6 Incandescence, Illuminous Epiphany becomes available.

effect.jinhsi_incandescence.description: Shining power gathered through coordinated assaults.
effect.jinhsi_incandescence.tooltip.read: At 6 stacks, Illuminous Epiphany is ready.
skill.jinhsi_incarnation.name: Incarnation
skill.jinhsi_incarnation.description: Jinhsi rises with Jue's power to strike a distant enemy and draw forth Incandescence.
skill.jinhsi_incarnation.tooltip.hit: Uses Melee Skill with +20 chance to hit, no distance penalty, and ignores shield defense.
skill.jinhsi_incarnation.tooltip.damage: Deals 100% weapon damage and 125% armor damage.

event.liuying_bond.20.title: The Unsent Letter
event.liuying_bond.20.text:
The campfire burns low after battle. Some sharpen blades, others murmur of home in their sleep, while Liuying drags a crate beside the flames and begins a letter. She has changed the paper three times, yet the space for its recipient remains empty.

Glamoth cavalry never needed letters, she says. Numbers were recorded, orders delivered, and sacrifices filed away. Only those uncertain of tomorrow wrote down the small pieces of today for someone not yet there. She writes that supper was too salty, that the tent leaks, and that someone saved the last clean bandage for her.

A dented armor shard holds the page down as a teal spark rises from its crack. Watching it circle the quill, she asks, %SPEECH_ON%If there is no recipient, does any of this still count as being remembered?%SPEECH_OFF% You hold the paper against the night wind and tell her that, for this moment, someone is listening.
event.liuying_bond.20.reveal:
Liuying finally begins the letter with, “To the future me.” Firelight softens her profile, and the firefly spark settles on the last line like tomorrow's signature. %SPEECH_ON%Then I will not send it yet. When I truly have a future, I will place it in her hands myself.%SPEECH_OFF%

The armor shard answers with a rapid pulse toward a nearby den occupied by beasts. More pages filled with ordinary lives lie scattered there, and she means to bring them home.
event.liuying_bond.20.option: Keep the letter safe for her.
event.liuying_bond.40.title: The Night of Fading
event.liuying_bond.40.text:
During the midnight watch, you find Liuying alone in an empty tent. She has lit no lamp, only stretched her right hand into the moonlight. Its outline flickers, and beneath the skin there is no red warmth—only teal particles slowly drifting apart.

She explains without drama that this body was never designed for a long life. Each battle hastens the fading. She learned to hide pain inside SAM's roar, but never learned how to face a morning when her fingers might no longer touch a cup, a page, or the person beside her.

You promise no miracle. You simply lay your cloak beside the entrance and sit. After a long silence, she places the half-transparent hand in yours. %SPEECH_ON%Please do not look away. Just tonight, let me know I am still here.%SPEECH_OFF% You hold on and count every breath with her.
event.liuying_bond.40.reveal:
By the time the mist thins, warmth has returned to her hand. Liuying presses an old military tag to her chest, no longer treating it as a soldier's number. %SPEECH_ON%If I still have to disappear, I want my last memory to be someone waiting with me for dawn—not an alarm.%SPEECH_OFF%

Fresh mud on the tag points to a nearby brigand camp. They looted a convoy of Glamoth relics. Liuying will reclaim them, and the names that were reduced to cargo.
event.liuying_bond.60.title: Core in the Rain
event.liuying_bond.60.text:
Rain passes through broken walls and washes the distant hills gray. Liuying kneels beside a half-buried Glamoth wreck, wiping mud from its armor plate by plate. The beacon within still repeats an old identification code, like a soldier who never learned that the war ended.

She once believed that leaving the cavalry and its orders behind would be freedom enough. Yet when the familiar pulse sounds, her hand still stops in the old response position. Training, pain, and an arranged sacrifice do not vanish with escape; they have become part of her body.

Liuying draws back her hand and lets the rain run from her fingertips. %SPEECH_ON%I do not want to pretend my past never existed. SAM was a cage, but it was also how I survived long enough to stand here.%SPEECH_OFF% She looks into the wreckage, where a core waits for its true pilot.
event.liuying_bond.60.reveal:
The core ignites in her hands. SAM's immense outline rises through the rain, yet gives no command. Eyes closed, Liuying rewrites the activation sequence to the rhythm of her own breathing. %SPEECH_ON%If this armor answers me, it will answer my will—not my cage.%SPEECH_OFF%

The beacon projects coordinates into ruins held by ancient dead. The remaining activation components are there. She asks you to come, not as a patient needing protection, but as a warrior about to reclaim her strength.
event.liuying_bond.60.option: Rewrite the activation sequence with her.
event.liuying_bond.80.title: Who the Fire Fights For
event.liuying_bond.80.text:
At twilight, Liuying stands alone on a ridge and watches the company's lamps come alive one by one. SAM's outline rises behind her in teal flame, then quietly kneels as though awaiting her permission.

She asks whether it would count as living if everyone remembered only the armor. Glamoth needed cavalry, enemies feared SAM, and even those she saved thanked the fire that descended from the sky. The girl named Liuying always seemed hidden behind victory.

Wind catches her silver hair. She presses a hand to her chest, where there is no armor—only a clear, hurried heartbeat. %SPEECH_ON%I want to fight, but not to prove a weapon still has value. I want to know whether anyone will call my name after the fire is gone.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.liuying_bond.80.reveal:
You call her “Liuying.” SAM bows its head, and countless teal lights cross the ridge toward the noisy, living camp below. Watching people eat, argue, and sing, she finally smiles like one of them. %SPEECH_ON%I am not borrowing a battlefield. I am stepping into my own future.%SPEECH_OFF%

An old cavalry tag answers her core from a southern raider camp. Liuying means to recover it—not for the registry, but to engrave the name she chose on its reverse.
event.liuying_bond.80.option: Call her by the name Liuying.
event.liuying_bond.100.title: A Ring in Morning Light
event.liuying_bond.100.text:
On the morning before the final challenge, the camp is strangely quiet. Liuying steps from the command tent not in armor, but in a wedding dress remade for her: teal fireflies embroidered into white silk, warm gold tracing Glamoth wings, and a few black-and-white armor accents left at the shoulder so past and future may exist together.

She once calculated how long she had left and treated every meeting as the prelude to farewell. The numbers remain; the fading has not vanished. But she no longer lets the ending decide the worth of today. The letter by the fire, the hand held until dawn, the core in the rain, and the name spoken aloud are proof that needed no order.

Liuying raises the hand bearing a ring. Morning light travels along silver and a teal stone. %SPEECH_ON%I cannot promise forever, but I can give every day I wake to a choice of my own.%SPEECH_OFF% She meets your eyes without looking away.
event.liuying_bond.100.reveal:
Teal fireflies rise from the hem of her wedding dress while SAM keeps silent watch in the sunrise. Liuying extends her ringed hand; the ring is as clear as a coordinate no battlefield can erase. %SPEECH_ON%I used to burn because I was ordered to. From now on, I want this light to mean that I chose to live beside you.%SPEECH_OFF%

The final Complete Combustion echo awakens in the wild. Only by defeating it will SAM accept her new will entirely. Liuying takes your hand and turns toward the last sea of fire with a smile.
event.liuying_bond.100.option: Set the ring firmly on her hand.

skin.changyeyue_skin.name: Evernight Skin

skin.mai_shiranui_skin.name: Mai Shiranui Skin

valkyrie.mai_shiranui.background.descrip: A kunoichi of Shiranui-ryu, renowned for folding-fan techniques, martial arts, and movement as swift as flame. Among the company, Mai opens armor with thrown weapons before seizing a gap, closing to melee, and ending the fight in one flowing blaze.

valkyrie.mai_shiranui.trait.description: Thrown weapons, martial arts, and weightless footwork flow together, letting her change between ranged and close combat at a moment's notice.
valkyrie.mai_shiranui.trait.tooltip: Melee Skill +10, Ranged Skill +10, Initiative +20, and Fatigue +10.

skill.mai_shiranui_chou_hissatsu_shinobi: Chou Hissatsu Shinobi Bachi: Flame Dance

effect.mai_shiranui_flame_dance.name: Flame Dance

valkyrie.himeko.bond.trait.name: Himeko Bond
valkyrie.himeko.bond.trait.description: Records the trust and love Himeko builds with you along the journey. Each victory grants 4 Bond. Exclusive events and permanent challenge locations trigger at 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100.
valkyrie.himeko.bond.trait.tooltip.max: Bond has reached its final stage. The oath will not fade.
valkyrie.himeko.bond.trait.tooltip.weapo: Recovered the unique Astral Pioneer Lance.
valkyrie.himeko.bond.trait.tooltip.oath: Unlocked the final bond skill We Are Trailblaze, replacing Victory Rush.
event.himeko_bond.reward.objective_highl: A new exclusive location is permanently highlighted on the map. Defeat its guards to claim this stage's reward.
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_faile: No suitable open ground could be found nearby. The event remains pending and may trigger again.
event.himeko_bond.20.title: A Morning Star at the Spearpoint
event.himeko_bond.20.text:
The camp grows quiet after battle, but Himeko remains beneath the workshop lamp, taking apart a long spear buried under years of dust. An oil-stained finger follows the constellation rails along its shaft before she pushes a freshly brewed cup of coffee toward you.

%SPEECH_ON%It once pointed somewhere very far away. But weapons and people are alike—the place they came from matters less than the person for whom they choose to set out again.%SPEECH_OFF%

She asks you to steady the butt while she calibrates the star-shaped blade. Warmth travels through the cold metal between your hands. For the first time she does not call you Commander. She simply says your name.
event.himeko_bond.20.reveal:
A broken star chart awakens along the spear and points toward an old armory camp occupied by brigands. Himeko drains her coffee, puts on her coat, and places the second key to its case in your palm.

%SPEECH_ON%If you will recover it with me, then from now on we will decide together where this spear points.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.20.option: Accept the key to the spear case.
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_20: Defeat the Lost Spear-Case Camp and recover the unique two-handed polearm Astral Pioneer Lance.
event.himeko_bond.40.title: The Night Navigator's Circlet
event.himeko_bond.40.text:
On a rainy night, Himeko's command wagon has become a tiny observatory. She places a white, crimson, and gold battle circlet on the chart table and explains that each golden rail marks a choice the two of you made along the road.

%SPEECH_ON%Navigation is not deciding another person's destination. It is only telling someone who is lost that a light is still waiting for them.%SPEECH_OFF%

She has you hold the circlet while she adjusts its guards. You stand close enough that the rain seems to belong to another world.
event.himeko_bond.40.reveal:
The red starstone reflects a goblin camp where the last golden conductor for its chart circuit has been hoarded.

Before rising, Himeko smooths your rain-soaked collar. %SPEECH_ON%When we return, finish this chart with me—the one that belongs to the two of us.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.40.option: Promise to finish your shared chart.
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_40: Defeat the Stolen Circlet Camp and claim the 300-durability Starfarer Circlet with only -4 Fatigue.
event.himeko_bond.60.title: Starlight Fastened by Your Hands
event.himeko_bond.60.text:
Before dawn, Himeko tries on the newly restored ceremonial armor. Its white breastplate is impossibly thin yet answers a knuckle with a steady ring; crimson panels and golden stars follow her silhouette.

The final shoulder clasp refuses to close. She turns her back, lifts her long hair, and places the tiny golden star in your hand. When you fasten it, she does not look away.

%SPEECH_ON%I used to think homecoming was only a route. Now I think it can also be a person.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.60.reveal:
The clasp reveals an ancient armory occupied by barbarians, where the last layer of star-silver still waits.

Himeko turns and tightens your bracer in return, taking her time. %SPEECH_ON%Commander, wherever this journey goes, as long as you are there, I will always know which way leads home.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.60.option: Hold the hand she has not withdrawn.
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_60: Defeat the Homebound Armory and claim the 300-durability Homebound Ceremonial Armor with only -4 Fatigue.
event.himeko_bond.80.title: The Sleeping Trailblazer
event.himeko_bond.80.text:
A signal hidden in the armor leads you underground. An enormous white and crimson machine stands in the dark, wing-blades folded like sails and its stellar core cold.

Himeko takes out a palm-sized summoner core and lays your hand over hers. Two pulses travel through the mechanism, and the first morning star ignites in the machine's chest.

%SPEECH_ON%It is called Trailblazer. Once it obeyed only coordinates and orders. From today onward, I want it to protect the future we choose together.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.80.reveal:
Trailblazer unfolds its wings and illuminates the outer hangar occupied by orcs. The core recognizes your joined command, then returns to Himeko's palm.

%SPEECH_ON%I will wake it. You tell me where our next stop is. I rather like that arrangement.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_80: Defeat the Trailblazer Hangar and claim a summoner that can deploy the mech once per battle.
event.himeko_bond.100.title: Toward the Same Tomorrow
event.himeko_bond.100.text:
When dawn reaches the camp, Himeko is waiting among flowers and star charts. Her wedding gown was made for this day: ivory layers carrying a deep crimson train, while golden rails sew the long journey into her veil.

She waits for no officiant. Instead she raises her left hand to her heart, making the red-star wedding ring unmistakable and leaving no shelter for hesitation.

%SPEECH_ON%I have seen many stations, and I have said goodbye to many people. But I love you, Commander—not because you can take me to some final destination, but because every day that begins beside you makes me want to choose the next tomorrow for myself.%SPEECH_OFF%
event.himeko_bond.100.reveal:
She gives you her hand, the ring bright in the morning. Trailblazer lowers its wings in the distance. There are no grand bells, only coffee, the company's hushed cheers, and the real warmth of your joined hands.

%SPEECH_ON%So let me remain here as your beloved, your companion, and your Himeko. However far the stars may be, we will travel toward the same tomorrow.%SPEECH_OFF%

The final oath chart lights within nearby ancient ruins: your last trial together, and the first station of a new journey.
event.himeko_bond.100.option: Steady the ring on her hand and swear to travel together.
event.himeko_bond.reward.challenge_100: Defeat the Oath Star-Gate Ruins to permanently unlock We Are Trailblaze, removing Victory Rush and its Charge mechanic.
location.himeko_bond.20.name: Lost Spear-Case Camp
location.himeko_bond.20.description: Brigands keep a long case engraved with constellation rails among their spoils.
location.himeko_bond.40.name: Stolen Circlet Camp
location.himeko_bond.40.description: Goblins are dismantling the delicate golden conductor from Himeko's battle circlet.
location.himeko_bond.60.name: Homebound Armory
location.himeko_bond.60.description: An ancient armory occupied by barbarians still holds a layer of star-silver light as silk.
location.himeko_bond.80.name: Trailblazer Hangar
location.himeko_bond.80.description: Orcs occupy the outer hangar. The sleeping mech's summoner lies within.
location.himeko_bond.100.name: Oath Star-Gate Ruins
location.himeko_bond.100.description: Ancient dead guard the final oath chart, which shines only for those who pass together.
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.name: Standard of Presence — Eternal Radiance
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.description: A two-handed sacred standard raised together from the ashes and sewn whole again. Its silver fleur-de-lis spearhead and reinforced shaft let it guard the line—and pierce the enemy personally.
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.tooltip.own: Only Jeanne can equip this bond weapon.
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.tooltip.ban: Counts as a true battle standard: enables Jeanne's Holy Banner abilities and extends Holy Banner Aura and Luminosité Eternelle to 5 tiles.
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.tooltip.tog: Presence: at the start of each normal turn, Jeanne recovers the same Fatigue as her Holy Banner Aura (5 base, 8 after Bond 60). Extra turns cannot trigger this again.
item.jeanne_eternal_standard.tooltip.ski: Grants Holy Banner Thrust and Holy Banner Sweep.
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_thrust.name: Holy Banner Thrust
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_thrust.descript: Jeanne drives the silver fleur-de-lis spearhead and reinforced standard shaft through the enemy line.
Reaches 1–2 tiles; attacks at 2 tiles suffer no distance penalty.
Gains +10 chance to hit and benefits from Revelation: Holy Banner's standard-fighting bonus.
Deals 100% weapon damage and neither spends nor generates Revelation.
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_sweep.name: Holy Banner Sweep
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_sweep.descripti: Jeanne wheels the shaft, sweeping the entire front line with sacred cloth and silver spearhead.
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_sweep.tooltip.a: Strikes the 3 adjacent tiles across the chosen front, dealing 80% weapon damage to each target.
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_sweep.tooltip.h: Has -5 chance to hit; each target rolls separately.
skill.jeanne_holy_banner_sweep.tooltip.r: Does not knock back or inflict extra control, and neither spends nor generates Revelation.
skill.jeanne_eternal_standard.tooltip.re: Requires Jeanne to equip Standard of Presence — Eternal Radiance.
item.himeko_astral_lance.name: Astral Pioneer Lance
item.himeko_astral_lance.description: A two-handed lance restored by Himeko. Its broad blade leads like a train breaking through the stellar night, while precision rails compress red-tier force into a 3 AP attack rhythm.
item.himeko_astral_lance.tooltip.owner: Only Himeko can equip this bond weapon.
item.himeko_astral_lance.tooltip.skill: Grants Astral Rail Thrust: a powerful 1–2 tile polearm attack costing 3 AP and 12 Fatigue.
item.himeko_navigator_circlet.name: Starfarer Circlet
item.himeko_navigator_circlet.descriptio: A light battle circlet of white plate, crimson guards, and golden constellation rails. It does not choose a direction for its wearer; it keeps her homeward star visible through the fiercest storm.
item.himeko_navigator_circlet.tooltip.ow: Only Himeko can equip this bond helmet.
item.himeko_navigator_armor.name: Homebound Ceremonial Armor
item.himeko_navigator_armor.description: White, crimson, and gold armor Himeko redesigned for a shared journey. Star-silver layers fold heavy protection into a silhouette nearly as light as formal wear.
item.himeko_navigator_armor.tooltip.owne: Only Himeko can equip this bond armor.
item.himeko_trailblazer_summoner.name: Trailblazer Summoner
item.himeko_trailblazer_summoner.descrip: A palm-sized stellar core holding Trailblazer's coordinates and awakening oath. Himeko can deploy the mech to an adjacent empty tile once each battle.
item.himeko_trailblazer_summoner.tooltip: Only Himeko can equip this summoner.
Grants Deploy Trailblazer, usable once per battle.
Trailblazer: 600 Hitpoints, 800 head and body armor, and 100 in all four attack and defense skills.
entity.himeko_trailblazer.name: Trailblazer
skill.himeko_astral_lance_strike.name: Astral Rail Thrust
skill.himeko_astral_lance_strike.descrip: Tear open the line with the Astral Pioneer Lance. Its precision rails let this legendary red weapon deliver a two-handed blow for only 3 AP.
skill.himeko_astral_lance_strike.tooltip: Targets enemies 1–2 tiles away and gains +15% chance to hit.
The weapon deals 110–140 damage, 175% armor damage, and 45% direct damage.
skill.himeko_trailblazer_deploy.name: Deploy Trailblazer
skill.himeko_trailblazer_deploy.descript: Awaken the AI-controlled Trailblazer on an adjacent empty tile. The summoner can deploy only once per battle, even if the mech is destroyed.
Its head and body each have 800 armor.
Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense, and Ranged Defense are all 100.
Star-Span Cleave costs 2 AP and 0 Fatigue and reaches 1–10 tiles.
Trailblazer has already been deployed this battle.
skill.himeko_trailblazer_mech_attack.des: Trailblazer extends a wing-blade along its astral rail, delivering a physical melee cleave across the battlefield.
skill.himeko_trailblazer_mech_attack.too: Deals 120–150 damage, 175% armor damage, and 45% direct damage, comparable to a powerful red-tier two-hander.
Uses Melee Skill and may attack enemies 1–10 tiles away.
skill.himeko_we_are_trailblaze.name: We Are Trailblaze
skill.himeko_we_are_trailblaze.descripti: Whenever a companion takes the next trailblazing step, Himeko's orbital fire follows.
skill.himeko_we_are_trailblaze.tooltip.t: After any allied unit makes an active direct attack, Himeko follows up once against that attack's primary target. Himeko's own active attacks also qualify.
skill.himeko_we_are_trailblaze.tooltip.f: The follow-up costs no AP, Fatigue, ammunition, or durability; it deals 100% weapon damage, 150% armor damage, and gains +25 percentage points of armor penetration, with no range limit.
skill.himeko_we_are_trailblaze.tooltip.r: The original attack resolves first. No follow-up is made if its primary target is dead or removed; counters, attacks of opportunity, and follow-ups cannot trigger it.
valkyrie.sparxie.name: Sparkle
valkyrie.sparxie.background.name: Masked Fool: Sparkle
valkyrie.sparxie.background.description: A Masked Fool from beyond this tavern world. She treats every mercenary clash as a carefully staged broadcast, and as long as the audience keeps screaming, she can keep the absurd script rolling.
valkyrie.sparxie.trait.name: Kaleidoscope Persona
valkyrie.sparxie.trait.description: Sparkle changes expressions, identities, and stage rhythm at will, leaving her enemies unable to predict the next scene behind the camera.
valkyrie.sparxie.trait.tooltip: +3 maximum Action Points, +15 Ranged Skill, +20 Initiative, and +10 Resolve.
skin.sparxie_skin.name: Sparkle
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.name: Backstage Sleight
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.descriptio: When a player-roster unit actively hits the Live Guest, Sparkle sends one gift after that action fully resolves and gains Smile. Smile increases direct weapon attack damage for the roster and further empowers Sparkle's signature attacks.
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.tooltip.gi: A Live Guest can receive up to 3 gifts per broadcast. One attack action can trigger only once, regardless of hit count.
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.tooltip.da: Each Smile increases eligible direct weapon attack damage for player-roster units by 2%, up to 12%.
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.tooltip.ex: Sparkle's Connection, Audience Gift, and Carnival attacks gain a total of 4% per Smile and do not also receive the roster bonus.
skill.sparxie_backstage_trick.tooltip.ca: Smile is capped at 6. Carnival of Me, Keep the Camera Rolling consumes all Smile after resolution.
skill.sparxie_live_connection.name: Scream! Sparkle Is Live
skill.sparxie_live_connection.descriptio: Open a live connection with one enemy. After the attack fully resolves, a surviving target becomes the Live Guest.
skill.sparxie_live_connection.tooltip.at: Requires a ranged weapon. Attacks at 2–6 tiles for 100% weapon damage, 100% armor damage, and +20 chance to hit.
skill.sparxie_live_connection.tooltip.gu: A surviving target becomes the Live Guest for the current round and the following full round, with up to 3 Audience Gifts.
skill.sparxie_live_connection.tooltip.tr: Only active direct weapon hits by player-roster units trigger a gift, at most once per action.
skill.sparxie_live_connection.tooltip.sp: A live connection has already been opened this round.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.name: Carnival of Me, Keep the Camera Rolling
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.description: Sweep the camera across the battlefield, attacking every visible nearby enemy with a ranged weapon before launching random follow-ups based on Smile at cast time.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.tooltip.area: Attacks every visible enemy within 6 tiles for 80% weapon damage and 125% armor damage.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.tooltip.hit: The base area attacks gain +30 chance to hit and roll independently for each target.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.tooltip.foll: Each Smile at cast time adds one auto-hit random strike for 25% weapon damage and 50% armor damage. Every strike rebuilds the list of living targets.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.tooltip.cons: Usable once per battle. Once formally started, it consumes all Smile. Carnival attacks cannot trigger Audience Gifts.
skill.sparxie_carnival_live.tooltip.spen: Carnival of Me has already been broadcast this battle.
effect.sparxie_live_guest.name: Live Guest
effect.sparxie_live_guest.description: This target is at the center of Sparkle's camera. When a player-roster unit actively hits it, Sparkle sends an Audience Gift after the original action fully ends, provided the guest is still alive.
effect.sparxie_audience_buff.name: Audience Hype
effect.sparxie_audience_buff.description: Sparkle turns the audience's laughter into direct weapon attack damage for player-roster members.
effect.sparxie_audience_buff.tooltip.dam: Current eligible direct weapon attack damage +
ui.hub.tab.memory_inscribe.body: Preserve ordinary footsteps as undying lights in the sea of memory.
ui.hub.tab.memory_shop.body: Exchange inscription rewards for permanent-growth items delivered to the stash.
ui.hub.tab.memory_biographies.body: Read the company stories already inscribed in memory.
memory.ui.intro: Cyrene can inscribe living ordinary brothers still serving in the company. Inscription permanently removes the brother; all equipment is safely returned to the stash before memory resources are calculated from eight permanent base attributes.
memory.ui.biography_intro: A name may leave the roster, but its story does not vanish from the sea of memory. Each page preserves a brother's life and attributes at inscription.
memory.ui.empty_candidates: There are no eligible ordinary brothers. Fallen brothers, Valkyries, special heroes, origin protagonists, and temporary units never appear here.
memory.ui.empty_records: No life has yet been preserved in the sea of memory.
memory.ui.confirm_message:
Inscribe {name} ({rank}) into the sea of memory?
Rewards: {rewards}
memory.ui.confirm_warning: This brother will permanently leave the company and the action cannot be undone. Equipment returns to the stash first; inscription is blocked if space is insufficient.
memory.ui.biography_template: {name} joined the company as {background}. He was level {level} when he departed after {company_days} days of service. On day {archive_day}, Cyrene preserved this mortal journey in the sea of memory under the title {rank}.
memory.error.actor_not_found: That brother is no longer in the company. Refresh the interface and try again.
memory.error.in_combat: Brothers cannot be inscribed while combat is active.
memory.error.dead: A fallen or dying brother cannot be inscribed.
memory.error.special_identity: Valkyries and special heroes are not ordinary brothers and cannot be inscribed here.
memory.error.protected: Origin protagonists, guests, summons, and protected units cannot be inscribed.
memory.error.already_archived: This memory has already been inscribed and cannot grant rewards twice.
memory.error.world_unavailable: The current world state is unavailable, so inscription cannot proceed.
memory.error.stash_unavailable: The stash is unavailable. Inscription was cancelled to prevent equipment loss.
memory.error.stash_full: The stash lacks enough empty slots for all of this brother's equipment. Inscription was cancelled.
memory.error.stash_transfer_failed: Not all equipment could be transferred safely. No inscription rewards were settled.
