memory.error.archive_failed: The inscription transaction could not complete safely. No rewards were granted.
memory.result.success: Inscription complete. Equipment returned to the stash, and both rewards and biography were written into the sea of memory.
memory.shop.error.world_unavailable: The current world state is unavailable, so the exchange cannot proceed.
memory.shop.error.invalid_product: That memory keepsake does not exist or is no longer available.
memory.shop.error.insufficient_resources: There are not enough memory resources for this exchange.
memory.shop.error.stash_full: The stash has no room for the exchanged item.
memory.shop.error.item_create_failed: The memory item could not be created. No resources were deducted.
memory.shop.error.purchase_failed: The exchange could not complete safely. Resources were restored.
memory.shop.result.success: Exchange complete. The memory item was placed in the stash.
memory.shop.ui.empty: The memory shop has no keepsakes available yet.
item.memory_keepsake.name: Unshaped Memory Keepsake
item.memory_keepsake.description: A keepsake of the company's memories. Grants bond to ordinary Valkyries or corruption to Black Beast women. It is not consumed at the cap.
item.memory_keepsake.tooltip.use_charact: Right-click or drag onto the selected company member. Ordinary characters and Valkyries can both use it. Consumed after a successful effect.
item.memory_keepsake.tooltip.use_bond: Right-click on the selected Valkyrie: grants bond to ordinary Valkyries or corruption to Black Beast women.
item.memory_melee_skill.name: Edge-Tempered Memory
item.memory_melee_skill.description: Entrust a company member with a memory forged through countless close battles.
item.memory_ranged_skill.name: Bowstring Memory
item.memory_ranged_skill.description: Entrust a company member with the memory of an impossible distant shot.
item.memory_melee_defense.name: Guarded Memory
item.memory_melee_defense.description: Entrust a company member with a memory of calmly moving between blades.
item.memory_ranged_defense.name: Arrow-Dodger's Memory
item.memory_ranged_defense.description: Entrust a company member with a memory that reads the path of every arrow.
item.memory_stamina.name: Vial of the Unending March
item.memory_stamina.description: It holds the breath and will of a march that never stopped.
item.memory_hitpoints.name: Vial of Tenacious Life
item.memory_hitpoints.description: A spark of life rekindled through countless wounds.
item.memory_initiative.name: Vial of First Light
item.memory_initiative.description: It captures a moment that moved one step ahead of danger.
item.memory_bravery.name: Vial of the Fearless Oath
item.memory_bravery.description: It holds the oath of a mortal who refused to retreat from despair.
item.memory_level.name: Traveler's Restored Page
item.memory_level.description: Carries a company member through the last experience needed for the current level and resolves one normal level-up.
item.memory_level.effect: Raise one company member by 1 level
item.memory_bond.name: Light of a Remembered Meeting
item.memory_bond.description: A light that remembers time spent together. It strengthens a Valkyrie bond or deepens Olga's Corruption.
item.memory_bond.effect: Grants +15 Bond, or +15 Corruption to Olga, up to 100. Stages still require completing their story challenges.
item.memory_perk.name: Shard of Unchosen Potential
item.memory_perk.description: A test keepsake that returns one unrealized choice to a company member.
skin.robin_skin.name: Robin: Sunny Song
skin.robin_skin.description: Robin in her blue-and-white stage dress, carrying Harmony through wings and a stellar halo.
valkyrie.robin.name: Robin
valkyrie.robin.background.name: Valkyrie Robin
valkyrie.robin.background.description: A singer from a stage among the stars. Robin does not claim the spotlight with a blade; she makes every ally the protagonist of the song, soothing exhaustion, restoring action, and building the whole company toward a battle-turning finale.
valkyrie.robin.trait.name: Singer of Clear Skies
valkyrie.robin.trait.description: Robin supports the formation from the back line through the wings of Harmony, regardless of her equipped weapon.
valkyrie.robin.trait.tooltip: +3 maximum Action Points, +20 Resolve, +15 Initiative, +15 Ranged Defense, and +50% Fatigue recovery efficiency; morale checks cannot lower her morale.
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.name: A Chorus of One Heart
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.descripti: Each roster ally's first direct attack in an action turn grants 1 Harmony whether it hits or misses, and their first kill grants another 1. Harmony caps at 12 and strengthens the whole company at 3/6/9/12. Follow-ups, fixed damage, damage over time, reflection, and scenery damage do not count.
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.tooltip.h: Each ally's first direct attack and first kill per action turn grant 1 Harmony each, up to 12.
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.tooltip.a: At 3/6/9/12 Harmony, all allies gain +3/+6/+9/+12 Melee and Ranged Skill.
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.tooltip.t: At 3/6/9/12 Harmony, all allies deal +5%/+10%/+15%/+20% damage.
skill.robin_harmonic_resonance.tooltip.c: . Harmony gain pauses during the ultimate's concerto.
skill.robin_winged_sunny_song.name: Winged Sunny Song
skill.robin_winged_sunny_song.descriptio: Support every roster ally with a bright song, immediately restoring health, Fatigue, and morale and granting a powerful offensive and defensive enhancement through the end of the next full round. 3-round cooldown.
skill.robin_winged_sunny_song.tooltip.he: All allies recover 15 Hitpoints and attempt to improve morale by one level.
skill.robin_winged_sunny_song.tooltip.bu: +15 Melee/Ranged Skill, +10 Melee/Ranged Defense, +20 Resolve, +20% damage, and -25% Fatigue generated.
skill.robin_winged_sunny_song.tooltip.du: Lasts for the current round and the next full round; reapplying refreshes rather than stacks.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.name: An Encore for You
skill.robin_encore_for_you.description: Spend 3 Harmony to restore one other roster ally within 1–7 tiles. If that ally has already acted this round, they immediately gain another action. Once per round.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.tooltip.resto: Restore 6 Action Points up to the normal maximum and let a target who already acted act again. Cooldowns, ammunition, and per-round resources are not refreshed.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.tooltip.heal: Restore 20% maximum Hitpoints and remove half of current Fatigue.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.tooltip.clean: Remove Dazed, Staggered, Distracted, and Disarmed, then improve morale by one level.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.tooltip.prota: The target deals +25% damage until the end of their next action.
skill.robin_encore_for_you.tooltip.round: An Encore has already been given this round.
skill.robin_myriad_tones_starry_fugue.na: A Myriad Tones, a Starry Fugue
skill.robin_myriad_tones_starry_fugue.de: Spend all 12 Harmony to perform the finale. Every roster ally except Robin restores health and Fatigue and gains 4 Action Points that may exceed the maximum. Allies who already acted act again immediately; allies yet to act retain the overflow for their upcoming normal action. Once per battle.
skill.robin_myriad_tones_starry_fugue.to: Every other ally gains 4 Action Points beyond the maximum. Allies yet to act also receive them and begin their normal action at maximum AP +4.
Restore 20 Fatigue and 20% maximum Hitpoints. Robin ends her current action after casting but acts normally the next time her turn arrives.
During the next action: +15 Melee/Ranged Skill, +10 Melee/Ranged Defense, +30% damage, and -1 AP per tile moved.
The first direct damaging hit in that action makes Robin deal 25 fixed damage ignoring armor; the attacker recovers 15 Hitpoints and 10 Fatigue.
The finale has already been performed this battle.
effect.robin_harmony_aura.name: Harmonic Chorus
effect.robin_harmony_aura.description: Supported across the battlefield by Robin's current Harmony tier.
effect.robin_sunny_song.name: Winged Sunny Song
effect.robin_sunny_song.description: A bright song strengthens offense, defense, Resolve, and Fatigue efficiency.
effect.robin_sunny_song.tooltip.stats: +15 Melee/Ranged Skill, +10 Melee/Ranged Defense, +20 Resolve, and +20% damage.
effect.robin_encore_protagonist.name: Encore Protagonist
effect.robin_encore_protagonist.descript: Deals 25% more damage until the end of the next action.
effect.robin_granted_action.name: Harmonic Action
effect.robin_granted_action.description: Action Points granted by Robin expire after this action.
effect.robin_starry_concerto.name: Starry Concerto
effect.robin_starry_concerto.description: The Starry Fugue empowers this action; its first direct damaging hit triggers Robin's harmonic echo.
valkyrie.nahida.name: Nahida
valkyrie.nahida.background.name: Moon of the Sanctuary of Surasthana
valkyrie.nahida.background.description: Sumeru's God of Wisdom. Her perception branches through the thoughts of others like living roots, weaving isolated enemies into a network of shared consequence.
valkyrie.nahida.trait.name: Physic of Purity
valkyrie.nahida.trait.description: Nahida excels at observing, marking, and amplifying coordinated attacks.
valkyrie.nahida.trait.tooltip: +20 Resolve, +10 Ranged Skill, +10 Ranged Defense, and +10 Initiative.
skin.nahida_skin.name: Nahida · Physic of Purity
skin.nahida_skin.description: The Dendro Archon's white, verdant, and gold leaf-patterned attire.
skill.nahida_akara.name: Akara
skill.nahida_akara.description: Launch a Dendro-infused ranged attack independent of the equipped weapon.
skill.nahida_akara.killed: Struck down by Akara's verdant light
skill.nahida_akara.tooltip.damage: Deals 55–75 damage and 100% damage to armor.
skill.nahida_all_schemes_to_know.name: All Schemes to Know
skill.nahida_all_schemes_to_know.descrip: Observe a target and nearby enemies, damage them once, and connect them with Seeds of Skandha.
skill.nahida_all_schemes_to_know.killed: Unmade beneath All Schemes to Know
skill.nahida_all_schemes_to_know.tooltip: Deals 40–60 damage, 25% ignoring armor, to the nearest 4 enemies within 2 tiles of the target.
Survivors gain Seed of Skandha for 3 rounds and share Tri-Karma Purification triggers across their network.
Recasting removes every Seed previously placed by Nahida and creates a new network. 3-round cooldown.
skill.nahida_tri_karma_purification.name: Tri-Karma Purification
skill.nahida_tri_karma_purification.desc: When an ally damages an enemy bearing a Seed of Skandha, strike every marked enemy in that network.
skill.nahida_tri_karma_purification.tool: A direct attack or damage-over-time tick from a roster member against a Seed bearer triggers the network. Attacks of opportunity, counters, and follow-ups cannot trigger it.
Deals 45–60 damage to every living enemy bearing Nahida's Seed, with 25% ignoring armor.
For every full 5 Resolve above 70, gain +2 damage and +1.5% armor penetration, up to 10 steps.
Each contributor may trigger once per round; the party may trigger twice per round in total.
Shrine of Maya active: 3 party triggers per round and +20% Tri-Karma damage.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.name: Illusory Heart
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.description: Manifest the Shrine of Maya at Nahida's position, empowering allies and Seed reactions within it. Once per battle.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.tooltip.doma: Creates a stationary radius-4 domain for 3 rounds and extends all current Seeds by 1 round.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.tooltip.reso: On cast, 20% of the roster's highest Resolve, up to 20, becomes bonus Resolve for allies inside.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.tooltip.dama: Allies inside gain bonus damage against Seed bearers equal to half the shared Resolve as a percentage, up to +10%.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.tooltip.karm: +20% Tri-Karma damage and increases the party trigger cap from 2 to 3 per round.
skill.nahida_illusory_heart.tooltip.spen: The Shrine of Maya has already been manifested this battle.
effect.nahida_seed_of_skandha.name: Seed of Skandha
effect.nahida_seed_of_skandha.descriptio: Linked to other enemies marked by Nahida; allied damage may trigger Tri-Karma Purification.
effect.nahida_shrine_of_maya.name: Shrine of Maya
effect.nahida_shrine_of_maya.description: While inside the domain, gain shared Resolve and deal more damage to Seed bearers. Leaving temporarily suspends the bonuses.
effect.nahida_shrine_of_maya.tooltip.dam: Damage against Seed bearers inside the domain: +
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.name: Hakurei Reimu
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.background.name: Shrine Maiden of Hakurei
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.background.descri: The shrine maiden who guards the boundary of Gensokyo. Guided by effortless intuition, Reimu casts homing amulets, raises sacred barriers, and seals disturbances before they can upset the balance.
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.trait.name: Hakurei Shrine Maiden
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.trait.description: Reimu's spiritual discipline makes her a precise ranged exorcist and an unusually elusive guardian.
valkyrie.hakurei_reimu.trait.tooltip: +15 Ranged Skill, +20 Resolve, +15 Initiative, and +10 Ranged Defense. Reimu's spell attacks are independent of weapons, ammunition, and durability.
skin.hakurei_reimu_skin.name: Hakurei Reimu: Shrine Maiden
skin.hakurei_reimu_skin.description: Reimu's iconic red-and-white shrine maiden attire, great ribbon, detached sleeves, and sacred amulets.
skill.hakurei_reimu_inborn_intuition.des: Read the flow of battle and gather Spirit Power for Fantasy Seal.
skill.hakurei_reimu_inborn_intuition.too: The first direct active attack each round that deals Hitpoint or armor damage grants 1 Spirit Power. Counters, attacks of opportunity, follow-ups, damage over time, fixed bonus damage, and Fantasy Seal do not qualify.
The first enemy direct attack each round that misses Reimu or an ally protected by her Duplex Barrier grants 1 Spirit Power.
Begin each battle with 1 Spirit Power. Maximum 4; it does not decay. At 4, Spirit Sign: Fantasy Seal becomes available.
skill.hakurei_reimu_hakurei_amulet.name: Hakurei Amulet
skill.hakurei_reimu_hakurei_amulet.descr: Launch a paired homing amulet attack independent of the equipped weapon.
skill.hakurei_reimu_hakurei_amulet.toolt: +20 Ranged Skill, range 2–6 tiles, with no distance penalty.
Deals 55–75 damage and 80% damage to armor.
On hit, applies Sealing Charm until the end of the target's next turn. The two visible amulets form one attack and one damage instance.
skill.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.name: Dream Sign: Duplex Barrier
skill.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.descr: Protect Reimu or one ally with two layers of sacred defense until Reimu's next turn begins.
skill.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.toolt: Outer barrier: +20 Melee Defense and +20 Ranged Defense.
Inner barrier: reduce the first incoming instance of Hitpoint damage by up to 25 without reducing armor damage, then the inner layer breaks.
Range 0–4 tiles. Does not stack; recasting replaces the old barrier. Enemy misses against the protected target can grant Spirit Power.
Duplex Barrier has already been cast this turn.
skill.hakurei_reimu_fantasy_seal.name: Spirit Sign: Fantasy Seal
skill.hakurei_reimu_fantasy_seal.descrip: Consume maximum Spirit Power to unleash an unavoidable sealing barrage on a target and nearby enemies.
skill.hakurei_reimu_fantasy_seal.tooltip: Automatically hits the primary target for 150–190 damage, 125% armor damage, and 40% armor penetration.
Automatically hits all other enemies within 1 tile for 80–110 damage, 100% armor damage, and 25% armor penetration. Allies are never hit.
If the primary target has Sealing Charm, consume it after the base hit and deal 30 fixed Hitpoint damage ignoring armor if the target survives.
effect.hakurei_reimu_spirit_power.name: Spirit Power
effect.hakurei_reimu_spirit_power.descri: Spiritual power gathered through decisive attacks and effortless evasion.
effect.hakurei_reimu_spirit_power.toolti: Gather 4 Spirit Power to unlock Fantasy Seal.
effect.hakurei_reimu_sealing_charm.name: Sealing Charm
effect.hakurei_reimu_sealing_charm.descr: A Hakurei amulet disrupts the target's attacks and primes it for Fantasy Seal.
effect.hakurei_reimu_sealing_charm.toolt: Lasts until the end of the target's next turn. Does not stack; reapplying refreshes it.
effect.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.name: Duplex Barrier
effect.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.desc: Two sacred layers deflect attacks and blunt the first wound.
effect.hakurei_reimu_duplex_barrier.tool: Inner layer ready: the first incoming Hitpoint damage is reduced by up to 25.
The inner layer has broken; the Defense bonuses remain.
Expires when Reimu's next turn begins, or immediately if Reimu dies.
skin.texas_omertosa_skin.name: Texas the Omertosa: Extermination
skin.texas_omertosa_skin.description: Texas the Omertosa in black-and-white tactical dress, wielding twin blades through cobalt sword rain.
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.name: Texas the Omertosa
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.background.name: Valkyrie Texas the Omertosa
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.background.descr: A silent executor from the wolf packs of Siracusa. Her twin blades cut through disorder as she appears at the enemy formation's fatal point; the first foe to fall awakens the Texas tradition and calls down a sword rain that should already have ended.
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.trait.name: Silent Executor
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.trait.descriptio: Texas enters the enemy formation with a wolf's composure and an executor's speed. Her unique active skills require a melee weapon.
valkyrie.texas_omertosa.trait.tooltip: +1 maximum Action Point, +15 Melee Skill, +10 Melee Defense, and +25 Initiative. Unique active skills require a melee weapon.
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.name: Texas Tradition
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.descripti: An execution loop built around rapid redeployment. A cut-in sustains two turns of sword rain, while her first personal kill fully restores her and makes the active rain fall again.
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.tooltip.c: Cut-in begins ready. Either unique active consumes it to teleport beside a target within 5 tiles, ignoring zones of control and attacks of opportunity; it remains unavailable for the next two complete personal turns.
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.tooltip.m: Downpour or Sword Rain lasts through the current and next personal turn. During it, all direct weapon attacks deal 20% more regular and armor damage.
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.tooltip.s: Until her first personal kill, incoming Hitpoint and armor damage is reduced by 25%.
skill.texas_omertosa_tradition.tooltip.f: First personal kill each battle: fully restore Hitpoints. If a rain mode remains active, replay its entry effect for free after the current action, refresh it to two turns, and restart cut-in recovery; otherwise cut-in becomes ready immediately. Does not repair armor or resurrect.
skill.texas_omertosa_shared.tooltip.cool: Cut-in is not ready, or no melee weapon is equipped.
skill.texas_omertosa_unrelenting_downpou: Cut in beside the target, sweep nearby enemies with high-penetration twin blades, then chain execution slashes after subsequent attacks.
Cut down in the unrelenting downpour
Range 1–5. Teleport to the nearest legal empty tile adjacent to the target; remain in place if already adjacent.
On entry, attack every enemy within 1 tile: +25 chance to hit, 120% weapon damage, 150% armor damage, and +30 armor penetration points.
Survivors gain Rain Erosion for 2 turns. Texas gains another +30 armor penetration points against them.
For two turns, the next 3 active melee weapon attacks are followed by a free strike against the original target: +20 chance to hit, 60% weapon damage, and 100% armor damage.
skill.texas_omertosa_torrential_sword_ra: Cut into the enemy formation and suppress nearby foes with two waves of blades, then automatically hunt high-priority enemies at each turn's end.
Pierced by the torrential sword rain
Range 1–5. Teleport to the nearest legal empty tile adjacent to the target; remain in place if already adjacent.
On entry, attack each enemy within 1 tile twice. Each strike gains +30 chance to hit, deals 70% weapon damage and 100% armor damage, with +20 armor penetration points.
If either strike hits, stun for 1 turn; stun-immune targets are Dazed instead.

For two turns, automatically attack up to 3 different enemies within 4 tiles at each personal turn's end, prioritizing unacted enemies with higher Initiative. Each gains +30 chance to hit, deals 70% weapon damage with +20 penetration points, and inflicts Dazed.
effect.texas_omertosa_rain_erosion.name: Rain Erosion
effect.texas_omertosa_rain_erosion.descr: Cobalt sword rain has opened weak seams in the target's armor.
effect.texas_omertosa_rain_erosion.toolt: Texas the Omertosa gains +30 armor penetration points when attacking this target.
Lasts 2 target turns. Reapplying refreshes the duration.
valkyrie.sword_maiden.name: Sword Maiden
valkyrie.sword_maiden.background.name: Valkyrie Sword Maiden
valkyrie.sword_maiden.background.descrip: A blind high priestess and sword saint who judges evil with a balance-shaped blade. She survived the darkness of a goblin nest; now every hunt is written into her sacred codex, strengthening an already formidable executioner into the doom of goblinkind.
valkyrie.sword_maiden.trait.name: Blind Sword Saint
valkyrie.sword_maiden.trait.description: +2 maximum Action Points and no nighttime accuracy penalty. Melee attacks ignore shield defense. Against goblins, gain +15 chance to hit and deal 25% more total damage.
skin.sword_maiden_skin.name: Sword Maiden
skin.sword_maiden_skin.description: Her original platinum hair, black blindfold, blue-white vestments, and balance blade—the emblems of judgment tempered by mercy.
hunt.sword_maiden.record.name: Goblin Hunt Record
hunt.sword_maiden.record.description: Records goblins judged personally or through Holy Binding. Points settle after combat and permanently unlock new powers.
hunt.sword_maiden.rank_bonus: Gain 1 rank per 25 points, up to rank 12. Each rank grants +2 Hitpoints, +2 Fatigue, +1 Melee Skill, +1 Melee Defense, and +1% total damage.
skill.sword_maiden_unseeing_mind.name: Unseeing Mind's Eye
skill.sword_maiden_unseeing_mind.descrip: Though her eyes are covered, her mind senses killing intent before sight ever could.
skill.sword_maiden_unseeing_mind.tooltip: The first direct melee attack each turn gains +20 chance to hit, +20% weapon damage, and +15 armor penetration points. A miss still consumes it.
The first direct melee attack each turn gains major accuracy, damage, and penetration bonuses.
The first-strike bonus is consumed even if the attack misses.
All direct melee attacks ignore defense granted by shields.
Cross one tile with the balance blade and deliver an inescapable judgment, especially deadly to goblins.
Range 1–2, once per turn. Gain +20 chance to hit and ignore shield defense.
Deal 160% weapon damage, 140% armor damage, and gain +25 armor penetration points.
Against goblins, deal 210% weapon damage instead.
Before Root Extermination unlocks, a kill refunds 3 Action Points and removes 10 Fatigue.
Balance Blade: Condemnation has already been used this turn.
skill.sword_maiden_goblin_codex.name: Sacred Hunt Codex
skill.sword_maiden_goblin_codex.descript: Every goblin cruelty and weakness is entered in the codex. Accumulated hunt points permanently strengthen Sword Maiden.
skill.sword_maiden_cave_survivor.name: Cave Survivor
skill.sword_maiden_cave_survivor.descrip: She returned from the deepest nest; nets, roots, and terror can no longer hold her.
skill.sword_maiden_cave_survivor.tooltip: At turn start, remove one Net, Web, or Root effect. If one is removed, recover 2 Action Points.
Deal 15% more total damage against targets that are netted, rooted, stunned, or dazed.
skill.sword_maiden_holy_binding_judgment: Call forth the scales' sacred chains to bind the guilty and record the judgment owed at the other end.
Range 1–4. For 2 turns, reduce Melee/Ranged Skill and Defense by 15 and block movement skills. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
Goblins are also rooted and disarmed for 1 turn. Root-immune bosses ignore both root and disarm.
If an ally kills the marked goblin, gain half its base points, rounded up.
skill.sword_maiden_root_extermination.de: Every death fuels the next judgment; against goblins, that power rises a second time.
skill.sword_maiden_root_extermination.to: The first personal kill each turn restores 4 Action Points, removes 12 Fatigue, and resets Condemnation once.
If the first trigger came from a goblin, another goblin kill may trigger the Action Point and Fatigue recovery once more that turn.
skill.sword_maiden_balance_final_judgmen: Place the battlefield upon the scales, deliver sword judgment to the main target, and settle every sinner nearby.
Reduced to dust by final judgment
Range 1–4, once per battle. The main target suffers an attack at +30 to hit, 250% weapon damage, 160% armor damage, and +40 penetration points, ignoring shields.
All enemies within 2 tiles additionally lose 60 Hitpoints; goblins lose 100. Allies are never harmed.
If this skill kills any enemy, restore Action Points to maximum.
Balance Blade: Final Judgment has already been used this battle.
skill.sword_maiden_light_in_darkness.des: The long darkness did not take her mercy; it showed her the light she must reach with her own hands.
skill.sword_maiden_light_in_darkness.too: The first Condemnation each turn costs no Action Points or Fatigue and deals 30% more total damage.
After the first kill each turn, the next direct weapon attack gains +25 chance to hit and +25% total damage.
The first personal goblin kill each turn restores Action Points to maximum.
effect.sword_maiden_holy_binding.name: Holy Binding Judgment
effect.sword_maiden_holy_binding.descrip: The sacred chains of the scales tighten around the target while awaiting final judgment.
effect.sword_maiden_holy_binding.tooltip: Melee/Ranged Skill and Defense are reduced by 15.
Movement skills are blocked. Goblins may also be rooted and disarmed during the first turn.
valkyrie.the_herta.name: The Herta
valkyrie.the_herta.background.name: Genius Before Nous
valkyrie.the_herta.background.descriptio: Member 83 of the Genius Society: human, female, young, beautiful, and adorable. She does not chase answers; answers are merely annotations left behind by her calculations.
valkyrie.the_herta.trait.name: Genius Society No. 83
valkyrie.the_herta.trait.description: The Herta thinks fast enough to move before the battlefield. Gains +20 Ranged Skill, +30 Initiative, +15 Fatigue, and +1 Vision.
valkyrie.the_herta.trait.tooltip: +20 Ranged Skill, +30 Initiative, +15 Fatigue, and +1 Vision.
skin.the_herta_skin.name: The Herta: Original
skin.the_herta_skin.description: Her elegant original design: violet-black witch attire, broad hat, and the unmistakable poise of the Genius Society.
skill.the_herta_optimal_solution.name: Optimal Solution
skill.the_herta_optimal_solution.descrip: The Herta compresses the battlefield into an equation she may revise at leisure. At 4 Inspiration, the answer is ready.
skill.the_herta_optimal_solution.tooltip: Starts each battle with 2 Inspiration, maximum 4. Gain 1 when the first ordinary weapon attack each turn hits; False Premise always grants 2.
Her special damaging attacks choose the currently less-armored body part (Body on a tie) and roll weapon damage twice, keeping the higher roll.
skill.the_herta_false_premise.name: Calculation: False Premise
skill.the_herta_false_premise.descriptio: Insert a false premise into the enemy's action model and contaminate the conclusion of their next turn.
skill.the_herta_false_premise.tooltip.co: Range 1–6. The target and enemies within 1 tile lose 30 Initiative and 2 maximum Action Points for their next action, to a minimum of 6; current Action Points are reduced immediately.
skill.the_herta_false_premise.tooltip.in: Makes no hit roll and deals no damage. Gain 2 Inspiration after use. Once per own turn.
effect.the_herta_false_premise.name: False Premise
effect.the_herta_false_premise.descripti: The action rests on a false assumption, delaying even the time at which its conclusion may be reached.
effect.the_herta_false_premise.tooltip.a: Maximum Action Points are reduced by 2 (minimum 6), and 2 current Action Points are lost immediately. Removed after the next action.
skill.the_herta_answer_written.name: Proof: The Answer Was Written
skill.the_herta_answer_written.descripti: The answer was never waiting at the end of battle. The Herta merely lets everyone else see it later.
skill.the_herta_answer_written.tooltip.p: Spend 4 Inspiration, range 1–7. Main target: +35 to hit, 180% weapon damage, 200% armor damage, +30 penetration points; on a surviving hit, deal 40 fixed Hitpoint damage.
skill.the_herta_answer_written.tooltip.a: All enemies within 2 tiles: +25 to hit, 130% weapon damage, 150% armor damage, +15 penetration points; on a surviving hit, deal 15 fixed Hitpoint damage. Ignores distance and shields; never harms allies.
skill.the_herta_answer_written.tooltip.c: Each target independently selects its less-armored body part and rolls weapon damage twice, keeping the higher result. Inspiration is cleared after all targets resolve, even if every attack misses.
research.the_herta.title: Enchantment Promotion Experiment
research.the_herta.description: Choose an enchanted item from the stash, then retain the existing conclusion or rerun every affix from scratch.
research.the_herta.requires_summon: Recruit The Herta before enchantment promotion research can be used.
research.the_herta.unavailable: The equipment system is not enabled, so enchantment promotion is unavailable.
research.the_herta.empty: The stash contains no enchanted item eligible for further promotion.
research.the_herta.picker.title: Choose Research Equipment
research.the_herta.mode.retain_descripti: Keep affix identities and promote base-affix quality; add one legal random affix when the new rarity adds a slot.
research.the_herta.mode.reroll_descripti: Clear every affix and generate the full target set. Red can roll legendary affixes; prismatic guarantees at least one prismatic affix.
research.the_herta.confirm: Promote “{item}” to {rarity} using “{mode}”? Materials and crowns are deducted only after success.
research.the_herta.ready: All requirements met. Promotion is ready.
research.the_herta.need_quota: No promotion charge is currently available.
research.the_herta.success: Promotion complete. The item instance, appearance, and durability ratio were preserved.
research.the_herta.error.disabled: The Herta is not in the company, or the equipment system is disabled.
research.the_herta.error.invalid_item: The item is not in the stash or is ineligible for promotion.
research.the_herta.error.locked: A locked item cannot be promoted.
research.the_herta.error.max_rarity: This item is already at maximum rarity.
research.the_herta.error.materials: Not enough enchantment stones of the required color.
research.the_herta.error.quota: No charge has accumulated for this high-rarity promotion.
research.the_herta.error.failed: The calculation failed; no materials or quota were consumed.
valkyrie.lily.name: Lily
valkyrie.lily.background.name: White Priestess
valkyrie.lily.background.description: The last White Priestess of Land's End. She bears the Blight through prayer while twenty-six purified spirits wield their strength in her stead.
valkyrie.lily.trait.name: Ender Lily
valkyrie.lily.trait.description: Lily cannot equip main-hand or off-hand weapons and never makes ordinary unarmed attacks. Six equipped spirits fight with Spirit Power that grows with her level, and accumulated Blight can awaken her briefly.
valkyrie.lily.trait.tooltip: +20 Resolve, +10 Fatigue, +10 Ranged Defense. Hands are locked; damage comes from Spirit Power.
skin.lily_skin.name: White Priestess Lily
skin.lily_skin.description: Lily's white ceremonial dress, teal amulet, and lily ornaments.
skin.lily_blighted_skin.name: Blighted Lily
lily.spirit_record.name: Blight Purification Record
lily.spirit_record.description: Records Lily's purified spirits and their current equipped order.
skill.lily_blight_controller.name: The Cost of Purification
skill.lily_blight_controller.description: Spirit attacks, control, purified deaths, and effective prayer build Blight. At 3 Lily may accept it; at 6 she transforms automatically and recovers 3 AP. The Blighted form lasts three of Lily's turns before Final Purification.
skill.lily_blight_controller.tooltip.pow: Spirit Power is 60–80 and gains 2 at each level from 2 through 11.
skill.lily_prayer.name: Lily's Prayer
skill.lily_prayer.description: Heals all allies within 2 tiles for 15 plus 15% maximum HP and removes bleeding and poison. Three uses per battle; healing is 25% stronger while Blighted.
skill.lily_prayer.tooltip: The first effective prayer each turn grants 1 Blight.
skill.lily_accept_blight.name: Accept the Blight
skill.lily_accept_blight.description: At 3 Blight, freely enter Blighted form for three own turns: +15 accuracy, +30% final damage, and +20% armor penetration. Once per battle.
skill.lily_final_purification.name: Final Purification
skill.lily_final_purification.descriptio: Enemies within 2 tiles take 100% Spirit Power, 200% armor damage, 50% penetration, and Stagger. Allies heal 15% maximum HP, Lily 25%, and lose bleeding and poison. Lily then returns to normal.
effect.lily_pending_purification.name: Pending Purification
effect.lily_pending_purification.descrip: If this target dies within two turns, it contributes to Lily's purification record.
effect.lily_guard.name: Guardian Spirit
effect.lily_guard.description: Negates the next eligible direct attack, then retaliates. Both guardian spirits share this reaction slot.
effect.lily_spirit_poison.name: Spirit Poison
effect.lily_spirit_poison.description: Lasts three turns. When both poisons coexist, the stronger harms HP and the weaker harms body armor only.
effect.lily_attendant.name: Attendant Spirit
effect.lily_attendant.description: A purified spirit attached to Lily that makes follow-up attacks by its own rules.
lily.spirits.title: Blight Purification Record
lily.spirits.empty_warning: An empty slot leaves Lily with fewer than eight active skills in battle.
lily.spirits.read_only: Summon Lily to save a loadout.
lily.spirits.manager_hint: Browse purified spirits and arrange the six combat slots.
lily.spirits.saved: Spirit loadout saved and the combat bar rebuilt in the new order.
lily.spirits.error.combat_locked: Spirits cannot be changed during battle or deployment.
lily.spirits.error.invalid: The loadout contains a locked, duplicate, or invalid spirit.
lily.spirits.error.sync: The loadout was recorded, but runtime skill reconstruction failed.
lily.spirits.tooltip.power: Damage is based on Lily's current Spirit Power.
lily.spirits.tooltip.main: Main Spirits have no per-battle use limit.
skill.lily_spirit_umbral_knight.name: Umbral Knight
skill.lily_spirit_umbral_knight.descript: Range 1–2. Deals 120% Spirit Power with +15 accuracy. The first kill each turn restores 2 AP.
skill.lily_spirit_gerrod.name: Gerrod, the Elder Warrior
skill.lily_spirit_gerrod.description: Range 1. Deals 180% Spirit Power, 250% armor damage, and +20% penetration. Staggers, or stuns when armor breaks.
skill.lily_spirit_dark_witch_eleine.name: Dark Witch Eleine
skill.lily_spirit_dark_witch_eleine.desc: Range 2–7. Three projectiles deal 110% Spirit Power total with +25 accuracy, no range penalty, and 50% penetration.
skill.lily_spirit_guardian_silva.name: Guardian Silva
skill.lily_spirit_guardian_silva.descrip: Range 1. Two hits deal 150% Spirit Power total and 200% armor damage; 200% total and stun if Lily did not move this turn.
skill.lily_spirit_mad_knight_ulv.name: Mad Knight Ulv
skill.lily_spirit_mad_knight_ulv.descrip: Range 1. Two claws deal 140% Spirit Power total with +30% penetration and bleeding; a kill permits a free one-tile disengage.
Range 1–4 line. Every enemy takes 140% Spirit Power with +25 accuracy and +25% penetration, ignoring shields.
skill.lily_spirit_hoenir.name: Hoenir, Keeper of the Abyss
skill.lily_spirit_hoenir.description: Range 2–6. Deals 90% Spirit Power with +25 accuracy and +35% penetration; usable twice per turn.
skill.lily_spirit_faden.name: Faden, the Heretic
skill.lily_spirit_faden.description: Range 2–5. Target and adjacent enemies take 160% Spirit Power with +35% penetration, knockback, and stun; once per turn.
skill.lily_spirit_guardian_sigrid.name: Guardian Sigrid
skill.lily_spirit_guardian_sigrid.descri: All adjacent enemies take 80% Spirit Power, 220% armor damage, and Stagger. Four uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_cliffside_hamlet_youth: Range 2–5. Target and adjacent enemies take 100% Spirit Power, ignoring shields. Four uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_western_merchant.name: Western Merchant
skill.lily_spirit_western_merchant.descr: Attaches a crow for four turns; each turn it strikes the nearest enemy within 6 for 50% Spirit Power. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_headless_defender.name: Headless Defender
skill.lily_spirit_headless_defender.desc: Negates the next frontal direct attack and counters for 140% Spirit Power. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_castle_town_maiden.des: Attaches for four turns; the first spirit hit each turn follows up on the same target within 4 for 60% Spirit Power. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_fallen_archer.name: Fallen Archer
skill.lily_spirit_fallen_archer.descript: Range 2–6. Target and adjacent enemies take 100% Spirit Power; large targets take another 60%. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_elder_crypt_keeper.des: Range 1–4. Deals 70% Spirit Power and roots; immune elites instead lose 3 AP and may be stunned. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_fungal_sorcerer.name: Fungal Sorcerer
skill.lily_spirit_fungal_sorcerer.descri: Range 2–4 area. Deals 60% Spirit Power and fungal poison for three turns, 20 armor-ignoring HP per turn. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_floral_sorceress.name: Floral Sorceress
skill.lily_spirit_floral_sorceress.descr: All adjacent enemies take 70% Spirit Power, heavy Stagger, and knockback. Four uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_fallen_sentinel.name: Fallen Sentinel
skill.lily_spirit_fallen_sentinel.descri: Length-5 line shot. Every enemy takes 120% Spirit Power, ignoring shields. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_hidden_test_subject.de: Negates the next direct attack from any direction, then deals 100% Spirit Power around the attacker. Shares the guard slot. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_dark_executioner.name: Dark Executioner
skill.lily_spirit_dark_executioner.descr: Range 2–6. Teleports behind the target for 150% Spirit Power, +30 accuracy and +30% penetration, ignoring shields. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_incompetent_sinner.des: Dashes up to 3 tiles in a line, dealing 90% Spirit Power to enemies passed and disengaging. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_verboten_champion.name: Verboten Champion
skill.lily_spirit_verboten_champion.desc: Leaps to a valid tile within 2; two landing strikes deal 110% Spirit Power total around it. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_cliffside_hamlet_elder: Range 2–6. Target and adjacent enemies take 140% Spirit Power and Stagger. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_chief_guardian.name: Chief Guardian
skill.lily_spirit_chief_guardian.descrip: Choose a center within 2; two strikes deal 110% Spirit Power total around it. Three uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_one_eyed_royal_aegis.d: Target and adjacent enemies take 150% Spirit Power and 250% armor damage; main target is stunned, others staggered. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_spirit_forsaken_fellwyrm.name: Forsaken Fellwyrm
skill.lily_spirit_forsaken_fellwyrm.desc: Range 2–5, radius 2. Deals 50% Spirit Power and Fellwyrm poison for three turns, 30 armor-ignoring HP per turn. Two uses per battle.
skill.lily_ulv_step.name: Mad Knight's Hunting Step
skill.lily_ulv_step.description: A free step left by Ulv after a kill. Move to a valid adjacent empty tile without triggering attacks of opportunity.
valkyrie.meltryllis.name: Meltryllis
valkyrie.meltryllis.background.name: The Melting Ballerina
valkyrie.meltryllis.background.descripti: An otherworldly Alter Ego who turns ballet and steel blades into a single art. Cool and proud, she refuses to abandon a stage she has chosen. She slips through the battle line, weakens powerful enemies with Melt Virus, and ends her solo with Sarasvati Meltout.
valkyrie.meltryllis.trait.name: Alter Ego: Melting Lilith
valkyrie.meltryllis.trait.description: Fights with innate leg blades and keeps both hands empty. Helmets, armor and accessories remain available. Maximum AP remains 9. Disarm does not disable her blades; stun and fatigue still constrain her actions.
valkyrie.meltryllis.trait.tooltip: Melee Skill +10, Melee Defense +10, Initiative +20. Innate blade base damage: 55–75.
skin.meltryllis_skin.name: Meltryllis: Original
meltryllis.hub.active.name: Blade Dance / Crime Ballet / Melt Virus / Sarasvati Meltout
skill.meltryllis_sadistic_constitution.d: After an actively initiated Blade Dance or Noble Phantasm deals HP or armor damage, gain one Sadism stack per action, up to three. Each stack grants +10% damage to subsequent signature attacks. While any stacks remain, Melee Defense -5. Reset at the start of your next turn, not on waiting. Counters, follow-ups, opportunity attacks and damage over time grant no stacks.
skill.meltryllis_blade_dance.name: Ankle Blade: Whip Dance
skill.meltryllis_blade_dance.description: Whip Dance: 3 AP, 10 Fatigue, range 1. One melee attack for 55–75 base damage, 100% armor damage and 35% armor penetration. Normal shield and accuracy rules apply. No cooldown.
skill.meltryllis_crime_ballet.name: Crime Ballet A+
skill.meltryllis_crime_ballet.descriptio: Crime Ballet: 2 AP, 15 Fatigue, 2-round cooldown. Cast in place or move along up to two legal empty tiles without opportunity attacks. Cannot cross actors, obstacles or height changes greater than one; rooted actors may only cast in place. Until your next turn starts, negate two otherwise successful enemy single-target direct attacks and their riders. Natural misses cost no charge. Area attacks and damage over time bypass evasion.
skill.meltryllis_melt_virus.name: Melt Virus EX
skill.meltryllis_melt_virus.description: Melt Virus: 2 AP, 10 Fatigue, range 1–3, 3-round cooldown. Erode a visible enemy without an accuracy roll: -20% ordinary attack damage and -20 Initiative for two target turns. Recover 15 accumulated Fatigue and gain Absorption, raising the next Noble Phantasm's base multiplier to 450%. Absorption lasts through the end of your next turn, does not stack, and is consumed on casting even if the attack misses.
skill.meltryllis_sarasvati_meltout.name: Sarasvati Meltout
skill.meltryllis_sarasvati_meltout.descr: Sarasvati Meltout: 5 AP, 30 Fatigue, range 1–2, 3-round cooldown. +25 accuracy; ignores shield defense. On casting, remove Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte before a single melee attack: 300% blade damage, or 450% with Absorption; 150% armor damage and 50% armor penetration. Sadism multiplies this damage separately. Does not destroy shields or remove permanent abilities.
effect.meltryllis_absorption.name: Absorption
effect.meltryllis_absorption.description: Your next Sarasvati Meltout has a 450% base multiplier, consumed on casting. Expires at the end of your next turn after casting Melt Virus.
effect.meltryllis_virus.name: Melt Erosion
effect.meltryllis_virus.description: Ordinary attack damage -20% and Initiative -20 for two full turns. This is not poison and does not stack.
effect.meltryllis_ballet.name: Crime Ballet: Evasion
effect.meltryllis_ballet.description: Negates otherwise successful enemy single-target direct attacks and their riders, costing one charge for an entire multi-hit action. Natural misses, area attacks and damage over time consume no charges. Expires at your next turn start.
valkyrie.m4a1.name: M4A1
valkyrie.m4a1.background.name: AR Team Leader
valkyrie.m4a1.background.description: A tactical Doll developed by 16LAB and leader of Griffin's AR Team. Gentle and reserved, she puts her companions' safety first. On an unfamiliar battlefield, she searches for a way to bring everyone home. Arrives with her signature rifle, M4A1: Homecoming.
valkyrie.m4a1.trait.name: 16LAB Tactical Doll
valkyrie.m4a1.trait.description: A tactical fire-control system sustains her rifle fire; a commander's judgment directs her allies.
valkyrie.m4a1.trait.tooltip: Maximum AP +3, Ranged Skill +15, Maximum Fatigue +20, Resolve +15 and Ranged Defense +10. Recover 10 extra fatigue each normal turn. Her rifle can fire in melee, with -15 accuracy whenever an enemy is adjacent.
skin.m4a1_skin.name: Road Home
skin.m4a1_skin.description: Dark brown hair, yellow-green strands, a cream headset and a grey scarf. As the smoke clears, she waits for every teammate to return.
item.m4a1_homecoming_rifle.name: M4A1: Homecoming
item.m4a1_homecoming_rifle.description: M4A1's modular signature rifle with an Inheritor cannon module. Precise shots, three-round bursts and selectable ammunition handle both light and heavily armored targets.
item.m4a1_homecoming_rifle.tooltip: M4A1 only; occupies both hands; Maximum Fatigue -10. Base damage 65-85, range 1-7. Each battle: 12 standard rounds loaded, 36 standard and 24 AP in reserve. Uses no campaign ammunition supplies. Re-equipping never refills ammunition.
m4a1.hub.active: Rifle Fire Control / Mark of Vengeance
skill.m4a1_ar_commander.name: AR Commander
skill.m4a1_ar_commander.description: After a rifle action finishes, its surviving primary target receives the sole Focus Target mark if hit. Until M4's next normal turn, roster allies including M4 gain +10 accuracy and +15% regular HP/armor damage against it, excluding fixed damage and damage over time. The triggering burst does not benefit from its new mark. Missing does not replace the mark; it expires when M4 dies or leaves combat.
skill.m4a1_inheritor.name: Inheritor
skill.m4a1_inheritor.description: Start each battle with 3 cannon charges, maximum 6. A paid rifle action dealing HP or armor damage grants 1 charge, up to 2 per global round. Other roster allies' active direct attacks damaging the marked target grant 1 additional charge per round. Multi-hit/area actions count once. Follow-ups, counters, damage over time, fixed damage and cannon attacks grant none. Waiting, extra turns, equipment swaps and skill repair do not reset limits.
skill.m4a1_tactical_shot.name: Tactical Shot
skill.m4a1_tactical_shot.description: 3 AP / 8 fatigue / 1 round. Range 1-7, 100% rifle damage, +20 accuracy. -4 accuracy per tile beyond 3 and -15 while any enemy is adjacent. Retains line of sight, cover, shields, elevation, night and ranged resistance. Misses consume ammunition.
skill.m4a1_three_round_burst.name: Three-round Burst
skill.m4a1_three_round_burst.description: 4 AP / 18 fatigue; requires 3 rounds. Range 1-7, up to 3 independent shots at one target, each at 70% rifle damage and +5 accuracy. Uses Tactical Shot's distance/melee penalties. Two hits on the primary target apply Suppressed. Stop when the target dies, retaining unfired rounds without retargeting or refunding AP/fatigue. The burst is one action.
skill.m4a1_tactical_reload.name: Tactical Reload: Standard
skill.m4a1_tactical_reload.description: 3 AP / 8 fatigue. Return remaining rounds to their reserve pool and load up to 12 standard rounds: 100% base damage, 160% armor damage and 45% armor penetration. Unavailable with a full standard magazine or no standard reserve; supports partial reloads. Firearm mastery does not reduce reload AP.
skill.m4a1_reload_ap.name: Tactical Reload: Armor-piercing
skill.m4a1_reload_ap.description: 3 AP / 8 fatigue. Return remaining rounds to their reserve pool and load up to 12 AP rounds: 80% base damage, 220% armor damage and 70% armor penetration. These replace standard-round parameters. Unavailable with a full AP magazine or no AP reserve.
skill.m4a1_firepower_focus.name: Firepower Focus
skill.m4a1_firepower_focus.description: 2 AP / 15 fatigue. Rifle damage +50% and +10 accuracy for this turn and the next normal turn. Immediately gain 1 cannon charge outside the round's gain limits. Cooldown: 4 normal turns. For example, used on normal turn 1, ready again on normal turn 5. Does not boost the cannon, replenish ammunition or restore AP.
skill.m4a1_mark_of_vengeance.name: Mark of Vengeance: Inheritor Cannon
skill.m4a1_mark_of_vengeance.description: 6 AP / 30 fatigue / 3 charges, once per global round. Range 2-7; requires the signature rifle and no adjacent enemy. Center: 400% base damage / 250% armor damage / 65% penetration. Adjacent enemies: 160% / 200% / 35%. Independent of rifle ammo. Each target rolls separately with +25 accuracy, no distance penalty, ignoring shields. Splash resolves even if the center misses; no friendly fire or wall penetration. A previously marked center takes an extra x1.25 damage, alongside the mark's x1.15. Does not apply marks, consume rifle ammo or generate charges. Misses are not refunded.
effect.m4a1_focus_target.name: Focus Target
effect.m4a1_focus_target.description: M4A1's sole focus target. Player roster allies gain +10 accuracy and +15% regular HP/armor damage against it until M4's next normal turn. Does not amplify fixed damage or damage over time.
effect.m4a1_suppressed.name: Suppressed
effect.m4a1_suppressed.description: Melee Skill -15, Ranged Skill -15 and Initiative -20 until the end of the next normal turn. Refreshes without stacking. Requires no morale check and affects undead.
effect.m4a1_magazine.name: Magazine and Cannon System
effect.m4a1_magazine.description: Battle allocation: 12 standard rounds loaded, 36 standard and 24 AP in reserve. Equipment swaps, waiting and skill reconstruction never refill it. Switching either ammunition type requires a paid reload.
m4a1.state.outside: Ammunition and charges initialize at the start of the next battle.
m4a1.state.cooldown: Normal turns until Focus is ready:
m4a1.state.focus: Firepower Focus active: +50% rifle damage and +10 accuracy.
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.name: Sakiko Togawa
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.background.name: Oblivionis / Ensemble Conductor
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.background.descri: The keyboardist of Ave Mujica shapes her stage with calm resolve. Beyond moonlit curtains, her music brings scattered footsteps into rhythm, giving every companion a vital part in the ensemble.
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.trait.name: Architect of the Perfect Stage
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.trait.description: Even when the stage falls apart, its conductor refuses to abandon her score.
valkyrie.togawa_sakiko.trait.tooltip: +20 Resolve, +20 Maximum Fatigue, +20 Initiative and +10 Ranged Defense. Recover 5 additional Fatigue at the start of each normal turn, once per round; extra turns do not trigger this.
skin.togawa_sakiko_skin.name: Stage Regalia
skin.togawa_sakiko_skin.description: Periwinkle hair, black ribbons, burgundy and black stage attire, and layered ivory ruffles preserve her Oblivionis appearance.
skill.togawa_sakiko_ensemble_stage.name: Fear Not Oblivion: Ensemble Stage
skill.togawa_sakiko_ensemble_stage.descr:
Other roster allies within 4 tiles gain +10 Melee and Ranged Skill and +15 Resolve, and recover 5 extra Fatigue at normal turn start, once per round. Piano is the starting timbre. Leaving range removes the ordinary stage; stun or fleeing pauses it.
Melody starts at 2, gains 2 per normal turn once per round, and caps at 6. Waiting and extra actions do not charge it. Sakiko recovers 5 extra Fatigue on her own normal turn but receives no team stage bonuses.
skill.togawa_sakiko_full_moon_dance.name: Full Moon Dance
skill.togawa_sakiko_full_moon_dance.desc:
Costs 2 AP and 10 Fatigue. Switch timbre once per round; the chosen timbre persists until switched or combat ends.
Piano: allies on the stage gain +15 percentage points of armor penetration (capped at 100%) and +20% armor damage for direct attacks.
Organ: +10 Melee and Ranged Defense and 20% lower active skill Fatigue costs. Fatigue from incoming hits is unchanged. Switching neither restores AP nor resets counters.
skill.togawa_sakiko_crescent_echo.name: Crescent Echo: Fever
skill.togawa_sakiko_crescent_echo.descri:
Costs 6 AP, 30 Fatigue and 6 Melody. Other roster allies within 5 tiles immediately recover 20 Fatigue and rise to Steady morale if below it.
For their next 2 normal turns, recipients gain the stage and both timbres even outside range, without stacking with the ordinary stage. Their first two active weapon attacks per round during normal turns cost 2 less AP, minimum 2. Attacks costing 0–2 AP are unchanged and consume no charge. Each area or multi-hit cast counts once; misses count.
Movement, reloading, character actives, follow-ups, counters, opportunity attacks and extra turns receive no discount. Waiting does not reset charges; extra turns do not advance duration. Refreshing Fever preserves round counters. Sakiko dying, leaving the field or combat ending removes the effects.
sakiko.hub.active: Full Moon Dance / Crescent Echo: Fever
sakiko.piano: Current timbre: Piano / +15 percentage points of penetration, +20% armor damage
sakiko.organ: Current timbre: Organ / +10 defenses, -20% skill Fatigue
sakiko.fever: Fever: both timbres; discounted first two weapon attacks on normal turns
sakiko.remaining: Normal turns remaining / discounts this round:
effect.togawa_sakiko_ensemble.name: Sakiko's Ensemble
effect.togawa_sakiko_ensemble.descriptio: The stage grants +10 Melee and Ranged Skill, +15 Resolve and 5 Fatigue recovery at normal turn start once per round. Piano improves penetration, Organ improves defense and endurance. Fever grants both and discounts the first two active weapon attacks of normal turns by 2 AP, minimum 2 AP.
valkyrie.enterprise.name: Enterprise
valkyrie.enterprise.background.name: Eagle Union Carrier
valkyrie.enterprise.background.descripti: Enterprise, a Yorktown-class carrier of the Eagle Union, brings her rigging bow and carrier air wing to the battlefield. Precise targeting and carefully timed sorties keep her comrades safe.
valkyrie.enterprise.trait.name: The Grey Ghost
valkyrie.enterprise.trait.description: A steadfast carrier commander who marks enemies with her bow and seizes the decisive moment with Lucky E.
valkyrie.enterprise.trait.tooltip: This identity trait grants no additional attributes. Enterprise’s managed skills provide the air wing, Lucky E and combat resources.
skin.enterprise_skin.name: Enterprise Classic Uniform
skin.enterprise_skin.description: Silver hair, a white officer’s cap and a dark naval coat: Enterprise’s classic Eagle Union uniform.
enterprise.hub.passive: Eagle Union Air Wing / Lucky E
skill.enterprise_white_eagle_airwing.des: Start each battle with 2/3 sortie points. Recover 1 at the start of each normal turn after the first, up to 3. Waiting, extra turns and skill reconstruction do not recover points. All airstrikes share a limit of one use per global round. Enterprise’s four offensive skills are blocked in enemy zones of control.
skill.enterprise_lucky_e.name: Lucky E
skill.enterprise_lucky_e.description: Once per successfully launched airstrike, roll a 70% chance to double its base damage against every target and gain Grey Ghost until the next normal turn. It cancels the next hostile direct-damage attack action that would hit Enterprise, including its subsequent hits against her and hit-dependent effects. Natural misses do not consume it. Does not stack or block damage over time or independent control.
skill.enterprise_eagle_guidance.name: Eagle’s Guidance
skill.enterprise_eagle_guidance.descript: 3 AP, 8 Fatigue, range 2–6. Requires a bow and one arrow. Attack for 100% bow damage with +10 accuracy, using ordinary distance, elevation, cover, diversion and applicable bow mastery rules. A surviving selected target hit receives the sole Air Lock: Enterprise’s next airstrike containing it gains +10 accuracy and ×1.20 base damage against it, consuming the lock even on a miss. Expires at Enterprise’s next normal turn. With Dauntless Wings equipped, Guidance reaches 2–7 with +5 additional bow accuracy; Air Lock becomes +15 accuracy and ×1.35 base damage, and an airstrike hitting the locked target restores 4 Fatigue once per global round.
skill.enterprise_dauntless_dive.name: Dauntless Dive
skill.enterprise_dauntless_dive.descript: 6 AP, 20 Fatigue, 2 sortie points, range 2–7. Strike one visible enemy for 55–70 base damage, 150% armor damage, 25% armor penetration and +15 accuracy.
skill.enterprise_carrier_strafe.name: Carrier Strafing Run
skill.enterprise_carrier_strafe.descript: 6 AP, 24 Fatigue, 2 sortie points. Select a starting tile 2–7 tiles away; attack visible enemies along the three highlighted tiles extending away from Enterprise. Allies are safe. Off-map tiles and tiles farther than 7 are excluded. Each target takes 35–45 base damage, 100% armor damage, 20% armor penetration, with +10 accuracy. Roll Lucky E once for the entire action.
skill.enterprise_decisive_airwing.name: Decisive Air Wing
skill.enterprise_decisive_airwing.descri: 7 AP, 35 Fatigue, 3 sortie points, once per battle, range 2–7. Strike a visible enemy and visible enemies on adjacent tiles, sparing allies and excluding targets farther than 7. Base damage is 60–80 at the center and 30–40 around it; 150% armor damage, 25% armor penetration and +15 accuracy. Each enemy is struck once; roll Lucky E once for the entire action.
enterprise.airstrike.rules: Airstrikes use independent base damage with general damage modifiers and enemy ranged defense. Ignore cover, shields, distance and elevation accuracy modifiers. They are not arrows, consume no ammunition and are unaffected by disarm or bow mastery. Require visible targets; at most one airstrike per round.
enterprise.command.blocked: Cannot command: Enterprise must be alive, able to act, not fleeing or busy, and outside enemy zones of control.
enterprise.airstrike.blocked: Insufficient sortie points, an airstrike was already used this round, or Decisive Air Wing was already used this battle.
enterprise.guidance.weapon_required: Requires an equipped bow and a quiver with at least one arrow.
enterprise.state.decisive_used: Decisive Air Wing: used this battle
enterprise.state.decisive_ready: Decisive Air Wing: available this battle
effect.enterprise_grey_ghost.name: Grey Ghost
effect.enterprise_grey_ghost.description: Cancel the next hostile direct-damage attack action that would hit Enterprise, including subsequent hits of that action and hit-dependent effects. Natural misses do not consume protection. Does not block damage over time or independent control. Expires at Enterprise’s next normal turn.
effect.enterprise_air_lock.name: Air Lock
effect.enterprise_air_lock.description: The marking Enterprise’s next airstrike containing this target gains +10 accuracy and ×1.20 base damage against it, consuming this lock even on a miss. Other units gain no benefit. Expires at Enterprise’s next normal turn.
effect.enterprise_sortie_points.name: Sortie Readiness
effect.enterprise_sortie_points.descript: Prepared carrier squadrons. Ordinary airstrikes cost 2 points; the decisive strike costs 3. Waiting and extra actions do not accelerate preparation.
valkyrie.katsushika_hokusai.name: Katsushika Hokusai
valkyrie.katsushika_hokusai.background.d: The Foreigner bearing the name Hokusai appears as Oei and her octopus-shaped father. Mercenaries, monsters, mountains and seas all become subjects for their paintings.
valkyrie.katsushika_hokusai.trait.name: Father and Daughter
valkyrie.katsushika_hokusai.trait.descri: A pair of devoted artists who weaken foes with ink and gather inspiration for the waves of Mount Fuji.
valkyrie.katsushika_hokusai.trait.toolti: Ranged Skill controls accuracy and current Resolve improves painting damage. Inspiration and Ink Marks last only for the battle; skins grant no combat abilities or attributes.
skin.katsushika_hokusai_skin.name: Hokusai Painter Kimono
skin.katsushika_hokusai_skin.description: An ukiyo-e painter in a red and black floral kimono.
skill.hokusai_painting_mania.name: Painting Mania
skill.hokusai_painting_mania.description: Start combat with 1 Inspiration, maximum 6. A paid Brushstroke or Alien Octopus action that hits grants 1 Inspiration, at most 2 per global round. Surviving targets gain 1 Ink Mark after damage, maximum 3. Each stack reduces both defenses by 4 and increases incoming attack armor and HP damage by 6%, excluding fixed and periodic damage. Marks last through the next two normal turns, excluding the turn already in progress. Waiting and extra actions do not tick duration.
skill.hokusai_brushstroke.name: Brushstroke
skill.hokusai_brushstroke.description: 3 AP, 10 Fatigue, range 1-4. Ranged Skill +15 accuracy. Base damage is floor(55 + 0.35 x current Resolve), 100% armor damage and 25% armor penetration. Shields apply. Deals damage before adding ink.
skill.hokusai_all_things_in_nature.name: All Things in Nature
skill.hokusai_all_things_in_nature.descr: 2 AP, 12 Fatigue, cooldown 3 global rounds. Gain 2 Inspiration outside the attack-income cap and +25 to both defenses until your next normal turn starts. Does not remove control effects or guarantee evasion.
skill.hokusai_father_daughter_bond.name: Father-Daughter Bond
skill.hokusai_father_daughter_bond.descr: 2 AP, 12 Fatigue, cooldown 3 global rounds. Through the end of your next normal turn: painting damage +20%; once per global round, Father adds 1 Ink Mark to one surviving Brushstroke or Alien Octopus hit target, preferring the main target. This adds no damage or Inspiration. Resist the next 2 negative morale checks originating from hostile skills, excluding allied death/fleeing cascades. No summoned unit is created.
skill.hokusai_alien_octopus.name: Alien Octopus
skill.hokusai_alien_octopus.description: 4 AP, 18 Fatigue, cooldown 2 global rounds. Select an enemy at range 2-4; hit up to 3 enemies within radius 1, main target first, then distance from the center, with ties resolved in a fixed order. Each rolls Ranged Skill +20 and deals 40 plus 25% of current Resolve damage, rounded down, 100% armor damage, 25% penetration. Shields apply. Each surviving hit gains ink; the whole action grants at most 1 Inspiration.
skill.hokusai_thirty_six_views.name: Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji
skill.hokusai_thirty_six_views.descripti: 6 AP, 35 Fatigue, 6 Inspiration, cooldown 3 global rounds. Select an enemy at range 2-5, radius 1. Each rolls Ranged Skill +25, ignoring shield defense. Base damage is 110 plus 50% of current Resolve, rounded down, then +15% per pre-cast Ink Mark, rounded down; 150% armor damage, 35% penetration. Existing ink vulnerability applies. Hits consume all ink; misses preserve it. +20% damage against explicitly registered human types; orcs, goblins, undead and unregistered mod enemies do not qualify. No ink, Father assist or Inspiration gained.
effect.hokusai_ink_mark.name: Ink Marks
effect.hokusai_ink_mark.description: Each stack: -4 Melee and Ranged Defense, +6% incoming attack armor and HP damage, maximum 3. Does not amplify fixed or periodic damage. Hokusai's ultimate consumes marks on a hit. A departing source removes only its own stacks.
hokusai.state.outside: Available in combat; start with 1 Inspiration and no initial tactical cooldowns.
hokusai.state.nature: Nature: +25 defenses until the next normal turn begins.
hokusai.state.bond_turns: Normal turns still to begin before Bond expires:
hokusai.spell.rules: Independent of weapon base damage, ammunition and durability. General damage bonuses apply once. Always hits the body. Every target must be visible, within maximum range and in line of sight from the caster. Elevation applies. Ignores cover from intervening units or obstacles, with no accuracy penalty or projectile diversion.
hokusai.blocked: Requires an active, living Hokusai and a finished cooldown; the ultimate also requires 6 Inspiration. Extra actions share this global round's income and assist limits.
valkyrie.abigail_williams.name: Abigail Williams
valkyrie.abigail_williams.background.des: A girl from mist-shrouded Salem, carrying a cherished doll. Her prayers comfort her companions, while her silver key opens a gate beyond the stars.
valkyrie.abigail_williams.trait.name: Bearer of the Silver Key
valkyrie.abigail_williams.trait.descript: Gathers otherworldly power through Gate Keys, using Terror, Erosion and Trial to prepare a decisive single-target attack.
valkyrie.abigail_williams.trait.tooltip: Her identity grants her abilities. Favors Ranged Skill, Resolve and Fatigue. The cosmetic skin grants no abilities or attributes.
skin.abigail_williams_skin.name: Abigail Initial Outfit
skin.abigail_williams_skin.description: A navy dress, orange bows and flowing golden hair. Cosmetic only.
skill.abigail_outer_realm.name: Existence Outside the Domain EX
skill.abigail_outer_realm.description: Start combat with 1 Gate Key, up to 6. From round 2, gain 1 at the first normal turn each round; Root Touch hits grant at most 1 per round, Prayer grants 2, and a successful Trial grants 1. Waiting, free attacks and extra turns do not refresh income. Negative morale checks gain the equivalent of 20 extra Resolve, without increasing displayed Resolve or spell damage. Keys reset between battles.
skill.abigail_root_touch.name: Touch of the Qliphoth
skill.abigail_root_touch.description: 4 AP, 12 Fatigue, range 1–4. A single-target spell with +20 Ranged Skill. Base damage: floor(55 + 0.4 × Resolve), 100% armor damage and 35% armor penetration. Hits grant a Gate Key, at most once per round. No cooldown.
skill.abigail_faithful_prayer.name: Prayer of Faith
skill.abigail_faithful_prayer.descriptio: 3 AP, 18 Fatigue, 3-round cooldown. Gain 2 Gate Keys. Bless yourself and roster allies within 3 tiles and line of sight: recover 10 Fatigue at the start of each of their next two normal turns; their next paid direct attack gains +15% damage for the entire action, consumed even on a miss. Free attacks, counters, follow-ups and damage over time neither benefit nor consume the charge. Does not stack or add recovery charges; expires after the second subsequent normal turn.
skill.abigail_mass_hysteria.name: Mass Hysteria
skill.abigail_mass_hysteria.description: 4 AP, 22 Fatigue, range 1–4, radius 1, 3-round cooldown. Visible enemies suffer Erosion: -10 Melee and Ranged Defense for two subsequent normal turns. Terror attempts a stun at each of their next two normal turn starts. Chance: clamp(45 + 0.5 × (caster Resolve at cast - current target Resolve), 15, 65)%. Terror ends after a successful stun. Respects morale, fear, stun and explicit debuff immunity; native status resistance can still reject a stun. At most one Terror stun per target per battle, shared by all Abigails. No direct damage.
skill.abigail_witch_trial.name: Witch Trial
skill.abigail_witch_trial.description: 3 AP, 18 Fatigue, range 1–5, 3-round cooldown. The target deals 20% less direct attack damage through its next two normal turns. After AP restoration on its next normal turn, remove up to 2 AP without reducing it below 6 by this skill alone. Does not remove AP immediately; waiting and extra turns do not repeat the loss. Does not stack. Gain 1 Gate Key when a debuff is applied; targets immune to both parts cannot be selected.
skill.abigail_qliphoth_rhizome.name: Qliphoth Rhizome
skill.abigail_qliphoth_rhizome.descripti: 6 AP, 35 Fatigue, 6 Gate Keys, range 2–6, 3-round cooldown. First dispel Adrenaline, Killing Frenzy, Shieldwall, Spearwall and Riposte, then make one attack with +35 Ranged Skill. Base damage: floor(160 + 0.6 × Resolve), 150% armor damage and 65% armor penetration. If the target had Abigail Terror or Erosion at cast, multiply damage by 1.25 once. Remove both marks from a surviving target on hit or miss. A miss does not refund costs, cooldown or dispelled buffs.
effect.abigail_prayer.name: Blessing of Faith
effect.abigail_prayer.description: Recover 10 Fatigue at each of the next two normal turn starts. The next paid direct attack gains +15% damage for its entire action, consumed on hit or miss; excludes free follow-ups and opportunity attacks. Reapplication does not stack or replenish either benefit.
effect.abigail_erosion.name: Otherworldly Erosion
effect.abigail_erosion.description: -10 Melee Defense and -10 Ranged Defense for two subsequent normal turns. Does not stack or directly damage armor. Qliphoth Rhizome can exploit and consume this mark.
effect.abigail_terror.name: Terror
effect.abigail_terror.description: Attempts a stun at each of the next two normal turn starts, never immediately on application. Ends after one successful stun; Erosion remains independent. All Abigails share a limit of one successful Terror stun per target per battle. The chance below uses current target Resolve; native status resistance may further resist it.
effect.abigail_trial.name: Witch Trial
effect.abigail_trial.description: -20% direct attack damage through two subsequent normal turns. Remove up to 2 AP once after AP restoration on the next normal turn, without reducing it below 6 by this effect alone. Explicit immunity prevents the corresponding component.
abigail.ap_used: AP reduction resolved; will not repeat
abigail.ap_pending: Remove up to 2 AP after the next normal turn restores AP

chapter.yunki.name: The Yunki Exorcism Chronicle
chapter.yunki.description: A caravan has vanished, and its cargo list describes the missing Qingming casket. Join Yixuan and Ye Shunguang to rescue the travelers, recover the sword core and uncover the source of the mist.
chapter.goal.temple_victory: Recover the bell; both companions fight and survive
chapter.goal.sigil_road: Recover the first sword sigil on the old road
chapter.goal.sigil_spring: Recover the second sigil at the spring
chapter.goal.sigil_pavilion: Recover the third sigil at the pavilion
chapter.goal.heartwood: Collect heartwood from the lightning-struck tree
chapter.goal.ward_heart: Place the ward of the heart
chapter.goal.nightmare_victory: Defeat the Faceless Nightmare; both companions fight and survive
chapter.location.battle: A battle site in %s. %s must fight together and survive the victory. Submit the objective on the chapter page afterwards.
