chapter.yunki.1.name: A Voice in the Casket
chapter.yunki.1.brief: Investigate the wagon, tracks, and campfire. Recover the old casket that answers Ye Shunguang.
chapter.yunki.1.reward: Obtain Ye Shunguang’s Qingming Casket: two-handed, 70–90 damage, 130% armor damage, 30% penetration, +5 accuracy, range 1–2.
chapter.yunki.1.story:
The wagon lies across the mountain road. Halfway from its broken wheels, every trail of footprints turns back, as if the travelers heard the same call at the same moment.

Beside the cold campfire you find a crumpled warning: Do not listen to the people in the mist.

Ye Shunguang stops beside a long wooden casket. Something taps softly beneath its lid.
“It’s here.”
Blue light answers her fingers. Farther up the mountain, a familiar voice begins to speak.
“Not yet.” Yixuan lays a talisman across the clasp. The voice stops.

You pull a breathing carter from beneath the wreck. He clutches his sleeve and repeats a name, unable to wake. Yixuan checks his pulse and asks you to carry him back.

The seal will not open, but a thread of swordlight slips from the casket at Ye Shunguang’s touch. It cuts through the beam trapping the wagon axle.
“It knows you,” Yixuan says. “I’ll deal with the outer seal.”

You tuck the warning into the chronicle. Ye Shunguang does not try the lid again. She fastens the casket securely to her back.
chapter.yunki.2.name: A Talisman for the Frightened
chapter.yunki.2.brief: Yixuan must treat the haunted carter. Gather 1 cloth roll, 1 salt, and 10 medical supplies; consumed on submission. Missing trade goods are available near the marked settlement.
chapter.yunki.2.reward: Purified casket: base damage increases to 80–100.
chapter.yunki.2.story:
Salt forms a fine white line around the casket. Clean cloth binds its clasp. As medicine warms over the fire, Yixuan presses a talisman over the shadow moving beneath the carter’s brow.

He wakes at dawn and asks for his mother. Only after a long silence does he remember that she died years ago. The voices came from an old temple, he says. Raiders stole a bronze bell; soon afterward, his companions began walking into the mist.

Ye Shunguang brings him water. He looks at her casket.
“Are you looking for someone too?”
Her hand stills. “I only wanted to hear clearly.”

Yixuan lifts the last talisman. The casket’s blue patterns shine cleanly, though one inner seal remains.
“The voice borrows someone you miss.”
“What if I really want to hear them once more?”
“Then remember this conversation. When you hear it, ask the person standing beside you first.”

You leave the carter with the town physician and mark the temple on your map. Before departing, Ye Shunguang looks carefully at you, then at Yixuan, as though committing this moment to memory.
chapter.yunki.3.name: The Bell in the Old Temple
chapter.yunki.3.brief: Defeat the temple raiders and recover the calming bell. Both companions must fight and survive; no last-hit requirement.
chapter.yunki.3.reward: Obtain the story bell. Ye Shunguang starts combat with 2 stance while wielding the casket.
chapter.yunki.3.story:
When the last raider falls, the temple bell is still ringing. The darkness clears from his eyes. He cannot explain why he came here, or why he is holding a blade.

Ye Shunguang retrieves a bronze bell from behind the altar. You stand beside her, but your voice calls from outside:
“You’ve got it. Come back.”

She looks up sharply. Yixuan draws a line in the air. The face beyond the doorway dissolves into pale mist.
“Ask the person beside you first,” Ye Shunguang murmurs.
You take the bell she offers. “I’m right here.”

Yixuan cleans its stained surface. One clear note sets three empty grooves on the casket trembling. Threads of light lead toward the old road, a cold spring, and a pavilion halfway up the mountain.
“The sword sigils were scattered. Something is using them to weave people’s longing into the mist.”

Two threads of sword intent now settle steadily in Ye Shunguang’s palm. She taps the casket; it answers.
“Our turn to find it.”
chapter.yunki.4.name: Three Calls on the Road Home
chapter.yunki.4.brief: Follow the bell to the road, spring, and pavilion. Recover three sword sigils, safely stored with the chapter rather than in your stash.
chapter.yunki.4.reward: The three sigils return. Casket accuracy increases to +10.
chapter.yunki.4.story:
On the road, a familiar voice urges you to hurry, promising that one missed step will cost you everything. The bell rings. The first sigil falls from behind a milestone.

At the spring, Ye Shunguang’s reflection does not turn when she does. It asks about an old promise with such tenderness that she nearly reaches into the water. Yixuan sets a talisman afloat. The reflection fades, revealing the second sigil below.

The pavilion holds a cup of hot tea and an empty seat facing the road. After a long silence, Ye Shunguang asks, “Did it rain that day?”
“It rained today.” You offer her a cloak. “We used the last dry cloth for the casket. Yixuan asked me to bring this.”

She holds its edge, then smiles. “You don’t sound anything like it.”
“I only remember today.” You break off some bread for her.

The third sigil waits under the cup. As all three return to their grooves, the steam and borrowed memories fade. Real wind moves through the pavilion.

Yixuan writes the creature’s name: the Faceless Nightmare. It weaves dreams from stolen sword intent and takes shape through human longing.
Ye Shunguang lifts the casket. “I can remember yesterday and still finish today’s bread. Let’s go.”
chapter.yunki.5.name: New Scars on an Old Casket
chapter.yunki.5.brief: Recover the heartwood and prepare 30 tools and supplies plus 1 amber shard to repair the same casket. Materials are consumed on submission.
chapter.yunki.5.reward: Repaired casket: base damage increases to 90–110. Receive the three formation talismans.
chapter.yunki.5.story:
The heartwood must be shaved thin and the amber ground fine. You spread out the tools and discover more wounds inside the casket than outside. Some are old. Others look as though something recently pushed against them from within.

“At least let me hold it,” Ye Shunguang says.
“You’ve held it all night.”
“It moves.”
The casket knocks once, conveniently supporting her argument.

She steadies it while you fit the wood. One strip sits slightly crooked. She notices but does not ask you to start again. Yixuan seals the seam with amber powder, carefully reconnecting the broken talisman lines.

The sky is pale before she puts down her brush. You push warm tea toward her and stop her reaching for another sheet.
“The rest can wait until you’ve rested.”
For once, she does not argue.

Ye Shunguang draws a clean ribbon of swordlight along the repaired grain. No borrowed voice remains within it.
Yixuan finishes her tea and gives you three talismans: form, heart, and homecoming.
“Tomorrow we set the formation. Let it face us openly.”
chapter.yunki.6.name: Qingming Unsheathed
chapter.yunki.6.brief: Visit the three ward sites. Submit when all wards are placed to break the final seal before facing the Nightmare.
chapter.yunki.6.reward: Unlock Qingming Unsheathed: once per battle, 2 AP / 10 fatigue, set stance to 6 and strike enemies within 2 tiles for 150% weapon damage. Use Reflection to enter Enlightenment. Sword form lasts this battle: 120–150 damage, 175% armor damage, 45% penetration, +15 accuracy. Active weapon attacks outside Enlightenment grant 3 stance each; Enlightenment never restores stance.
chapter.yunki.6.story:
The ward of form stills the mist. The ward of the heart burns, and the voices become painfully clear. Someone begs you to turn back. Someone says you are too late. Someone speaks only a name.

Beside the homecoming ward, you ring the bell. Ye Shunguang keeps her eyes on the newly repaired strip of wood.
“It’s still crooked.”
“I’ll fix it next time.”
“Leave it.”

The three wards join. Yixuan draws the final thread of nightmare mist from the casket. Something in the fog falls abruptly silent. Three pale lamps ignite behind the mountain gate.
“Shunguang. Draw your sword.”

The lid opens. Qingming settles into her hand, and six currents of sword intent fall into place. She steps forward. Clear blue light cuts through the fog, driving back the reaching shadows.

For the first time, you see the creature whole: armor without a face. Its stolen swordlight is gone. Only the nightmare lamps hold the darkness behind it together.

Ye Shunguang sheathes the sword, then draws it again, as naturally as though they had never been apart.
“It has lost the power it borrowed. Now it will fight desperately,” Yixuan says.
“Then let’s finish this.”
You tighten your grip on the bell and make room for the company.
chapter.yunki.7.name: One Sword Against the Nightmare
chapter.yunki.7.brief: Defeat the Faceless Nightmare. Each of its three lamps grants 20% damage reduction. Destroy them and heed the mist warning. Both companions must fight and survive.
chapter.yunki.7.reward: Yixuan gains the Yunki Oath: +20 maximum HP and +10 resolve. Unlock Sanctuary: once per battle, 3 AP / 0 fatigue, grant self and roster allies within 3 tiles a 40-point shield, reduce fatigue by 20, and refill Yixuan’s technique to 3. Ye Shunguang need not be present.
chapter.yunki.7.story:
The final lamp breaks. The faces within it drift away like paper ash. The Faceless Nightmare’s armor can no longer hold its borrowed voices. Qingming severs the black thread from crown to ground.

The mountain gate shakes. Yixuan stands at the homecoming ward, her talismans pulled taut by the wind. You brace her shoulder and shield her from the cold pouring between the stones.
“Didn’t I tell you to stay behind?”
You point to the talisman underfoot. “The ward is here. So is the road home.”

She says nothing more. A final light rises between you. The missing travelers cross the gate one after another. Some cry. Some look back in confusion. None answer the mist again.

Back at camp, the wine is less impressive than expected, but the hot soup disappears quickly. Ye Shunguang writes today’s date inside the casket, carefully avoiding the crooked repair.
“Don’t smooth that part away.”

By the fire, Yixuan replaces your torn ward. Two lines cross on the new paper; their final strokes meet.
“Some arts can only be used when you trust another person with your back.”
“And now?”
She looks up. “Now I can.”

You place this page at the end of the record and give it a title: The Yunki Exorcism Chronicle.
The last line counts no fallen monsters. It reads:

The sword rests in its casket. Every companion has returned.

chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line1: A merchant comes to the company with a rain-soaked cargo list. His wagons have vanished in the mountains. Ye Shunguang takes one look at the list and points to a drawing of a sword casket.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line2: Master, it's Qingming. I recognize that notch on the corner. I'm sure of it.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line3: Let's get the details first. Where was it found, and where did the wagons last stop?
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line4: The merchant says his drivers found the casket outside the northern ruins. They were due back two days ago. A searcher found an overturned wagon yesterday and saw several people walking into the mist. None answered his calls.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line5: I've been looking for it ever since we arrived in this world. So they found it... Master, let's go. The drivers might still be alive.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line6: Yes. Have the merchant write down everyone's name and how many were on the wagons. We'll need to account for them. The sword isn't all we're looking for.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.name: A Sound in the Casket
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line1: As the talismans are pinned down, the mist beneath the wagon recedes. You and Ye Shunguang lift the frame while Yixuan pulls the driver free and checks his injured leg.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line2: The wound hasn't reached the bone. We'll dress it first. Xiaoguang, the water.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line3: Here. Drink slowly. Don't try to stand yet. We've come to find your wagons.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line4: Once he catches his breath, the driver describes the ambush. The bandits took the cargo, pried open the long casket and removed a blue-green piece from the sword. Then a bronze bell rang, and his companions simply followed it away.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line5: You mean they didn't resist? They just went with them?
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line6: He heard his late wife calling to him. His trapped leg kept him from following. That bell makes people mistake things in the mist for someone they know.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line7: Ye Shunguang pulls the casket from beneath a broken plank. The familiar notch remains, but the clasp has been chiseled open. She wipes it with her sleeve and rests a hand on it. A brief metallic note answers from inside.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.name: Taking Back the Bell
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line1: Resistance at the shrine finally ends. Ye Shunguang kicks the loose weapons aside and helps you open a back room. Two bound workers are inside. Several names on your list are still unaccounted for.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line2: Master, these two don't seem wounded, but they won't stop shaking. Could you put the bell away? The sound frightens them.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line3: I've sealed it. Let them sit outside and get some air. Give them a moment before asking questions.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line4: Yixuan wraps the bronze bell in cloth. Fresh chisel marks score its rim, and a scrap of rotten sealing paper is caught beneath it. She lays the scrap beside the excavation notes found in the shrine.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line5: That explains it. These men broke into the tomb above us and removed its warding bell. The broken seal let the nightmare out. Then they ambushed the wagons.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line6: So the driver's wife, and the people who followed the voices... that was all its doing?
chapter.yunki.v2.3.name: A Steadying Note
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line1: Ye Shunguang steadies the bell with wooden tongs. Yixuan washes away the grime and applies freshly drawn talismans. The final rinse reveals the bronze beneath.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line2: Master, can I let go now? I'm worried I'll flatten it before we're done.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line3: You could have let go a while ago. Didn't you hear me ask for fresh water?
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line4: ...I thought you were asking the captain.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line5: Yixuan takes the bell and rings it gently. A worker who has been clutching his coat looks up and finally recognizes his companion. Until that moment, he says, he thought he was sitting outside his own home.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line6: It worked, Master. He's looking at us properly now.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.name: Beyond the Stone Gate
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line1: Once the priest falls, the soldiers blocking the gate stop moving one by one. Your company clears the shields away. Fresh footprints and a scrap of a worker's sleeve lie beside the wall.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line2: They came through here. The blood on the cloth is still wet. They can't be far ahead.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line4: I only knocked it against something. I can move it. Master, we should find the others first.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line5: Show me anyway. Your hand has been shaking against the casket.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line6: She finally releases her grip. Yixuan checks her wrist for a displaced bone, then examines the casket. A heavy axe has split its edge and torn through the sealing talisman.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.name: Repairs Beneath the Tree
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line1: Under the old tree, you pass resin and tools to Ye Shunguang. She holds the casket closed while Yixuan redraws its broken seals. Together you secure the clasps until light stops leaking from the cracks.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line2: Master, is this clasp secure now?
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line3: A little farther left. That's it. You can let go. Does your wrist still hurt?
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line4: It's better. I wasn't trying to hide it. I saw the blood, and I thought if we were too late, they might...
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line5: I'm worried too. But someone has to look after the wounded and keep this path clear. Otherwise we'll rescue one person and lose another on the way back.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line6: Then I'll stay where you can see me. And if you need help with the people behind us, call me. Don't try to take care of everything yourself.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.name: Breaking the Soul Array
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line1: The last line of the soul array is severed, releasing the light trapped over the altar. Ye Shunguang does not reach for the core at once. She first helps up a captive lying below the steps.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line2: Master, this one's breathing. There are others in the cave behind us. The captain should send someone to check.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line3: I'll tend to him. Sit down for a moment. You're pale. What did you see back there?
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line4: I saw you inside the array. You told me to leave everyone, take the sword and go. It even sounded like you.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line5: So that's why you stopped. What made you move again?
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line6: It kept hurrying me, but a wounded man was lying at its feet. If you'd really been there, you'd have been helping him, not telling me to take the sword.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.name: Qingming Restored
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line1: At the return ward, Yixuan rings the cleansed bell and draws the nightmare taint from the sword heart with talisman ink. Ye Shunguang steadies the casket, waiting for the signal before sending power into its broken pattern.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line2: Slowly, Xiaoguang. The first section has joined. Don't force the rest.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line3: Right... this part hasn't quite joined. Master, hold the right side steady.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line4: Yixuan pins the wavering talisman with two fingers. The final channel lights up, and this time the light holds. Ye Shunguang takes the hilt and slowly draws the complete Qingming blade.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line6: I see it. Ease your grip. Are you afraid it'll run off again?
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line7: A little. I've been looking for so long. Now it's back, I don't quite know what to say.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.name: Ending the Nightmare
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line1: When the Formless Nightmare falls, the mist finally clears. Yixuan rings the bell, and the people slumped against the wall begin to look up. You check every name on the list. This time, everyone is accounted for.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line2: Master, we've found everyone. Two over there can't walk. I'll help carry them.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line3: Wait. Let me check you first.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line4: I'm not hiding anything this time. My wrist is fine. That mark on my shoulder is only a scrape.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line5: She offers her hand and turns her wrist to prove it. After checking, Yixuan secures a loose strap. Ye Shunguang notices a burned hole in her master's sleeve.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line6: What about you, Master? You were awfully close when you stopped that last strike.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line7: Just a little burned cloth. I'll change when we're back. Weren't you going to help carry someone? Come on. I'll take the other end.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line8: Back at the old tree, the driver recognizes his companions and tries to stand. Yixuan settles him down. Ye Shunguang crouches beside him and counts off the news: everyone found, the cargo list recovered, even the missing packhorse brought back.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line9: Master, he says he'll buy us dinner in town. I didn't ask this time.
chapter.v2.goal.wreck_cart: Inspect the wreck and find the driver
chapter.yunki.v2.1.brief: Inspect the overturned wagon and prepare one nachzehrer teeth item and one spider silk to dispel the mist. Missing supplies can be recovered from the wagon reserve.
chapter.v2.goal.temple_victory: Recover the shrine bell with both companions alive
chapter.yunki.v2.2.brief: Take the bandit-held shrine, search for the missing drivers and recover the bronze bell. Yixuan and Ye Shunguang must fight and survive.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.brief: Examine the bell at the preparation site and prepare one poison gland to cleanse it. The shrine medicine chest provides a fixed reserve.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.reward: Start combat with 2 Sword Stance while wielding Qingming
chapter.v2.goal.stone_gate_victory: Break the stone gate formation with both companions alive
chapter.yunki.v2.4.brief: Defeat the ancient soldiers serving the Formless Nightmare and open the stone gate to follow the missing drivers. Yixuan and Ye Shunguang must fight and survive.
chapter.v2.goal.heartwood: Repair the casket at the ancient tree
chapter.yunki.v2.5.brief: Gather resin at the ancient tree, inspect the casket and retreat route, then submit 10 tools for repairs.
chapter.v2.goal.soul_array_victory: Destroy the soul-binding array with both companions alive
chapter.yunki.v2.6.brief: Defeat the soul array's guardians, free the captives beside it and recover Qingming's core. Yixuan and Ye Shunguang must fight and survive.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.reward: Reclaim the sword-heart; forge the complete blade next
chapter.v2.goal.ward_home: Prepare the final tempering at the returning ward
chapter.yunki.v2.7.brief: Use the bell to cleanse the recovered Qingming sword heart, check the return ward and complete the repair.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.reward: Permanently obtain the complete Qingming Sword; unlock Qingming Unsheathed
chapter.v2.goal.nightmare_victory: Defeat the Faceless Nightmare with both companions alive
chapter.yunki.v2.8.brief: Defeat the Formless Nightmare and rescue the remaining captives. Break its shielding lamps and avoid the marked ground. Yixuan and Ye Shunguang must fight and survive.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.reward:
Yixuan bond: Yunki Oath and Life Sanctuary
Unlock skin: Inkform Shadow

chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line7: You take the list and lead the company along the wagon tracks. At a fork, half a wheel emerges from the mist. A faint scratching comes from beneath the wagon, nearly drowned out by a distant bell.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line8: Someone's underneath it! Master, I'll lift the wagon.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line9: Wait, Xiaoguang. Look at the mist under the wagon. The wind isn't moving it. Whoever's in there may already be affected.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line10: Will a calming talisman help? I'll get things ready.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line11: Bring one nachzehrer teeth item and one spider silk. Ground teeth will anchor the talismans, and silk will link them. If supplies are short, check the driver's crate rather than keeping the wounded waiting.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line12: Captain, please arrange the supplies and keep watch on the road. If you hear someone calling from the mist, stay with the company.
chapter.yunki.v2.opening.line13: I'll stay here. Can you hear me under there? Hold on. We're getting you out.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line8: There you are. Master, could you take a look? Is the sword damaged?
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line9: The blade is here, but its core is gone. Drawing it now would split the channels further. We'll seal it for protection and repair it once we recover the core.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line10: Then I'll carry it like this for now. Bear with me, Qingming.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line11: You can still fight with it enclosed. Avoid taking heavy blows on it, especially along this edge.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line12: The driver points toward an old shrine on the slope. The bandits took their cargo there. He remembers one of them saying the sword piece had to be delivered to an altar farther up.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line13: Master, I'd like to try the shrine first. There may be survivors there, and someone may know where the core went.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line14: Agreed. Captain, see that the driver is cared for before we move out. Xiaoguang, stay with me. Don't pursue anyone into the shrine alone.
chapter.yunki.v2.1.line15: Understood, Master. I'll find something to support his leg.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line7: Yes. It's a Formless Nightmare. It uses familiar voices and faces to control people. The bandits delivered captives to it, along with Qingming's core.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line8: What can it do with the core?
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line9: The core holds power. It can use Qingming to spread the mist and lure people in from beyond the mountain. We need to recover it and find the remaining captives.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line10: A bound bandit comes to by the door, insisting that he remembers nothing. Ye Shunguang looks at him, then at the cut ropes from the back room.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line11: He was robbing people before the nightmare took him. Master, we can't just let him go, can we?
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line12: Of course not. Keep the survivors under guard and hand them over in town. Treat their wounds; that doesn't excuse what they did.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line13: Right. What about the bell? Would breaking it disperse the mist?
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line14: The nightmare has left the tomb. Breaking the bell won't stop it. It was made to ward off nightmares. Once cleansed, it can wake the people under its influence.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line15: Prepare one poison gland to mix a wash for the bell, then use my talisman ink to seal the taint. The shrine medicine chest has a reserve. Do not touch the poison directly.
chapter.yunki.v2.2.line16: I've got it, Master. Call me when you're ready. I'll hold it steady.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line7: Keep the bell in the middle of the company and stay close. If you hear other voices, check who's beside you and listen for this note. It can clear your head. It won't stop a blade.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line8: Then I'll watch the path ahead. Qingming has settled too. Did the bell suppress the taint in the casket?
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line9: It did. You won't have to keep fighting it when you use the sword. Try gathering your stance. Slowly.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line10: Ye Shunguang sets her feet and lifts the casket. This time, the light travels the length of its channels instead of scattering at the cracks. She exhales and secures it on her back.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line11: The recovered worker sketches the route he remembers: behind the shrine stands a stone gate guarded by dead men in armor. The other drivers were taken through it.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line12: Master, the gate's too narrow. We'd be caught between them if we pushed straight in. I'd like to take a few people around the flank and break up their shield wall.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line13: Good. I'll watch their rear for anyone casting. Don't go too wide. If you lose sight of the company, stop and wait for me.
chapter.yunki.v2.3.line14: All right, Master. The captain has the bell. We'll keep to the plan.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line7: The axe was aimed at someone carrying a wounded man. I was closest. There wasn't time to do anything but block it.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line8: I saw. You were right to stop it. But tell me when you're hurt. I don't want to find out in the next fight that you can't hold your sword.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line9: ...Understood, Master. The casket needs repairing too, doesn't it?
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line10: Yes. Until we have the core, another split could damage the blade inside. There's shelter beneath that old tree ahead. We'll stop there.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line11: Scratched lettering remains on the inside wall. Yixuan makes out a warning: the altar robs the living of their senses and commands the tomb's dead. Drag marks lead in its direction.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line12: The core should be that way. It's taking people to the altar to keep feeding the array.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line13: Then we must not go in with a broken casket. Commander, prepare ten tools. We can gather hardened resin by the old tree, seal the cracks and secure the clasps before seeking the sword heart.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line14: I'll renew the trail marks so the others can find us. Then I'll sit down. I won't wander off.
chapter.yunki.v2.4.line15: Come on, then. I'll go with you.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line7: All right. I'll take your advice this time.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line8: Yixuan shares out the remaining warm water. The rescued driver can now sit against the tree. He asks after his companions by name and only accepts a bowl once he hears that some of them are safe.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line9: Master, once we've found everyone, perhaps they could show us around town. I still don't know where to get a decent meal.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line10: Let's get them home first. Then ask about food. If you're hungry now, there's bread in the bag.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line11: I know. I wanted him to hear that we're still planning to go back together.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line12: Yixuan glances at the driver and fastens the waterskin without hurrying her. The repaired casket now holds steady under Ye Shunguang's grip. The path behind you has been marked for those bringing up the rear.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line13: We'll move when everyone's ready. The soul array surrounds the altar and drives both the dead and the phantoms. Break it before taking the core. Don't reach for anything offered from the mist.
chapter.yunki.v2.5.line14: Yes, Master. I'll watch the flank, you watch our rear, and the captain can support us from the middle.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line7: Yixuan pauses briefly, then loosens the wounded man's collar and asks you to support him.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line8: I'm glad you recognized it. If you're unsure next time, call for me. I'll answer.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line9: I will, Master. You can call for me too.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line10: Once the altar is safe, Ye Shunguang takes the core and fits it back into the casket. Half the channels light up, then go dark. A ring of black residue clings to the join.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line12: It's been powering that array for too long. The taint is still inside. Don't draw it yet. I need to clean the core and restore the channels, or we'll have broken the array for nothing.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line13: Bring the bell and sword heart to the return ward. The bell will reveal the remaining taint, and the ward will help remove it. You will take up the sword while I hold the formation.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line14: All right, Master. Let's get the rescued people back to the tree, then gather what we need. We have Qingming back. We can finish the repair properly.
chapter.yunki.v2.6.line15: You check off the newly rescued people. A few are still missing, taken into the deepest burial chamber. Mist continues to flow from its stone doorway. The Formless Nightmare is still there.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line8: Then put it away safely for now. You'll have plenty of time with it. You don't need to say everything today.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line9: Ye Shunguang tests the blade and sheathes it with her usual sure movement. You lay out the scouts' report: three dark lamps stand inside the deepest chamber, with the captives trapped behind them.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line10: Do we reach the people first, or break the lamps? If it uses them to block us...
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line11: We'll cover each other. While someone reaches the captives, we keep it occupied. The three lamps shield it from damage. Break them when you can; don't waste every strike on its body.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line12: Mist will mark the ground before its strike lands. Move when you see it. Don't stay just to squeeze in another hit.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line13: Understood, Master. And don't spend all your strength protecting us. Call me to switch places if you need to.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line14: I will. Xiaoguang, Captain, keep an eye on each other in there. Once we have everyone, we're going down the mountain.
chapter.yunki.v2.7.line15: You secure the bell at your waist and wait until the company is ready before opening the burial chamber. Ye Shunguang and Yixuan enter on either side of you. Qingming's light reaches the last of the missing drivers.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line10: I heard. Let him get that leg healed first.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line11: Back at camp, Yixuan changes out of the scorched coat into the dark outfit she brought with her. Beside the fire, Ye Shunguang cleans Qingming and carefully wraps the repaired casket.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line12: Captain, may I have your hand? Thank you for taking the time to care for the wounded, and for looking after Xiaoguang.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line13: She draws a talisman inside your bracer, then adds matching marks to the company's protective gear. Once dry, the ink leaves only a faint trace, with nothing to hinder movement.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line14: I've left you a protective mark. Next time we fight together, it will help me shield the company from a blow you can't avoid. Having it isn't a reason to stop dodging.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line15: That last part was meant for me too, wasn't it?
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line17: Ye Shunguang smiles, fastens her bracer and gets up to serve the meal. She gives Yixuan the first bowl, then brings another portion to the injured driver.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line18: Master, let's travel with the wagons tomorrow. They still need to fix that axle, and someone should stay with them on the road.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line19: All right. You sleep first tonight. I'll take the early watch.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line20: Then wake me for the late watch. Promise, Master. Don't stay up until dawn on your own again.
chapter.yunki.v2.8.line21: Yixuan agrees and passes her the empty bowl. On the back of the cargo list, you record the recovered people and goods. Only after the wounded are settled does the camp finally grow quiet.

chapter.painted_harbor.name: The Painted Harbor and the Last Lantern
chapter.painted_harbor.description:
A damp ferry ticket. A harbor trapped in its lantern festival.
Join Abigail and Hokusai to bring the people inside the painting home.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.name: The Damp Ticket
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line1: After three traders vanished, the guild brought you a ferry ticket still dripping seawater. Its destination was White Tide Harbor, destroyed by fire twelve years ago.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line2: That shine on the paper is not water. It is paint, still wet.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line3: Someone is knocking from the other side... Very softly, but they have not stopped.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line4: Between the charred ferry posts, lantern light revealed a street that should not exist. A sweet seller repeated the same greeting, again and again.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line5: Beautiful work. But if a painting refuses to let its visitors leave, we should have a word with its painter.
chapter.painted_harbor.opening.line6: Captain, let us take a real lantern inside. Then we will know the way home.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.name: Waves on Paper
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line1: Cloth supports the damaged paper, and the ticket fits the entrance pattern. Hokusai smooths the final crease, and the landing settles firmly behind you.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line2: This lantern is warm. But none of the street lanterns can light my hand.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line3: Borrowed light cannot cast a living shadow. Abby, stay near our lantern.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line4: She drew a line pointing out of the ticket. Behind a warehouse door, someone coughed, unmistakably alive.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line5: It is the person asking for help. Not one of those repeating shadows.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.line6: People first, paintings later. Someone in that warehouse is collecting an entrance fee.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.name: The Living in the Warehouse
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line1: The smugglers fell, and the pale figures slumped like wet paper. The first missing trader huddled beside crates that cast no shadows.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line2: Do not be afraid. Take my hand. Can you remember your name?
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line3: He answered, but light still passed through his fingertips. The ledger listed no weights, only colors: the gold of laughter, the red of blood, the blue of living eyes.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line4: They are selling people as pigments. Even a perfect painted exit cannot return what has been stolen.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line5: The ledger named Evan, the lantern keeper, as recipient. His old home stood beneath the clocktower.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.line6: Then we must find their colors too. Every last one.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.name: Twelve Years at the Window
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line1: Solvent recovered from the pigment warehouse removes the fresh paint. The girl at the window still waits for her father, without breathing or growing older.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line2: She remembers lanterns, sweet cakes, and her father holding her hand... But there is nothing after those memories.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line3: Someone has traced these memories for twelve years. No amount of care can make the paper live her tomorrow.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line4: A fire report lay behind the canvas. Evan had lost his daughter and bought pigments that should not exist. That was when the Curator in his painting learned to demand more.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line5: I will not tell him she has come back. That would leave someone else trapped here.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.line6: First we cut the threads feeding this painting. They are still pulsing beneath the clocktower.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.name: The Street That Cannot Change
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line1: The tower guards broke and the pigment channels stopped. For the first time, the festival music failed to begin on cue.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line2: Evan emerged from behind the clock. He did not ask for mercy, only whether the lamp at the window would go out.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line3: I know you miss her. But the people in the warehouse have families waiting too.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line4: You can keep her portrait. You cannot fill her yesterday with other people's tomorrows.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line5: He handed over the portrait gallery key. The Curator no longer obeyed him; it had collected every living name into its master scroll.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.line6: Please help us find the way. And we cannot hide what happened from anyone.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.name: A Space for Tomorrow
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line1: Hokusai steadies the paper on the repaired easel and measures the charred beams. She neither restores the burnt railings nor paints the broken piles as flowering trees.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line2: This is the exit. Ugly or incomplete, it must lead somewhere that truly exists.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line3: You have left such a large empty space here.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line4: For tomorrow. We only learn the next brushstroke after we step outside.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line5: Night air drifted through the makeshift studio. Loosening her ink-stained sleeve, she smiled back and asked you to hold the paper corner. Her little octopus stole the brush first.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.line6: Do not just stare, Captain. This painting is only finished once everyone comes home.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.name: Give Their Names Back
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line1: The last gallery guard fell. Color followed the names back into living bodies: not only the three traders, but travelers never entered in any ledger.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line2: One face, one name. Count the people before us, not the guild's list.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line3: I heard her. The girl at the window can only speak words from that day... She is not here waiting to be rescued.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line4: Evan tried to object, then crouched and pressed his paint-covered hand to the floor. Nobody softened the truth for him.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line5: It is not wrong to miss her. But we must take home the people who are still frightened, still hungry, still hoping.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.line6: Their colors are back. Abby, now we open their door.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.name: A Door Only for Home
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line1: The portraits and names identify those who must return, and the surveyed coordinates anchor the threshold. Abigail sees something beyond it waiting for her to call its name.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line2: If I stayed behind to hold it open...
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line3: No. I have not painted your part yet. This door is for everyone, and that includes you.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line4: You took the lantern and helped her turn the key toward home. Hokusai added a stroke to the threshold. Real waves sounded beyond the paper.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line5: Then I will open it only for the journey home. No bargain. Nobody left behind.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.line6: Evan severed the final thread feeding his daughter's portrait. Deep in the master scroll, the Faceless Curator rose.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.name: The Last Lantern
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line1: The Curator's blank mask cracked and the painted harbor faded. You led everyone across the real threshold before the illusion could collapse around them.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line2: One more count. The cloth merchant, the lady with the scarf... Hokusai, Captain. Yes. Everyone is here.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line3: Evan left the ferry last, carrying the real lantern. He would face the guild's inquiry and account to the survivors for every transaction.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line4: This one is for you. A piece of railing is missing and the sky is uneven. You will have to forgive the artist.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line5: But everyone is in it, and there is a road beyond. This is my favorite.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line6: By the campfire, the little octopus refused to leave the soup pot. Dawn lit the blank space on the paper. Nobody needed to be painted exactly the same ever again.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line7: Captain, where are we going tomorrow? I will take good care of the lantern.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.line8: Anywhere will do. We will paint the next stroke when we get there.
chapter.painted_harbor.reward.cg: Unlock this chapter’s character CG in the Gallery.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage1.brief: Compare the ticket and painted entrance. Submit one cloth-roll item to back the damaged paper and stabilize the entrance.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage2.brief: Defeat the warehouse guards and rescue the first trader. Abigail and Hokusai must participate and survive.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage3.brief: Remove the fresh paint with the recovered solvent and compare the old painting with the fire records. No stash supplies are consumed.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage4.brief: Cut the clocktower’s pigment supply. Both companions must participate and survive.
chapter.painted_harbor.reward.stroke: Hokusai learns A Human Brushstroke: once per battle, the first successful ink application gains one extra stack on that target, up to three.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage5.brief: Survey the real ruins and draw the exit coordinates. Submit 5 tools to secure the measuring rig and easel.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage6.brief: Recover every captive’s portrait and name. Both companions must participate and survive.
chapter.painted_harbor.reward.prayer: Abigail learns Homeward Prayer: the first prayer each battle additionally removes 10 Fatigue from each eligible recipient.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage7.brief: Match the recovered portraits and names, then align the threshold with the surveyed exit so everyone can return home.
chapter.painted_harbor.stage8.brief: Defeat the Faceless Curator and lead the living home. Both companions must participate and survive.
chapter.cg.painted_harbor.lantern.title: First Lanterns
chapter.cg.painted_harbor.lantern.captio: Abigail and Hokusai carry a real lantern into an impossible harbor.
chapter.cg.painted_harbor.painter.title: Ink Still Wet

chapter.cg.painted_harbor.homeward.title: Only a Way Home

chapter.cg.painted_harbor.ending.title: The Last Lantern
chapter.cg.painted_harbor.ending.caption: Beyond the paper lies a tomorrow they can share.
chapter.cg.yunki.tea.title: Rain beneath the Eaves
chapter.cg.yunki.tea.caption: During a quiet rest, Yixuan offers a cup of warm tea.
chapter.cg.yunki.sword.title: Qingming Lights the Night
chapter.cg.yunki.sword.caption: Qingming lights Ye Shunguang’s eyes and the path she has chosen.
chapter.cg.yunki.dawn.title: Dawn at the Mountain Gate
chapter.cg.yunki.dawn.caption: As night gives way to dawn, they remain beside each other.

skill.painted_harbor_human_stroke.name: A Human Brushstroke
skill.painted_harbor_human_stroke.descri: Once per battle, after an active attack hits and successfully applies Ink, add one extra Ink stack to that surviving target, up to three. Only one target benefits. Misses, kills and failed applications do not consume this effect.
skill.painted_harbor_homeward_prayer.des: The first prayer each battle additionally removes 10 Fatigue from every eligible recipient who receives its prayer effect.
enemy.painted_harbor.puppet.name: Wet Ink Puppet
enemy.painted_harbor.curator.name: Faceless Curator
enemy.painted_harbor.claw.name: Scrape Color
enemy.painted_harbor.claw.description: The painted creature tears at an adjacent target with pigment-soaked arms.
enemy.painted_harbor.curator.description: Every second normal turn, marks one original puppet with wet ink. If it dies before the end of its next turn, a half-health copy appears on the Curator’s next turn; copies cannot replicate. At half health or less, every second turn marks a fixed line for Whitewash: 35 HP damage and 15 Fatigue on its next turn. Leave the marked tiles to evade it.
enemy.painted_harbor.wet.name: Wet Ink
enemy.painted_harbor.wet.description: If killed before the end of its next turn, the Curator creates a half-health copy next turn. Copies cannot replicate.
enemy.painted_harbor.whitewash.name: Whitewash Warning
enemy.painted_harbor.whitewash.descripti: Whitewash strikes the marked stationary tiles at the beginning of the Curator’s next turn. Move off the ground marks to escape.
enemy.painted_harbor.warning: The Curator is preparing Whitewash along the marked line. Leave the marked tiles!
enemy.painted_harbor.archivist.name: Portrait Collector
enemy.painted_harbor.archivist.descripti: At half health or less, summons three puppets on its next normal turn. Once per battle.
chapter.painted_harbor.ending: The painted harbor has faded and the living have returned home. A Human Brushstroke and Homeward Prayer are unlocked, with four character CGs in the gallery.
chapter.silent_city.name: An Encore for the Silent City
chapter.silent_city.description: Join Robin and Togawa Sakiko to trace Bellspring’s subterranean echoes and bring music back to the square. Eight chapters, four battles.
chapter.silent_city.ending: The tunnels are sealed. Residents may sing, applaud, or simply listen. Three chapter CGs and completed dialogue remain available for replay.
chapter.silent_city.opening.name: A Trial Without Applause
chapter.silent_city.opening.line1: The bellspring tower has no clapper. Mia closes the last auditorium window and hands the captain the merchants’ investigation fee.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line2: She asks for no dangerous concert, only one quiet phrase from Robin. When it ends, a mother gently catches her child’s hands before he can clap.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line3: What frightened you about that little phrase?
chapter.silent_city.opening.line4: The child looks at the tower. “Not the song. I’m afraid it will hear us liking it.”
chapter.silent_city.opening.line5: No more trials yet. There is still a sound beneath the floor.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line6: I have stopped. Something is still answering.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line7: Sakiko closes the score and asks Mia to take everyone outside. The captain posts guards and checks the door below the stage.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line8: First the stage and the old copper pipes. No public rehearsal until it is safe.
chapter.silent_city.opening.line9: Once we know why it answers, we can decide where the next phrase belongs.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.name: A Trial Without Applause
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line1: Tools secure the loose stage supports, and chalk marks the vibrating floorboards. The investigation can finally proceed under guard.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line2: These are not drains. They carry low notes to the tower, then into the rock.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line3: So brief speech is harmless, but a sustained note wakes something.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line4: Mia brings an incomplete repair receipt: old plans, removed pipe mouths and sealed instruments are in the outlying storehouse.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line5: We need the whole route. Blocking this end would leave the next mining shift at risk.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line6: Captain, bring shield bearers to the storehouse. We are collecting plans, not testing sounds on the townspeople.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line7: Outside, the child asks when clapping will be safe. Robin kneels and promises to return after the inspections.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.line8: You do not have to prove you are brave. Wait for our news.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.name: The Sealed Instruments
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line1: After the storehouse beasts fall, wind continues to hum through a cracked copper pipe.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line2: They gathered here, not by the cash box. This note attracted them.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line3: When we stop the pipe, the little scratching inside stops too.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line4: The captain orders the pipe wrapped and the shelves searched. Gray quarry dust lies beside the old plans.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line5: The theater, tower and old drain. Three routes meet beside the mine.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line6: Let us take the repairable instruments out first. This room need not stay a tomb.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line7: Mia accepts a little drum with a cracked rim. The young drummer Noel still remembers the score played during the attack.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.line8: Find a room disconnected from these pipes. Repair the portable keyboard; we will compare the score there.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.name: The Rest in the Score
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line1: With the portable keyboard repaired, Sakiko verifies that the room is disconnected. The captain guards the door for a brief rehearsal.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line2: Noel stops at the same beat every time. Sticks suspended, he says, “Again. I will keep up this time.”
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line3: Wait a moment. Does your hand hurt, or does this part bring something back?
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line4: Noel says nothing. Sakiko turns the old score and marks that beat clearly.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line5: Rest here. Come back in when I raise my hand.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line6: “That makes it different from before,” Noel murmurs.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line7: Yes. We are rehearsing this time.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line8: I will wait for that signal too. You need not chase the whole piece alone.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line9: Next time, the drum returns steadily after the pause. Comparing the old bass passage with the plans reveals the drain entrance.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.line10: You did not play it wrong. Something underground was listening. We must investigate it.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.name: The Audience Beneath the Floor
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line1: The drainage beasts are cleared. Beyond the broken copper pipe, mine air carries a deeper echo.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line2: Those scrape marks are too high. The creatures we fought were not the largest.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line3: It has reached beneath the houses. Removing one pipe will not make them safe.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line4: A miner warns that collapsing this tunnel would damage the foundations of the houses above.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line5: Then draw its answer outside town, into open ground with escape routes and visible lines.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line6: The public concert must wait. We and the company will handle the dangerous performance.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line7: The captain tells Mia what was found, including the nearby leader. She points to the abandoned quarry outside town.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.line8: Inspect it first. We will not need audience seating.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.name: A Stage in the Wind
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line1: Miners mark safe ground while the captain arranges shields, ropes and retreat routes. Quarry wind flips half the score.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line2: They will not hear quiet instructions out here.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line3: The captain replies, “We have signals. Stop, reposition, fall back. We practice them.”
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line4: Then I watch her, and she watches you. Someone must always see the next step.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line5: Stand here. I can see you too.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line6: Sakiko turns the stand and rewrites the bass part lost in the wind. Robin tests one phrase, then stops to check her breath.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line7: This distance is enough. We need not spend all our strength merely to be louder.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line8: Noel offers to help. They ask him to count in camp rehearsals and make clear that he will not join the lure.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line9: Save your opening beat for a safe stage. Leave this place to us.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.line10: One short trial now. When the captain signals stop, we stop together.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.name: The First Ensemble
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line1: Nest guards follow the brief trial into the quarry. The company holds the side paths, revealing the direction of the main nest.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line2: When the line shifted right, you changed the accompaniment.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line3: The old interval would have made you turn to find me. I chose one you could enter directly.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line4: I heard it. It was not our rehearsal passage, but I knew where the next phrase could land.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line5: The captain checks the retreat route. The shields held their ground, and the miners’ guide rope remains intact.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line6: This was not about who could endure longest. Everyone carried their part.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line7: One final preparation remains. Let us tell each other where we will need a hand.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.line8: A deep answer rises from the cavern. They pack their instruments and do not pursue it underground.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.name: A Beat Left for You
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line1: The resonance platform and escape ropes are checked. There is no audience for this rehearsal; everyone practices the stop signal first.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line2: Holding this phrase longer should draw it to the entrance.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line3: Do not hold it. I will take the next part.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line4: Will that disturb the original entry?
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line5: Better change it now than when you cannot breathe. If you miss the entry, look at me. We stop together.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line6: Sakiko adds two bars and sets water beside the keyboard. Robin nods and entrusts the strained phrase to her.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line7: Then leave yourself a little room for the next change of tone too.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line8: I will. The first beat need not use everything.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line9: The captain confirms the plan: during the lord’s charge, three different company members attack to break its rhythm. Otherwise, move beyond its two-tile wave.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.line10: We are ready. Not to sing until we collapse, but to know someone will take the next phrase.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.name: An Encore for the Silent City
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line1: The Hollow Echo Lord falls. Miners seal the cleared connection, and Mia and the captain inspect every pipe before returning the performance to town.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line2: Noel gives the first beat himself. Some sit near the stage; others listen from a distance or through a partly open window.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line3: Being here to listen is enough. You need not respond as anyone expects.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line4: Watch my hand. Just as we rehearsed.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line5: When the piece ends, the square rests in silence. Nobody hurries Noel or demands applause.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line6: The child from the trial claps once. His mother looks at the tower: no rumble, no falling stone. Her shoulders relax, and she adds the second clap.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line7: Applause gathers slowly, leaving room for those who listen quietly. Mia first asks whether the performers have strength for more.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line9: The one from rehearsal. Let him give the first beat.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line10: Sakiko opens the much-revised practice score. Robin nods to Noel, and the breeze carries his first drumbeat across the square.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.line11: This time, we sing for those who choose to stay.
chapter.silent_city.tools_source: Buy tools and supplies at town markets; deducted from company tools.
chapter.silent_city.reward.story: Advance the story and unlock this scene for replay.
chapter.silent_city.stage1.brief: Investigate the hum at the hall and submit 10 tools to reinforce the stage.
chapter.silent_city.stage2.brief: Clear the storehouse and recover plans and instruments. Robin and Sakiko must fight and survive.
chapter.silent_city.stage3.brief: Repair the piano with the recovered parts and plans, then find the missing beat. No tools are consumed.
chapter.silent_city.stage4.brief: Clear the tunnels and trace the pipes to the mine. Both protagonists must fight and survive.
chapter.silent_city.stage5.brief: Survey the quarry; submit 15 tools and one spider silk to secure the platform and retreat ropes.
chapter.silent_city.stage6.brief: Defeat the nest guards drawn by the trial and test the retreat route. Both protagonists must fight and survive.
chapter.silent_city.reward.growth: Unlock: Hear Your Breath and Begin on This Beat.
chapter.silent_city.stage7.brief: Run the closed rehearsal and check positions and the route out, gaining both growth rewards before the final battle.
chapter.silent_city.reward.ending: Unlock both chapter skins and the encore CG; skin delivery waits if the stash is full.
chapter.silent_city.stage8.brief: Defeat the Hollow Echo Lord and submit. Both protagonists must fight and survive before the town concert can begin.
chapter.silent_city.cg.rest.title: The Rest in the Score
chapter.silent_city.cg.rest.caption: A pause is not failure. Wait for her hand, then enter the next beat together.
chapter.silent_city.cg.handoff.title: A Beat Left for You
chapter.silent_city.cg.handoff.caption: No need to sing to exhaustion. Someone will take the next phrase.
chapter.silent_city.cg.encore.title: The First Encore
chapter.silent_city.cg.encore.caption: Nobody was hurried into applause. The first clap came all the same.
skill.silent_city_robin_breath.name: Hear Your Breath
skill.silent_city_robin_breath.descripti: Robin only. The first successful Winged Sunny Song each battle restores 5 additional fatigue to its existing eligible recipients. Invalid casts do not consume it; rebuilding skills does not reset it.
skill.silent_city_sakiko_entry.name: Begin on This Beat
skill.silent_city_sakiko_entry.descripti: Togawa Sakiko only. The first successful tone switch each battle costs 1 less AP. Fatigue, once-per-round switching and Fever rules are unchanged. Cost previews do not consume it; rebuilding skills does not reset it.
enemy.silent_city.beast.name: Resonance Beast
enemy.silent_city.lord.name: Hollow Echo Lord
enemy.silent_city.resonance.name: Resonance and Broken Rhythm
enemy.silent_city.resonance.description: Charges every four rounds, leaving one full intervening round before releasing on its first action two rounds later. The wave deals 25 fixed HP damage and 20 fatigue within two tiles. During charging, direct active attacks dealing armor or HP damage from three different living player-roster members cancel the wave and reduce both defenses by 20 until its scheduled release. One count per attacker; counters, opportunity attacks, follow-ups and fixed bonus damage do not count. Kill it directly or move beyond two tiles.
enemy.silent_city.resonance.broken: Rhythm broken: -20 melee and ranged defense.
enemy.silent_city.resonance.interrupted: The Hollow Echo Lord’s charge is interrupted!
enemy.silent_city.resonance.release: The Hollow Echo Lord releases its two-tile wave!
enemy.silent_city.resonance.warning: The Hollow Echo Lord begins charging: a two-tile wave releases on its first action two rounds from now. Three distinct attackers can interrupt it!

skin.robin_wind_encore_skin.description: Chapter attire earned by completing An Encore for the Silent City. Cosmetic only.

chapter.grey_falcon.name: Grey Falcon Pass: The Last Order
chapter.grey_falcon.description: Enterprise and M4A1 uncover a withheld withdrawal order and bring home a garrison already listed among the dead.
chapter.grey_falcon.ending: The garrison has reached safety. The receiving town is auditing the ledgers, wages and compensation. The fallen will not be forgotten.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.name: Alive on the Casualty Roll
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line1: The wounded soldier tumbled down the snowy slope and asked whether the grain was for the pass. The captain found the name he had just given on the casualty roll.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line2: When did you last receive supplies? Take your time. Keep your hands under the blanket.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line3: “Since the clock stopped, we count the days by what is left in the pot.” The soldier clutched a sweat-soaked appeal for help.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line4: The seal is unbroken. He came to deliver a letter, not collect compensation for his own death.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line5: The captain sealed the chest and receipt. The order to burn the old records would wait until the rightful recipients were established.
chapter.grey_falcon.opening.line6: We go up first. Bring them food, and find out who is still waiting beneath that flag.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.name: Alive on the Casualty Roll
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line1: An oil lamp lit the aid post. Wounds were dressed and bread was broken into small pieces for those who could sit up.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line2: Ronne signed the appeal. The list includes civilians and stretcher bearers as well as soldiers.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line3: They are waiting to be relieved. The roll below has already declared them dead.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line4: The captain compared both lists, retained the originals and asked the soldier for the route. The garrison could no longer clear the checkpoint.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line5: I will check the road. Before we engage, give them a chance to explain and let us through.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.line6: Agreed. Set the scouting limit and withdrawal signal first. I will cover you from where you can see me.
chapter.grey_falcon.source.bread: Buy at town markets; each whole inventory item counts as one.
chapter.grey_falcon.source.medicine: Replenish company medical supplies at town markets or temples.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage1.brief: Investigate the aid post and submit 2 bread items and 10 medical supplies. The sealed compensation fund is not used for rewards.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.name: A Barricade of Their Own
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line1: The blockade invoked quarantine, but its officer ordered a volley at the messenger. The company broke the barricade and detained those who surrendered.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line2: The crossbowmen above have stopped firing. I will clear the near side; bring the supply cart through.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line3: Do not chase beyond the bend. Our objective is the supply route.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line4: The officer carried a different order: no living person or old ledger was to leave the pass. A prisoner said his briefing had mentioned only disease.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line5: Record what each person knew and did. One statement cannot establish everyone’s responsibility.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.line6: Keep that order with the appeal. The people above are their own, being held behind a blockade.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage2.brief: Defeat the blockade. Enterprise and M4A1 must both fight and survive.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.name: The Last Pot of Soup
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line1: The repaired stove no longer leaks smoke. An old belt is set aside, and soup made from the first ration delivery passes down the table.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line2: Give my portion to the wounded. I can still keep going.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line3: Give it to them. Leave the bowl here.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line5: It is saving your place. Sit with us when you are done and warm your coat.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line6: They sat beside the stove. M4 removed her wet gloves and Enterprise moved the bowl closer. Nobody insisted she eat; the place simply belonged to her.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line7: Ronne produced the hold order. The quartermaster’s assistant brought the original ledger: his superior had been killed on the road, and another courier was held at the station.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.line8: We find the courier and verify the armistice. Getting everyone out requires facts, and a road they can use.
chapter.grey_falcon.source.tools: Replenish company tools at town markets.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage3.brief: Use the first ration delivery for soup and submit 10 tools to repair the stove and stretchers.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.name: The Withheld Armistice
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line1: After the fight, the station gates opened. The courier recovered the withdrawal order from a locked storehouse, its envelope still stained from his arrest.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line2: It is dated ten days ago. The transport record confirms when he was detained.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line3: An armistice copy from a neutral abbey confirmed the date. Hermann’s diverted grain manifests explained why Grey Falcon had been reported destroyed.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line4: They charged the missing grain and relief funds to the pass, then planned to erase the witnesses.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line5: Ronne admitted that waiting would cost more lives. The captain sent copies of the ledger, testimony and armistice to a town willing to receive the wounded.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line6: With the evidence beyond the pass, the pursuers cannot burn every trace in one battle.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.line7: The main road is exposed. Survey the quarry road. The evacuation cannot wait here while we improvise.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage4.brief: Rescue the courier and recover the withdrawal order. Both protagonists must fight and survive.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.name: A Road for Tomorrow
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line1: Tools repair the damaged road, and the stretcher teams follow the authorized route. The commander spreads out two deployment maps and finds different names beside the final defensive line.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line2: I can maintain fire at close range. Enterprise should go first so she can support us later.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line3: Your ammunition is finite too. Leave that position to me.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line4: The captain crossed out neither name, but placed a pencil between them. “Add the relief. Who gives the signal, who receives you? Write it down.”
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line5: After the last strike, I fall back to you. Two signals; if we cannot hear them, withdraw at the agreed time.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line6: Understood. I will leave room for you, and name the next relief.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line7: Shoulder to shoulder, they completed the map. Coats rested on chair backs; neither kept insisting on being the last one left.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.line8: That is an order people can come home under. We both follow it.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage5.brief: Check the recovered retreat order, survey the quarry road and submit 15 tools to reinforce the evacuation route.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.name: Reinforcements Who Stopped Waiting
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line1: The pursuing vanguard blocked the exit. While the company engaged it, Ronne led the walking soldiers in clearing rubble and lowering the first stretcher.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line2: The near side is clear. Take the stretchers slowly; your relief is below the slope.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line3: I see the receiving flag. Keep the route open so the front group does not have to turn back for the rear.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line4: The evidence messenger returned with the town’s receipt. Beds and shelter were ready, but Hermann’s personal troops were approaching the final pass.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line5: They are no longer just waiting for reinforcements. Someone stepped forward for every stretcher.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.line6: Show Ronne the receipt. People are waiting at the other end. Now we keep our promise.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage6.brief: Defeat the vanguard blocking the exit. Both protagonists must fight and survive.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.name: The Last Order
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line1: The survivors answer the roll, and the retreat order passes to the escorts. Roen takes down the old banner, folds it carefully and places it in his pack.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line2: “Wounded first. Two walking men to each stretcher. Cover teams relieve on signal.” Asked about the pass, Ronne replied, “Our watch is over. Bring them down.”
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line3: My sorties are limited. After the first strike, confirm the return route and recover the airwing for its next assignment.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line4: I will fit my first tactical reload into the relief window. Ammunition and reserves still count; our cover must not lapse.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line5: The captain repeated the signal and relief time. Both confirmed their withdrawal positions without moving their names to the rear.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.line6: Ready. Watch the near side; I will watch the far side. We relieve together, on time.
chapter.grey_falcon.reward.growth: Enterprise: Return Route; M4A1: Covering Reload
chapter.grey_falcon.stage7.brief: Reconcile the survivor register, hand over the retreat order and confirm the assembly. Submission unlocks both permanent growth rewards.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.name: Beyond the Pass
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line1: The pursuers were defeated. Hermann could no longer close the pass with an order. Each wounded survivor crossed the receiving line and had their name checked by both teams.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line2: Enterprise, your relief position is ready.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line4: The captain is checking. According to the plan, you come to me now.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line5: Enterprise lowered her bow and came down. Back at camp she removed her gloves and noticed her trembling hands only when soup arrived. M4 steadied the bowl.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line6: The next watch... someone has taken it, haven’t they?
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line7: The handover is complete. This table is your place now, too.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line8: The first messenger borrowed pen and paper but could not find a beginning. M4 placed ink beside him. “Start by saying you are alive.”
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line9: The sealed chest went to the auditors. Survivors would recover their names and unpaid wages. The fallen remained on the roll, with compensation due to their families after verification. The investigation continued.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line10: Some will never return. Record their names correctly, and the names of those who came home today.
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.line11: A fresh watch took its post outside. Firelight warmed their resting shoulders as the first letter home finally began.
chapter.grey_falcon.reward.ending: Snowline Homecoming and Armistice Day skins, plus the ending CG
chapter.grey_falcon.stage8.brief: Break through Hermann and his pursuers. Suppress the crossbowmen or kill the commander to end Focus Fire. Both protagonists must fight and survive.

chapter.grey_falcon.cg.hearth.caption: A bowl, a chair and time to rest belong to a comrade too.
chapter.grey_falcon.cg.relief.title: Write the Return into the Order
chapter.grey_falcon.cg.relief.caption: Two plans become one, with a relief assigned for everyone.
chapter.grey_falcon.cg.homecoming.title: Someone Has Taken the Watch
chapter.grey_falcon.cg.homecoming.captio: After the handover, there is finally time for a letter home.

skill.grey_falcon_return_route.descripti: After the first valid airstrike resolves each battle, recover 1 sortie, up to 3. Misses count as a sortie; no valid targets or caster death do not trigger it. Does not reset the round limit or Decisive Airwing. Rebuilding skills or changing equipment does not reset usage.
skill.grey_falcon_cover_reload.name: Covering Reload
skill.grey_falcon_cover_reload.descripti: The first valid reload each battle costs 1 less AP. Standard and armor-piercing reloads share the use. Unloading, reserve expenditure and loading work normally. Invalid reloads do not consume it. Changing equipment or rebuilding skills does not reset usage.
