enemy.grey_falcon.guard.name: Blockade Shield Guard
enemy.grey_falcon.billman.name: Blockade Billman
enemy.grey_falcon.arbalester.name: Command Crossbowman
enemy.grey_falcon.focus.name: Focus Fire
enemy.grey_falcon.focus.description: Each round Hermann marks one visible enemy within 7 tiles. For the rest of that round, his command crossbowmen within 6 tiles gain 10 Ranged Skill against the marked target. Grants no extra attacks. Ends immediately if Hermann dies.
chapter.blackgold.name: The Blackgold Auction and the Thirteenth Forgery
chapter.blackgold.description: A debt signed after its issuer died leads Silver Wolf and Kafka to an auction of living people. A false name buys entry; a way out must include everyone.
chapter.blackgold.ending: The deeds are restored and the witnesses leave safely. Silver Wolf remembers an exit for a third person; Kafka entrusts her own escape to her companion.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line1: A widow in Mistbridge produces a debt dated three days after the mayor’s burial. Mia, a bookbinder’s apprentice, recognizes her master Rutt’s old binding thread.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line2: A dead man signs, the living pay. That is a profitable exploit.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line3: And Mr. Weiss is auctioning the debts tomorrow evening. Our employer brought two blank invitations.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line4: Blank invitations, exactly two places. Too convenient. I dislike it.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line5: Then let us see what he intends to sell. Bring the company, and a way out.
chapter.blackgold.opening.line6: Mia asks for no blind trust: only her master and the original deeds. The two accept a commission, not a predetermined ending.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.name: Rehearse Your False Names
chapter.blackgold.alias.ash: Lady Adela and the Grey Finch
chapter.blackgold.alias.rose: Lady Rosa and the Silver Fox
chapter.blackgold.clue_escape_route.line: The narrow stair only works for me. Keep this freight route for the whole company.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.brief: At the riverside inn, choose aliases and inspect the company’s alternative exit. Aliases only change later forms of address.
chapter.blackgold.reward.story: Investigations consume no materials. Each protagonist earns 1 Perk point on each battle-stage submission.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line1: Kafka holds the invitation to the candle. She will play a mine-owning widow, Silver Wolf her appraiser. The chosen aliases go into the register.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line2: I memorized it. What does your mine produce?
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line3: Enough to pay an appraiser. Now, once more.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line4: Silver Wolf marks the narrow kitchen stair, then crosses out a one-person railing and adds a freight route wide enough for the company.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line5: This route is slower, but nobody has to stay behind.
chapter.blackgold.stage1.line6: Good. You have remembered tonight’s most important line.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.name: The Box Worth Stealing
chapter.blackgold.goal.depot_clear: Recover the toolbox and transfer slip
chapter.blackgold.stage2.brief: Field Silver Wolf and Kafka and keep both alive. Defeat the depot’s 16 guards to recover the toolbox and transfer slip.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line1: After the guards fall, Silver Wolf ignores the gilded chests and kneels by a paste-stained toolbox. The transfer slip calls it scrap.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line2: I will hold the lamp. Which piece is worth something?
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line3: The awl, the spool, the worn finger guard. Whoever earns a living with these would never call them scrap.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line4: A backstage transfer slip lies beneath the tools, bearing the invitation’s seal. Mia’s old thread remains wound around a broken awl.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line5: It seems our invitation is for more than placing bids.
chapter.blackgold.stage2.line6: Then let us note who expects payment. Keep the light still. One lock left.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.name: Two Extra Place Settings
chapter.blackgold.clue_table.line1: Silver Wolf counts fourteen settings for twelve registered guests. The extra seats have no name cards.
chapter.blackgold.clue_accounts.line1: The accounts show a deposit on lot thirteen without a buyer’s name. Someone has already bid for us.
chapter.blackgold.clue_plinth.line1: Behind the curtain are two empty name frames. A service-contract registration number is engraved on the base.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.brief: Investigate the table, accounts window and thirteenth plinth in the same banquet hall. Record all three clues before submitting; you may leave freely.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line1: The table, accounts and empty plinth agree: twelve registered guests, fourteen place settings, and one unnamed lot.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line2: Those two extra places are not for late arrivals.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line3: A thoughtful host. He even prepared seats for his prey.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line4: {alias}. As the waiter addresses them, Kafka takes a jam pastry from the silver tray and folds it into a napkin.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line6: Investigating will not conjure dinner. Half is yours when we return.
chapter.blackgold.stage3.line7: Silver Wolf writes the final observation on the invitation. They leave with three clues, keeping their knowledge to themselves.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.name: Every Key Is Genuine
chapter.blackgold.goal.vault_clear: Find the rebound deeds and wage note
chapter.blackgold.stage4.brief: Field both protagonists and keep them alive against the ledger vault’s 17 guards. The three keys are genuine; so are the alarm wires.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line1: The vault guards are defeated. Three keys open three locks, but Silver Wolf stops at the threshold and lifts the alarm wires behind them.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line2: The keys are genuine. Whoever gave them to us really wants us inside.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line3: As for leaving, he likely has other arrangements.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line4: A supposedly decade-old ledger uses new thread. A wage note dates the day Rutt was forced to rebind the deeds.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line5: They rewrote the accounts and forgot to pay the craftsman. Better than a password.
chapter.blackgold.stage4.line6: Find him first. Let him tell us which page belongs to whom.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.name: An Exit for a Third Person
chapter.blackgold.clue_witness.line1: Kafka helps the injured Rutt stand. Recognizing his toolbox, he points out where he hid the original deeds.
chapter.blackgold.clue_originals.line1: The witness takes the originals. Copy these internal accounts for their most conspicuous display case.
chapter.blackgold.goal.third_exit: Prepare a route for the injured witness
chapter.blackgold.clue_third_exit.line1: No railing jumps. The cargo bridge is slower, but I can support him. Include that time.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.brief: At the underground workshop, help Rutt, recover the original pages and plan a route an injured witness can use.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line1: Rutt’s injured leg cannot cross Silver Wolf’s planned railing. She studies the map and quietly erases the fastest route.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line2: A way out for two does not work for three. I missed that.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line3: Add him now. You find the route; I will support him.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line4: The original deeds lie under the press. Rutt identifies their owners. Silver Wolf copies the corrupt internal accounts for the display case; the witness keeps the originals.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line5: Let the buyers read the seller’s secrets. Faster than shouting.
chapter.blackgold.stage5.line6: Provided we also get the man who wrote them out alive.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.name: The Thirteenth Forgery
chapter.blackgold.stage6.brief: Field both protagonists and keep them alive against 18 backstage guards. The trap never removes your equipment or inventory.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line1: The backstage ambush is defeated. Weiss’s forged service contract lists the two guests as the thirteenth lot.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line2: He told us to put down our weapons. His expression when I set down my wineglass was amusing.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line4: When the joke ends, Silver Wolf tightens her grip on the route sheet. Her timing nearly left Rutt behind the door.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line5: I mistimed that. I thought I could fix it alone.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line6: Tell me sooner next time. You do not have to repair every mistake alone.
chapter.blackgold.stage6.line7: They agree on a new bridge signal. No one is disarmed, and a forged paper makes no one merchandise.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.name: Leave Your Escape to Me
chapter.blackgold.goal.evidence_safe: Secure the deeds and account copies
chapter.blackgold.clue_evidence_safe.lin: Mia checks the bindings and gives copies to two townspeople. Losing one will no longer leave Weiss’s account unchallenged.
chapter.blackgold.goal.witness_safe: Evacuate the witness across the bridge
chapter.blackgold.clue_witness_safe.line: The company escorts Rutt over the bridge. Mia takes his hand on the far bank. The witness is safe.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.brief: At the cargo bridge, secure the evidence and evacuate the witness. There is no timer; resupply whenever needed.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line1: The original deeds and the witness are across. Kafka withdraws to the bridge’s center, where the cargo lever jams behind her.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line2: Stay there. Leave your escape to me.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line3: Silver Wolf wedges the invitation’s metal seal into the lever, changing position with Kafka’s offered hand. She does not jump ahead to safety.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line4: This time, I will listen to you.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line5: Both sides are secured. Come over on three.
chapter.blackgold.stage7.line6: The river wind catches their evening clothes. They stand on the same bank, without invitations but with a real road ahead.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.name: This Auction Is Closed
chapter.blackgold.goal.yard_clear: Defeat Weiss and end the auction
chapter.blackgold.stage8.brief: Field both protagonists and keep them alive against the cargo yard’s 15 enemies, including Weiss. There are no reinforcements.
chapter.blackgold.reward.ending: Each gains 1 Perk point; unlock both independent memories, both Blackgold Soiree skins and the ending CG.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line1: Weiss falls in the cargo yard. His final offer to bribe the witnesses is trampled into mud. The deeds return to their owners; copies circulate among the buyers.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line3: Before leaving with Rutt, Mia gives Silver Wolf a repaired finger guard. She asks only that the books they bind from now on be honest.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line4: Honest books still require wages. Do not forget that part.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line5: At the inn, Kafka unfolds the napkin. The pastry is crushed, but she divides it carefully beside the chessboard.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line6: The half I promised you. Your move.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line7: One condition: no thirteenth lot in this game.
chapter.blackgold.stage8.line8: Kafka smiles and nods. Silver Wolf places a piece, leaving her opponent a way out.
chapter.blackgold.cg.banquet.title: Two Extra Place Settings
chapter.blackgold.cg.banquet.caption: Three clues, and a pastry saved for the way home.
chapter.blackgold.cg.bridge_handoff.capt: The witness crosses first. Then hold your companion’s hand.
chapter.blackgold.cg.ending.title: No Lots in This Game
chapter.blackgold.cg.ending.caption: A crushed pastry still divides in two. The board holds a way out.

chapter.blackgold.growth.kafka.descripti: Once per battle, successfully issuing the friendly Your Turn directive and surviving the complete action removes 10 Fatigue. Does not refund AP or directives. Silver Wolf need not be present.
chapter.blackgold.weiss.name: Weiss, Keeper of Contracts
chapter.blackgold.bid.name: Raise the Bid
chapter.blackgold.bid.description: On his first turn each round, Weiss grants one hostile guard +20% weapon damage until his next normal turn. Control or death of either participant clears it.
chapter.blackgold.collection.name: Personal Collection
chapter.blackgold.collection.description: At the next normal turn after reaching half health, stop bidding and gain +15% weapon damage and -10 Melee Defense for this battle. No health or armor is restored.
chapter.spring.name: Spring Will Pass Through Here
chapter.spring.description: Castorice and Hyacine escort an old gardener to Whiteflower Waystation, learning to care, to say goodbye, and to return together.
chapter.spring.ending: The alien flowers are gone. The plants by the window still need care. You promise to visit again.
chapter.spring.opening.name: A Cart of Seeds
chapter.spring.opening.line1: The old gardener Mare loads grain and ordinary flower seeds onto the cart. He can afford half a deposit for an escort to Whiteflower Waystation.
chapter.spring.opening.line2: I have brought medical supplies too. Sit comfortably; we will take care of the road.
chapter.spring.opening.line3: Mare says the patients have been sleeping poorly. His own chronic illness has been treated for years, with regular visits from a physician.
chapter.spring.opening.line4: Did you choose all these seeds yourself?
chapter.spring.opening.line5: "Yes. Whoever sits by the window will be able to see them bloom." Mare smooths the manifest without urging the cart onward.
chapter.spring.stage1.name: White Flowers off the Manifest
chapter.spring.stage1.line1: White flowers have spread from the drains into the courtyard, while the listed seeds remain sealed. Lya moves the new patients away from the flowers.
chapter.spring.stage1.line2: Boil the water first, and store medicine separately from food. Keep away from these flowers for now.
chapter.spring.stage1.line3: There are things in this soil that do not belong in a garden. The roots follow the old waterway.
chapter.spring.stage1.line4: You deliver grain and medicine and mark the unsafe ground. Lya recognizes the sign for the old watermill.
chapter.spring.stage1.brief: Visit the waystation; deliver a sack of grain and 10 medical supplies.
chapter.spring.reward.story: Continue the waystation's care and investigation
chapter.spring.source.medicine: Buy medical supplies in settlements; uses the company's medical reserve.
chapter.spring.source.grain: Buy a sack of grain at a settlement market.
chapter.spring.stage2.name: Along the Old Waterway
chapter.spring.stage2.line1: The root-bound guards fall. You lift each nameplate from the mud beside the sluice and wrap it separately.
chapter.spring.stage2.line2: These names must not be thrown away. When we find the cemetery, I will take them home.
chapter.spring.stage2.line3: The waterway is open. I will bring clean water and medicine back first.
chapter.spring.stage2.line4: The roots did not grow from the flower seeds. A storm broke the old battlefield cemetery's drainage wall and carried them here.
chapter.spring.stage2.brief: Deploy Castorice and Hyacine; both must survive the battle at the watermill.
chapter.spring.reward.battle: One perk point for each companion
chapter.spring.stage3.name: A Little Green by the Window
chapter.spring.stage3.line1: Clay pots warm on the repaired windowsill. Raised beds with fresh soil stand apart from the contaminated drains; the seeds are stored dry.
chapter.spring.stage3.line2: We can put a leafy plant here. Rest whenever you are tired; you need not wait for flowers.
chapter.spring.stage3.line3: Mare asks Lya to note how much water to use. The flowers did not cause his old illness, and his physician has promised no cure.
chapter.spring.stage3.line4: This chair can stay here for whoever needs it afterward.
chapter.spring.stage3.line5: The breeze lifts their sleeves. Hyacine settles the wrap over Castorice's shoulder, and they quietly watch the unflowering leaves.
chapter.spring.stage3.brief: Deliver 10 tools to repair the windowsill and build isolated flowerbeds.
chapter.spring.source.tools: Buy tools and supplies in settlements; uses the company's tool reserve.
chapter.spring.stage4.name: Names Unearthed
chapter.spring.stage4.line1: With the courtyard roots cut, an old register emerges beneath a lifted slab. You match remains to names and mark burial places.
chapter.spring.stage4.line2: They need not rise again. We have heard them.
chapter.spring.stage4.line3: This path leads to the nursery. Before we return, let me check everyone's injuries.
chapter.spring.stage4.line4: The map reveals the main roots' course. Rather than press deeper immediately, you bring the legible names back.
chapter.spring.stage4.brief: Both companions must fight and survive in the cemetery; recover the nameplates and grounds map.
chapter.spring.stage5.name: Write Down What Remains
chapter.spring.stage5.line1: The nameplates and cemetery map are matched, and the care book passes to its new keeper. Mare writes down unfinished tasks: which pot needs less water, which window should open in the afternoon.
chapter.spring.stage5.line2: Take today's medicine as your physician prescribed. We have time to listen.
chapter.spring.stage5.line3: Lya reads the notes aloud. Mare corrects a flower name. That night someone holds his hand, while another closes the draughty window.
chapter.spring.stage5.line4: Mare dies peacefully with company. His illness does not vanish by a miracle. At dawn, you leave time to say goodbye.
chapter.spring.stage5.line5: Let us stay with him for a while today. The garden can wait until tomorrow.
chapter.spring.stage5.brief: Match the nameplates and map recovered from the cemetery, then arrange Mare's care and the garden handover.
chapter.spring.stage6.name: Still in Need of Water
chapter.spring.stage6.line1: The nursery's branch roots are cleared. Castorice retrieves a crystal from a root knot; Hyacine checks it can be purified before sealing it away.
chapter.spring.stage6.line2: Sit down for a moment. I can see your hands trembling.
chapter.spring.stage6.line3: Just for a moment, then. There are people waiting for us.
chapter.spring.stage6.line4: Hyacine adjusts her collar and bandages beside her. Back at the waystation, the old cup is still in its place, and Lya waters the seedlings from the notes.
chapter.spring.stage6.line5: No one becomes another Mare. But the garden still needs water, and someone is willing to tend it.
chapter.spring.stage6.brief: Both companions must fight and survive at the nursery; recover a crystal for purification.
chapter.spring.stage7.name: We Are Both Going Back
chapter.spring.stage7.line1: The smith sets the purified crystal into the prepared scythe frame. Hyacine tunes the energy along the blade and ties a green ribbon in place.
chapter.spring.stage7.line2: This circuit catches the escaping power. It needs neither your blood nor anyone else's life.
chapter.spring.stage7.line3: Springkeeper... it does not mean keeping someone here forever, does it?
chapter.spring.stage7.line4: It means those who return will have a place to sit. That includes you.
chapter.spring.stage7.line5: Castorice tests the new scythe; petal-like light spills along its edge. Hyacine withdraws her hand and insists she finish the warm tea first.
chapter.spring.stage7.line6: This time, we are both going back.
chapter.spring.stage7.brief: Purify the crystal recovered from the nursery, complete Liuchun and promise to return.
chapter.spring.reward.growth: Springkeeper and two permanent growth skills
chapter.spring.stage8.name: Spring Will Pass Through Here
chapter.spring.stage8.line1: The Carrion Bloom Mother falls, and its parasitic roots wither. You clear the contamination, bury the remains, and place ordinary flower seeds in Lya's hands.
chapter.spring.stage8.line2: Those hurt by the parasite can begin to recover. Their existing illnesses still need care and medicine.
chapter.spring.stage8.line3: Mare's remaining money and gardening notes return to the waystation. Everyone sows fresh seeds; no flowers spring up overnight.
chapter.spring.stage8.line4: When we next visit, let us look at them together.
chapter.spring.stage8.line5: Yes. Write when things are hard, and save us a little time in the window seats.
chapter.spring.stage8.line6: At dusk they change into lighter clothes in the clean courtyard. A lamp glows by the window. Lya sets down the watering can; tomorrow has work of its own.
chapter.spring.stage8.brief: Both companions must fight and survive the Carrion Bloom Mother; bury the remains and sow new seeds.
chapter.spring.reward.ending: Two commemorative skins and the ending gallery

item.castorice_liuchun.description: A two-handed scythe forged at Whiteflower Waystation, fitted with a purified crystal and Hyacine's green ribbon. When equipped by Castorice with positive durability, Cocoon Drain costs 0 hitpoints. It neither transfers harm nor takes allies' lives.

skill.spring_liuchun_strike.description: A normal adjacent melee attack dealing 100% weapon damage, 150% armor damage and 25% armor penetration.
skill.castorice_cocoon_drain.tooltip.liu: Springkeeper flow: costs 0 hitpoints. Other costs and Newbud gains are unchanged.

enemy.spring.root_beast.name: Root Beast

effect.spring.parasite.name: Root Parasite
effect.spring.parasite.description: Lose 8 hitpoints at the start of your next three normal turns. The mother heals by the actual hitpoints lost. Feather Rescue cleanses it; the mother's death removes it immediately.
effect.spring.embrace.name: Root Embrace
effect.spring.embrace.description: Roots shield the flower: +25 melee and ranged defense until the mother's next normal turn.
effect.spring.controller.name: Carrion Bloom Pulse
effect.spring.controller.description: Every other round, inflicts non-stacking Root Parasite on up to two enemies within six tiles and gains Root Embrace temporarily.
chapter.royal_tide.name: The Royal Banner and Returning Tide
chapter.royal_tide.description: Enter White Tide Fortress with Cerydra and Hysilens, end an order without release, and open a way home.
chapter.royal_tide.ending: The old oath is ended and the lighthouse returned to its people. Beneath the royal banner, the tide welcomes those who return.
chapter.royal_tide.opening.name: The Old Royal Seal
chapter.royal_tide.opening.line1: The tide washed an old command seal into camp. Its banner belonged to no living sovereign, yet the distant lighthouse still flashed its orders.
chapter.royal_tide.opening.line2: Caesar, the signals at White Tide Fortress have never stopped. Someone is asking the sea for help, while someone else calls every departing ship a deserter.
chapter.royal_tide.opening.line3: Sword-Banner Duke, first we find who is still giving orders. Captain, hold our evacuation route. We will bring those inside home.
chapter.royal_tide.opening.line4: The captain agreed. Hysilens opened her chart, and Cerydra weighted its corner with the seal. They had always known where the other would stand. Now they needed a way back.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.name: Orders Brought by the Tide
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.line1: Repair tools reached the seawall. Every fragment repeated the same order: Hold until the king returns. No retreat. Beneath the tide marks, there was no release.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.line2: Caesar, spears block the main causeway. The abandoned watercourse will take us to the cells first.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.line4: The waterline, the footholds, the distance to our support. All marked here.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.line5: Then we follow your chart. Sword-Banner Duke, lead on.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.line6: She crossed out the original frontal approach without qualification. As Hysilens folded the chart, her fingertip rested briefly beside the new line.
chapter.royal_tide.source.tools: Buy tools at settlements or recover them as loot.
chapter.royal_tide.stage1.brief: Examine the orders at the seawall and prepare bridge repairs. Hysilens has found a route around the spear line to reach the keeper.
chapter.royal_tide.reward.story: Advance the story and reveal the next location.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.name: The Sword-Banner Crosses the Causeway
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.line1: The last ancient shield fell on the causeway. Freed from his cell, the keeper clutched an unlit lantern and kept apologizing.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.line2: Save your breath. Our people are beyond the seawall. You can reach them.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.line4: A shallow cut. I can still hold my sword.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.line5: I was not asking about the sword. Let me see the wound when we reach the lighthouse.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.line6: Hysilens answered softly. Cerydra let her continue helping the keeper, but eased their pace.
chapter.royal_tide.stage2.brief: Deploy Cerydra and Hysilens together, defeat the causeway guards and rescue the keeper. Both must survive.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.name: One Lamp, Two Sea Charts
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.line1: The grain went to the wounded. One lamp remained in the watchroom. Cerydra cut away the bloodied sleeve and wound the bandage firmly, gently.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.line4: She loosened it by half a finger. Hysilens kept her hand still until the last fold was smoothed, then replaced Cerydra’s cold tea with warm water.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.line5: The keeper repaired an external signal cable. He thought he was restoring the light. Instead, he woke the fortress oath.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.line6: He never ordered anyone imprisoned. This is not his guilt to bear. We will find the core that refuses to stop.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.line7: Under the lamp, two charts became a single route. Steam rose from the cup; the end of the bandage still rested in Cerydra’s palm.
chapter.royal_tide.source.grain: Buy a whole grain supply item at a settlement.
chapter.royal_tide.stage3.brief: Shelter the keeper and wounded at the lighthouse. Submit 10 medicine and one grain item, then compare the charts.
chapter.royal_tide.cg.lamplight.title: A Way Home by Lamplight
chapter.royal_tide.cg.lamplight.caption: Under the lamp, two charts became a single route. Steam rose from the cup; the end of the bandage still rested in Cerydra’s palm.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.name: The Army Forbidden to Return
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line1: Silence returned to the muster courtyard. Inside a stone coffer lay unsigned withdrawal permits. The wounded had been crossed back onto the rolls again and again.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line2: The last king never returned. The order still demands that everyone wait.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line3: An order that never allows its soldiers home has lost its claim to obedience.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line4: The east corridor still carries its signal. Cut the outer circuit there and the core cannot wake the dead beyond the seawall.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line5: The east corridor is yours to judge. If the route changes, do not wait for my permission.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.line6: Hysilens gathered the withdrawal rolls. That permission appeared on none of the old orders, yet it was clearer than any royal seal.
chapter.royal_tide.stage4.brief: Both companions must fight and survive in the muster courtyard to recover withdrawal records and plans of the oath core.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.name: The Tide Beyond the Royal Tent
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line1: Evacuation records and core plans lie inside the royal tent. Hysilens finishes marking the cutoff and return route, then shifts Cerydra's position slightly out of the wind.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line2: I cannot see the whole eastern line from here.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line3: But you will see my signal. Caesar, leave that stretch to me.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line4: Cerydra studied her, then left the mark where Hysilens had placed it. Beyond the curtains, the tide sounded closer than it had by day.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line5: Keep half an hour after the battle. No reports, no charts.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line7: Only the tide. Sword-Banner Duke, that is a promise too.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.line8: They sat together at the tent opening, moonlight catching their boots. The tide came and went; half an hour in the future now belonged to them both.
chapter.royal_tide.stage5.brief: Compare the evacuation records and core plans, then mark the signal corridor cutoff. No supplies are consumed.
chapter.royal_tide.cg.tidewatch.title: Tide Beyond the Tent
chapter.royal_tide.cg.tidewatch.caption: They sat together at the tent opening, moonlight catching their boots. The tide came and went; half an hour in the future now belonged to them both.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.name: This Move Is Yours
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.line1: Broken stairs forced a change of route in the signal corridor. Hysilens raised the agreed signal and turned west without going back for permission.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.line2: Caesar, take the western stairs. The outer circuit is cut. I will meet you at the next landing.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.line3: I see it. This move is yours.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.line4: Cerydra cleared the western stairs with the relief party. Their blades met the same line at the landing as the last command lamp on the wall went dark.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.line6: I know. You brought it back.
chapter.royal_tide.stage6.brief: Both companions must fight and survive in the signal corridor to sever the outward command circuit. There is no split party or tide timer.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.name: Those Who Return, Words Unfinished
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line1: Medicine and grain were placed along the retreat route, and the sword’s repairs were complete. Cerydra checked the bandage on Hysilens’s shoulder before lifting the restored scabbard.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line2: Returning Oath. The old binding is gone. What remains is for its wielder to decide.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line4: The old one caught your sleeve. Bring it back after the battle.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line5: She did not release it at once. The scabbard lay between them, still warm from the forge.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line6: Together with the one who carries it.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line7: Yes, Caesar. And tonight, I will stay until we finish the chart.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.line8: There was no distance left for awaiting orders. Hysilens drew her chair closer, and Cerydra moved the lamp where both could see.
chapter.royal_tide.stage7.brief: Restore Returning Oath with the core parts recovered from the Signal Gallery and 10 Tools and Supplies. The weapon and both companions' growth rewards arrive before the final battle.
chapter.royal_tide.reward.growth: Learn both growth skills and receive Returning Oath; delivery waits if the stash is full.
chapter.royal_tide.cg.oath_blade.title: The Blade and Its Returning Bearer
chapter.royal_tide.cg.oath_blade.caption: There was no distance left for awaiting orders. Hysilens drew her chair closer, and Cerydra moved the lamp where both could see.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.name: The Royal Banner and Returning Tide
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line1: The Last Oath Regent fell. No order of succession followed. Cerydra stopped the core herself, bringing its endless vigil to an end.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line2: A royal banner should not hold everyone in the past. Those who can return, go home. Those whose journey is over, rest.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line3: The residents took the lighthouse keys. At dawn, the two changed out of their sea-soaked battle clothes and returned to the seawall. No one interrupted their promised half hour.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line4: Caesar, the wind is rising again.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line5: She reached to fasten Cerydra’s cloak. Another hand settled over her fingers and lingered longer than the clasp required.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line6: Then sit a little longer, Sword-Banner Duke. Today the tide calls no one to war.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.line8: The royal banner stirred behind them. Side by side, they listened to the returning tide until the first boat of the living left the harbor.
chapter.royal_tide.stage8.brief: Both companions must defeat the Last Oath Regent and his finite garrison and survive to stop the core. A fallen anchor can only be replaced on the Regent’s next normal turn.
chapter.royal_tide.reward.ending: Each companion gains 1 perk point. Unlock Tidal Regalia and Returning Sword-Banner.
chapter.royal_tide.cg.ending.title: The Banner and Returning Tide
chapter.royal_tide.cg.ending.caption: The royal banner stirred behind them. Side by side, they listened to the returning tide until the first boat of the living left the harbor.
skin.cerydra_tidal_regalia_skin.name: Tidal Regalia
skin.cerydra_tidal_regalia_skin.descript: After the White Tide oath ended, a quiet tide remained for those who came home.
skin.hysilens_returning_sword_banner_ski: After the White Tide oath ended, a quiet tide remained for those who came home.
item.hysilens_returning_oath.name: Returning Oath
item.hysilens_returning_oath.description: The reforged scabbard bears a clasp that will no longer catch a sleeve. Any bearer may use Returning Tide Slash. Only Hysilens wielding this unbroken blade empowers erosion and Crystal Tide: 3 turns, -15 melee/ranged defense, +25% damage received, 35/15 fixed follow-up damage from owner/allied hits, and 10 fixed turn-end damage. Crystal Tide applies erosion first, then attacks each enemy for 150% weapon damage with an extra +20 hit chance. Unequipping or breaking the blade returns existing erosion to base strength and caps remaining duration at 2 turns.
skill.royal_tide_cerydra_growth.name: A Royal Order That Hears the Tide
skill.royal_tide_cerydra_growth.descript: Recover 5 fatigue after the first successful Royal Edict: Next Move each combat. This does not change Edict costs or reset extra-action limits.
skill.royal_tide_hysilens_growth.name: Returning to the Banner
skill.royal_tide_hysilens_growth.descrip: Recover 5 fatigue after the first successful Crystal Tide each combat. Equipment changes, skill reconstruction and extra actions do not reset this limit.
skill.royal_tide_slash.name: Returning Tide Slash
skill.royal_tide_slash.description: Strike an adjacent enemy for 100% weapon damage using a normal hit roll. Costs 4 AP and 12 fatigue; gains the weapon’s +15 hit chance. Available to any bearer, without granting erosion or Crystal Tide.
skill.royal_tide.crystal_upgrade: Returning Oath: apply empowered erosion to every enemy in the area, then attack each for 150% weapon damage. Weapon accuracy +15, plus an extra +20; misses do not trigger erosion follow-up damage.
effect.royal_tide.defense: Melee and ranged defense reduced by 15.
effect.royal_tide.fixed_damage: Suffer 10 fixed hitpoint damage at turn end.
effect.royal_tide.followup: After a damaging hit, the erosion owner adds 35 fixed damage and their allies add 15. This follow-up cannot trigger itself.

enemy.royal_tide.spearman.name: White Tide Ancient Spearman
enemy.royal_tide.regent.name: Last Oath Regent
effect.royal_tide.fortified.name: Hold and Succeed
effect.royal_tide.fortified.description: At the start of each normal turn, choose a living Tide-Oath Guard within 2 tiles as anchor. While the anchor remains within 2 tiles, gain 20 melee and ranged defense. Killing or drawing away the anchor removes the bonus; replacement waits for the Regent’s next normal turn. No reinforcements or invulnerability.
effect.royal_tide.fortified.inactive: No valid anchor; the defense bonus is inactive.

chapter.grail.name: The Unclaimed Grail and Four Oaths
chapter.grail.description: Four invitations lead four companions to a city powered by borrowed wishes. Rescue its people and restore each companion’s right to choose.
chapter.grail.ending: All four returned to the campfire. Keep the Grail until ready; only one wish can be confirmed.
chapter.grail.stage1.name: Four Unsigned Invitations
chapter.grail.stage1.line1: Four invitations lie on the shelter table. Medicine and bread go to the wounded before the four companions compare their titles.
chapter.grail.stage1.line2: It calls me a king who never retreats. Behind that gate are people who only want to go home.
chapter.grail.stage1.line3: An unsigned contract usually charges someone else. We inspect its conduits first.
chapter.grail.stage1.line4: The wounded can stay here. I will dress their wounds. No one must suffer to prove their faith.
chapter.grail.stage1.line5: Four letters, four assigned endings? Fine. Let their author explain in person.
chapter.grail.supplies: Purchase in settlements or collect as loot. Consumed on submission, not investigation.
chapter.grail.stage1.brief: Compare the invitations and register the wounded outside the city. Submit 10 medical supplies and one whole bread item to shelter them.
chapter.grail.stage2.name: The Crown That Would Not Fall
chapter.grail.stage2.line1: The blockade fell. The first wagon of wounded civilians rolled through the open gate.
chapter.grail.stage2.line2: I protect them so that they can leave. I will not turn this wall into their gravestone.
chapter.grail.stage2.line3: The gate was only a terminal. The circuit still feeds on their wishes.
chapter.grail.stage2.line4: Let the children and wounded pass first. We will be the last to leave.
chapter.grail.stage2.line5: Do not thank the statues. Thank the people pushing your wagon.
chapter.grail.stage2.brief: Break the blockade. All four companions must fight and survive.
chapter.grail.stage3.name: Lights Beyond the Court
chapter.grail.stage3.line1: Morgan draws the diversion plan on the table. Tools remove the dangerous links, and ordinary wicks replace lamps dependent on the Grail.
chapter.grail.stage3.line2: They wanted an eternal fuel source. I will give them lamps ordinary people can maintain.
chapter.grail.stage3.line3: That means you can leave as well.
chapter.grail.stage3.line4: The houses outside the chapel are lit. Their families can finally sleep.
chapter.grail.stage3.line5: A queen teaching people to replace a wick. Better than the Grail’s hymns.
chapter.grail.stage3.brief: Trace the circuit shared by homes and the palace, plan independent lighting, and submit 15 tools for the conversion.
chapter.grail.stage4.name: The Saint Who Refused the Chair
chapter.grail.stage4.line1: The penitential chair’s chains snapped. The transferred pain ceased with the machinery.
chapter.grail.stage4.line2: I choose to help. That does not give you the right to nail everyone’s suffering to me.
chapter.grail.stage4.line3: This time you leave through that door with us.
chapter.grail.stage4.line4: The replacement circuit is stable. Shutting this down will not hurt the city.
chapter.grail.stage4.line5: You heard her. She said no. Stop pretending you cannot understand.
chapter.grail.stage4.brief: Sever the chapel machinery that transfers suffering to the saint. All four must fight and survive.
chapter.grail.stage5.name: Testimony for the Living
chapter.grail.stage5.line1: The original petitions asked for missing relatives. The Executor copied every name into a death warrant.
chapter.grail.stage5.line2: This is not revenge. It is murder signed with someone else’s name. I will not light its fire.
chapter.grail.stage5.line3: The witnesses are ready to speak. We will take the originals home.
chapter.grail.stage5.line4: Keep separate copies. Truth should not depend on one easily burned page.
chapter.grail.stage5.line5: Now we know who still needs rescuing.
chapter.grail.stage5.brief: Recover original petitions, verify forged verdicts, protect the witness and separate the copies. No supplies are consumed.
chapter.grail.stage6.name: Burn the Borrowed Oaths
chapter.grail.stage6.line1: The Wishforged Guards shattered. The four effigies went dark, releasing the names they had stolen.
chapter.grail.stage6.line2: A king is not a wall without a gate.
chapter.grail.stage6.line3: A queen is not a tool to be consumed and discarded.
chapter.grail.stage6.line4: Even a saint may say she is tired.
chapter.grail.stage6.line5: And an avenger needs no automatic execution list. I have questions for that empty shell.
chapter.grail.stage6.brief: Break the four effigies and defeat their Wishforged Guards. All four must fight and survive.
chapter.grail.stage7.name: Four Freely Made Decisions
chapter.grail.stage7.line1: By the fire, they set aside their dusty cloaks. No ritual bound them here, yet four hands rested on the same map.
chapter.grail.stage7.line2: I will lead the way. Please leave a road home for me too.
chapter.grail.stage7.line3: Wards, evacuation routes, spare lamps: all checked. No one offers herself as payment tonight.
chapter.grail.stage7.line4: Not because I must become someone. Because, today, I choose to walk with you.
chapter.grail.stage7.line5: There had better be a hot meal when we return. Four portions. No exceptions.
chapter.grail.growth: Each learns to recover 5 fatigue after her signature action, once per battle.
chapter.grail.stage7.brief: Use the true register to confirm the evacuation and backup lamps, then hear all four decisions. Submit to receive the final growth rewards before approaching the Grail core.
chapter.grail.stage8.name: The Empty Cup and the Road Home
chapter.grail.stage8.line1: The Wish Executor fell and the core went quiet. The remaining cup commanded no one. It waited for a freely chosen wish.
chapter.grail.stage8.line2: Being able to sit down for supper after victory is worth protecting too.
chapter.grail.stage8.line3: The Grail can wait. Wealth, valor, or companionship. Read what each grants before deciding.
chapter.grail.stage8.line4: No one must suffer for another tonight. The soup is still warm.
chapter.grail.stage8.line5: Stop staring into that cup. Eat, or I am taking your portion too.
chapter.grail.final: The unique Four Oaths Grail, four traveler skins, and the ending CG.
chapter.grail.stage8.brief: Defeat the Wish Executor and its finite guards. All four must fight and survive; submit to receive the unique Grail.
chapter.grail.cg.invitations.title: Four Unsigned Invitations
chapter.grail.cg.invitations.caption: Four invitations arrived in one night. An ownerless cup stood where a signature should have been.
chapter.grail.cg.decision.title: Four Freely Made Decisions
chapter.grail.cg.decision.caption: By the fire, they set aside their dusty cloaks. No ritual bound them here, yet four hands rested on the same map.
chapter.grail.cg.ending.title: The Empty Cup and the Road Home
chapter.grail.cg.ending.caption: The Wish Executor fell and the core went quiet. The remaining cup commanded no one. It waited for a freely chosen wish.
chapter.grail.skin.description: A road home named by no Grail. Complete The Unclaimed Grail and Four Oaths.

event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.name: A Knot in Red
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.title: Ye Shunguang: A Knot in Red
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.text: [p]Everyone has eaten before Ye Shunguang lifts her lukewarm soup. As she lowers her head, a thin silver plate falls into her lap. A blade has cut halfway through its fastening cord; the remaining threads have only just given way.[/p][p]"When did that happen?" you ask.[/p][p]"At the pass." She turns the circlet over and tries to twist the broken threads together. "It is all right. It missed my ears."[/p][p]You draw a length of red cord from the repair bag. She glances from your hands to your unfinished cloak. "You have not mended yours yet."[/p][p]"A cloak can be pulled over a tear. If this falls again, it will land in the fire."[/p][p]She hands it over, but does not quite withdraw her fingers. On your third turn of the cord, she gently pins the end. "A little looser here. Otherwise it pulls my hair when I turn."[/p][p]You undo the knot and start again. This time she does not say that anything will do. She tests the fit twice before murmuring, "That is just right."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.reveal: [p]At dawn you stop beside the abandoned outer barricade. Yesterday's wheel tracks turn uphill toward the tollgate. The smith's wagon is there, along with several travelers who refused to surrender their last sack of grain.[/p][p]Ye Shunguang holds the repaired circlet against her chest. The red cord is bright, but a dangerous crack remains in the silver.[/p][p]"The cord alone will not do," you say. "Let us bring them back, and ask the smith to fit a new backing."[/p][p]She looks at you and smiles. "So this time, saying I am fine will not settle it?"[/p][p]"Not this time."[/p][p]She wraps the circlet carefully and starts up the path. After two steps she looks back to make sure you are following.[/p][p]"Together, then. And when we return, that cloak of yours gets finished too."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.victory: [p]The smith fits a thin steel backing beneath the silver ornament, leaving the old red cord in place. Ye Shunguang puts on the finished Heartbound Circlet and touches its slightly clumsy knot. "Keep this one. I know it."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.option: Tell me if it does not fit. We can try again.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.challenge_opt: Go to the Severed Cord Tollgate.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.20.reward: First camp victory reward: Heartbound Circlet.
location.ye_shunguang_bond.20.name: Severed Cord Tollgate
location.ye_shunguang_bond.20.descriptio: A Heart at Home: A Knot in Red. Ye Shunguang must participate and survive a victory here to earn this bond reward.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.name: Leave a Light
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.title: Ye Shunguang: Leave a Light
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.text: [p]Rain has delayed tonight's patrol. While you update the supply ledger by lamplight, Ye Shunguang brings two cups of hot water and slides one toward you.[/p][p]"Do you write this much every day?"[/p][p]"Mostly money. And who mistook our last bag of salt for sugar."[/p][p]She laughs, then asks with sudden seriousness, "What about that bird beside the road?"[/p][p]Your pen stops. She describes how it tried to drag a piece of bread into the grass, failed, pecked off a little, then tried again. You passed the same spot together, yet you never saw it.[/p][p]"You want to record things like that too?"[/p][p]"Yes." She shields the flame from a draft. "Not only because I might forget. When I tell you about something, it feels as though today lasted a little longer."[/p][p]You turn to a blank page and ask how round the bird was. When she sees the ball you draw, she laughs too hard to drink.[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.reveal: [p]Three short flashes appear among the reeds after nightfall. The rescued smith recognizes the road signal, but the messenger on watch has been missing for two days.[/p][p]Across the stream, a goblin palisade hides behind the lights. Captives have been tied beside the lanterns to lure rescuers into bow range.[/p][p]Ye Shunguang does not draw her sword at once. First she ties a red ribbon to a low branch on your bank and sets the lantern behind a stone.[/p][p]"The wounded will need to see the way back."[/p][p]You mark the sentries; she checks the depth of the water. Before you separate to scout, she catches your sleeve.[/p][p]"When we return, I will draw that bird properly for you."[/p][p]"I will leave the light."[/p][p]"I know." She releases your sleeve. "So make sure you come back too."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.victory: [p]The rescued messenger drinks beside the lantern while she redraws the bird at your side. Halfway through, she admits your round version was rather close. The escort payment and recovered tools join the company supplies.[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.challenge_opt: Clear Reedlight Camp and bring them back to the light.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.40.reward: Second camp victory reward: 1,000 crowns and 30 tools and supplies.
location.ye_shunguang_bond.40.name: Reedlight Ambush Camp
location.ye_shunguang_bond.40.descriptio: A Heart at Home: Leave a Light. Ye Shunguang must participate and survive a victory here to earn this bond reward.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.name: Through Wind and Snow
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.title: Ye Shunguang: Through Wind and Snow
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.text: [p]The smith brings an unfinished suit of light armor. Thin plates lie beneath white cloth; the shoulders allow a free lift of the arm, and no hard buckle obstructs a turn. Ye Shunguang tries a few sword movements, then lays it beneath the lamp to inspect it.[/p][p]"The soft lining is still missing," you say. "Once the shipment arrives, you can wear it through winter."[/p][p]Instead of answering, she catches your wrist. Beneath the rolled sleeve is the scrape you earned moving a wagon for the wounded.[/p][p]"You said this had healed."[/p][p]"Almost."[/p][p]She presses a dressing against it and looks up. You remember giving her precisely that look beside the fire.[/p][p]You sit. Only after winding a clean bandage does she move the remaining cloth aside.[/p][p]"This coat can wait a little," she says. "You cannot keep putting yourself last."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.reveal: [p]The caravan carrying the lining has been trapped outside Cold Forge Stockade. The barbarians took the cargo, sent those who could walk to carry ore, and locked the others in an old shed.[/p][p]At the mountain pass, Ye Shunguang wears the trial coat before its inner armor is complete. Wind finds a shoulder seam. She stops to tighten the collar rather than pretend she is warm, then offers you another cloak.[/p][p]"That one is for you. Put it on yourself."[/p][p]You take it and ask how she knew to bring a spare.[/p][p]"I can watch the weather too." She straightens the red fastening. "You prepare mine; I prepare yours. Is that so difficult?"[/p][p]The forge flares below. You mark the prisoners' shed and agree on the approach and retreat. Before folding the map, she checks your bandage once more.[/p][p]"Bring them home. When the coat is finished, we will try it together."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.victory: [p]The complete inner plates and supple lining are finally sewn into the Homeward Vestment. She raises an arm, turns, and nods in satisfaction. When you say you can rest easy, she first fastens your cloak. "Only when both of us are dressed properly."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.option: All right. This time I will listen.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.60.reward: Third camp victory reward: Homeward Vestment.
location.ye_shunguang_bond.60.name: Cold Forge Stockade
location.ye_shunguang_bond.60.descriptio: A Heart at Home: Through Wind and Snow. Ye Shunguang must participate and survive a victory here to earn this bond reward.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.name: A Promise for Tomorrow
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.title: Ye Shunguang: A Promise for Tomorrow
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.text: [p]You find Ye Shunguang outside camp, her sword against a tree and fine wood shavings at her feet.[/p][p]The round little bird has finally become a carving, although its wings do not quite match. She gives it to you, then speaks before you can. "Do not say it looks like bread."[/p][p]You swallow the words. Your expression makes her laugh first.[/p][p]After a while sitting together, she asks, "If one day we did not have to hurry away, what would you want to do?"[/p][p]Perhaps find a roof that does not leak, you say, and sleep until you wake naturally.[/p][p]"I would like to learn to cook well. Better than merely edible." She considers it. "And there should be room to put things beside the window."[/p][p]She glances at the wooden bird in your hands.[/p][p]"If you would like, it could sit there."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.reveal: [p]Orcs have blocked the old bridge downstream. Families trying to go home crowd the near bank. A carpenter cradles a window frame and says his repaired house is just across the river. He can see the chimney, but cannot reach it.[/p][p]Ye Shunguang touches the wooden bird in her palm. She neither puts it aside nor postpones your conversation until the whole world is at peace.[/p][p]"Let us clear their road first. We can look for our window along the way."[/p][p]You mark the sound sections of the broken bridge. Wind pulls a red ribbon taut. She offers her hand so you can step over a loose stone.[/p][p]Once you are steady, she still does not let go.[/p][p]"What I said earlier was not just a passing thought."[/p][p]"I will remember."[/p][p]She nods, and together you look toward the bastion beyond the bridge.[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.victory: [p]Before crossing, the carpenter gives you two silver rings set with small red stones: thanks for leaving someone a road home. Ye Shunguang meets your eyes. "Keep them safe. We will choose a good day." The company receives its payment and medical supplies; the rings remain keepsakes in the story.[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.option: Save it a place in the morning sun.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.challenge_opt: Clear Broken Bridge Bastion and open the road home.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.80.reward: Fourth camp victory reward: 1,500 crowns and 30 medical supplies.
location.ye_shunguang_bond.80.name: Broken Bridge Bastion
location.ye_shunguang_bond.80.descriptio: A Heart at Home: A Promise for Tomorrow. Ye Shunguang must participate and survive a victory here to earn this bond reward.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.name: A Heart at Home
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.title: Ye Shunguang: A Heart at Home
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.text: [p]When you lift the tent flap, Ye Shunguang is arranging her veil against the lamplight. An ivory skirt pools at her feet, silver thread traces its neckline, and her familiar red flowers rest beside her ears. Seeing you, her fingers tighten, but she does not pull the curtain closed.[/p][p]"Do not stand there. Help me see whether the veil is pressing on my ears."[/p][p]You loosen the gauze. She opens a small box, takes out the silver rings, and gives one to you. Once hers is on, she lifts her left hand toward the lamp and studies it for a long time.[/p][p]"I wondered whether we should wait until everything was settled."[/p][p]She looks at you. "But there is always another stretch of road. I do not want to keep saying later."[/p][p]You take her hand. She returns your grip, her voice steadier now.[/p][p]"I chose to wear this today. I chose the ring too. Not because we are going into battle, or because I am afraid there is no time left."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.reveal: [p]At dawn you reach the old cloister. Through its arches you can see the final stretch of the return road. The ancient court seals the pass; its dead guards still obey orders no living person remembers. The evacuation wagons must pass through it.[/p][p]Ye Shunguang still wears her wedding dress. She wanted you to see it in the morning light before returning to camp to put on her armor. She raises her ringed left hand and reaches for you.[/p][p]"I cannot promise never to be hurt again, or to remember every detail perfectly." She pauses. "But I know who I want beside me today, and on the road ahead."[/p][p]You promise there will be someone to leave a light for her.[/p][p]She shakes her head, smiling as she tightens her grip. "We come back together this time. Whoever arrives first lights it."[/p][p]Wind passes beneath the arch. A slender thread of sword intent gathers quietly near her hand, not yet a blade. She glances at it, then at you.[/p][p]"We will try the rest after we have finished this road."[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.victory: [p]The last shield falls in the ancient court, and the wagon wheels finally pass the stone gate. Ye Shunguang makes certain that you and the others are there before resting her hand on her sword. Six clear threads of sword intent settle into place, complete, without borrowing anyone else's voice. She touches her ring. "So I can call it home myself." Heart Recalled is permanently unlocked.[/p]
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.challenge_op: Return together. Go to the Court of No Return.
event.ye_shunguang_bond.100.reward: Final camp victory reward: permanently unlock Heart Recalled.

skill.ye_shunguang_heart_recalled.name: Heart Recalled
skill.ye_shunguang_heart_recalled.descri: Gather your resolve and immediately fill Qingming Sword Stance to 6 stacks. Once per battle; does not automatically enter the Enlightened State.
skill.ye_shunguang_heart_recalled.rules: Costs 2 AP and 10 fatigue. Works inside or outside Enlightened State; preserves spent stance and the current block limit. Its use is independent of Qingming Unsheathed. Deals no damage.
skill.ye_shunguang_heart_recalled.unavai: Requires the final bond camp, an active battle, fewer than 6 stance stacks, and an unused charge this battle.
item.ye_shunguang_heartbound_circlet.des: The silver can be reforged, but she kept the red cord. The knot is not beautiful; its fit is exactly right.
item.ye_shunguang_heartbound_circlet.own: Only Ye Shunguang may equip this item.
item.ye_shunguang_homeward_vestment.name: Homeward Vestment
item.ye_shunguang_homeward_vestment.desc: The lining keeps the warmth; the plates turn the blade. Once her coat is fastened, she checks your buttons too.
item.ye_shunguang_homeward_vestment.owne: Only Ye Shunguang may equip this item.
chapter.grail.combat.saber.mana: Grail blessing: start with 2 mana. Gain 1 on the first normal active melee weapon hit each round and 1 on the first enemy direct attack dealing actual HP or armor damage. Maximum 4; no turn decay.
chapter.grail.combat.saber.excalibur: Grail blessing: Excalibur may be activated twice per battle. Each activation still costs all 4 mana, 7 AP and 40 fatigue. Misses consume a use. Wide-line targeting and damage rules are unchanged.
chapter.grail.combat.morgan.mana: Grail blessing: start with 4/6 mana. Gain 1 on the first normal turn each global round, plus 1 per Holy Lance hit, up to two per round. Extra turns do not recharge.
chapter.grail.combat.morgan.camelot: Grail blessing: pay 6 mana, 6 AP and 40 fatigue upfront, once per global round. Refund 2 mana only after the full cast completes while Morgan is alive, once regardless of targets or hits. Curse damage never refunds mana.
chapter.grail.combat.jeanne.aura: Grail blessing: with a legal banner or polearm, the aura gives other roster allies in range +15 resolve, melee/ranged skill and melee/ranged defense. The strongest same-type aura applies without stacking. Range and fatigue recovery are unchanged.
chapter.grail.combat.alter.hunt: Grail blessing: melee weapon attacks against Black Flame targets gain +35% weapon damage and +10 percentage points of penetration; retain the original hit bonus. Fixed damage and dedicated NP attacks are not amplified.
chapter.grail.combat.alter.attack: Costs 5 AP and 30 fatigue, once per battle. Targets without Black Flame at the snapshot take 200% weapon damage, 200% armor damage and +30 accuracy.
chapter.grail.combat.alter.curse: Targets already bearing Black Flame at the area snapshot take 240% weapon damage, +45 accuracy and +10 penetration points. A hit adds 60 fixed HP damage if the target survives. Dispel, Black Flame refresh and buff denial remain unchanged.
chapter.grail.wish.missing_actor: This companion is absent or cannot receive the blessing. Return with them alive and refresh.

settings.enable_roster_expansion: Enable formation UI and roster expansion
settings.enable_roster_expansion.descrip: Controls the new formation UI, combat limit choices and reserve expansion together. Enabled by default. Disabling hides formation access in the character screen and Hub and returns roster limits, formation, hiring and deployment to vanilla or other mods. Your chosen limits remain saved. Reopen the character screen or Hub after switching. Disabling rebuilds formation using the current native rules without deleting members or equipment. Cannot switch during combat; reduce the company to the capacity supported by vanilla or other mods before disabling.
settings.enable_roster_expansion.battle: Finish the battle before switching formation and roster expansion.
settings.enable_roster_expansion.capacit: Too many members to disable expansion safely. First reduce your company to this capacity or fewer:
settings.combat_capacity.description: Only applies while formation UI and roster expansion are enabled. Default follows the current vanilla or Legends origin rules. Choose a fixed limit of 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26 or 27. Formation uses three rows with 27 positions. Takes effect when reopening the character screen or entering the next battle. Lowering the limit moves excess deployed members to reserve without removing anyone. Arena and other scripted line-ups still follow their scenario rules.
settings.roster_capacity.description: Only applies while formation UI and roster expansion are enabled. Expands company and reserve capacity without changing your origin combat limit. Lowering this setting never removes members; recruitment pauses while over capacity. Native wages, food and Legends camp rules still apply.

chapter.preparation.evidence_hint: Evidence is saved with chapter progress, uses no stash space and is retained after submission.
chapter.preparation.stock_source: Tools and medicine use company resources; other supplies consume whole items from the stash.
chapter.preparation.cache_source: Use your stash stock or recover the reserve at this site. Local supplies are reserved for this stage and do not enter the stash.
chapter.preparation.grail.stage1_complet: The seals come from the same city, but the titles contradict one another. The refugees recognize the gate depicted on the paper.
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_1_2.name: Register the wounded and shelter
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_1_2.text: The wounded and their families are accounted for, and shelter is ready. Medicine and bread will let the relief work begin.
chapter.preparation.grail.stage3_complet: The palace and homes share a circuit. Cutting it would darken the shelters as well; the connections must first be separated.
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_3_2.name: Prepare independent lighting
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_3_2.text: Morgan marks the junctions and teaches residents to fit ordinary wicks. The tools will disconnect the dangerous links and secure independent lamps.
chapter.preparation.grail.stage5_complet: The originals ask for missing relatives to be found. None asks for an execution. Their signatures and dates can be checked against the verdicts.
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_5_2.name: Compare the forged verdicts
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_5_2.text: Names were copied from missing-person petitions into the execution list, dated one day earlier. The alteration can now be independently verified.
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_5_3.name: Protect the witness and separate copies
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_5_3.text: The witness is at the shelter. Different people hold the originals and two copies, allowing the rescue to follow the true register.
chapter.preparation.grail.stage7_complet: Check evacuation routes and reserve lamps
Residents have left the streets around the core. The reserve lamps work independently, and the marked route home remains open.
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_7_2.name: Hear the four companions' decisions
chapter.preparation.grail.prep_7_2.text: Each companion freely chooses to go with the company. The Grail no longer speaks for them. The final wish will be chosen only after the core is closed and the Grail recovered.
chapter.preparation.grail.evidence.true_: Obtained in stage 5 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.spring.waystation_co: Hyacine lists the dressings needed, and the gardener points to an empty grain sack. Food and medicine must come before the garden.
chapter.preparation.spring.window_comple: Inspect the windowsill and quarantine bed
The window frame leaks and diseased roots reach the healthy beds. The repair points and quarantine boundary are marked for the tools.
chapter.preparation.spring.handover_comp: Match nameplates to the cemetery map
The cemetery map fills the gaps on worn nameplates. Those overlooked have a recorded place, and Mare no longer has to guess.
chapter.preparation.spring.prep_5_2.name: Arrange garden care and handover
chapter.preparation.spring.prep_5_2.text: Watering, dressings and visitors are recorded together. Those staying take the key and promise to tend the new shoots.
chapter.preparation.spring.forge_complet: Castorice and Hyacine remove the remaining blight. The stable crystal can be used for Liuchun without taking another life.
chapter.preparation.spring.prep_7_2.name: Complete Liuchun and the promise to return
chapter.preparation.spring.prep_7_2.text: They finish the final checks and mark the road back to the waystation. Their promise to return is settled; Liuchun needs only its final seal.
chapter.preparation.spring.evidence.ceme: Obtained in stage 4 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.spring.evidence.nurs: Obtained in stage 6 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.royal_tide.seawall_c: Hysilens finds footing beyond the spear line. The weak sections are marked; ten tools will secure passage for the rescuers.
chapter.preparation.royal_tide.lighthous: Prepare shelter for the keeper and wounded
The keeper places two charts beside the bed and points toward the old orders. Medicine and grain will stay with the wounded at the lighthouse.
chapter.preparation.royal_tide.royal_ten: Compare evacuation records and core plans
The records show evacuation was authorized, while the core repeats an obsolete order. The plans reveal its sole outward relay.
Together they mark the cutoff and route back. The next objective is clear; no further supplies are needed to settle the order.
chapter.preparation.royal_tide.returning: Inspect recovered parts and the oathblade
The recovered core part no longer transmits commands. Hysilens confirms it can repair the oathblade; the tools are reserved for that work.
Obtained in stage 4 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
Obtained in stage 6 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.auditori: Inspect the stage and low hum
The hum travels through loose supports. The repair points are marked so the tools can make the stage safe.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.rehearsa: Repair the portable piano with recovered parts
The warehouse plans identify the broken key mechanism. The recovered parts fit it, and Noel finally hears a complete phrase.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.prep_3_2: Find the missing beat in the score
Sakiko leaves a deliberate pause and Robin takes the next beat. Noel finds his entry, and the echo leading below grows clearer.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.platform: Mark the platform and escape lines
The platform loads and escape lines are measured. Fifteen tools and one spider silk will secure them away from the fractures that amplify the hum.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.dress_re: Their timing aligns, with pauses left for each other to enter. The rehearsal draws no new audience.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.prep_7_2: Check positions and the route out
The line, ropes and residents' evacuation route are confirmed. The stage is ready. They will sing the last passage on their own terms.
chapter.preparation.silent_city.evidence: Obtained in stage 2 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.aid_post: The wounded give names and units matching the casualty register. Bread and medicine will go to these living people.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.hearth_c: Part of the first ration delivery is set aside for soup. The stove and stretchers need repair; ten tools will cover the marked damage.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.quarry_r: Check the retreat order and quarry road
The recovered order authorizes withdrawal. The quarry road avoids the blockade, but two sections must be reinforced.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.last_ord: Reconcile survivors at the assembly point
Soldiers still listed as dead answer the roll. Stretchers and escorts are assembled, and no one is missing from the register.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.prep_7_2: Enterprise hands over the order while M4A1 checks the rear group. The final command is to bring the living out; no further delivery is needed.
chapter.preparation.grey_falcon.evidence: Obtained in stage 4 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.yunki.wreck_cart.nam: Inspect the wagon and nightmare mist
chapter.preparation.yunki.wreck_cart.tex: Yixuan locates the binding mist while Ye Shunguang hears breathing beneath the wagon. Once the ritual supplies are ready, the driver can be freed.
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_1_reserve: The driver's crate holds one set of teeth and silk, enough for this ritual. They stay at the site and use no stash space.
chapter.preparation.yunki.bell_preparati: The bell bears the same pattern as the mist beneath the wagon. Yixuan marks three points; a single poison gland will make the cleansing mixture.
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_3_reserve: The chest found when the bell was recovered has reached the preparation site. It contains one preserved poison gland for cleansing the bell.
chapter.preparation.yunki.heartwood.name: Gather resin for the sword casket
chapter.preparation.yunki.heartwood.text: Usable resin has set beside an old wound in the tree. It is enough to seal the cracks without harming the roots.
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_5_2.name: Inspect the casket and route back
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_5_2.text: The resin is ready and the tools will secure the clasps. The wounded and retreat route are checked; the sword heart must still be recovered from the array.
chapter.preparation.yunki.ward_home.name: Purify the recovered sword heart
chapter.preparation.yunki.ward_home.text: Yixuan uses the bell to identify the remaining nightmare taint. Ye Shunguang holds the return ward as the sword's clear note rises above the noise.
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_7_2.name: Check Qingming and the return ward
chapter.preparation.yunki.prep_7_2.text: The heart and casket fit again, and the return ward remains stable. Submit this stage to complete Qingming before facing the nightmare.
chapter.preparation.yunki.evidence.clean: Obtained in stage 2 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.yunki.evidence.caske: Obtained in stage 5 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.yunki.evidence.sword: Obtained in stage 6 of this chapter; recorded with chapter progress.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.ferry: Match the ticket to the painted entrance
The ticket fits a gap in the painting, but the tide sounds from behind the paper. Hokusai marks the damage that needs cloth backing.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.home_: Remove the new paint with recovered solvent
Solvent recovered from the warehouse removes the fresh paint. Fire records appear on the back, proving the festival has been repainted for twelve years.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.prep_: Compare the old painting and fire records
The girl's name matches the fire records, but the portrait holds no new memories. Hokusai traces the pigment supply toward the clocktower.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.ruins: Hokusai measures the broken piles, charred beams and shore, keeping every gap. Tools will secure the measuring rig and easel.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.prep_: The painted exit now matches the real shore. The blank space belongs to tomorrow rather than becoming another prison built from memories.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.thres: Each recovered portrait matches the rescue register. Every living person has a name, and no one must remain as another's substitute.
chapter.preparation.painted_harbor.prep_: Align the threshold with the way home
Hokusai anchors the threshold to the surveyed coordinates, and Abigail turns the key toward the real tide. The gate leads home without sacrificing anyone.

event.olga_corruption.prologue.title: Prologue: A Queen Without a Throne
event.olga_corruption.prologue.text: [p]When Olga first entered your tent, she still demanded to be addressed as Queen of the Dark City. The fighting was over, her banner lay in the mud, and she was your company's captive. Yet the head beneath the crescent crown remained high.[/p][p]“You can take a city. You cannot make its queen your soldier.” You set the company rules beside the roster: no attacks on comrades, obey battlefield commands, and handle casualties and spoils by the same rules as everyone else.[/p][p]The memory ends. Outside, another muster sounds. Olga stands at the tent entrance, waiting for you to explain her place in the company.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.prologue.option: Explain the orders and her responsibilities.
event.olga_corruption.prologue.reveal: [p]“Nobody takes an extra arrow for your crown. Nor will I send you to die because you are a captive.” You lay out her drills: keep spells clear of allies, obey withdrawal signals, and account for mistakes in the same debrief as everyone else.[/p][p]Olga reads without signing. “I will see whether you follow these rules yourself.” You leave the pen on the table and let her observe the first exercise.[/p][p]She begins marching with the company. Discipline will not purchase instant loyalty. Each victory and each discovery about her old court will give her another reason to reconsider both you and her crown.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.prologue.confirm: Let her march with us. Prove it through actions.
event.olga_corruption.20.name: Orders Beyond the Tent
event.olga_corruption.20.text: [p]After morning drills, Olga stands by a pillar with folded arms. Her black flame always finds the target, but often half a beat before the signal. Waiting on someone else is harder for a queen than casting.[/p][p]You draw yesterday's line in the dirt and show how destroying cover early exposed the crossbowmen. “And when your judgment is wrong?” she asks. You summon the covering soldiers and record your own mistakes alongside hers.[/p][p]A scout reports that raiders, aided by deserters from the Dark City, are preparing an ambush for refugees. Olga lowers her arms. She knows that road.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.20.reveal: [p]She proposes charging the camp. You assign her the flank and order her to seal the enemy's retreat on your signal. “You would have a queen cover mercenaries?”[/p][p]“I need the person best able to control that ground.” You entrust the withdrawal route to her. What began as the disciplining of a captive becomes a precise responsibility.[/p][p]She takes the map. “This time I follow your timing. But if you abandon the wounded, you will answer to me.” The camp is located; the company can now march.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.20.victory: [p]When the dust clears, Olga still holds her assigned flank. She has covered the last wounded soldier instead of chasing fugitives.[/p][p]“Your signals are more useful than I expected.” She returns the map. It is not submission, but for the first time she treats your orders as judgments worth following.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.20.reward: Enter Stage I: maximum AP becomes 10; unlock Soul Shock.
event.olga_corruption.20.title: Orders Beyond the Tent
event.olga_corruption.20.option: Hear what she has to say.
event.olga_corruption.20.challenge_optio: Mark the objective and prepare to march.
location.olga_corruption.20.name: Roadblock Raiders
location.olga_corruption.20.description: Raiders and deserters threaten the road from this camp.
event.olga_corruption.40.name: Cracks in the Royal Ledger
event.olga_corruption.40.text: [p]Olga now arrives at debriefs on time, though she still calls the company a temporary shelter. One quiet evening she searches a borrowed library for the names of loyal courtiers.[/p][p]The surviving records contain omissions and altered orders. Ministers she trusted sold evacuation routes and classified the civilians left behind as necessary losses. Her finger rests on the page without moving.[/p][p]The original ledgers are held by goblins. She brings copies to your tent, and for once does not begin with a command.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.40.reveal: [p]“I need your people to recover the originals.” You agree on one condition: the entire company sees the findings. No page is to disappear to spare the court embarrassment.[/p][p]She looks into the library's old moonlit mirror, as if waiting for the queen within it to answer. Then she signs the company's operation roster herself.[/p][p]The goblin camp lies nearby. After recovering the records, she must choose between defending a royal name and trusting the imperfect people who actually stand beside her.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.40.victory: [p]The recovered ledgers confirm her fears. Olga burns the orders and preserves the signatures as evidence.[/p][p]“A title does not make someone worthy of trust,” she says. “At least you never hid the cost.” For the first time, the company takes a place once reserved for her court.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.40.reward: Enter Stage II: maximum AP becomes 11; unlock Black Flame Storm.
event.olga_corruption.40.title: Cracks in the Royal Ledger
event.olga_corruption.40.option: Hear what she has to say.
event.olga_corruption.40.challenge_optio: Mark the objective and prepare to march.
