location.olga_corruption.40.description: Goblins keep the stolen court records in this defended camp.
event.olga_corruption.60.name: The Flame She Chooses
event.olga_corruption.60.text: [p]Olga asks for longer evening drills. She controls black flame on command now, yet still binds herself to prohibitions inherited from the court. Once symbols of sovereignty, they increasingly resemble excuses left by people unwilling to bear consequences.[/p][p]You ask which rules protect comrades and which merely protect royal dignity. The discussion lasts until the lamps burn low. She admits she has never seriously asked some of these questions.[/p][p]Northern raiders working for exiled ministers are taking supplies. They believe their old pact will stop her from using forbidden flame against them.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.60.reveal: [p]At an abandoned altar, Olga kneels and compresses black flame between her hands until it burns only within marked lines. You keep time; the soldiers mark the ground. Nobody makes her final decision for her.[/p][p]“I will end that pact myself. Not because you ordered it, but because they keep hurting my comrades.”[/p][p]The fire reveals a restrained smile. The northern camp has been found. This time she asks to lead the assault.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.60.victory: [p]Black flame falls along the planned line. Olga neither hesitates for the old pact nor lets her anger cross into friendly ranks.[/p][p]Afterward she tears the court's prohibitions in two. “I will answer for my own power.” She hands you the remaining plan. “And it will serve your banner.”[/p]
event.olga_corruption.60.reward: Enter Stage III: maximum AP becomes 12; unlock Dark Annihilation; Curse Recovery increases to 15.
event.olga_corruption.60.title: The Flame She Chooses
event.olga_corruption.60.option: Hear what she has to say.
event.olga_corruption.60.challenge_optio: Mark the objective and prepare to march.
location.olga_corruption.60.name: Fangs of the Exiles
location.olga_corruption.60.description: Northern raiders serving the exiled ministers stockpile supplies here.
event.olga_corruption.80.name: An Oath in the Storm
event.olga_corruption.80.text: [p]Rain lashes the terrace banners. You place a document releasing Olga from custody on the balustrade. Her actions have proved enough; the company no longer holds her as a captive.[/p][p]“You do not fear I will leave?” You point toward the soldiers repairing their gear. “Staying because you cannot leave is not loyalty.” She takes the document without answering.[/p][p]Before dawn, scouts find orcs blocking the supply road. As you prepare a detour, Olga returns with a complete assault plan.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.80.reveal: [p]She understands the danger and knows another road would carry her away from your banner. She sets the release document beneath the map and indicates the strongest section of the orc defenses.[/p][p]“Leave this to me. I am tired of searching for an insult in every order. You have given us a direction. I choose to put my strength behind it.”[/p][p]She steps into the storm to muster the flank. Nobody needs to remind her to wait for the company this time.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.80.victory: [p]The road opens and the company banner rises in the rain. Olga returns the release document, then takes one knee before the flag.[/p][p]“I choose to remain. Captain, from this day I accept your command.” Her pride survives, but for the first time she willingly places her orders beneath yours.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.80.reward: Enter Stage IV: maximum AP becomes 13; unlock Soul Enslavement.
event.olga_corruption.80.title: An Oath in the Storm
event.olga_corruption.80.option: Hear what she has to say.
event.olga_corruption.80.challenge_optio: Mark the objective and prepare to march.
location.olga_corruption.80.name: The Broken Road
location.olga_corruption.80.description: Orcs strike from this camp to block the company's supply road.
event.olga_corruption.100.name: Disciple Beneath the Eclipse
event.olga_corruption.100.text: [p]Olga no longer treats the old court as the home she must eventually reclaim. She organizes drills, takes dangerous flanks and explains to recruits the signals she once disputed.[/p][p]One final letter offers her throne back if she visits the royal tombs alone and submits to ancestral judgment. She hands it to you. “They want dead kings to decide whom the living must obey.”[/p][p]The tomb guardians have awakened. She will no longer allow that throne to issue orders to the company.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.100.reveal: [p]Before departure, Olga sits on an obsidian seat with a small eclipse hovering in her palm. It is no new crown, only power she can finally hold with ease.[/p][p]“I thought submission meant losing one's will. Now I know that committing my strength to a direction I believe in is also a choice.” She will enter the tombs beside you and sever the last old oath herself.[/p][p]“Afterward, I will not call myself a captive without a throne. I will be your follower and your disciple.” Then she rises to check the company's preparations.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.100.victory: [p]The ancestral guardians fall and the old oath becomes silent. Olga leaves the royal seal on its altar and returns to your banner.[/p][p]“The Dark City taught me that everyone must look up to a throne. You showed me something worth following can walk at the head of a column.” She bows and speaks her loyalty without hesitation.[/p][p]“Captain, I will guard your path. Whatever my old court calls this fall, I choose to become your most faithful disciple.” She still wears the crescent crown when she rises, but it now belongs to a queen who has chosen her own allegiance.[/p]
event.olga_corruption.100.reward: Enter Stage V: maximum AP becomes 14; unlock Eclipse Finale and eligibility for the Eclipse Queen skin.

skill.alicia_counter.name: Seamless Counter
skill.alicia_counter.description: 2 AP / 12 fatigue. Gain +20 melee defense until the first normal turn in a later round. An active adjacent single-target melee miss triggers a free 100% counter (IV 150%), +10 accuracy/+25 weapon penetration points. Completed counters restore 5 fatigue, at most 30 per round. No counters to opportunity/ranged/area attacks or while rooted, stunned or disarmed.
skill.alicia_breath.name: Endless Sword Breath
skill.alicia_breath.description: 2 AP / 0 fatigue. Once per round, restore 30 fatigue, 40 from IV. Requires a one-handed sword, no separate offhand item equipped and positive current fatigue. Does not attack or add momentum.
skill.alicia_triple.name: Silver Triple
skill.alicia_triple.description: 5 AP / 25 fatigue. Once per round, three hits on one enemy at 85% weapon damage each, V 100%; sword armor ratio, +25 accuracy/+25 penetration points plus momentum. Stop on death. V costs 4 AP only if already at 10 stacks before casting; no retroactive refund.
valkyrie.alicia.name: Alicia
valkyrie.alicia.background.name: Silver Sword Stance
valkyrie.alicia.background.description: A captured knight tests her vows against exacting sword training and the decisions made beside her new comrades.
valkyrie.alicia.trait.name: Silver Sword Stance
valkyrie.alicia.trait.description: With a one-handed sword and empty offhand: ordinary active weapon attacks cost 1 less AP, with +10 hit chance and +25 percentage points of armor penetration. Start battle with 2 Sword Momentum stacks, maximum 5; stage III starts at 3 with maximum 8, stage V at 5 with maximum 10. Each stack grants +5 Melee Skill and Defense; from III, also +5% weapon damage. Gain one stack per active attack that hits, once for a multi-hit attack; IV adds one more on the first hit each round. Without a refresh, stacks expire at the end of your turn two rounds later; at V they last through battle. From I, ignore shields and reduce a hit enemy’s Melee Defense by 10 for two normal turns.
skill.alicia_passive.name: Silver Swordmaster
skill.alicia_passive.description: With a one-handed sword and empty offhand: ordinary active weapon attacks cost 1 less AP, with +10 hit chance and +25 percentage points of armor penetration. Start battle with 2 Sword Momentum stacks, maximum 5; stage III starts at 3 with maximum 8, stage V at 5 with maximum 10. Each stack grants +5 Melee Skill and Defense; from III, also +5% weapon damage. Gain one stack per active attack that hits, once for a multi-hit attack; IV adds one more on the first hit each round. Without a refresh, stacks expire at the end of your turn two rounds later; at V they last through battle. From I, ignore shields and reduce a hit enemy’s Melee Defense by 10 for two normal turns.
skin.alicia_skin.name: Alicia Initial Appearance
skin.alicia_skin.description: The commander of the Holy Iris Knights, resolute and ready with sword and shield.
skin.alicia_oath_skin.name: Alicia Oath Appearance
skin.alicia_oath_skin.description: She keeps her sword at her side and her new oath close to her heart.
skill.claudia_hammer.name: Siege Hammer
skill.claudia_hammer.description: 4 AP / 20 fatigue. Adjacent enemy: 150% weapon damage, 250% armor damage, 50% penetration, +35 total accuracy; hits apply daze, stagger and shatter. III unarmored bonus is separate.
skill.claudia_wedge.name: Armor-Shattering Wedge
skill.claudia_wedge.description: 3 AP / 16 fatigue. Once per round: adjacent enemy, 100% weapon/350% armor/15% penetration/+40 accuracy. After hit damage, remove 25% of remaining armor, rounded down from head and body; misses do not shave armor.
skill.claudia_sweep.name: Earthsplit Sweep
skill.claudia_sweep.description: 5 AP / 26 fatigue. Once per round, all adjacent enemies: 120% weapon/275% armor/40% penetration/+30 accuracy. Hits apply daze, stagger and shatter. Allies are excluded.
skill.claudia_wave.name: Cityquake
skill.claudia_wave.description: 6 AP / 30 fatigue. Once per round, center 1-3 tiles away and first ring: enemies take 140% weapon/300% armor/45% penetration/+35 accuracy. Hits daze, stagger and shatter; center attempts a stun respecting immunity.
skill.claudia_city.name: White City Fall
skill.claudia_city.description: 6 AP / 36 fatigue. Once per round: first hit 200% weapon/550% armor/65% penetration/+45 accuracy. On hit clear remaining head/body armor; if the original target survives, follow once at 200% (includes unarmored bonus)/150% armor/100% penetration. No follow-up on miss or death.
valkyrie.claudia.name: Claudia
valkyrie.claudia.background.name: Siegebreaker
valkyrie.claudia.background.description: A hammer knight taken after the white city's defenses fell learns to rebuild responsibility alongside the walls she once trusted.
valkyrie.claudia.trait.name: Siegebreaker
valkyrie.claudia.trait.description: With a two-handed hammer: +15 hit chance, +50 percentage points of armor damage and +15 percentage points of armor penetration. While body armor remains, take 20% less armor damage and resist forced movement. Active hammer hits apply Siegebreaker Fracture for two normal turns: -25 Melee and Ranged Defense and +50% armor damage taken. At III: -30 defenses, +100% armor damage taken, and attacks against the target gain 25 percentage points of penetration. At V, Fracture lasts through battle. From III, attacks against enemies with neither head nor body armor gain 50 percentage points of weapon damage. Recover 12 fatigue the first time each round you destroy an enemy’s head or body armor.
skill.claudia_passive.name: Siegebreaker
skill.claudia_passive.description: With a two-handed hammer: +15 hit chance, +50 percentage points of armor damage and +15 percentage points of armor penetration. While body armor remains, take 20% less armor damage and resist forced movement. Active hammer hits apply Siegebreaker Fracture for two normal turns: -25 Melee and Ranged Defense and +50% armor damage taken. At III: -30 defenses, +100% armor damage taken, and attacks against the target gain 25 percentage points of penetration. At V, Fracture lasts through battle. From III, attacks against enemies with neither head nor body armor gain 50 percentage points of weapon damage. Recover 12 fatigue the first time each round you destroy an enemy’s head or body armor.
skin.claudia_skin.name: Claudia Initial Appearance
skin.claudia_skin.description: The commander of the Dawn Knights, holding the line in heavy armor with her polehammer.
skin.claudia_oath_skin.name: Claudia Oath Appearance
skin.claudia_oath_skin.description: She stands beneath a new banner, still keeping her charge safe.
skill.celestine_judgment.name: Holy Judgment
skill.celestine_judgment.description: 4 AP / 16 fatigue. Within 8 tiles, automatically hits body for 70 + 50% of current HP, rounded down, 100% armor damage and 50% penetration. Armor and damage reduction still apply.
skill.celestine_blessing.name: Divine Blessing
skill.celestine_blessing.description: Costs 2 AP and 12 fatigue. Bless yourself or an ally within 8 tiles: +15 Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense and Ranged Defense, and +20 Resolve and Initiative. From III, grant +20 skills and defenses and +30 Resolve and Initiative. Lasts two normal turns; recasting refreshes duration without stacking.
skill.celestine_healing.name: Life Light
skill.celestine_healing.description: Costs 4 AP and 22 fatigue. Heal yourself or an ally within 8 tiles for 50 + 25% of their maximum HP, and repair both head and body armor by 50 + 15% of their maximum HP, rounded down. Remove bleeding and poison. From stage I, also heal one injured or armor-damaged ally within 2 tiles of the target for 50% of these amounts; stage V affects up to two for 75% each, without cleansing them. From stage I, the first successful heal or repair each round restores 10 fatigue to the caster.
skill.celestine_gate.name: Farshore Gate
skill.celestine_gate.description: Costs 3 AP and 12 fatigue. Select a movable unit occupying one tile, then a standable empty tile anywhere on the map. Costs are paid only after selecting the destination. Crosses height differences, obstacles and enemy zones of control without provoking attacks of opportunity. Preserves the target’s AP, fatigue and turn state. Cannot move multi-tile creatures, fixed objects, certain special bosses or corpses.
skill.celestine_protect.name: Absolute Shelter
skill.celestine_protect.description: 4 AP / 25 fatigue. Self or ally within 8 tiles takes zero HP/head/body damage, including fixed and periodic damage, until their first normal turn in a later round. Waiting does not end it; no control/debuff immunity.
skill.celestine_celestial.name: Celestial Judgment
skill.celestine_celestial.description: 6 AP / 30 fatigue. Once per round, within 8 tiles, automatically hits body for 150 + 80% of current HP, rounded down, 200% armor and 70% penetration, using normal armor/reduction rules.
skill.celestine_resurrection.name: Resurrection Seal
skill.celestine_resurrection.description: 5 AP / 30 fatigue. At most two casts per battle, each living player target triggers once, range 8. Before the first lethal hit, consume seal; set HP/fatigue to 50% maximum, zero AP and end this round's action, clear bleed/poison. Preserve armor, equipment, position and counters. Does not revive corpses.
valkyrie.celestine.name: Celestine
valkyrie.celestine.background.name: Divine Body
valkyrie.celestine.background.descriptio: An elven priestess held by the company preserves her convictions through healing and finds a new spiritual anchor during repeated rescues.
valkyrie.celestine.trait.name: Divine Body
valkyrie.celestine.trait.description: Halves HP and armor damage from the first direct attack action each round, including all hits of that action. Indirect damage does not consume it. From I, the first actual heal or repair each round restores 10 fatigue. Holy spells use current HP when cast and require no weapon. Maximum AP: 9/10/11/12/13/14.
skill.celestine_passive.name: Divine Nature
skill.celestine_passive.description: Halves HP and armor damage from the first direct attack action each round, including all hits of that action. Indirect damage does not consume it. From I, the first actual heal or repair each round restores 10 fatigue. Holy spells use current HP when cast and require no weapon. Maximum AP: 9/10/11/12/13/14.
skin.celestine_skin.name: Celestine Initial Appearance
skin.celestine_skin.description: A high elf crowned with laurel, serene and dignified.
skin.celestine_oath_skin.name: Celestine Oath Appearance
skin.celestine_oath_skin.description: Her crown remains, but her own hand has sealed a new oath.
skill.kaguya_thrust.name: Divine Thrust
skill.kaguya_thrust.description: 4 AP / 16 fatigue. One enemy 1-2 tiles away: 130% damage/50% penetration at one, 180%/80% and ignores shield at two; armor 150%, +40 accuracy. Hits apply current Divine Seal.
skill.kaguya_talisman.name: Soulbinding Talisman
skill.kaguya_talisman.description: 3 AP / 16 fatigue. Enemy within 8 tiles: automatic hit, no damage; apply web, subtract 3 current AP once for this cast, and apply current Divine Seal.
skill.kaguya_sweep.name: Moonwheel Sweep
skill.kaguya_sweep.description: 5 AP / 24 fatigue. Once per round, center 1-2 tiles away plus two flanks, each enemy is struck once. 120% damage (two-tile center 170%), 150% armor, 50% penetration (two 80% and ignores shields), +40 accuracy; hits apply seals.
skill.kaguya_array.name: Eightfold Seal
skill.kaguya_array.description: 5 AP / 26 fatigue. Once per round, center 2-7 tiles away and first ring: each enemy will receive web and Divine Seal without damage. Allies excluded.
skill.kaguya_purge.name: Solar Purge
skill.kaguya_purge.description: 7 AP / 36 fatigue. Cooldown two rounds. Center 1-2 and first ring: 150% damage (two-tile center 200%), armor 150%, penetration 60% (two 90%, ignore shields), +50 accuracy. Regardless of hit, surviving enemies receive web/permanent seal; center forced stun for one normal turn, including bosses.
valkyrie.kaguya.name: Kaguya
valkyrie.kaguya.background.name: Divine Seal
valkyrie.kaguya.background.description: A captured shrine priestess holds to old rites until seal training and distant campaigns reshape her understanding of order and faith.
valkyrie.kaguya.trait.name: Divine Seal
valkyrie.kaguya.trait.description: With a two-handed polearm or spear: +20 hit chance. Selecting an attack center 2 tiles away grants +50 percentage points of weapon damage, +30 percentage points of armor penetration, and ignores shields. Active weapon hits apply Divine Seal for two normal turns: -2 maximum AP, -25% direct attack damage and -10 Melee and Ranged Defense; stage I reduces defenses by 15. At III: -3 AP, -35% damage, -20 defenses, and active movement skills are disabled. At V: -4 AP, -40% damage, -30 defenses, lasting through battle. From I, recover 10 fatigue the first time each round you seal a new enemy.
skill.kaguya_passive.name: Solar Priestess
skill.kaguya_passive.description: With a two-handed polearm or spear: +20 hit chance. Selecting an attack center 2 tiles away grants +50 percentage points of weapon damage, +30 percentage points of armor penetration, and ignores shields. Active weapon hits apply Divine Seal for two normal turns: -2 maximum AP, -25% direct attack damage and -10 Melee and Ranged Defense; stage I reduces defenses by 15. At III: -3 AP, -35% damage, -20 defenses, and active movement skills are disabled. At V: -4 AP, -40% damage, -30 defenses, lasting through battle. From I, recover 10 fatigue the first time each round you seal a new enemy.
skin.kaguya_skin.name: Kaguya Initial Appearance
skin.kaguya_skin.description: The shrine maiden, composed in bearing and steady in her gaze.
skin.kaguya_oath_skin.name: Kaguya Oath Appearance
skin.kaguya_oath_skin.description: She finishes her prayer and looks toward the one who shares her oath.
skill.prim_thrust.name: Banner Thrust
skill.prim_thrust.description: 4 AP / 12 fatigue. Enemy at 1-2 tiles: 140% weapon/125% armor, weapon penetration +20 points. Total accuracy +25+20% of current Resolve (rounded down), including own passive. Costs already include reductions.
skill.prim_rally.name: Rally the Ranks
skill.prim_rally.description: 3 AP / 18 fatigue. Once per round, pay first then self and allies within aura recover 15 fatigue and gain one morale level; I restores 20 and two morale levels, V 30 and two. Tiers replace.
skill.prim_twin.name: Twin Star Thrust
skill.prim_twin.description: 5 AP / 22 fatigue. Two hits on one enemy at 1-2 tiles, each 90% weapon damage+25% of current Resolve (rounded down) ordinary damage; V 100%+50% of current Resolve (rounded down). Weapon armor/penetration, total accuracy +20+20% of current Resolve (rounded down). Stop on death, no retarget.
skill.prim_cleanse.name: Banner Cleanse
skill.prim_cleanse.description: 3 AP / 15 fatigue. Once per round, self/ally within 6 and one adjacent additional ally: remove stun/daze/stagger/root/disarm/knockdown and restore 30 fatigue each. Does not clear bleeding, poison, curses or injuries.
valkyrie.prim.name: Prim
valkyrie.prim.background.name: Princess Banner
valkyrie.prim.background.description: A princess without her court learns to carry the battle banner and accept responsibility for the company's courage.
valkyrie.prim.trait.name: Princess Banner
valkyrie.prim.trait.description: With a two-handed polearm or standard, ordinary active weapon attacks cost 1 less AP and 5 less fatigue; gain hit chance equal to 10 + 20% of current Resolve, rounded down. Other allies within 5 tiles gain +20 Resolve, +10 Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense and Ranged Defense, and +15 Initiative. From I they recover 5 extra fatigue on their first normal turn each round. At III: radius 6, +25 Resolve, +15 skills and defenses, +25 Initiative, and 8 fatigue recovery. At V: radius 8, +35 Resolve, +20 skills and defenses, +30 Initiative, and 10 fatigue recovery; allies at Wavering morale or better also deal 15% more direct attack damage. Multiple sources do not stack.
skill.prim_passive.name: Banner Command
skill.prim_passive.description: With a two-handed polearm or standard, ordinary active weapon attacks cost 1 less AP and 5 less fatigue; gain hit chance equal to 10 + 20% of current Resolve, rounded down. Other allies within 5 tiles gain +20 Resolve, +10 Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense and Ranged Defense, and +15 Initiative. From I they recover 5 extra fatigue on their first normal turn each round. At III: radius 6, +25 Resolve, +15 skills and defenses, +25 Initiative, and 8 fatigue recovery. At V: radius 8, +35 Resolve, +20 skills and defenses, +30 Initiative, and 10 fatigue recovery; allies at Wavering morale or better also deal 15% more direct attack damage. Multiple sources do not stack.
skin.prim_skin.name: Prim Initial Appearance
skin.prim_skin.description: The Flower Princess holds her spear with a gentle but earnest expression.
skin.prim_oath_skin.name: Prim Oath Appearance
skin.prim_oath_skin.description: She tightens her grip on the spear, no longer looking away from those beneath the banner.
skill.maia_taunt.name: Redwolf Taunt
skill.maia_taunt.description: Costs 2 AP and 10 fatigue. Requires a shield. Taunt one enemy within 5 tiles to make it prioritize Maia. This does not give control of the target; some special enemies may be unaffected.
skill.maia_fang.name: Wolf Fang Bash
skill.maia_fang.description: 3 AP / 14 fatigue. One-handed melee weapon and shield: adjacent enemy 100% damage/150% armor/30% penetration/+30 accuracy. Hit dazes/staggers and knocks one tile; if knockback is impossible, force stun for one normal turn.
skill.maia_wall.name: Covering Shieldwall
skill.maia_wall.description: Requires a shield. Gain +30 Melee and Ranged Defense and strengthen nearby allies against direct attacks: 50% reduction within 1 tile at stages 0–II, 50% within 2 tiles at III–IV, and 65% within 2 tiles at V. Lasts until your first normal turn next round; waits do not end it and recasts do not stack. Costs 2 AP and 16 fatigue.
skill.maia_sweep.name: Redwolf Sweep
skill.maia_sweep.description: 5 AP / 25 fatigue. Once per round, one-handed melee weapon and shield: all adjacent enemies 100% damage/150% armor/30% penetration/+20 accuracy. Hits daze/stagger without knockback or friendly fire.
skill.maia_cry.name: Redwolf Battlecry
skill.maia_cry.description: Costs 4 AP and 24 fatigue, once per round. Requires a shield. Taunt eligible enemies within 5 tiles and activate Covering Shieldwall: +30 Melee and Ranged Defense for Maia; other allies within 2 tiles take 50% less direct attack damage, or 65% at stage V. Lasts until your first normal turn next round, with no additional wall cost or stacking.
valkyrie.maia.name: Maia
valkyrie.maia.background.name: Redwolf Guard
valkyrie.maia.background.description: The captured redwolf warrior tests her new companions with her shield and redefines strength through protecting them.
valkyrie.maia.trait.name: Redwolf Guard
valkyrie.maia.trait.description: While holding a shield: double its defense component, 20% less direct damage and forced-movement immunity. Adjacent other allies gain +10 defenses and 25% direct reduction, 50% during wall. I restores 15 fatigue each round and halves shield wear. III shield defense 2.5x, 35% self reduction, radius 2/+15 defenses/35% reduction; indestructible shield and stun/daze/stagger immunity. V: 50% self reduction, allies +20 defenses/50% reduction or 65% during wall and forced-movement immunity; restore 25 fatigue. Tiers replace earlier values.
skill.maia_passive.name: Redwolf Shieldguard
skill.maia_passive.description: While holding a shield: double its defense component, 20% less direct damage and forced-movement immunity. Adjacent other allies gain +10 defenses and 25% direct reduction, 50% during wall. I restores 15 fatigue each round and halves shield wear. III shield defense 2.5x, 35% self reduction, radius 2/+15 defenses/35% reduction; indestructible shield and stun/daze/stagger immunity. V: 50% self reduction, allies +20 defenses/50% reduction or 65% during wall and forced-movement immunity; restore 25 fatigue. Tiers replace earlier values.
skin.maia_skin.name: Maia Initial Appearance
skin.maia_skin.description: A red-haired mercenary whose leather armor and fur collar have followed her from battlefield to battlefield.
skin.maia_oath_skin.name: Maia Oath Appearance
skin.maia_oath_skin.description: Her sword is still within reach. This time, she has comrades at her back.
skill.luu_luu_mountain.name: Mountain Cleaver
skill.luu_luu_mountain.description: 4 AP / 20 fatigue. Adjacent enemy 175% weapon/125% armor/65% penetration/+35 total accuracy. Furnace pressure on the target's first hit is separate.
skill.luu_luu_vent.name: Pressure Vent
skill.luu_luu_vent.description: Costs 3 AP and adds no fatigue, once per round. Strike an adjacent enemy for 125% weapon damage plus half your current fatigue as regular damage, counting up to 40 fatigue and rounding down. Uses the weapon’s armor damage, adds 20 percentage points of armor penetration and +15 hit chance. Recover the counted fatigue even on a miss. At stage III, count up to 60 fatigue and add its full value as damage. Replaced by Furnace Release at V. Does not also trigger Pressure bonus damage.
skill.luu_luu_split.name: Shieldbreak Pursuit
skill.luu_luu_split.description: 3 AP / 15 fatigue. Adjacent shielded enemy: apply double shield damage through native shield-break handling. Only an actual break on a surviving original enemy follows at 145% weapon/100% armor/60% penetration/+35 accuracy. No body hit without break; pressure applies to the body follow-up.
skill.luu_luu_spin.name: Red Furnace Spin
skill.luu_luu_spin.description: 5 AP / 28 fatigue. Once per round, all adjacent enemies 160% weapon/125% armor/55% penetration/+30 accuracy. Pressure applies once per enemy first hit; allies excluded.
skill.luu_luu_behead.name: Triple Cleaver
skill.luu_luu_behead.description: 6 AP / 32 fatigue. Once per round, three hits on one enemy at 100% weapon/100% armor/65% penetration/+35 accuracy each. Pressure once for the action; stop on original target death, no retarget.
skill.luu_luu_furnace.name: Furnace Release
skill.luu_luu_furnace.description: 6 AP / 0 fatigue. Once per round, requires an adjacent enemy. Each adjacent enemy takes 200% weapon damage+precast current fatigue ordinary damage, 125% armor/70% penetration/+40 accuracy. After all hits/misses set own fatigue to zero. No extra pressure.
valkyrie.luu_luu.name: Luu Luu
valkyrie.luu_luu.background.name: Pressure Core
valkyrie.luu_luu.background.description: An adult master of the great axe, captured after a reckless advance, learns to govern her strength in the workshop and on the battlefield.
valkyrie.luu_luu.trait.name: Pressure Core
valkyrie.luu_luu.trait.description: Requires a two-handed axe. +15 hit chance, +25 percentage points of weapon damage, +20 percentage points of armor penetration, and double shield damage. After paying an active attack’s fatigue cost, add 25% of your fatigue at that moment as regular damage, rounded down, on the first hit against each enemy per use. Stage III raises this to 50% and grants +20 maximum fatigue. Attacks of opportunity, counterattacks, Vent and Furnace Release do not trigger this bonus. Maximum AP by stage: 9, 10, 10, 11, 11, 12.
skill.luu_luu_passive.name: Red Furnace Berserker
skill.luu_luu_passive.description: Requires a two-handed axe. +15 hit chance, +25 percentage points of weapon damage, +20 percentage points of armor penetration, and double shield damage. After paying an active attack’s fatigue cost, add 25% of your fatigue at that moment as regular damage, rounded down, on the first hit against each enemy per use. Stage III raises this to 50% and grants +20 maximum fatigue. Attacks of opportunity, counterattacks, Vent and Furnace Release do not trigger this bonus. Maximum AP by stage: 9, 10, 10, 11, 11, 12.
skin.luu_luu_skin.name: Luu Luu Initial Appearance
skin.luu_luu_skin.description: The halfling clan leader, her gaze unyielding beneath a wide-brimmed hat.
skin.luu_luu_oath_skin.name: Luu Luu Oath Appearance
skin.luu_luu_oath_skin.description: She shoulders her great axe, determined to protect both her clan's path and her own.
black_beast.chloe.prologue.text: Chloe stayed behind to cover a retreat. Captured after her guard was defeated, she lays her sword on your desk but refuses a new allegiance. At every drill, her shield still faces the old city.
black_beast.chloe.prologue.reveal: You order her to protect the comrades beside her rather than forget her old sovereign. She calls this a temporary truce. Her instincts as a guard will gradually change what those words mean.
event.black_beast_chloe.20.name: Distance Behind the Shield
event.black_beast_chloe.20.title: Chloe: Distance Behind the Shield
event.black_beast_chloe.20.text: In the rain, Chloe repeats the rotation drill, always a heartbeat late to obey. What troubles her is the resistance she no longer feels.
event.black_beast_chloe.20.reveal: An old guard detachment is taking food from refugees. She insists on confronting the familiar insignia herself.
event.black_beast_chloe.20.victory: After the camp falls, she returns its stolen provisions. At the next command she raises her shield immediately, without looking back.
event.black_beast_chloe.20.reward: After victory: Pursuit reduces costs by 2 AP / 12 fatigue and adds 30 percentage points to damage. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_chloe.20.name: Chloe: Distance Behind the Shield
location.black_beast_chloe.20.descriptio: An old guard detachment is taking food from refugees. She insists on confronting the familiar insignia herself.
black_beast.chloe.stage.1.name: Distance Behind the Shield
black_beast.chloe.stage.1.description: After the camp falls, she returns its stolen provisions. At the next command she raises her shield immediately, without looking back.
event.black_beast_chloe.40.name: A Figure on the Map
event.black_beast_chloe.40.title: Chloe: A Figure on the Map
event.black_beast_chloe.40.text: Chloe joins your planning table but speaks only of routes and casualties. One night she realizes her first marks identify dangers to you.
event.black_beast_chloe.40.reveal: Scouts find an ambush camp cutting off a retreat. She accepts command of the rotation formation without treating it as an insult to her old oath.
event.black_beast_chloe.40.victory: She opens the retreat route and escorts the final wounded soldier. Taking her place beside you, she knows why she has chosen to remain.
event.black_beast_chloe.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Darkmoon Blades. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_chloe.40.name: Chloe: A Figure on the Map
location.black_beast_chloe.40.descriptio: Scouts find an ambush camp cutting off a retreat. She accepts command of the rotation formation without treating it as an insult to her old oath.
black_beast.chloe.stage.2.name: A Figure on the Map
black_beast.chloe.stage.2.description: She opens the retreat route and escorts the final wounded soldier. Taking her place beside you, she knows why she has chosen to remain.
event.black_beast_chloe.60.name: The Guard on the Bridge
event.black_beast_chloe.60.title: Chloe: The Guard on the Bridge
event.black_beast_chloe.60.text: Drills at a broken bridge are demanding. Repeated changes of guard no longer provoke arguments; Chloe asks how to bring everyone home.
event.black_beast_chloe.60.reveal: Warriors hold the bridgehead, trapping fugitives on a narrow bank. She requests the front line and promises to trust the formation.
event.black_beast_chloe.60.victory: With the bridgehead secured, her shield remains between you and the arrows. She admits the company's commands have become an order she can rely on.
event.black_beast_chloe.60.reward: After victory: Obsidian Fortress replaces Obsidian Stance. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_chloe.60.name: Chloe: The Guard on the Bridge
location.black_beast_chloe.60.descriptio: Warriors hold the bridgehead, trapping fugitives on a narrow bank. She requests the front line and promises to trust the formation.
black_beast.chloe.stage.3.name: The Guard on the Bridge
black_beast.chloe.stage.3.description: With the bridgehead secured, her shield remains between you and the arrows. She admits the company's commands have become an order she can rely on.
event.black_beast_chloe.80.name: The Watchtower Oath
event.black_beast_chloe.80.title: Chloe: The Watchtower Oath
event.black_beast_chloe.80.text: On watch, Chloe first calls you her own captain. Her old oath protected a city; your banner protects people who are still alive.
event.black_beast_chloe.80.reveal: Raiders gather outside the watchtower. She will prove that her chosen obedience can become a steadfast defense for her comrades.
event.black_beast_chloe.80.victory: After victory, she offers the salute of a royal guard and freely places her sword and shield within your command.
event.black_beast_chloe.80.reward: After victory: Slashes improve; recover 20 fatigue at the first normal turn each round. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_chloe.80.name: Chloe: The Watchtower Oath
location.black_beast_chloe.80.descriptio: Raiders gather outside the watchtower. She will prove that her chosen obedience can become a steadfast defense for her comrades.
black_beast.chloe.stage.4.name: The Watchtower Oath
black_beast.chloe.stage.4.description: After victory, she offers the salute of a royal guard and freely places her sword and shield within your command.
event.black_beast_chloe.100.name: The Blackblade's Faith
event.black_beast_chloe.100.title: Chloe: The Blackblade's Faith
event.black_beast_chloe.100.text: Chloe keeps her former insignia beneath the new banner. Loyalty now means the promises she sees you fulfill each day.
event.black_beast_chloe.100.reveal: An undead host occupies the hall of old oaths. She asks to clear it and affirm the path she will guard.
event.black_beast_chloe.100.victory: In the quiet hall she kneels with both hands on her sword. Your command becomes her chosen rule; the once-defiant guard is now a steadfast believer.
event.black_beast_chloe.100.reward: After victory: Permanent Fortress, improved attacks and two exchanges per round. Maximum AP: 12
location.black_beast_chloe.100.name: Chloe: The Blackblade's Faith
location.black_beast_chloe.100.descripti: An undead host occupies the hall of old oaths. She asks to clear it and affirm the path she will guard.
black_beast.chloe.stage.5.name: The Blackblade's Faith
black_beast.chloe.stage.5.description: In the quiet hall she kneels with both hands on her sword. Your command becomes her chosen rule; the once-defiant guard is now a steadfast believer.
black_beast.chloe.stage.0.name: Captured, Unbowed
black_beast.chloe.stage.0.description: Chloe stayed behind to cover a retreat. Captured after her guard was defeated, she lays her sword on your desk but refuses a new allegiance. At every drill, her shield still faces the old city.
black_beast.alicia.prologue.text: Alicia is captured when her sword formation breaks. Instead of the duel she demands, you assign daily drills in footwork, discipline and escort duty. She counts each order as an affront.
black_beast.alicia.prologue.reveal: You permit her knightly customs but demand that results give her oath meaning. She joins the company temporarily, still intending to challenge you after a victory.
event.black_beast_alicia.20.name: The Delayed Salute
event.black_beast_alicia.20.title: Alicia: The Delayed Salute
event.black_beast_alicia.20.text: Alicia draws before every command and delays putting her blade away. Repetition teaches her that restraint is part of swordsmanship.
event.black_beast_alicia.20.reveal: Raiders have ravaged a village near the drill yard. She will test the new formation and prove obedience need not stain honor.
event.black_beast_alicia.20.victory: After victory she sheathes her sword on command and reports without a challenge. The quiet salute marks her first acceptance of your discipline.
event.black_beast_alicia.20.reward: After victory: Unlock Swordheart Breath; paid hits expose targets and ignore shields. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_alicia.20.name: Alicia: The Delayed Salute
location.black_beast_alicia.20.descripti: Raiders have ravaged a village near the drill yard. She will test the new formation and prove obedience need not stain honor.
black_beast.alicia.stage.1.name: The Delayed Salute
black_beast.alicia.stage.1.description: After victory she sheathes her sword on command and reports without a challenge. The quiet salute marks her first acceptance of your discipline.
event.black_beast_alicia.40.name: A Question in the Scabbard
event.black_beast_alicia.40.title: Alicia: A Question in the Scabbard
event.black_beast_alicia.40.text: In the armory, Alicia asks why you place wounded soldiers before loot. Looking for mercenary hypocrisy, she finds none in the reports.
event.black_beast_alicia.40.reveal: Ambushers hold the road used by the wounded. Holding her scabbard across her hands, she asks for an order that will keep the route safe.
event.black_beast_alicia.40.victory: She escorts the wounded home and keeps the retreat record with her sword. Your example of responsibility begins to replace her obsession with rank.
event.black_beast_alicia.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Silver Triple. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_alicia.40.name: Alicia: A Question in the Scabbard
location.black_beast_alicia.40.descripti: Ambushers hold the road used by the wounded. Holding her scabbard across her hands, she asks for an order that will keep the route safe.
black_beast.alicia.stage.2.name: A Question in the Scabbard
black_beast.alicia.stage.2.description: She escorts the wounded home and keeps the retreat record with her sword. Your example of responsibility begins to replace her obsession with rank.
event.black_beast_alicia.60.name: Sword Stance on the Snow Ridge
event.black_beast_alicia.60.title: Alicia: Sword Stance on the Snow Ridge
event.black_beast_alicia.60.text: In the snow, she invites corrections to every movement. The duelist now cares whether each step supports her comrades.
event.black_beast_alicia.60.reveal: Warriors block a mountain pass under the guise of duels. Alicia chooses the company's formation over risking lives for personal fame.
event.black_beast_alicia.60.victory: With the pass open, she says she can finally hear both her blade and your commands. She wants to perfect that accord, not leave.
event.black_beast_alicia.60.reward: After victory: Enter with 3 sword stacks, cap 8; each stack adds 5% weapon damage. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_alicia.60.name: Alicia: Sword Stance on the Snow Ridge
location.black_beast_alicia.60.descripti: Warriors block a mountain pass under the guise of duels. Alicia chooses the company's formation over risking lives for personal fame.

black_beast.alicia.stage.3.description: With the pass open, she says she can finally hear both her blade and your commands. She wants to perfect that accord, not leave.
event.black_beast_alicia.80.name: The Offered Sword
event.black_beast_alicia.80.title: Alicia: The Offered Sword
event.black_beast_alicia.80.text: At dawn, Alicia brings her sword in both hands. Every argument had demanded proof of your worth; she needs no further excuse.
event.black_beast_alicia.80.reveal: Armored raiders besiege a caravan. She asks to lead the attack and place her sword entirely within your plan.
event.black_beast_alicia.80.victory: After victory she asks for no prize, only that you accept her allegiance. Her oath belongs to someone she has chosen herself.
event.black_beast_alicia.80.reward: After victory: Improve counters and recovery; the first paid hit each round grants an extra stack. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_alicia.80.name: Alicia: The Offered Sword
location.black_beast_alicia.80.descripti: Armored raiders besiege a caravan. She asks to lead the attack and place her sword entirely within your plan.
black_beast.alicia.stage.4.name: The Offered Sword
black_beast.alicia.stage.4.description: After victory she asks for no prize, only that you accept her allegiance. Her oath belongs to someone she has chosen herself.
event.black_beast_alicia.100.name: A New Silver Oath
event.black_beast_alicia.100.title: Alicia: A New Silver Oath
event.black_beast_alicia.100.text: Alicia writes a new oath in the chapel, recording how your conduct turned honor from a title into action.
event.black_beast_alicia.100.reveal: The remnants of an old order haunt its oath hall. One final battle will end her belief that allegiance must follow birth.
event.black_beast_alicia.100.victory: Beneath the blue-gold banner she places a hand over her heart. Your ideals become the rule of her sword and the foundation of her faith.
event.black_beast_alicia.100.reward: After victory: Enter with 5 permanent stacks, cap 10; improve triple strikes. Maximum AP: 12
location.black_beast_alicia.100.name: Alicia: A New Silver Oath
location.black_beast_alicia.100.descript: The remnants of an old order haunt its oath hall. One final battle will end her belief that allegiance must follow birth.

black_beast.alicia.stage.5.description: Beneath the blue-gold banner she places a hand over her heart. Your ideals become the rule of her sword and the foundation of her faith.

black_beast.alicia.stage.0.description: Alicia is captured when her sword formation breaks. Instead of the duel she demands, you assign daily drills in footwork, discipline and escort duty. She counts each order as an affront.
black_beast.claudia.prologue.text: Claudia is captured at a breach in the wall. She asks only how many defenders survived. Assigned camp fortifications and daily inspections, she treats your discipline as another siege.
black_beast.claudia.prologue.reveal: You demand that she prove leadership by protecting comrades. She accepts the hard assignment as temporary cooperation. Responsibilities beyond a city wall will change her judgment.
event.black_beast_claudia.20.name: The Breach and the Order
event.black_beast_claudia.20.title: Claudia: The Breach and the Order
event.black_beast_claudia.20.text: Claudia criticizes every gap in your defenses. Made responsible for closing them, she turns arguments into workable plans.
event.black_beast_claudia.20.reveal: Raiders strip a nearby fort of building supplies. She will reclaim them so obedience can leave a tangible wall behind.
event.black_beast_claudia.20.victory: She works beside the builders late into the night. Her report first acknowledges your plan instead of merely listing faults.
event.black_beast_claudia.20.reward: After victory: Unlock Armor Wedge; the first paid armor break each round refunds 12 fatigue. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_claudia.20.name: Claudia: The Breach and the Order
location.black_beast_claudia.20.descript: Raiders strip a nearby fort of building supplies. She will reclaim them so obedience can leave a tangible wall behind.
black_beast.claudia.stage.1.name: The Breach and the Order
black_beast.claudia.stage.1.description: She works beside the builders late into the night. Her report first acknowledges your plan instead of merely listing faults.
event.black_beast_claudia.40.name: The Forge Debrief
event.black_beast_claudia.40.title: Claudia: The Forge Debrief
event.black_beast_claudia.40.text: At the forge you review every hammer strike, remembering each sheltered soldier as carefully as the damage to the wall.
event.black_beast_claudia.40.reveal: An armory camp holds the city's builders. She will use her armor-breaking training to bring them back.
event.black_beast_claudia.40.victory: With the builders safe, she offers her hammer for inspection. Accepting guidance now means saving lives rather than surrendering dignity.
event.black_beast_claudia.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Earth Sweep. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_claudia.40.name: Claudia: The Forge Debrief
location.black_beast_claudia.40.descript: An armory camp holds the city's builders. She will use her armor-breaking training to bring them back.
black_beast.claudia.stage.2.name: The Forge Debrief
black_beast.claudia.stage.2.description: With the builders safe, she offers her hammer for inspection. Accepting guidance now means saving lives rather than surrendering dignity.
event.black_beast_claudia.60.name: Plans in the Rain
event.black_beast_claudia.60.title: Claudia: Plans in the Rain
event.black_beast_claudia.60.text: Rain damages the temporary defenses. Sketching routes at the gate, Claudia first asks your purpose, then where her strength belongs.
event.black_beast_claudia.60.reveal: Mountain warriors hold the far end of the route. She will break their formation and open a road for the company and refugees.
event.black_beast_claudia.60.victory: After breaking the camp, she returns command to you. The defender is willing to let your judgment unite her duties.
event.black_beast_claudia.60.reward: After victory: Stronger Shatter; add 50 damage percentage points against completely unarmored targets. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_claudia.60.name: Claudia: Plans in the Rain
location.black_beast_claudia.60.descript: Mountain warriors hold the far end of the route. She will break their formation and open a road for the company and refugees.
black_beast.claudia.stage.3.name: Plans in the Rain
black_beast.claudia.stage.3.description: After breaking the camp, she returns command to you. The defender is willing to let your judgment unite her duties.
event.black_beast_claudia.80.name: The Rebuilt Battlement
event.black_beast_claudia.80.title: Claudia: The Rebuilt Battlement
event.black_beast_claudia.80.text: The rebuilt battlement bears your banner. Asked to undergo the strictest drills again, Claudia answers before anyone else.
event.black_beast_claudia.80.reveal: An armored raiding force approaches the rebuilding settlement. She asks to lead the assault without abandoning your formation for pride.
event.black_beast_claudia.80.victory: After shattering the enemy camp, she salutes beside the new wall. The order you have built is what she truly wants to defend.
event.black_beast_claudia.80.reward: After victory: Unlock Cityquake. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_claudia.80.name: Claudia: The Rebuilt Battlement
location.black_beast_claudia.80.descript: An armored raiding force approaches the rebuilding settlement. She asks to lead the assault without abandoning your formation for pride.
black_beast.claudia.stage.4.name: The Rebuilt Battlement
black_beast.claudia.stage.4.description: After shattering the enemy camp, she salutes beside the new wall. The order you have built is what she truly wants to defend.
event.black_beast_claudia.100.name: Where the White City Belongs
event.black_beast_claudia.100.title: Claudia: Where the White City Belongs
event.black_beast_claudia.100.text: Claudia polishes the old city insignia. Stone alone is not a city; the will that lets people live together deserves lifelong defense.
event.black_beast_claudia.100.reveal: An ancient army holds the white oath steps. She asks to clear them and end an allegiance bound only to a city.
event.black_beast_claudia.100.victory: At the white steps she kneels over her hammer, accepting you as her leader and belief. The city she protects will travel with your banner.
event.black_beast_claudia.100.reward: After victory: Unlock White City Fall; Shatter lasts for the battle. Maximum AP: 12
location.black_beast_claudia.100.name: Claudia: Where the White City Belongs
location.black_beast_claudia.100.descrip: An ancient army holds the white oath steps. She asks to clear them and end an allegiance bound only to a city.

black_beast.claudia.stage.5.description: At the white steps she kneels over her hammer, accepting you as her leader and belief. The city she protects will travel with your banner.

black_beast.celestine.prologue.text: Celestine is captured while evacuating a sanctuary. Expecting destruction from mercenaries, she is instead assigned to heal both sides and record every spell. She obeys quietly while reserving judgment.
black_beast.celestine.prologue.reveal: She keeps her distance in the goddess's name. You leave her prayers untouched but insist her power reach those who need it. Future battles will reshape how she understands faith.
event.black_beast_celestine.20.name: Beyond Prayer
event.black_beast_celestine.20.title: Celestine: Beyond Prayer
event.black_beast_celestine.20.text: In the garden she asks whether you fear the gods. You hand her the wounded list and ask her to answer their suffering first.
event.black_beast_celestine.20.reveal: Raiders hoard medicine and clean water. She joins the attack on the condition that surrendered enemies receive care too.
event.black_beast_celestine.20.victory: You keep that promise. Discovering mercy within military orders, she first speaks your name in her evening prayer.
event.black_beast_celestine.20.reward: After victory: Healing adds half recovery to one nearby ally; the first actual recovery refunds 10 fatigue. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_celestine.20.name: Celestine: Beyond Prayer
location.black_beast_celestine.20.descri: Raiders hoard medicine and clean water. She joins the attack on the condition that surrendered enemies receive care too.

black_beast.celestine.stage.1.descriptio: You keep that promise. Discovering mercy within military orders, she first speaks your name in her evening prayer.
event.black_beast_celestine.40.name: Light in Her Hands
event.black_beast_celestine.40.title: Celestine: Light in Her Hands
event.black_beast_celestine.40.text: Healing drills become exacting. She records your timing instructions herself and realizes your voice steadies her during the night watch.
event.black_beast_celestine.40.reveal: A hostile camp holds medicine wagons. She asks for your plan and offers her light to support every command.
event.black_beast_celestine.40.victory: With the wagons recovered she heals through the night. She admits her reliance on you has outgrown a temporary alliance.
event.black_beast_celestine.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Farshore Gate. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_celestine.40.name: Celestine: Light in Her Hands
location.black_beast_celestine.40.descri: A hostile camp holds medicine wagons. She asks for your plan and offers her light to support every command.

event.black_beast_celestine.60.name: Beyond the Gate
event.black_beast_celestine.60.title: Celestine: Beyond the Gate
event.black_beast_celestine.60.text: Her gate drills now focus on extracting comrades rather than returning to the sanctuary. She is willing to let you choose where the door leads.
event.black_beast_celestine.60.reveal: A blocked mountain route demands a precise extraction. She will test her new trust by placing the gate within your breakthrough plan.
event.black_beast_celestine.60.victory: She returns only after the last comrade passes through. Her divine power, she says, is willing to follow your purpose.
event.black_beast_celestine.60.reward: After victory: Unlock Absolute Shelter and improve blessings. Maximum AP: 12
location.black_beast_celestine.60.name: Celestine: Beyond the Gate

event.black_beast_celestine.80.name: Shelter After Mourning
event.black_beast_celestine.80.title: Celestine: Shelter After Mourning
event.black_beast_celestine.80.text: At the memorial she stops calling every loss divine will. She asks how to protect the living and accepts harder battlefield training.
event.black_beast_celestine.80.reveal: Armored raiders threaten a refuge. She places her shelter within your plan to defend individual lives.
event.black_beast_celestine.80.victory: With the refuge safe, her evening prayer becomes a blessing for the company. Your promises become the measure by which she understands faith.
event.black_beast_celestine.80.reward: After victory: Unlock Celestial Judgment. Maximum AP: 13

event.black_beast_celestine.100.name: A Faith Freely Chosen
event.black_beast_celestine.100.title: Celestine: A Faith Freely Chosen
event.black_beast_celestine.100.text: In the white-gold chapel she admits she once hid faith behind a distant divine name. Shared hardship lets her place trust in someone before her.
event.black_beast_celestine.100.reveal: The dead occupy the place of vows. She will clear it, guard her comrades with a seal of life, and affirm her choice.
event.black_beast_celestine.100.victory: Kneeling in the light, she names you her guide. Her power remains her own, but steadfast faith entrusts its direction to her captain.
event.black_beast_celestine.100.reward: After victory: Unlock Resurrection Seal; healing reaches two extra allies at 75% strength. Maximum AP: 14

black_beast.kaguya.prologue.text: Kaguya is captured when her seal formation fails. She resents foreign camp rules and accepts only quiet talisman drills. You ask her to witness the company's rescues before judging whether her teachings answer everything.
black_beast.kaguya.prologue.reveal: She records your commands to expose flaws in the company's beliefs. You permit her scrutiny and hold her responsible for the consequences of her rites.
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.name: Hesitation Beneath the Torii
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.title: Kaguya: Hesitation Beneath the Torii
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.text: Kaguya recites an old rule before every command. Repeated drills make her question whether hesitation comes from doctrine or herself.
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.reveal: Armed zealots expel villagers in a deity's name. She will examine whom their doctrine actually protects.
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.victory: She returns the recovered charms to the villagers and admits your commands came closer to the true purpose of protection.
event.black_beast_kaguya.20.reward: After victory: Seals reduce defense by 15; the first new seal each round refunds 10 fatigue. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_kaguya.20.name: Kaguya: Hesitation Beneath the Torii

event.black_beast_kaguya.40.name: A Rewritten Talisman
event.black_beast_kaguya.40.title: Kaguya: A Rewritten Talisman
event.black_beast_kaguya.40.text: At her desk she adds your tactical marks to a seal. Corrections no longer feel like insults; she wants her rites to serve the formation.
event.black_beast_kaguya.40.reveal: A mountain ambush camp disrupts ritual timing. She asks you to lead the test of her revised seals.
event.black_beast_kaguya.40.victory: After victory she writes your commands in the margin of a talisman, placing your judgment before its old commentary.
event.black_beast_kaguya.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Moonwheel Sweep. Maximum AP: 10

event.black_beast_kaguya.60.title: Kaguya: The Rain Bridge Seal
event.black_beast_kaguya.60.text: Bridge drills require her to surrender control of timing. Your coordination sharpens the seals and relieves her of carrying everything alone.
event.black_beast_kaguya.60.reveal: Warriors hold the bridgehead. She asks to weave her seal formation into your plan so every charm protects someone specific.
event.black_beast_kaguya.60.victory: The bridge opens. Saluting with her naginata, she says her obedience follows what she has witnessed it achieve.
event.black_beast_kaguya.60.reward: After victory: Seals reduce 3 AP, 35% direct damage and 20 defense, blocking active displacement. Maximum AP: 11

black_beast.kaguya.stage.3.description: The bridge opens. Saluting with her naginata, she says her obedience follows what she has witnessed it achieve.
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.name: The Banner on the Moon Terrace
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.title: Kaguya: The Banner on the Moon Terrace
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.text: At the moonlit rite she places your banner within her seal circle. She is no longer merely observing the company's beliefs; she officiates them.
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.reveal: Armored raiders enter the ritual grounds. She will use the Eightfold Seal under your command to defend the new covenant.
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.victory: With peace restored, she leaves the place of honor for you. Shared promises now guide the interpretation of her old rules.
event.black_beast_kaguya.80.reward: After victory: Unlock Eightfold Seal. Maximum AP: 11

event.black_beast_kaguya.100.name: The Divine Within Her Heart
event.black_beast_kaguya.100.title: Kaguya: The Divine Within Her Heart
event.black_beast_kaguya.100.text: In the incense hall she writes a new prayer, choosing her captain as the guide of her belief rather than hiding from choice behind divine names.
event.black_beast_kaguya.100.reveal: Ancient dead occupy the solar altar. She asks to perform the final purification and leave her former limits behind.
event.black_beast_kaguya.100.victory: In the lingering incense she vows with a hand over her heart. Her strength, judgment and faith join the company; she becomes your steadfast believer.
event.black_beast_kaguya.100.reward: After victory: Unlock Solar Purge; seals become stronger and last for the battle. Maximum AP: 12

black_beast.prim.prologue.text: Prim is captured after her escort collapses. She insists on noble etiquette but knows little of a soldier's drills. You assign daily banner duty with no exemption for rank.
black_beast.prim.prologue.reveal: She believes a banner should represent a family name. You require her to learn the names beneath it and witness what her hesitation costs them.
event.black_beast_prim.20.name: The Weight of the Banner
event.black_beast_prim.20.title: Prim: The Weight of the Banner
event.black_beast_prim.20.text: Prim complains of the banner's weight. Drilling until she keeps pace, she first remembers the soldier who helps correct her steps.
event.black_beast_prim.20.reveal: Raiders take a village company's banner and food. She joins the recovery to learn that banners need not belong only to nobles.
event.black_beast_prim.20.victory: The villagers raise their recovered banner. She stays among them, giving her first obedience a human reason.
event.black_beast_prim.20.reward: After victory: Banner allies recover 5 fatigue each round; improve Rally. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_prim.20.name: Prim: The Weight of the Banner
location.black_beast_prim.20.description: Raiders take a village company's banner and food. She joins the recovery to learn that banners need not belong only to nobles.
black_beast.prim.stage.1.name: The Weight of the Banner
black_beast.prim.stage.1.description: The villagers raise their recovered banner. She stays among them, giving her first obedience a human reason.
event.black_beast_prim.40.name: Names in the Command Tent
event.black_beast_prim.40.title: Prim: Names in the Command Tent
event.black_beast_prim.40.text: Prim begins maintaining the company roster. Corrected for every omission, she grows embarrassed but no longer asks others to bear her mistakes.
event.black_beast_prim.40.reveal: Ambushers hold a missing standard-bearer. She asks for your rescue plan and carries the roster herself.
event.black_beast_prim.40.victory: When the bearer returns, she greets him by name. Reliance on you becomes responsibility toward the whole company.
event.black_beast_prim.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Twin Star Thrust. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_prim.40.name: Prim: Names in the Command Tent
location.black_beast_prim.40.description: Ambushers hold a missing standard-bearer. She asks for your rescue plan and carries the roster herself.

black_beast.prim.stage.2.description: When the bearer returns, she greets him by name. Reliance on you becomes responsibility toward the whole company.
event.black_beast_prim.60.name: Twin Stars on the Ridge
event.black_beast_prim.60.title: Prim: Twin Stars on the Ridge
event.black_beast_prim.60.text: Ridge drills forbid letting the banner fall. Breathing to your commands turns her panic into a steady rhythm.
event.black_beast_prim.60.reveal: Mountain fighters threaten the column's morale. She chooses to carry the banner at the front and share its danger.
event.black_beast_prim.60.victory: After victory her banner still stands. She obeys because you have never left anyone's courage unsupported.
event.black_beast_prim.60.reward: After victory: Banner radius becomes 6; improve attributes and fatigue recovery. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_prim.60.name: Prim: Twin Stars on the Ridge
location.black_beast_prim.60.description: Mountain fighters threaten the column's morale. She chooses to carry the banner at the front and share its danger.

black_beast.prim.stage.3.description: After victory her banner still stands. She obeys because you have never left anyone's courage unsupported.
event.black_beast_prim.80.name: The Promise After Folding the Flag
event.black_beast_prim.80.title: Prim: The Promise After Folding the Flag
event.black_beast_prim.80.text: Prim folds the banner herself. She asks about the next battle rather than when her former position will be restored.
event.black_beast_prim.80.reveal: An armored force threatens the protected road. She offers her cleansing rites and commands entirely to your plan.
event.black_beast_prim.80.victory: With the road safe, she pledges allegiance in a noble salute. The standing she wants is now that of a bearer trusted by her captain.
event.black_beast_prim.80.reward: After victory: Unlock Banner Cleanse. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_prim.80.name: Prim: The Promise After Folding the Flag
location.black_beast_prim.80.description: An armored force threatens the protected road. She offers her cleansing rites and commands entirely to your plan.

black_beast.prim.stage.4.description: With the road safe, she pledges allegiance in a noble salute. The standing she wants is now that of a bearer trusted by her captain.
event.black_beast_prim.100.name: The Banner as Faith
event.black_beast_prim.100.title: Prim: The Banner as Faith
event.black_beast_prim.100.text: Prim prepares a modest ceremony. Instead of placing her family name on the banner, she tells how you have kept the company's shared promises.
event.black_beast_prim.100.reveal: An ancient formation holds the ceremonial grounds. She asks to break it with you so the banner can symbolize a choice made by the living.
event.black_beast_prim.100.victory: Before the company she raises the banner and embraces your ideals as her faith. What once represented a family now carries her wholehearted devotion.
event.black_beast_prim.100.reward: After victory: Banner radius becomes 8; improve aura, twin strikes and Rally. Maximum AP: 12
location.black_beast_prim.100.name: Prim: The Banner as Faith

black_beast.maia.prologue.text: Maia is captured after failing to hold a bridge, hiding anger behind laughter. You assign shield duty and require every covering exchange, forbidding reckless charges alone.
black_beast.maia.prologue.reveal: She accepts service as the price of a future challenge. You demand she protect others before debating her courage. Responsibility behind the shield will change her.
event.black_beast_maia.20.name: Temper at the Shield Rim
event.black_beast_maia.20.title: Maia: Temper at the Shield Rim
event.black_beast_maia.20.text: Maia wants to end every correction with a hard blow. Learning to stand firm and cover a flank proves harder than brute strength.
event.black_beast_maia.20.reveal: Raiders control the outpost's timber camp. She will reclaim it under orders rather than chase the thrill of a charge.
event.black_beast_maia.20.victory: She stays with the wounded instead of pursuing fleeing enemies. For the first time restraint, not a war cry, makes her proud.
event.black_beast_maia.20.reward: After victory: Recover 15 fatigue each normal round; halve shield wear. Maximum AP: 10
location.black_beast_maia.20.name: Maia: Temper at the Shield Rim
location.black_beast_maia.20.description: Raiders control the outpost's timber camp. She will reclaim it under orders rather than chase the thrill of a charge.

event.black_beast_maia.40.name: The Shield Beside the Fire
event.black_beast_maia.40.title: Maia: The Shield Beside the Fire
event.black_beast_maia.40.text: At the outpost debrief Maia admits fearing another lost position. You ask her to put that fear into the defense plan instead of hiding it in laughter.
event.black_beast_maia.40.reveal: Ambushers threaten the patrol's retreat. She asks to lead the shield guard and turn fear into dependable cover.
event.black_beast_maia.40.victory: With the patrol safe she quietly takes your watch beside the fire. Relying on command no longer feels like cowardice.
event.black_beast_maia.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Redwolf Sweep. Maximum AP: 10

location.black_beast_maia.40.description: Ambushers threaten the patrol's retreat. She asks to lead the shield guard and turn fear into dependable cover.
black_beast.maia.stage.2.name: The Shield Beside the Fire
black_beast.maia.stage.2.description: With the patrol safe she quietly takes your watch beside the fire. Relying on command no longer feels like cowardice.
event.black_beast_maia.60.name: The Bridge in the Storm
event.black_beast_maia.60.title: Maia: The Bridge in the Storm
event.black_beast_maia.60.text: In storm drills she accepts repeated shieldwall corrections. Commands now show the comrades behind her where safety lies.
event.black_beast_maia.60.reveal: Mountain warriors take a bridgehead. At the site of her old failure she will defend through your formation.
event.black_beast_maia.60.victory: The bridge is reclaimed, her shield facing the greatest danger throughout. She freely entrusts the direction of her courage to you.
event.black_beast_maia.60.reward: After victory: Shield defense ×2.5, unbreakable shield, stronger protection and stun/daze/stagger immunity. Maximum AP: 11
location.black_beast_maia.60.name: Maia: The Bridge in the Storm
location.black_beast_maia.60.description: Mountain warriors take a bridgehead. At the site of her old failure she will defend through your formation.

black_beast.maia.stage.3.description: The bridge is reclaimed, her shield facing the greatest danger throughout. She freely entrusts the direction of her courage to you.
event.black_beast_maia.80.name: The Redwolf on the Tower
event.black_beast_maia.80.title: Maia: The Redwolf on the Tower
event.black_beast_maia.80.text: Maia practices battle cries on the tower, matching the formation's rhythm. She no longer needs to sound louder than your orders.
event.black_beast_maia.80.reveal: Armored raiders surround the outpost. She asks you to direct the battle while she steadies the company behind the shieldwall.
event.black_beast_maia.80.victory: After routing the camp she salutes from the tower, entrusting every advance and withdrawal to your judgment.
event.black_beast_maia.80.reward: After victory: Unlock Redwolf Battlecry. Maximum AP: 11

black_beast.maia.stage.4.description: After routing the camp she salutes from the tower, entrusting every advance and withdrawal to your judgment.
event.black_beast_maia.100.name: The Redwolf Returns to the Banner
event.black_beast_maia.100.title: Maia: The Redwolf Returns to the Banner
event.black_beast_maia.100.text: Maia rests her repaired shield beneath the red-gold banner. Faith means believing, in the worst danger, that her captain will bring everyone home.
event.black_beast_maia.100.reveal: The dead hold the final oath camp. She asks to clear it with you, defending the new belief with an unbreakable shield.
event.black_beast_maia.100.victory: Kneeling with a hand over her heart, she names you the banner of her life. The Redwolf's cry now declares steadfast, loyal devotion.
event.black_beast_maia.100.reward: After victory: Improve personal and aura protection; recover 25 fatigue per normal round. Maximum AP: 12

black_beast.luu_luu.prologue.text: Luu Luu, an adult axe warrior, is captured after a reckless advance. She denies losing control until you assign daily haft repairs, fatigue records and precise axe drills.
black_beast.luu_luu.prologue.reveal: She treats discipline as a nuisance that limits strength. You require her to inspect every damaged tool and witness how comrades bear the cost of a reckless advance.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.name: Marks on the Axe Haft
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.title: Luu Luu: Marks on the Axe Haft
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.text: Luu Luu wants to split every practice post at once. You have her mark a rhythm on the haft and strike only at the commanded moment.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.reveal: Raiders take the quarry's tools. She will follow the new rhythm to recover the workers' livelihood.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.victory: Returning the tools, she checks her haft for cracks. She is willing to govern today's strength for tomorrow's battle.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.20.reward: After victory: Unlock Shieldbreak Pursuit. Maximum AP: 10

event.black_beast_luu_luu.40.text: In the workshop you review every expenditure of fatigue. Careful guidance makes her feel valued rather than dismissed.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.40.reveal: An armory camp hoards replacement hafts. She asks you to lead and promises not to break formation to strike first.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.40.victory: She presents the new haft for inspection, valuing your approval more than another uncontrolled crash.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.40.reward: After victory: Unlock Red Furnace Spin. Maximum AP: 10

event.black_beast_luu_luu.60.title: Luu Luu: A Rhythm on the Mountain Road
event.black_beast_luu_luu.60.text: Long marches teach her to conserve strength. Obeying the command to stop, even when exhausted, brings unexpected relief.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.60.reveal: Mountain fighters exhaust travelers through repeated challenges. She will break through with the formation and controlled pressure.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.60.victory: With the road open she rests the axe on her shoulder instead of seeking another opponent. You may decide when her strength is released.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.60.reward: After victory: Maximum fatigue +20, pressure coefficient 50%, vent cap 60. Maximum AP: 11

event.black_beast_luu_luu.80.name: A Promise Before the Furnace
event.black_beast_luu_luu.80.title: Luu Luu: A Promise Before the Furnace
event.black_beast_luu_luu.80.text: At the campfire Luu Luu listens through the whole plan. Waiting no longer frightens her when it protects those beside her.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.80.reveal: Armored raiders try to crush the formation. She offers to break their line, promising every stroke will follow your commands.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.80.victory: After breaking the line she stops at your chosen position. Precise obedience has become the skill she is proudest of.

event.black_beast_luu_luu.100.title: Luu Luu: Where the Furnace Belongs
event.black_beast_luu_luu.100.text: Beneath an old oak, Luu Luu describes the future she wants to protect. Your ideals can give a home to the strength she once could not govern.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.100.reveal: The dead guard the shrine of oath bells. She asks to enter the final trial and release the furnace in defense of her comrades.
event.black_beast_luu_luu.100.victory: As the bells sound, she vows with a hand over her heart. The axe remains heavy, but her heart is settled: her captain is the belief she follows faithfully.
