chapter.black_city.goal.queen_won: Defeat Olga and the court guard
chapter.black_city.name: Fall of the Black City
chapter.black_city.description: Accept a mercenary contract against the dark elf queen. Cut her supplies, break the bridge guard, extinguish the wards, and take her surrender.
chapter.black_city.ending: The Black City has ceased resistance. Its banner and surrender are sent to the employer. Chloe and Olga sign new contracts and draw the company’s pay. At tomorrow’s muster, they will stand beneath your flag.
chapter.black_city.opening.name: The Black Moon on the Contract
chapter.black_city.opening.line1: The contract lies on a table still wet with spilled ale. Its seal is cracked. Half a trade map is tucked inside; the road to the Black City has been heavily inked.
chapter.black_city.opening.line2: The employer will pay the company to take the Black City and break Queen Olga’s blockade. The balance is due upon delivery of the royal banner and her surrender. Her head is not required.
chapter.black_city.opening.line3: Why did the last company fail to return?
chapter.black_city.opening.line4: No one gives a complete answer. Some mention a pale-haired guard at the Black Bridge. Others say the palace lights call the dead back. You note both claims on the back of the map.
chapter.black_city.opening.line5: Scout the road. Count their troops. We’re being paid for a job, not to gamble our lives on rumors.
chapter.black_city.opening.line6: Before dawn, the wagon axles are greased. The Black City is only a spot of ink on the map. Bringing it to heel will take more than a single charge.
chapter.black_city.stage1.name: Where the Wagon Tracks Lead
chapter.black_city.stage1.line1: Wet fodder remains in the abandoned waystation. Three broken bolts lie in a corner, but the door was never forced. Its defenders withdrew in good order.
chapter.black_city.stage1.line2: You follow the tracks to an old lime kiln. The wagons entering the city carried heavy grain sacks. Those returning were light, their rims stained with violet ash.
chapter.black_city.stage1.line3: The supply wagons bypass the Black Bridge. They change teams at the eastern kiln.
chapter.black_city.stage1.line4: A discarded duty roster confirms it. At dusk, the outer garrison collects supplies; the palace guard handles only the final stretch.
chapter.black_city.stage1.line5: Hit the collection detail. Keep the storehouse and fodder intact. We’ll be here a few days.
chapter.black_city.stage1.line6: You reverse a captured signpost at the fork. Crossbowmen take the low wall; the horses are led out of the wind. Tonight you wait for wagons, not a queen.
chapter.black_city.stage2.name: The Dusk Convoy
chapter.black_city.stage2.line1: The last wagon stops at the kiln. Guards lie beside the shafts. Bolts stud the cart, but most of the grain sacks are intact.
chapter.black_city.stage2.line2: Stop the wounded bleeding. Then open the crates. Keep the prisoners away from the horns.
chapter.black_city.stage2.line3: The crates hold armor patches, bandages, and a wooden tally listing the bridge watches. After nightfall, the guard is due to rotate out for supplies.
chapter.black_city.stage2.line4: Someone suggests a charge before the city recovers. You look at its walls. Every brazier is still lit. They have already heard the distant crossbows.
chapter.black_city.stage2.line5: Let them wait hungry. We eat and mend our shields.
chapter.black_city.stage2.line6: The bridge horn sounds three times that night. The third call is shorter. You keep the tally close and wait for a watch change with no supplies behind it.
chapter.black_city.stage3.name: The Old Gate Beneath the Bridge
chapter.black_city.stage3.line1: Low water exposes a rusted culvert gate. Its lock is packed solid. The smith removes the hinges with a cloth-wrapped hammer, pausing whenever a patrol crosses overhead.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line2: Steps behind the gate lead to the drawbridge winch. Few guards watch it, but fresh marks scrape the wall. The passage is still in use.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line3: That is far enough. Take another step and you’ll have no way back.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line4: A pale-haired dark elf stands at the far end of the bridge, shield pressed to the parapet. She counts the men behind you, then notices the watch tally in your hand.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line5: Chloe? We’re here for the queen’s surrender. You still have time to withdraw.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line6: Did you learn my name for your list of kills?
chapter.black_city.stage3.line7: So I won’t have to call you “the one with the shield” when I tell you to stop.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line8: Then watch closely. The guard of the Black Bridge will not stand aside.
chapter.black_city.stage3.line9: You take half a step back and put your shieldmen at the exit. The bridge is narrow enough for her to block you, and narrow enough that she cannot flank you.
chapter.black_city.stage4.name: The Guard’s Fallen Sword
chapter.black_city.stage4.line1: Chloe’s sword skids over the stone and stops at your boots. She falls to her knees, still reaching for it, but can no longer raise her shield.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line2: Leave them alone. Deal with me.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line3: The remaining guards have withdrawn behind the portcullis. She does not look back, but her ears follow every retreating footstep.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line4: Give me the winch. I won’t chase wounded men into the alleys.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line6: My company took this bridge. Here, I give the orders.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line7: She stares at you for a long time before loosening her grip. You kick the sword away, have her helped to a sheltered parapet, and leave two men to guard her.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line8: The queen won’t surrender because I lost.
chapter.black_city.stage4.line9: I know. Now tell me about the lights inside the city.
chapter.black_city.stage5.name: The City Beneath the Lights
chapter.black_city.stage5.line1: The prisoner sits on a captured grain chest, a waterskin within reach. Whenever violet light pulses from the palace tower, she looks up.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line2: Three ward lamps feed the court. The main gate is sealed. Bring another company and you’ll only crowd the road.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line3: We cut the supply road. We can extinguish the lamps. How do we reach them?
chapter.black_city.stage5.line4: The ward patrol uses the old armory passage. The guard holds the keys.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line5: She does not hand over the keys. You do not reach for them. Inside the walls, a cart loaded with bodies rolls past. You both see it.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line6: Once the lamps are out, no fires in the houses. Those people aren’t soldiers.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line7: I’m here to take a palace. A heap of burned bricks is no use to me.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line8: At last she places the keys on the chest. You mark the short route between tower and armory, post men at the well, and leave room for the wounded to withdraw.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line9: I haven’t agreed to fight for you.
chapter.black_city.stage5.line10: First, leave us a city that will still be here tomorrow. We can discuss the rest then.
chapter.black_city.stage6.name: Three Dark Lamps Extinguished
chapter.black_city.stage6.line1: The chains in the tower keep rattling after the priest falls. Shieldmen hold the stairs while the smith cuts the copper feeds to all three lamps.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line2: The light dies. The dead guards collapse, helmets striking stone. The violet veil over the palace gate finally breaks.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line3: Don’t smash the western lamp. There’s a cistern beneath it. Pulling the feed is enough.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line4: Do as she says. Remove the core. Leave the housing.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line5: You send the cores back to the bridge with the military map. The way into the city is open. The way out remains secure.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line6: She knows now that I gave you the keys.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line7: Then tell her why, to her face. I want a living queen and a living guard.
chapter.black_city.stage6.line8: Chloe returns the empty waterskin. She no longer asks whether you will hunt down the wounded. She asks when the palace doors will open.
chapter.black_city.stage7.name: Terms Before the Throne
chapter.black_city.stage7.line1: The court doors stand open. Olga is not seated on her throne. She stands before its steps, the end of her staff pinning a corner of her cape.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line2: My ward lamps. My guard. You’ve taken both. What else do you want from me?
chapter.black_city.stage7.line3: Your banner, your surrender, and your order for the remaining troops to lay down their arms.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line4: You think a hired contract gives you the right to decide the fate of my city?
chapter.black_city.stage7.line5: The contract paid our way here. The battles on the bridge and in your tower decided the rest.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line6: Your Majesty, the ward is broken. There is no second supply road.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line7: Stand aside, Chloe. You have said enough on their behalf.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line8: She raises her staff. One by one, the hall’s braziers flare. Her knuckles tighten, but the black flame is smaller than the rumors promised.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line9: Crossbowmen, spread out. Keep the doorway clear. The wounded stay outside.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line10: If you want my surrender, climb these steps and take it.
chapter.black_city.stage7.line11: You draw your weapon. Chloe moves to the side door, where the corridor leads the wounded out. This time, she does not raise her shield against you.
chapter.black_city.stage8.name: The Black Queen Defeated
chapter.black_city.stage8.line1: The staff strikes a step. The black flame flashes one last time. Olga falls against the foot of her throne, trying to rise on an arm that no longer obeys her.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line2: Come closer. You wanted my command, didn’t you?
chapter.black_city.stage8.line3: First, order them to stop fighting.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line4: Steel still clashes outside. She listens, then lifts her head. Her voice is quiet, but the guards at the doors lower their swords.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line5: The court ceases resistance. All troops withdraw to the courtyard. No further attacks.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line6: I take the banner. The granaries and wells remain open. You and Chloe leave with the company.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line7: You take me away and think the city becomes yours?
chapter.black_city.stage8.line8: Today it belongs to whoever can stop the fighting. The terms for what comes next go in the surrender.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line9: I leave with her. The surviving guard stays to protect the stores. Don’t hand them over to your employer’s troops.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line10: Agreed. They guard the stores. You two serve under my command. Put that in writing too.
chapter.black_city.stage8.line11: Olga looks at Chloe, then at the throne standing empty above her. Her fingers still tremble as she takes the surrender, but her signature is firm.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.name: After the Surrender
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line1: The court falls quiet. Olga and Chloe rest below the steps, their weapons set aside. A surrender document lies on the table, its ink still wet and one corner weighed down by the royal banner.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line2: Don’t think signing that paper means I’ll like your orders.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line3: You don’t have to like them. Follow them under fire. We can argue in camp.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line5: You slide over the new roster. Chloe checks the daily wage, then Olga’s name. Only after finding both on the same page does she take the pen.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line6: Company rules. Your equipment stays yours. Spoils go to the company. If you’re wounded, you get treatment.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line7: The city’s stores cannot wait. Send out the ceasefire today.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line8: Already sent. Eat something. We leave in the morning.
chapter.black_city.epilogue.line9: Outside, the black-moon banner is taken down and carefully rolled. Wagons bring grain over the bridge. You put both names in the roster: proof to claim the contract’s balance, and two stubborn new companions for the road ahead.
chapter.black_city.stage1.brief: Visit the abandoned waystation and trace the supply route from wagon tracks and duty records.
chapter.black_city.stage2.brief: Capture the dusk supply depot. Shieldmen cover the wagons and crossbowmen fire from behind them. Flank the shields and suppress the shooters.
chapter.black_city.tools_source: Tools for opening the gate; supplies were recovered from the convoy.
chapter.black_city.stage3.brief: Use the captured watch schedule to inspect the culvert and drawbridge winch. Opening the rusted gate consumes 10 tools.
chapter.black_city.stage4.brief: Break the Black Bridge guard. Chloe uses sword, shield, and rotation. Break her shield or flank; don’t spend every attack against her shieldwall.
chapter.black_city.stage5.brief: Question the prisoner at the bridge and inspect the armory passage. Cut the ward feeds to open the palace gate.
chapter.black_city.stage6.brief: Take the ward tower. Its priest raises dead guards. Eliminate the priest before clearing the remaining dead.
chapter.black_city.medicine_source: Treat the wounded before entering the court; medicine was recovered in earlier battles.
chapter.black_city.stage7.brief: Secure the withdrawal corridor and state your terms outside the court. Use 10 medicine to dress wounds. Olga still refuses to surrender.
chapter.black_city.stage8.brief: Defeat Olga and the last court guards. Her black flame has a range of 5 tiles and costs 6 AP. Spread your shooters and close to suppress her.
chapter.black_city.recruit_reward: Chloe and Olga join the company upon chapter completion.
chapter.black_city.cg.chloe.title: The Guard’s Fallen Sword
chapter.black_city.cg.chloe.caption: Chloe falls at the Black Bridge. The captain takes the winch and halts pursuit of her retreating guard.
chapter.black_city.cg.olga.title: The Black Queen Defeated
chapter.black_city.cg.olga.caption: With the wards broken and her guard defeated, Olga orders a ceasefire beneath her throne.
chapter.black_city.cg.together.title: After the Surrender
chapter.black_city.cg.together.caption: With the court lost, the defeated queen and her guard sit below the steps. A new contract awaits them.
chapter.black_city.start_hint: Accept the campaign contract to begin.
chapter.black_city.recruit_only: Recruited by completing Fall of the Black City
chapter.black_city.pending_recruit: Chloe and Olga are waiting to join the company. Free enough roster slots, then click Refresh.
chapter.black_city.location_battle: The black moon banner still flies above the outpost. The garrison blocks the road to the royal city, crossbow bolts glinting behind its shields.
chapter.black_city.enemy.chloe: Chloe, Captain of the Black Bridge
chapter.black_city.flame.name: Court Black Flame
chapter.black_city.flame.description: 6 AP and 18 fatigue; range 2–5 tiles. On hit, deals 55–75 spell damage with 25% penetration and 100% armor damage. Engage the caster in melee to suppress casting.
chapter.black_city.guard.name: Black City Guard
chapter.black_city.archer.name: Black City Crossbowman
chapter.seven_shields.upper.name: War against the Seven Shields: Part I
chapter.seven_shields.upper.description: The Black City has surrendered, but the promised bounty never arrives. The Alliance seals the return road, accusing the company of sheltering the Black Queen. Carry the original contract along the tax road and take Fortresses One through Three.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.ending: The first three fortresses lower their Alliance banners. Alicia, Prim and Kaguya join the company under the armistice. The original unpaid account and the road to Fortress Four are now in our hands.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.name: War against the Seven Shields: Part II
chapter.seven_shields.lower.description: The Third Fortress ledger traces the withheld bounty to the Alliance court. Cross Maia's mercenary line at Fortress Four and Luu Luu's clan defenses at Five, defeat Claudia's Dawn Knights, and demand a final answer at Fortress Seven.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.ending: Fortress Seven accepts the armistice and the overdue bounty is paid. Maia, Luu Luu, Claudia and Celestine sign service contracts. The Alliance retains its towns and civil administration, but can no longer discard the debt owed for the company's blood.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.opening.name: An Empty Letter with a Seal
chapter.seven_shields.upper.opening.line: The Alliance has stamped the surrender papers as received. The returning chest contains only a letter, not even an empty coin sack.
Loot from the Black City will cover a few days of wages. None of the contracted bounty has arrived. The letter says payment is suspended until the Black Queen is delivered into church custody.
The contract said to take the Black City. We have taken it. Now they have added a condition.
The second messenger never returned. The third was turned away at Fortress One with an embargo: no town may sell provisions to the company.
Put the contract in a waterproof tube. We take the tax road tomorrow.
This time no patron marks the enemy positions for us. Seven fortresses, seven shield banners. The road to payment is longer than the road to war.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.name: The Embargo on the Return Road
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line1: The new notice outside the tollhouse is still wet. The keeper sees our old travel token and shuts the window.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line2: Leave the door alone. Copy the notice. Copy the seal as well.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line3: The toll ledger is clear: Fortress Two assembled the expedition bounty and transferred it to the church. The money left the treasury while we were still bleeding in the Black City.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line4: The money exists. Someone merely expected us never to collect it.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line5: A tax wagon draped in church cloth has just passed the junction. Its deep ruts follow the military road toward Fortress One.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage1.line6: Follow the tracks. We need the account before we speak to the gate commander.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.name: The Tax Convoy Refuses to Halt
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line1: The convoy officer orders the crossbows loaded as soon as we name the contract date. He knows the contract, and he knows what is in the chests.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line2: The chests bear church seals. Keep the wagons intact and give the horses room to bolt.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line3: The pike and shield line bunches around the wagons. The crossbowmen cannot reach a second rank. When the fight ends, the clerk still clutches a key with a broken tooth.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line4: The captured tax money replenishes medicine and tools. Beneath it is an order telling Fortress One to detain the mercenaries returning with the Black Queen.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line5: So the bounty was withheld, but the accusation was delivered.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage2.line6: The church issued the order. Its execution is assigned to Alicia's Holy Iris Knights.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.name: Before the Holy Iris Gate
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line1: Lower your battle standard and surrender the Black Queen. I will petition for your bounty.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line2: We have petitioned three times. Your gate stayed shut each time.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line3: You carry spoils and force an armed company onto an Alliance road. I cannot let this army pass my walls.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line4: Then show your people the contract. Let them see more than the arrest order.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line5: A horn from the wall drowns out her answer. Alicia comes onto the gate bridge herself. The knights align their shields, leaving narrow gaps for the crossbows.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line6: The main gate is a lure. An old spillway leads to the bridge winch room. Ten tools will clear the rusted grate and repair its broken axle.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line7: Hold shields in front. Advance when the side gate opens. Do not ram into the knights as though they were masonry.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage3.line8: I will hold until the last soldier leaves this bridge. If you want this gate, come and take it.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.name: The First Shield Banner Falls
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line1: Alicia hears the side-gate winch turn. She does not look back. She withdraws the crossbows, then meets our advance at the bridge mouth herself.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line2: Holy Iris Knights... fall back into the inner streets. Keep the bridge clear.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line3: Her sword finally falls onto the stone steps. The shield line is broken, and our soldiers hold both ends of the bridge.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line4: The gate is ours. Your people put down their weapons. The wounded leave by the north gate.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line5: Will you take this city as the money you are owed?
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line6: I take the military road and the army stores. Then I find whoever signed the account.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line7: ...Fortress Two. Prim has the original appropriation book. She is my cousin. Do not turn her into a hostage for your payment.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line8: If she opens her gate, we will enter through it.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage4.line9: Alicia looks toward the city. She permits the banner to be lowered, but demands to watch the wounded leave. We agree.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.name: The Flower Princess's Ledger
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line1: Fortress Two opens its gate a handspan. Prim passes out a letter: she will inspect the accounts, but her guards refuse admission to any mercenary.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line2: I remember the appropriation. When my cousin marched out, I helped the clerks count the last chests.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line3: Then you know we are not inventing this debt.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line4: After the money went to the church, they sent only a receipt for consolidated war funds. I asked... They told me a princess should not question wartime accounts.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line5: Three guard shifts cover the provision gate beside the stores. Even food wagons must lose their wheels at a shift change. Negotiations linger at the front gate while ropes tighten at the rear.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line6: Set aside medicine for the evacuees. We breach the provision gate and keep clear of the residential streets.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line7: If you get inside, put out the granary fires first. Someone told the guards to burn it if they could not hold.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage5.line8: Hold on to the key. Tomorrow someone will ask you whether their grain still exists.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.name: The Key to Fortress Two
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line1: After the gate falls, the palace guard continues to surround the stores. Prim stands behind them until the last shield rank is driven back, then orders the ceasefire horn.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line2: Do not light it! I told you, that grain belongs to the townspeople.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line3: A torch drops onto stone instead of straw. Prim places the storehouse key on the table and takes a long moment to release it.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line4: Seal the granary and inventory the army stores. We take the original ledger. You keep a copy.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line5: What happened to my cousin's soldiers?
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line6: They left through the north gate. She checked every wounded soldier herself.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line7: Then I will come too. I signed the account. I have to see this through.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage6.line8: An acknowledgment from Fortress Three is tucked into the ledger. Its shrine keeps the church's sealed oaths. Kaguya may still hold a copy no one has amended.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.name: Seals beneath the Moon
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line1: The contract may be examined. Weapons may not enter.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line2: And afterward? Will you record what you find, or merely pronounce us guilty?
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line3: Words on paper will not bring back the dead.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line4: That is why the living need their wages. Otherwise, who will march next time?
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line5: Kaguya says nothing. Her gaze rests on the original signatures, then she closes the oath chest. A church messenger is waiting behind a pillar.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line6: The ward stays until dawn. If you force entry, the shrine will defend itself.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line7: Along the water channel we find three conduits beneath the moss. Restoring the old grounding stakes will discharge the ward into stone and buy the front rank a few steps.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage7.line8: Bring tools. We take the bell platform first, then the oath chest.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.name: The Third Fortress Bell Falls Silent
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line1: The shrine defenders hold behind the bell platform while crossbows fire between pillars. Kaguya's spell lights the steps again and again until we occupy the space between her and her guards.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line2: Do not ring the bell again. Stop.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line3: The last light sinks into the cracked bell. Kaguya sits against the steps and pushes the oath chest within reach.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line4: The seal is intact. Bring out the copy you witnessed.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line5: There are two. One says paid. One says suspended. Written on the same day.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line6: Who asked you to keep both?
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line7: The church quartermaster. I thought it was a copying error.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line8: A half-worn Alliance seal marks the page. The same authority announced payment complete and barred the creditors from returning.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line9: I will travel with the originals. Let no one turn a third copy into another false account.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.stage8.line1: The road ahead will be harder. Be certain.
chapter.seven_shields.upper.epilogue.nam: The Armistice of the First Three Shields
chapter.seven_shields.upper.epilogue.lin: In Fortress Three's military hall, three seals mark one armistice. The towns retain their civil officials. The company takes custody of the military roads, stores and original accounts.
I come with my sword. Your victory does not make me forget the dead.
Then see the account through. Whoever withheld the wages must also face the names of the dead.
The granary key stays in the city. This one opens the appropriation cabinet. I am keeping it.
I will keep the originals. All three of us must be present when they are examined.
Alicia, Prim and Kaguya enter their names on the muster roll and join the company. Each puts away her copy of the armistice. They will be back on the military road before dawn.
Fortress Four. First we ask its mercenaries whether they have been paid.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.opening.name: Old Colleagues at Fortress Four
chapter.seven_shields.lower.opening.line: Beyond the ridge, Fortress Four's flagpoles come into view. Old mercenary banners hang from the walls, bleached almost beyond recognition.
I hear you knocked over the first three. I thought collecting a debt meant breaking a table at most.
The advance. As for the balance, the quartermaster's mouth is tighter than the gate.
He gave us an arrest order.
Bad luck for you. Not much better for me. This time I am the one guarding the gate.
Maia rests her hand on her sword. Her smile is gone. She is contracted to defend Fortress Four, as we were contracted to take the Black City. Two unsettled contracts meet at the gate.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.name: A Garrison on Contract
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line1: Leave the granary alone. Miss a meal and these men will chew through your ranks tomorrow.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line2: We are checking the water line. Your people still need to drink.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line3: Old timber blocks the waterwheel sluice. A covered channel leads to the barracks yard. Ten tools will restore the winch and give the company an entrance from the side.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line4: My people hold that yard too. Old colleagues or not, they will not wave you through.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line5: I do not expect them to. Send your wounded out first.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage1.line6: Maia returns with our bandages. Her message is plain: a contract is a contract, but whichever side falls tomorrow, no one is to die forgotten in a ditch.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.name: The Fourth Shield: Mercenary Terms
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line1: Maia puts her toughest shields at the yard entrance and spreads crossbows along the waterwheel platform. She attacks every weakness herself, never sending another fighter ahead in her place.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line2: Enough. Blow the horn! Keep this up and the only payment left will be burial fees.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line3: When the ceasefire sounds, she sits on an overturned army chest, her sword hand trembling. The quartermaster has fled by the rear gate. Empty sacks fill the pay cabinet.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line4: Will you still defend that contract?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line5: I defended the fort and nearly lost everyone doing it. Let whoever wrote the contract defend it now.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line6: This company pays against the muster roll. The living collect in person. The dead have named beneficiaries.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line7: Keep that sentence for payday. I will be watching.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage2.line8: She signs the temporary ceasefire and withdraws the surviving mercenaries outside the fort. Her service contract will wait until Fortress Seven answers.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.name: The People of Fortress Five
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line1: The church took your money. Why are you at my gate?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line2: The road to Fortress Six passes through this gate.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line3: If I open it, the knights punish my people. If I do not, you do. Easy for you to say.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line4: Luu Luu carries an axe nearly her own height. Her clan's toll tokens lie at her feet. Fortress Five is more than a checkpoint: it is the home they are permitted to keep.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line5: Send your people down the western woodland path. They keep their toll rights. We secure the armory.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line6: Make sure that escape road is open. My axe is still here. That does not mean I will stake my people on this wall.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage3.line7: We clear the fallen trees from the path and reserve ten medicine. Once the clan leaves, the gate holds only the guard and that heavy axe.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.name: The Fifth Shield: The Axe Comes Down
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line1: Luu Luu splits the front rank's shield rims and breaks a barricade beam. Her guards rush the gap, falling back to the gate only when we turn both flanks.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line2: Back! I have no room to swing!
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line3: The crowd finally clears. She braces her axe against the stones, cannot lift it again, and sits on a block beside the gate.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line4: The western path is open. Your people are through.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line5: Give me the toll tokens. Any missing, and I add them to your account.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line6: Every one is here. Lower the banner. You can oversee the stores.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line7: I am going to Fortress Seven. Whoever promised to protect us can explain this to my face.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage4.line8: The fifth shield banner comes down. Luu Luu keeps her axe. Her thumbprint marks the ceasefire, lime from the gate still beneath her nails.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.name: The Dawn Knights' Two Lines
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line1: Fortresses Six and Seven share a supply corridor. Claudia commands the Dawn Knights and protects Celestine. She cannot defend only the wall before her.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line2: Send the originals. I will escort you to Fortress Seven. Your army stays outside.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line3: Three messengers brought back no payment. This time I travel with the standard.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line4: I will not let you force Celestine before an army.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line5: A rear-gate quartermaster privately offers to open the sluice at night in exchange for a pardon. His name appears on several false receipts.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line6: Take the latch plan. There is no pardon. He hands over the original accounts.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line7: You intend to enter with a traitor's help?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line8: Your gate was open while he forged the accounts. Only now does he become a traitor?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage5.line9: Claudia is silent for a long time. Then she sends the final civilian wagons to Fortress Seven and takes her place on Fortress Six's sluice bridge.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.name: The Sixth Shield: The Knight at the Sluice
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line1: Opening the sluice does not end the battle. Claudia's knights reform pikes and shields at the bridgehead, polearms reaching over the line. She holds its narrowest span herself.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line2: Polearms withdraw first. Shields leave last. Do not turn back.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line3: Her polehammer lowers to the bridge and her right knee gives way. Her eyes remain on the road to Fortress Seven.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line4: Fortress Six has fallen. Do not spend a handful of knights against an army.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line5: If I let you through, what guarantee does she have?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line6: Settle the account and the war ends. The quartermaster office yields those responsible. Celestine signs in person.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line7: ...I will bring her those words. I am not pleading your case.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line8: The wounded go with the message. We hold the bridge.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage6.line9: Claudia withdraws with the wounded into Fortress Seven. The Dawn Knights' outer line is broken. Their inner line has not surrendered.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.name: The Last Answer from Fortress Seven
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line1: I have read the contract. The bounty must be paid. The cities you have taken must also be returned.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line2: The earlier receipt also bears your seal. Why did it take six fallen fortresses to say must?
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line3: I allowed the quartermasters to use my seal and failed to check each appropriation. That fault cannot belong to them alone.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line4: She has ordered the vault opened. Withdraw beyond the ward and the clerks will come out.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line5: The clerks do not emerge. Fire flares behind the vault door as boxes of receipts are carried to the furnace. The inner guard closes the gate as Celestine turns.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line6: They are burning the accounts. Once the fire dies, anyone can deny the debt.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line7: I cannot leave the townspeople between two armies. Claudia, hold the outer court.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line8: Yes. Move all wounded into the side galleries.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line9: We inspect the side galleries and old furnace vents, stocking medicine and tools. The final battle must breach the outer court and inner guard before the original accounts burn.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage7.line1: Crossbows cover the caster. Shields take the court. Once the vault opens, no one throws fire inside.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.name: The Seventh Shield: Armistice in the White City
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line1: The inner guard's shield line falls first. Claudia can no longer cover both galleries. The light wall sustained by Celestine dims, fragment by fragment.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line2: Cease fighting. All of you, lay down your weapons.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line3: She sits on the steps before the throne. Her words are quiet, but the last guards hear them. The quartermaster's master ledger is carried from the furnace room, its cover charred.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line4: The original contract, appropriation book and paid receipt. All three are here. Sign now.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line5: Fortress Seven will settle the overdue wages. Those who misused the seal and burned the accounts will face examination. You assume military authority. The towns retain civil government.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line6: One more clause. Future mercenary wages are delivered to the named people on the muster roll.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line8: Only after the seal is set does the overdue pay leave the White City stores. Every sack is weighed. Every recipient is named.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line9: Lower the seventh banner. Dawn Knights, no pursuit.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.stage8.line1: The war against the Seven Shields is over. From the Black City to the White City, we have finally collected what the contract promised.
chapter.seven_shields.lower.epilogue.lin: The money is counted. You kept your word. I will sign.
My people stay at Fortress Five. Anyone touching their toll rights answers to my axe.
I travel with you to enforce the armistice. Klaus remains in the White City to sort the accounts. The knights will no longer shield the quartermasters from blame.
I will travel too. I carry the seal, and I will read every commission myself.
Maia, Luu Luu, Claudia and Celestine sign service contracts and join the company. The gates reopen. Seven shield banners remain on their walls, but military command beneath them has changed hands.
Secure the muster roll. Pay the company tomorrow morning. Then we march.
This time, the clerk does not enter their names under suspended.

chapter.seven_shields.cg.prim.caption: Resistance at the granary ends. Prim hands over the keys and ledger, with one condition: the town's grain must feed its people first.
chapter.seven_shields.cg.kaguya.name: The Darkened Bell Platform
chapter.seven_shields.cg.kaguya.caption: The shrine's line is broken. Two conflicting receipts bear the same seal. For the first time, Kaguya demands an account of the papers her own allies supplied.

chapter.seven_shields.cg.maia.name: Armistice on the Army Chest
chapter.seven_shields.cg.maia.caption: The Fourth Fortress pay chest is still empty. Resting against the battlements, Maia sees how closely her defense contract resembles our unpaid commission.
chapter.seven_shields.cg.luu_luu.name: The Axe by the Gate
chapter.seven_shields.cg.luu_luu.caption: Her clan has escaped along the mountain road. Luu Luu's axe lies beside the steps. The Fifth Fortress may fall; her people will never be payment for a debt.
chapter.seven_shields.cg.claudia.name: The Last Line at the Sluice
chapter.seven_shields.cg.claudia.caption: The Sixth Fortress bridgehead cannot hold. Claudia leads the survivors toward the White City, where someone still depends on her final stand.

chapter.seven_shields.cg.celestine.capti: The White City's final defense falls silent. Celestine lowers her staff and signs the settlement herself. This time, the great seal must be backed by actual silver.
