chapter.seven_shields.spell.description: A ranged invocation cast by a defending commander. Melee pressure prevents casting.
ui.hub.guide.abigail_williams.summary: Weapon-free magic with defense and AP debuffs.
ui.hub.guide.abigail_williams.analysis: A 4 AP spell has a hit bonus and Resolve scaling, saving early weapon costs. The finisher needs keys; mental control respects immunities.
ui.hub.guide.katsushika_hokusai.summary: Cheap ink attacks amplify later hits.
ui.hub.guide.katsushika_hokusai.analysis: The 3 AP attack enables repeated shots; ink lowers defenses and amplifies later damage. Art and ink need setup before the finisher.
ui.hub.guide.c_c.summary: Empower one carry; regeneration adds resilience.
ui.hub.guide.c_c.analysis: The contract grants accuracy, damage and fatigue recovery to one carry. Regeneration and one survival trigger do not repair armor or replace an equipped tank.
ui.hub.guide.enterprise.summary: Starts with a bow; protect her airstrikes.
ui.hub.guide.enterprise.analysis: A starting bow and 75 Ranged Skill lower startup costs. Sortie points, the round limit and adjacent enemies restrict airstrikes; Lucky E is probabilistic.
ui.hub.guide.togawa_sakiko.summary: Accuracy and fatigue support for weapon teams.
ui.hub.guide.togawa_sakiko.analysis: The 4-tile stage improves accuracy, Resolve and recovery. Climax discounts active weapon attacks, not independent spells or reloads, so larger weapon teams benefit most.
ui.hub.guide.m4a1.summary: Starts with a rifle; focus fire and armor damage.
ui.hub.guide.m4a1.analysis: The 3 AP aimed shot has +20 accuracy and two armor-oriented ammo types. Initial cannon charge is useful, but reload AP, distance, darkness and adjacency matter.
ui.hub.guide.morgan.summary: Weapon-free lances and repeatable area burst.
ui.hub.guide.morgan.analysis: Lances use Resolve and ranged accuracy; Lake's Grace restores AP and fatigue. The finisher needs six mana and 40 fatigue, so charging and recovery limit repetition.
ui.hub.guide.meltryllis.analysis: A 3 AP fixed-base blade saves weapon costs; Virus sets up the finisher. Ballet blocks only two single-target attacks, while area damage and reduced defense remain risks.
ui.hub.guide.saber.summary: Ignores shields; bond rewards and the exclusive sword accelerate Mana.
ui.hub.guide.saber.analysis: Ordinary melee attacks ignore shield defense. Bond challenges improve starting Mana and regeneration, award a sword at 60, reduce every Strike Air to 1 Mana at 80, and unlock two full Mana refills per battle at 100. Excalibur scales with the equipped weapon and retains one use, or two with the Grail blessing.
ui.hub.guide.silver_wolf.summary: Weapon-free rewrites solve early accuracy problems.
ui.hub.guide.silver_wolf.analysis: A 3 AP defense rewrite removes 100 defense without a hit roll; attack debuffs also protect the team. Only one persistent rewrite and one use per own turn; stun immunity still applies.
ui.hub.guide.robin.summary: Team recovery and extra actions scale with roster size.
ui.hub.guide.robin.analysis: The song improves accuracy, morale and recovery immediately. Allied attacks build Harmony for extra actions; these do not refresh cooldowns or ammunition.
ui.hub.guide.jeanne.summary: A banner support with repeatable team protection.
ui.hub.guide.jeanne.analysis: A real banner or polearm is required. The five-stat aura and recovery help accuracy and morale; protection cancels direct attacks but does not cover every damage source.
ui.hub.guide.sword_maiden.summary: High starting accuracy; begin her hunt progression early.
ui.hub.guide.sword_maiden.analysis: 78 Melee Skill, Mind's Eye and shield bypass help early fights, but a melee weapon is needed. Advanced judgments require Goblin hunt points, making late catch-up slower.
ui.hub.guide.jeanne_alter.summary: Weapon-based curse hunting with one area finisher.
ui.hub.guide.jeanne_alter.analysis: Repeated attacks exploit Black Flame for accuracy, damage and penetration. The area finisher is once per battle; startup still needs gear and accuracy support against enemy defense and armor.
ui.hub.guide.jingliu.summary: Build Moonlight for kill-based AP recovery.
ui.hub.guide.jingliu.analysis: Weapon hits build Moonlight and kills at full stacks return 4 AP. A free finisher aids chains, but armor and misses can break them; weapon quality matters.
ui.hub.guide.skirk.summary: Shield bypass with a shared weapon-resource cycle.
ui.hub.guide.skirk.analysis: Melee weapon attacks ignore shields and begin with resource. Stance attacks and the finisher spend the same pool, so their maximum benefits cannot be assumed simultaneously.
ui.hub.guide.jinhsi.summary: Mid-range weapon burst charged by allied attacks.
ui.hub.guide.jinhsi.analysis: Her ranged-looking attacks still use Melee Skill and weapon damage. Allied charging has a round cap; a developed attacking team enables a faster cycle.
ui.hub.guide.nahida.analysis: Fixed-base attacks save weapon costs; allied hits trigger a damage network. Per-actor and team caps, a fixed field and armored targets constrain the payoff.
ui.hub.guide.hakurei_reimu.analysis: Talismans have +20 accuracy without distance decay; barriers raise both defenses. The automatic-hit finisher needs spirit, and ordinary attacks have only 80% armor damage.
ui.hub.guide.yae_miko.summary: Fixed-base thunder; sustained attacks still need gear.
ui.hub.guide.yae_miko.analysis: The exclusive strike and 30 fixed HP follow-up help against armor. The strike is once per battle, so sustained output still needs an appropriate weapon.
ui.hub.guide.chisaki.analysis: The first melee hit adds fixed HP damage and a kill returns 3 AP. Blood Slash scales with the weapon and recovers fatigue on kills; armor and defense can disrupt the chain.
ui.hub.guide.kafka.summary: Buff a carry or turn a regular enemy against its allies.
ui.hub.guide.kafka.analysis: Support needs no weapon. Increasing max AP does not refill it; controlled enemies use AI, and champions or special bosses are excluded.
ui.hub.guide.ye_shunguang.summary: Weapon-hit stacks sustain a stance cycle.
ui.hub.guide.ye_shunguang.analysis: Normal weapon hits build sword stacks spent for stance discounts and blocks. Starting accuracy and weapon quality matter; personal bond progression improves reliability.
ui.hub.guide.himeko.summary: Armor-break follow-ups grow with a weapon team.
ui.hub.guide.himeko.analysis: The basic orbital skill removes fixed armor and HP, while follow-ups read the weapon. Later Trailblaze support requires bond progression and is excluded from startup strength.
ui.hub.guide.feixue.summary: Iai mobility with a weapon-based form cycle.
ui.hub.guide.feixue.analysis: Melee weapon hits charge the form; Iai and Liberation spend its resources. Shield bypass and afterimages help, but armor, accuracy and legal positions still matter.
ui.hub.guide.feixiao.summary: Ally-triggered follow-ups and multi-hit armor removal.
ui.hub.guide.feixiao.analysis: Follow-ups use Melee Skill and weapon damage. Armored finisher segments prioritize armor, rather than all dealing penetrating HP damage; charging is capped.
ui.hub.guide.changli.summary: Chain Enflamement into weapon-based area attacks.
ui.hub.guide.changli.analysis: Accuracy and stacks support area weapon damage. The finisher can fast-track full stacks, but she needs contact and a good weapon rather than serving as the team's tank.
ui.hub.guide.raiden_shogun.summary: Armor bypass is powerful once a melee weapon is ready.
ui.hub.guide.raiden_shogun.analysis: The current passive bypasses armor, a major benefit against BB heavy armor. The fixed-base active is once per battle; sustained combat still needs a weapon, accuracy and armor.
ui.hub.guide.yixuan.summary: Weapon hits add capped HP damage.
ui.hub.guide.yixuan.analysis: The HP-based follow-up is capped and requires the main target to survive weapon damage. It does not repeat on every area target; accuracy and HP investment improve it.
ui.hub.guide.xilian.summary: A free emergency reset protects an established carry.
ui.hub.guide.xilian.analysis: The starting reset is once per battle and restores allied AP, HP and armor. It supplies no constant team offense; full-bond upgrades are part of mature strength.
ui.hub.guide.liuying.summary: Constant mitigation and one self-reset stabilize the front.
ui.hub.guide.liuying.analysis: 50% mitigation and one AP, HP and armor reset lower frontline risk. No signature weapon is granted; armor and an ordinary weapon still need to be supplied.
ui.hub.guide.cartethyia.summary: Weapon roots and a powerful but risky transformation.
ui.hub.guide.cartethyia.analysis: Weapon hits root targets; erosion feeds area attacks. Transformation reduces HP to half, so protection and gear must precede the final heal.
ui.hub.guide.castorice.summary: Automatic-hit weapon damage needs gear and healing.
ui.hub.guide.castorice.analysis: Drain and Netherwing skip hit rolls but read the current weapon; Drain costs HP. Her area heal excludes herself, requiring allied sustain.
ui.hub.guide.changyeyue.analysis: Hits, kills and nearby allies losing HP build resource. The finisher scales with gear and costs HP; healing and armor are needed rather than deliberate unarmored tanking.
ui.hub.guide.hysilens.summary: Weapon attacks apply erosion over time.
ui.hub.guide.hysilens.analysis: Weapon hits apply erosion and the area active is once per battle. Ongoing effects need time and susceptible enemies; appropriate ranged gear is essential.
ui.hub.guide.tilixibiesi.analysis: Early global teleport can rescue or isolate units, but costs HP and is limited per own turn. Its value is tactical positioning rather than direct damage.
ui.hub.guide.cipher.summary: Fixed HP kickbacks and teleport-based finishing.
ui.hub.guide.cipher.analysis: Allied attacks build kickbacks; Cipher's weapon hits deal the extra HP damage. AP and teleport refreshes need her own kill, so accuracy and finishing access matter.
ui.hub.guide.cerydra.summary: Banner command gives an established carry extra turns.
ui.hub.guide.cerydra.analysis: The aura improves combat stats and Resolve; a carry's attacks build edicts. Command grants turns without bypassing per-round skill limits, favoring a developed carry.
ui.hub.guide.fengjin.summary: Fast cleansing is more valuable than her weapon damage.
ui.hub.guide.fengjin.analysis: High Initiative helps remove control early. Rescue heals 20 HP for 4 AP and cleanses widely but cannot repair armor; the 6 AP attack still needs a weapon.
ui.hub.guide.yuno.summary: Accuracy marks and weapon follow-ups reward kills.
ui.hub.guide.yuno.analysis: Death Omen improves the next hit and adds Yuno's weapon damage. Kill refunds need a successful finish; repeated marks cost progressively more AP.
ui.hub.guide.phoebe.summary: Low-AP area control is limited by fatigue.
ui.hub.guide.phoebe.analysis: A 2 AP no-hit-roll active stuns the center and staggers nearby enemies. Its 30 fatigue and immunity rules prevent unlimited control; offensive bonuses need weapon attacks.
ui.hub.guide.wisadel.summary: Area armor damage scales with a strong ranged weapon.
ui.hub.guide.wisadel.analysis: The 150% weapon area attack has accuracy, shield bypass and control. Its 7 AP and 30 fatigue cost restrict repetition; no starting signature weapon is granted.
ui.hub.guide.aglaea.summary: Free marks enable hit-based AP recovery.
ui.hub.guide.aglaea.analysis: A free stance marks enemies; hits return 2 AP and add fixed HP damage, favoring cheap weapon attacks. Misses and enemy armor still constrain the cycle.
ui.hub.guide.mai_shiranui.summary: Throwing penetration plus a separate melee entry.
ui.hub.guide.mai_shiranui.analysis: The passive boosts throwing while the entry requires a melee weapon and a legal straight path. Swapping costs AP and two weapon sets raise startup investment.
ui.hub.guide.scarlet_shadow.summary: Free staged finishers multiply good weapon damage.
ui.hub.guide.scarlet_shadow.analysis: Normal melee actions build stacks for free high-multiplier finishers. Forced full stacks cost remaining AP and are once per battle; accuracy and gear sustain the cycle.
ui.hub.guide.texas_omertosa.summary: Teleport, control and follow-ups need safe entry support.
ui.hub.guide.texas_omertosa.analysis: Teleporting beside a target and free sword follow-ups improve tempo. Mitigation and the first-kill heal do not repair armor, so deep entry needs protection.
ui.hub.guide.sparxie.summary: A ranged focus-fire support for a developed team.
ui.hub.guide.sparxie.analysis: A ranged weapon and allied active weapon hits on the guest are required. Each broadcast caps gifts at three and team damage at 12%, favoring later supplementary recruitment.
ui.hub.guide.the_herta.summary: Starts with both signature weapons for ranged burst and strong melee combat.
ui.hub.guide.the_herta.analysis: Joins with the staff, signature armor and helmet equipped, and the greatsword in her bag. The staff fires without ammunition; the sword offers a two-tile slash, Astral Step, fan cleave and heavy strike, adding full effective Ranged Skill to melee accuracy. Each bond stage grants 1 perk point: stage 20 raises staff recovery from 3 to 5; 40 reduces False Premise fatigue; 60 raises sword defense from 15 to 20; 80 refunds 1 Inspiration after the first finisher; 100 unlocks a once-per-battle Inspiration refill. Manage fatigue, shields and encirclement. Optional equipment research is excluded.
ui.hub.guide.lily.summary: Weapon-free souls and limited prayers support early fights.
ui.hub.guide.lily.analysis: Soul power scales with level and saves weapons; three prayers aid sustain. Souls unlock over time, and Blight requires timed purification rather than all abilities being available initially.
ui.hub.guide.suisui.summary: Passive healing and cheap magic are strong early tools.
ui.hub.guide.suisui.analysis: Passive healing covers up to three allies each round; a 3 AP spell and active healing add flexibility. The field stays fixed and healing does not repair armor.
ui.hub.guide.misono_mika.summary: Starts with a close-range signature gun.
ui.hub.guide.misono_mika.analysis: 85 Ranged Skill, a supplied gun and double shots lower startup costs without adjacency lockout. Magazine actions cost AP; armor is still needed and finisher overkill does not transfer.
ui.hub.guide.sorasaki_hina.summary: Starts with a machine gun and fatigue recovery.
ui.hub.guide.sorasaki_hina.analysis: 88 Ranged Skill, a supplied gun and 3 AP double shots are reliable. Cooling recovers fatigue, but heat, adjacent enemies and cone positioning limit sustained fire.
ui.hub.guide.xin.summary: Weapon-free magic benefits from alternating ally attack types.
ui.hub.guide.xin.analysis: The 3 AP spell works alone, but mirror follow-ups require different allies alternating melee and ranged attacks. The palace boosts this pattern rather than dealing area damage itself.
ui.hub.guide.shizuna.summary: High melee accuracy and focused dueling defense.
ui.hub.guide.shizuna.analysis: 88 Melee Skill helps, but a real melee weapon is needed. Parry applies only against one marked enemy, and entry does not prevent opportunity attacks.
ui.hub.guide.lumiore.summary: Weapon-free breath with a capped area echo.
ui.hub.guide.lumiore.analysis: A 3 AP Resolve-scaled breath saves gear and triggers an echo. Scales and Prestige are separate; the finisher needs setup and the echo is capped per round.
ui.hub.guide.argente.summary: Permanent defenses and weapon-free shield attacks.
ui.hub.guide.argente.analysis: +15 defenses, 25% mitigation and a 3 AP weapon-free attack stabilize startup. Shield transfer has range, count and damage budgets and still requires armor.
ui.hub.guide.sekka.summary: Weapon-free foxfire uses only melee accuracy.
ui.hub.guide.sekka.analysis: All foxfire uses Melee Skill and Resolve, avoiding dual accuracy investment. Free retreat requires a finisher kill; resource, marks and legal destinations remain necessary.
ui.hub.guide.yakumo_yukari.summary: High initial accuracy, magic, shields and repositioning.
ui.hub.guide.yakumo_yukari.analysis: 90 Ranged Skill, fixed-base spells and 70-point shields lower startup costs. The train needs charge and cooldown; gaps respect range, visibility and roots.
ui.hub.guide.tokisaki_kurumi.summary: Fixed-base gun skills need no physical gun purchase.
ui.hub.guide.tokisaki_kurumi.analysis: 95 Ranged Skill and fixed-base volleys reduce costs; time bullets control AP. Time Stop and Replay require engraving progression and are excluded from starting strength.
ui.hub.guide.cirno.summary: Accurate ice attacks control groups or punish immunity.
ui.hub.guide.cirno.analysis: 95 Ranged Skill and fixed-base ice attacks combine damage and control. Chill must land; freeze has a resistance window, while immune targets take an ice burst instead.
ui.hub.guide.shana.summary: Weapon-free blade skills start with excellent melee stats.
ui.hub.guide.shana.analysis: 100 Melee Skill, 35 defense and fixed-base attacks lower startup costs. AP and shield rewards need her own finisher kill; resource and movement limits still apply.
ui.hub.guide.tohsaka_rin.summary: Fixed-base gem spells need no inventory gems.
ui.hub.guide.tohsaka_rin.analysis: 95 Ranged Skill and fixed-base spells require no purchased weapon or inventory gem. Energy recovery is constrained; double formulas and resonance need research progression.
ui.hub.guide.olga.summary: Chapter recruit with automatic-hit penetrating magic.
ui.hub.guide.olga.analysis: Starts with a knife, buckler and basic armor; spells have no weapon requirement. She joins at level 1 after Black City. Black Flame hits automatically with 60% penetration. Startup excludes later storm, eclipse and control skills; maturity includes five growth stages.
ui.hub.guide.chloe.summary: Chapter sword-and-shield recruit with offense and defense.
ui.hub.guide.chloe.analysis: Starts with a shortsword, wooden shield and basic armor. She joins at level 1 with a sword and shield. Accuracy, penetration and swaps help the front; Fortress and later multi-target attacks require growth and still consume AP and fatigue.
ui.hub.guide.alicia.summary: Chapter swordswoman; starts with a shortsword and no offhand item.
ui.hub.guide.alicia.analysis: Her starting shortsword enables sword stacks and AP discounts while no shield or other offhand item is equipped. Riposte and Breath sustain combat; maturity includes growth stages.
ui.hub.guide.claudia.summary: Starts with a two-handed wooden hammer for close armor-breaking skills.
ui.hub.guide.claudia.analysis: Her starting two-handed wooden hammer and basic body armor meet her hammer-skill and armor-protection requirements. Exclusive skills use their own ranges. Armor mitigation and team armor debuffs excel against heavy targets; later abilities require stage progression.
ui.hub.guide.celestine.summary: Chapter healer with armor repair and automatic magic.
ui.hub.guide.celestine.analysis: Starts with a knife, buckler and basic armor; spells have no weapon requirement. She joins at level 1 after lower Seven Shields. Healing repairs both armor slots; spell damage uses current HP. Prevention cannot revive dead actors; maturity includes growth stages.
ui.hub.guide.kaguya.summary: Chapter controller needs a two-handed spear or polearm.
ui.hub.guide.kaguya.analysis: Her starting pitchfork meets the two-handed polearm requirement for her two-tile advantages. Permanent seals and later skills require growth.
ui.hub.guide.prim.summary: Banner support; replace the supplied one-hand spear and shield.
ui.hub.guide.prim.analysis: Her starting battle standard meets her passive equipment requirement. Her aura, rally and cleansing support the team; maturity includes growth.
ui.hub.guide.maia.summary: Chapter tank protects nearby allies with supplied gear.
ui.hub.guide.maia.analysis: Starts with a shortsword, wooden shield and basic armor. The supplied sword and shield enable doubled shield defense and protection immediately. Shieldwall costs AP and fatigue; taunt respects vanilla targets, while growth expands coverage.
ui.hub.guide.luu_luu.summary: Chapter two-handed axe fighter converts fatigue into damage.
ui.hub.guide.luu_luu.analysis: Her starting woodcutter's axe meets the two-handed axe requirement. Pressure uses actual fatigue; incoming hits and attacks reduce remaining capacity, so reserve AP for Vent. Furnace and extra max AP require growth.
ui.hub.guide.ui.empty: No matching characters. Adjust the filters.
ui.hub.guide.ui.notice: Source-based assessment. Click a card recommendation for the rationale.
ui.hub.guide.ui.basis: Optional equipment is disabled. Compare role contribution: S exceptional, A strong and reliable, B conditional, C low return on investment. Starting strength uses actual recruit level, unlocked skills and supplied gear plus equal-budget ordinary gear. Mature strength assumes level 11, ordinary gear and personal progression, excluding extra rewards from other chapters. Early means scarce resources; midgame means a basic team exists; late means filling a developed team. Long-term growth may favor early training. Shields, range, cover and immunities still apply; ordinary penetration retains armor and mitigation rules. Ratings are source analysis, not a playtested balance verdict.
valkyrie.shu.name: Shu
valkyrie.shu.background.name: Sui Wanderer
valkyrie.shu.background.description: A wanderer from the fields of Yan. Shu pauses wherever people lack grain or need healing. An ordinary shield becomes her shelter, and a handful of rice seeds brings hope to the camp.
valkyrie.shu.trait.name: Guardian of the Fields
valkyrie.shu.trait.description: A healing defender and farmer. Shu protects the front line with healing based on target maximum health and supplies daily provisions even in reserve.
valkyrie.shu.trait.tooltip: Starts with 130 health, 140 maximum fatigue, 90 resolve, 25 melee defense and 20 ranged defense, a wooden shield and militia spear. Healing and damage reduction do not depend on weapon or armor quality.
skin.shu_skin.name: Shu's Field Attire
skin.shu_skin.description: Pale hair, jade ornaments and golden rice. Shu wears her familiar field attire; the rice paddies at her feet mark her protection.
shu.passives: Thick Earth, Evergreen and Bountiful Harvest
skill.shu_thick_earth.name: Thick Earth
skill.shu_thick_earth.description: Reduces health and armor damage from attacks by 35%, or 60% for the first hit in each global round. Holding a shield grants +10 melee and ranged defense and halves native Shieldwall fatigue cost. Shu uses the highest of her defensive reductions instead of multiplying them.
skill.shu_evergreen.name: Evergreen
skill.shu_evergreen.description: Visible rice paddies cover Shu's tile and its 6 neighbors and move with her. Allies in the field recover 6 + 4% of maximum health at their turn start and take 15% less attack damage. At Shu's turn start she additionally heals the lowest health-ratio ally at or below 50% in her field for 18 + 8% maximum health, including herself. Each heal occurs at most once per global round.
skill.shu_bountiful_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
skill.shu_bountiful_harvest.description: Grants 150 provisions on joining. Each full elapsed day produces at least 150, increased according to the full roster's actual daily demand and current terrain to feed about 50 members. Works on the front line and in reserve, stopping upon death or departure. Rice lasts 10 days and cannot be sold. A full stash holds earned provisions in a saved ledger until space is available.
skill.shu_nurture.name: Nurture
skill.shu_nurture.description: Costs 3 AP and 8 fatigue. Heals a visible ally or Shu within 3 tiles for 25 + 15% of target maximum health. Usable once per global round. Seeds the target tile for 3 global rounds, granting Evergreen regeneration and 15% attack damage reduction.
skill.shu_granary.name: Granary Guardian
skill.shu_granary.description: Costs 4 AP and 15 fatigue. Immediately heals Shu and adjacent allies for 20 + 10% of each target's maximum health. For 2 global rounds Shu takes 50% less attack damage and gains +15 melee defense; adjacent allies take 25% less attack damage. Her first-hit 60% reduction takes priority and she can act normally. Cooldown: 3 global rounds. Available at combat start.
shu.heal_formula: Base heal + target maximum health percentage:
shu.field.name: Evergreen Paddies
shu.field.description: At your turn start, recover 6 + 4% maximum health, once per global round. Field benefits end immediately when you leave the active paddies.
shu.cooldown.unavailable: This skill is still cooling down.
shu.rice.name: Shu Rice
shu.rice.description: Rice harvested by Shu for front-line and reserve members. Lasts 10 days and cannot be sold.
ui.hub.guide.shu.summary: An early healing defender and reserve granary with little gear investment.
ui.hub.guide.shu.analysis: Recruited at level 1 with an ordinary wooden shield and militia spear. High starting health and defense combine with fixed mitigation; healing is independent of weapons. Evergreen sustains adjacent defenders, Nurture reaches distant wounded allies, and Granary Guardian answers focus fire. Bountiful Harvest works in reserve and supplies about 50 daily portions based on actual consumption. Movement, displacement or death changes field coverage; healing cannot revive and shields and armor remain valuable. Source-based rating, pending in-game balance review.
skill.ryza_core_crystal.name: Core Crystal
skill.ryza_core_crystal.description: Begin combat with 3 CC (maximum 6). Recover 1 CC each natural turn after the first, and 1 on the first Pulse hit each round. Waiting, extra turns and multi-hits do not duplicate recovery.
skill.ryza_pulse.name: Alchemy Pulse
skill.ryza_pulse.description: 4 AP, 10 fatigue, range 1–3. 30–45 damage, 80% armor damage, 20% penetration. First hit each round restores 1 CC.
skill.ryza_flame.name: Flame Flask
skill.ryza_flame.description: 4 AP, 18 fatigue, 2 CC, range 2–4. Separate hit rolls against enemies within one tile: 45–65 damage, 110% armor damage, 20% penetration. Once per round; no burning terrain.
skill.ryza_frost.name: Frost Bomb
skill.ryza_frost.description: 4 AP, 15 fatigue, 2 CC, range 1–4. 40–55 damage, 80% armor damage, 20% penetration. On hit, +1 movement AP and −30 initiative until the end of the target’s next natural turn. Cooldown: 2 natural turns.
skill.ryza_elixir.name: Restorative Elixir
skill.ryza_elixir.description: 4 AP, 15 fatigue, 2 CC, range 0–3. Restore 35 HP to self or an allied mercenary; remove one poison effect, otherwise one bleeding effect. No armor repair, revival or permanent-injury cure. Cooldown: 2 natural turns.
skill.ryza_core_drive.name: Core Drive
skill.ryza_core_drive.description: 7 AP, 30 fatigue, 6 CC, range 2–4. Separate hit rolls against enemies within one tile: 90–120 damage, 150% armor damage, 30% penetration. Cooldown: 3 natural turns.
valkyrie.ryza.name: Ryza
valkyrie.ryza.background.name: Kurken Island Alchemist
valkyrie.ryza.background.description: Ryza brings her alchemical discoveries to the company, breaking enemy lines with elemental flasks and caring for new companions born of synthesis.
valkyrie.ryza.trait.name: Adventuring Alchemist
valkyrie.ryza.trait.description: Powers elemental items and restorative elixirs with Core Crystals. Pet synthesis is available in her personal details.
valkyrie.ryza.trait.tooltip: Uses independent alchemical combat skills. Synthesize companions through her personal details on the world map.
skin.ryza_skin.name: Summer Alchemist
skin.ryza_skin.description: Her familiar white beret, yellow jacket and alchemical equipment.
ui.hub.guide.ryza.summary: Ranged elemental damage and healing, with a CC-fueled finisher.
ui.hub.guide.ryza.analysis: Use Pulse to build CC, Flame against groups, Frost to hinder movement and Elixir to save allies. Companion synthesis is a separate camp investment.
ryza.frost.name: Frostbound
ryza.frost.description: Movement costs +1 AP per tile and initiative is reduced by 30 until the end of the next natural turn. Does not stack.
ryza.pet.bone_mastiff.name: Bone Mastiff
ryza.pet.bone_mastiff.description: Bone guard: takes 10% less HP damage; movement costs +1 AP.
ryza.pet.scale_hound.name: Scale Warhound
ryza.pet.scale_hound.description: Heavy bite: +20 percentage points of armor damage.
ryza.pet.frost_wolf.name: Frostfang Wolf
ryza.pet.frost_wolf.description: Frostbite: first hit each round slows movement by +1 AP and initiative by −30 through the target’s next natural turn; does not stack.
ryza.pet.wind_hawk.name: Windarrow Hawk
ryza.pet.wind_hawk.description: Wind arrow: range 5, effective against lightly armored targets; accuracy penalty in melee.
ryza.pet.cerberus.name: Netherfang Cerberus
ryza.pet.cerberus.description: Triple bite: 6 AP, three hits against one target, each dealing 40% normal damage; stops immediately on death.
ryza.pet.iron_cerberus.name: Ironwall Cerberus
ryza.pet.iron_cerberus.description: Ironwall: after the first melee hit each round, counter once for 50% damage while alive; +1 movement AP.
ryza.pet.blood_wolf.name: Bloodfang Triwolf
ryza.pet.blood_wolf.description: Execution: 6 AP, three bites at 35% normal damage each; +25% damage against targets below half HP.
ryza.pet.spirit_vulture.name: Threehead Spirit Vulture
ryza.pet.spirit_vulture.description: Spirit feather: each natural turn heals the weakest ally within 2 tiles for 15/20/25/30 HP and removes one poison or bleed. A target can receive it only once per round.
ryza.pet.twin_guardian.name: Twin Guardian
ryza.pet.twin_guardian.description: Guard: each natural turn protects the weakest adjacent ally: +10 melee/ranged defense and resolve until the guardian’s next natural turn. Does not stack; ends if the guardian dies.
ryza.pet.splitjaw.name: Splitjaw Ravager
ryza.pet.splitjaw.description: Rend: +40 percentage points of armor damage; −15% body and head armor.
ryza.pet.griffin.name: Griffin
ryza.pet.griffin.description: Pounce: 4 AP leap to a legal empty tile within 3 tiles; 2-round cooldown. Disabled while rooted; destination reactions apply.
ryza.pet.mane_tusk.name: Maned Tuskbeast
ryza.pet.mane_tusk.description: Hindering bite: first hit each round applies slow; trades armor damage for durability.
ryza.pet.ironwing.name: Ironwing Gryph
ryza.pet.ironwing.description: Iron feathers: range 3 and 130% armor damage; +1 movement AP.
ryza.pet.nightwing.name: Nightwing Wolfgryph
ryza.pet.nightwing.description: Hunting mark: hits reduce target melee/ranged defense by 10 through its next natural turn; does not stack.
ryza.pet.rules: Equip in the accessory slot and unleash once per item per battle. Crafted companions survive defeat: rest 2 days at T1/T2, 3 at T3 or 5 at T4, then recover 25% HP. Recover 15% HP per day outside injury recovery; repair armor in the atelier. No total companion cap.
ryza.pet.unleash.description: 3 AP, 15 fatigue. Unleash the equipped companion onto an adjacent empty tile. It acts automatically. Once per item per battle; unavailable during injury recovery.
ryza.pet.attack.description: Use this species’ bite or feather attack. Multihead attacks resolve in separate hits, stopping if either combatant dies.
ryza.pet.mark.description: −10 melee and ranged defense through the next natural turn. Identical marks do not stack.
ryza.pet.guard.description: +10 melee defense, ranged defense and resolve until the guardian’s next natural turn. Ends if it dies. Does not stack.
ryza.pet.leap.description: 4 AP, 15 fatigue. Leap to a legal empty tile 2–3 tiles away. Cooldown: 2 rounds. Unavailable while rooted; landing reactions apply.
ryza.alchemy.title: Ryza’s Atelier
ryza.alchemy.description: 20 distinct companions, 68 pet recipes and 17 permanent traits. Choose a recipe, then review pets, brothers and materials. Exact costs and results are shown before confirmation.
ryza.ext.timeout: The latest result could not be confirmed. Refresh and check your stash and brothers. Synthesis is paused until then.
ryza.alchemy.locked: Recruit Ryza and return to the world map to use the atelier. Recipes remain browsable.
ryza.alchemy.invalid: Invalid request. Select the recipe again.
ryza.alchemy.select_pets: Select a different companion for each slot.
ryza.alchemy.changed: Inventory or preview changed. Review again; no resources were charged.
ryza.alchemy.invalid_pet: A companion does not match the recipe or is recovering.
ryza.alchemy.confirm: The listed companions and recipe materials will be consumed to create the result. The first companion supplies the retained name. Donors are not returned.
ryza.alchemy.full: HP and armor are already restored.
ryza.alchemy.training_locked: Training is full or the focus differs. Reset to change focus.
ryza.alchemy.empty_filter: No recipes match this filter. Select All roles to inspect missing companions and materials.
ryza.alchemy.need_pet: No eligible companion. Equipped companions must be unequipped first.
ryza.alchemy.retained: Retains the primary name and training. Upgrades preserve HP and armor percentages and do not heal for free. All donors and listed materials are consumed.
ryza.alchemy.requirements: Supply the companions, materials or crowns marked in red above.
ryza.alchemy.training_hint: Up to 2 training ranks: Vitality grants +5% HP and +2 defense per rank; Precision grants +3 accuracy and +2 min/max damage. Choose one focus; resetting costs 1000 crowns with no refund. Restoration costs 150 × tier crowns and restores all HP and armor. Injuries must finish recovery first.
ryza.alchemy.no_pets: No crafted companions yet. Synthesize one in the Recipe Book; equipped companions also appear here.
ryza.alchemy.base_stats: Base stats before inherited training; multi-head damage is scaled per hit as described.
ryza.alchemy.final_stats: Output maximum stats including inherited training:
origin.foreign_banner.name: A Banner in a Foreign Land
origin.foreign_banner.selection:
A failed escort cost you your old company, but brought you together with two strangers. They held the line around the wounded; you led the survivors to safety. With the final payment settled, four companions choose to raise a new banner.

[color=#bcad8c]Companions:[/color] Jeanne, Enterprise, a shield bearer and a crossbowman.
[color=#bcad8c]Guiding Pact:[/color] A single-use item turns your next pull into a free choice.
[color=#bcad8c]A Shared Road:[/color] Basic equipment and supplies, with normal company rules.
origin.foreign_banner.description: From a wagon brought to safety to a banner raised together. Revisit the beginning of your company with Jeanne and Enterprise.
origin.foreign_banner.replay_hint: Replay the opening at any time. After your first completed contract, revisit the night an employer first remembered your company.
origin.foreign_banner.next_contract: Return to the world map, visit a nearby town, and accept and complete an ordinary contract. Your first completed contract unlocks the follow-up story, Names on the Banner. This is the origin story replay page; there is no chapter objective to turn in here.
origin.foreign_banner.next_free: Your first-contract story is unlocked. Replay Names on the Banner below, or return to the world map to take contracts, recruit companions, and build your company.
origin.foreign_banner.next_pact: You can also open your stash and right-click the Guiding Pact to recruit one eligible Valkyrie of your choice for free.
origin.foreign_banner.hire_reason: Chose to rebuild the company together
origin.foreign_banner.shield_bio: %name% survived the fall of your old company. During the ambush, he stayed beside the wagon carrying the wounded. He saw you return to the fighting, Jeanne hold her banner, and Enterprise cover the retreat. He is willing to follow you once more.
origin.foreign_banner.crossbow_bio: %name% guarded the rear of your old company. During the retreat, he rationed his final bolts until Enterprise took over the covering fire. He remembers your promise to bring the wounded out, and chooses to stay beneath your new banner.
origin.foreign_banner.intro_event:
The gates close behind you, hiding the last glow of the pursuers' torches. The wounded are in a healer's care, and the final escort payment rests in your palm.

Jeanne straightens her banner beside a wagon wheel. Enterprise checks her bowstring. Your two old companions look to you for a decision about tomorrow.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.title: Those Who Stayed
origin.foreign_banner.retreat.title: The Last Wagon
origin.foreign_banner.town.title: A Living for Tomorrow
origin.foreign_banner.banner.title: A Banner Raised Together
origin.foreign_banner.pact.name: Guiding Pact
origin.foreign_banner.pact.description:
A crystal wrapped in old cloth, still holding a faint light. Jeanne and Enterprise entrusted it to you, hoping the next meeting will bring another companion beneath your banner.

Right-click in the stash to turn the next summon into a free choice. Consumed only after a successful summon; cancelling, a full roster or a failed summon preserves it.
origin.foreign_banner.pact.tooltip: Immediate choice, costing 0 crowns. Completes the current choice cycle: progress resets and the guarantee count increases once on success. With gacha disabled, grants one free direct summon with the same settlement. Chapter-only recruits and locked skins remain restricted.
origin.foreign_banner.pact.unavailable: The Guiding Pact is unavailable. Check the item in your stash on the world map.
origin.foreign_banner.cg.retreat.caption: Together, you brought the last wagon out of the ambush.
origin.foreign_banner.cg.town.caption: Counting the last payment, and what each of you can offer.
origin.foreign_banner.cg.banner.caption: The banner begins to stand for a road chosen together.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line1: Your old company's banner falls among the trees. Someone shouts that the commander is dead; footsteps fade into the forest. The last wagon is stuck in the mud, carrying two wounded men who cannot walk.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line2: The wheel is stuck. Stay any longer, and none of us gets out.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line3: Brace your shield beside the wagon. I'll push. If you can still draw a string, save your last shots.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line4: Three bolts left. Whether that's enough depends on what they believe.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line5: A white banner rises above the wagon shaft and steadies beside you. Its bearer asks nothing about payment. She looks first at the wounded.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line6: They are still alive. Keep pushing. I will hold this side.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line7: More pursuers on the right slope. Crossbowman, keep your last bolt. My arrows will cover you.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line8: The town gates are at the end of this road. Once we reach them, we can exchange names.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line9: At last, the wheel turns. Between banner and arrows, you retreat together, leaving no living soul behind.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line10: A healer takes the wounded. The employer deducts the lost cargo and sets the remaining payment on the table. The last account of your old company is settled.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line11: This will buy food and repairs. There's enough to give you two something for the road as well. Thank you.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line12: My name is Jeanne. Keep the travel money for the wounded. Will someone care for them after we leave?
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line13: The healer agreed to keep them until they can walk. I'll leave money, and return to check on them.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line14: Enterprise. You know the roads, and whom to ask for information. We know very little about this land.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line15: I can find contracts, keep accounts and buy provisions. That used to be my work. But now there's no company left.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line16: We're still here. As long as you don't send me against a castle tomorrow, I'm willing to try again.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line17: I'll stay too. This time, buy enough bolts first.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line18: If we travel together, we can help those who need us along the road. Food, medicine and shelter do cost money.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line19: Start with work we can finish. Escorts, patrols, enemies threatening villages. Give everyone a chance to come back.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line20: Then tomorrow, we find our first contract. Raise the banner again, and begin a new account.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line21: Before dawn, Jeanne cleans the mud from her banner. Enterprise lays an old cloth bundle before you. Inside rests a faintly glowing crystal.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line22: This remained from our arrival here. It can answer one more call. Keep it until you need it.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line23: Whoever chooses to answer will be a new companion. Once you know whom you wish to invite, let this light guide her.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line24: I'll remember. When she arrives, we should have food, a bed, and a place for her in the company ready.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line25: Good. A new companion should know what sort of people she will fight beside.
origin.foreign_banner.opening.line27: Your two old companions shoulder their packs. You put away the Guiding Pact and check the provisions and road for your new company. Morning wind unfolds the banner as the four of you pass through the gates.
origin.foreign_banner.first_contract.lin: As payment for your first contract drops into the purse, the employer asks your company's name again. He tells his clerk to write it down, saying he will seek you out next time.
Did you hear? Someone remembered us this time.
A name is a beginning. First provisions, then repairs. Everyone gets a hot meal tonight.
Contract completed. Companions accounted for. A beginning worth continuing.
At first, this banner sheltered a wagon. Now it shelters a place we can all return to.
Beside the fire, one companion cleans a weapon; another sets aside half a loaf for tomorrow. You enter the earnings in your ledger. The name beneath the banner begins to carry weight in this land.

ryza.ext.pet.vanguard_griffin.descriptio: Inherits three intrinsic attributes from one brother and retains its parent species' signature ability. Upgrading never duplicates the inherited bonuses.
ryza.ext.trait.bone.description: Take 10% less hitpoint damage; armor damage is unaffected.
ryza.ext.trait.scale.description: Weapon attacks deal 20% more armor damage.
ryza.ext.trait.hunt.description: Weapon attacks deal 15% more damage against enemies below half hitpoints.
ryza.ext.trait.three.description: After your first weapon miss each natural turn, the next weapon attack against that target this turn gains 10 accuracy. Once per turn.
ryza.ext.trait.wall.description: Gain 8 melee defense at the start of each natural turn until moving or your next natural turn. Does not stack.
ryza.ext.trait.blood.description: Heal 10% of hitpoint damage dealt to adjacent enemies with blood, capped at 12 per natural turn. Necrosavant potion lifesteal takes precedence; this effect does not add to it.
ryza.ext.trait.regen.description: Heal 5 hitpoints at each natural turn start in combat. Unhold potion regeneration takes precedence; this effect does not add to it.
ryza.ext.trait.guard.description: Gain 5 melee and ranged defense while adjacent to a friendly mercenary. More allies do not stack.
ryza.ext.trait.pierce.description: Weapon attacks ignore an additional 10 percentage points of armor, capped at 100%; for example, 30% becomes 40%.
ryza.ext.trait.stride.description: The first ordinary movement tile each natural turn costs 1 less AP, to a minimum of 1. Waiting and extra turns do not refresh it.
ryza.ext.trait.nerve.description: 50% chance to resist stun. Use the higher existing stun-resistance chance, without extra rolls.
ryza.ext.trait.wing.description: Take 15% less hitpoint damage from ranged attacks. Multiplies with other reductions.
ryza.ext.trait.night.description: Ignore nighttime penalties to ranged skill and vision. The normal nighttime ranged-defense penalty remains.
ryza.ext.trait.life.description: Core. Once per battle, survive lethal damage at 25% maximum hitpoints and clear poison and bleeding. No armor or extra actions. Existing protections such as Nine Lives trigger first.
ryza.ext.trait.fury.description: Core. Weapon attack damage increased by 15%.
ryza.ext.protected: Special, guest or irreplaceable characters cannot be consumed
ryza.ext.unavailable: The brother must be alive and in the world-map roster
ryza.ext.space: Not enough stash space for all returned gear and the result
ryza.ext.irreversible: This brother will be permanently consumed and leave the company. All equipment and bag items return to the stash.
ryza.ext.intrinsic: Only intrinsic attributes and level-up gains count. Equipment, potions, temporary effects, perk multipliers and alchemy traits are excluded. One donor per pet.
ryza.ext.limit: At most 6 alchemy traits, including at most 1 core trait
ryza.ext.owned: Already acquired; duplicates are not allowed
ryza.ext.full: All 6 alchemy trait slots are occupied
ryza.ext.core_full: A core trait is already present
ryza.ext.adaptation: During adaptation this brother cannot receive another alchemy trait. Stats and deployment are unaffected; other brothers and pet crafting remain available.
ryza.ext.trait_confirm: Consume the selected pet and materials, grant the permanent trait and start adaptation.
ryza.ext.trait_summary_desc: Permanent traits acquired through Ryza's alchemy.
ryza.ext.preview_note: Review the result, brother and all costs before confirming.
ryza.ext.ack: I confirm this brother will be permanently consumed
ryza.ext.fusion_path: T2 parent companion → new T3 species → same species T4
ryza.ext.power_note: Fixed recipe; donor attributes transfer once. Perks, potions and alchemy traits do not transfer.
ryza.ext.retained_note: Retains the primary pet's name, training and damage ratios. Upgrading preserves inherited bonuses unchanged.
ryza.ext.base_and_inherit: Result stats include primary-pet training and donor inheritance.
chapter.shu_granary.name: Granary of Plenty
chapter.shu_granary.description: Shu and nearby farmers provision the whole company. Defend one collection point for a batch of rice. One chapter, three difficulties, with a shared three-day interval after victory.
chapter.shu_granary.location_description: Bandits threaten the collection point. Defeat all enemies to earn this batch. Shu may remain in reserve; surviving enemies persist after retreat.
chapter.shu_granary.rules: A living Shu in the roster unlocks every difficulty, including while in reserve. A real victory starts a shared 72-game-hour cooldown. The reward is locked at the first battle using whole-roster food consumption. Claim it here; delivered rice lasts ten days.
chapter.shu_granary.repeatable: Repeatable supply / one chapter, three difficulties
chapter.shu_granary.daily: Actual daily food for the whole roster:
chapter.shu_granary.budget: portions. Daily budget including marching reserves:
chapter.shu_granary.available: A harvest is available. All three difficulties share a three-day interval.
chapter.shu_granary.food_days: Lasts the whole roster at its current consumption for
chapter.shu_granary.locked: Battle entered; this difficulty and reward are locked:
chapter.shu_granary.before_battle: Before battle, difficulty may be changed. The reward is recalculated and locked when combat is first entered.
chapter.shu_granary.missing_location: This entered encounter has lost its location. Abandon this cycle to start afresh. Old locations cannot award another harvest.
chapter.shu_granary.stash: The stash is full. Make room to collect the rice; earned grain stays safe and its freshness begins on delivery.
chapter.shu_granary.repeat: Another convoy has arrived. Keep the granary safe, and this fresh rice will reach everyone's bowls.
chapter.shu_granary.cg.fields: Morning fields, as Shu enters the company in the harvest ledger.
chapter.shu_granary.cg.guard: Golden shoots before the granary gate, protecting provisions for everyone.
chapter.shu_granary.cg.meal: Fresh rice becomes a warm meal shared by the front line and reserves.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.1: Rice heads droop over the banks. New grain covers the drying yard beside the storehouse. Shu spreads the roster on an old wooden table and records every name.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.2: Having so many people is a good thing. Since everyone has come this far, we should make sure they can eat.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.3: Farmers take turns bringing dried, threshed grain here; a new batch is ready every three days. Unfriendly riders have already appeared behind the distant convoy.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.4: Rice does not grow in three days. Several farms take turns delivering their harvests. Keep the grain road safe, and I will account for every sack.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.5: She adds those staying in camp to the final page. Protecting this collection point earns provisions for the entire company, not only those fighting today.
chapter.shu_granary.opening.6: Those in reserve are waiting for a meal too. Do not worry; they will have their share.
chapter.shu_granary.guard.1: The grain carts cross the bank, but bandits block the road before the granary. Shu puts the ledger away and moves the newly arrived sacks beneath the eaves.
chapter.shu_granary.guard.2: People are waiting for this grain. Please keep this place safe.
chapter.shu_granary.guard.3: You choose the company's defensive positions. Shu may support the fighters or stay behind to manage the grain. Defeating this band is all the battle requires.
chapter.shu_granary.guard.4: Do not rush into a distant pursuit. Clear the road before the granary, and the carts can come through.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.1: The grain road grows quiet. Farmers carry the last sack into the storehouse, and Shu marks the harvest as secured in her ledger.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.2: This batch is safe. If your stash has no room yet, that is all right. We will keep it on the ledger until there is space.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.3: The fighters remove their armor, and those who stayed in camp join them by the fire. She cooks the fresh rice; the first bowl she offers still sends up white steam.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.4: Have a bowl of warm rice first. There are many days still ahead.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.5: The next dried harvest will arrive in three days. Tonight, everyone on the roster can sit together and finish this meal at their own pace.
chapter.shu_granary.ending.6: When you set out tomorrow, remember to eat well.
chapter.shu_granary.delivery: The fresh rice is packed. Use the older provisions first, and make sure everyone gets a meal.
chapter.tenka_festival.name: Mistbound Academy: Festival of Five Swords
chapter.tenka_festival.description: Beyond the mountain mist lies a hidden academy. Join its festival, face five sword schools, and earn five legendary blades.
chapter.tenka_festival.ending: Five trial seals have earned the swordswomen’s respect. The legendary blades belong to the company; their rightful masters awaken a deeper resonance.
chapter.tenka_festival.opening.line1: The mountain mist parts. Bells, festival drums and the smell of roasted dumplings drift from an academy absent from your maps.
chapter.tenka_festival.opening.line2: We only meant to pass through. What are you celebrating?
chapter.tenka_festival.opening.line3: Our academy festival, and the trials of five schools. If our guests wish to ask with their swords, we shall answer.
chapter.tenka_festival.opening.line4: Register first. Trials follow normal combat rules. Blades are dangerous, so look after your companions.
chapter.tenka_festival.opening.line5: Five blades wait in the moon court. When all five of us acknowledge you, they may finally travel beyond the mist.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage1.name: Invitation to the West Court
chapter.tenka_festival.stage1.line1: Courtesy means respecting your opponent, not letting them win.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage1.line2: Understood. We brought the skills that keep us alive on the road.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage1.line3: Watch the point of my blade. It may not return along the line you expect.
chapter.tenka_festival.goal.mary_court: Complete Invitation to the West Court
chapter.tenka_festival.stage1.brief: Register and observe Mary’s fencing. If the examiner belongs to your company, place her in reserve.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage2.name: Trial of the Rose
chapter.tenka_festival.stage2.line1: I was too slow to answer that cut. Keep this first seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage2.line2: Your fencing is harder to face than the rumors suggested.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage2.line3: I shall remember the compliment. Now try not to let Warabi scatter your formation.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage2.brief: Defeat Mary and the pupils in a real trial, then submit the seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.seal_reward: A victory seal toward the five-school trial.
chapter.tenka_festival.seal_source: Win and submit the corresponding trial.
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.mary.title: Roses and a Sword Salute
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.mary.caption: Mary lowers her point and salutes the company’s earned victory.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage3.name: Preparing the Flower Walk
chapter.tenka_festival.stage3.line1: A wall of motionless shields is dull. Festival blades should move like the wind.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage3.line2: Then we shall see whether your wind passes through before our formation closes.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage3.line3: My bear will lend one blow, not an endless barrage. Do not watch only my sword.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage3.brief: Inspect the platform and its flanks, then hear Warabi’s rules.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage4.name: Trial of the Dancing Blossom
chapter.tenka_festival.stage4.line1: Ha! A fine encirclement. Even I must concede that one.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage4.line2: Your bear coordinates better than some of our recruits.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage4.line3: Then take a flower with your seal. Smile a little; the festival is only halfway through.
chapter.tenka_festival.goal.warabi_trial: Win Trial of the Dancing Blossom
chapter.tenka_festival.stage4.brief: Defeat Warabi and the pupils in a real trial, then submit the seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.warabi.title: A Leap Among Petals
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.warabi.caption: Warabi sheathes her blade beside the platform; even her bear quietly shares the celebration.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage5.name: Swords in the Mirror Gallery
chapter.tenka_festival.stage5.line1: That mark came from your favorite attack, did it not?
chapter.tenka_festival.stage5.line3: Favorite things are easy to remember. When I begin linking forms, another opponent may offer a different answer.
chapter.tenka_festival.goal.satori_court: Complete Swords in the Mirror Gallery
chapter.tenka_festival.stage5.brief: Study the crossing marks on the practice posts and Satori’s changing forms.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage6.name: Trial of Changing Forms
chapter.tenka_festival.stage6.line1: When you changed opponents, I guessed the next cut wrong. A formation can change forms too.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage6.line2: A companion can finish an answer one person cannot find.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage6.line3: I like that answer. The third seal is yours.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage6.brief: Defeat Satori and the pupils in a real trial, then submit the seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.satori.title: Stillness in the Mirror Gallery
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.satori.caption: Satori rests in the gallery, studying her guests anew beside the reflected lanterns.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage7.name: Preparing the Main Court
chapter.tenka_festival.stage7.line1: You have overcome three schools. A festival is no reason to take the last two lightly.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage7.line2: If the seals were merely gifts for visitors, they would mean little.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage7.line3: Good. Watch when I draw breath. After that cut, your opening will come.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage7.brief: Inspect the practice wards and learn to recognize Rin’s gathering breath.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage8.name: Trial of Aun
chapter.tenka_festival.stage8.line1: The one facing my blade held firm; the flank did not rush. You earned a steady victory.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage8.line2: We cannot afford to lose companions. We have learned steadiness.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage8.line3: Take that resolve to the moon court. The fourth seal is yours.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage8.brief: Defeat Rin and the pupils in a real trial, then submit the seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.rin.title: Aun by Lantern Light
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.rin.caption: Rin loosens her wrist wrapping, her stern composure briefly softening.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.name: Waiting for the Moon Bell
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.line1: The stalls grow quiet, and for the first time you can hear the bamboo leaves.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.line2: A blade has a direction even before it leaves its sheath. Can you hear it?
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.line3: Yes. And I see the openings my companions leave for one another.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.line4: Then wait for the bell to fade.
chapter.tenka_festival.goal.tsukuyo_cour: Complete Waiting for the Moon Bell
chapter.tenka_festival.stage9.brief: Confirm the final trial at the moon court. Company members sharing the examiner’s identity cannot fight on the challenger side.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage10.name: Final Trial of Unyo
chapter.tenka_festival.stage10.line1: The bell has fallen silent. Your final cut arrived first.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage10.line2: All five seals. May we finally see those blades?
chapter.tenka_festival.stage10.line3: Come with me. The others are waiting too.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage10.brief: Defeat Tsukuyo and the pupils in a real trial, then submit the seal.
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.tsukuyo.title: Blades Beneath the Moon
chapter.tenka_festival.cg.tsukuyo.captio: Tsukuyo presents the blades while the other four witness their departure from the academy.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.name: The Naming of Five Blades
chapter.tenka_festival.reward: Onimaru Aun, Odenta Rose, Juzumaru Changes, Dojigiri Dance and Mikazuki Unyo: five fixed legendary swords, each with two weapon techniques.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line1: Five sealed blades are placed upon the dais. Moonlight touches their guards and the five different seals.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line2: These blades are not a prize for one person. They belong to the company that completed all five trials.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line3: Anyone may learn their techniques. The understanding between us and our old swords is something you will see on the battlefield.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line4: Do not leave them gathering dust in your stash!
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line5: What new answer will you bring next time?
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line6: Your road lies beyond the mist. May every drawn blade return safely to its sheath.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.line7: We accept. When we hear the festival drums again, we shall return.
chapter.tenka_festival.stage11.brief: Bring five seals to the dais. If your stash is full, earned blades remain available for later delivery.
chapter.tenka_festival.goal.award: Accept the acknowledgment of all five swordswomen
chapter.tenka_festival.start_hint: No swordswoman is required in your roster. Trials use normal injury and death rules; place all company members sharing the current examiner’s identity in reserve.
chapter.tenka_festival.blocked: Place every member sharing the examiner’s identity in reserve and deploy at least one other challenger.
chapter.tenka_festival.location_battle: Academy trial ground. Normal damage, death and equipment wear rules apply. Retreat is allowed; trial equipment cannot be looted.
chapter.tenka_festival.enemy_description: Mary strikes precisely; Warabi’s first two sword attacks gain her bear’s force; Satori builds pressure against one target; Rin gathers strength every other round; Tsukuyo opens with a swift cut. Repositioning, control and armor remain effective.
chapter.tenka_festival.pending: Blades await free stash slots; refresh the chapter to continue delivery.
skill.onigawara_rin_weapon_guard.name: Aun Stance
skill.onigawara_rin_weapon_guard.descrip: 2 AP, 12 fatigue, 2-round cooldown. Gain +10 melee defense until your next normal turn and reduce the first paid single-target melee hit by 20%. Rin gains +14 defense. Overlapping stances and first-hit protection use the stronger benefit.
skill.kikakujo_mary_weapon_advance.name: Rose Advance
skill.kikakujo_mary_weapon_advance.descr: 2 AP, 20 fatigue, 2-round cooldown. Approach an enemy 2–3 tiles away along a legal path and strike for 100% weapon damage with +10 accuracy. Mary deals 120% and recovers 4 accumulated fatigue on hit. Shares the once-per-round sword movement budget.
skill.tamaba_satori_weapon_intercept.des: 3 AP, 16 fatigue, 1-round cooldown. Deal 90% weapon damage with +15 accuracy and halve shield defense. On Satori’s hit, her next different paid sword technique against that target gains +10 accuracy; consumed on attempt and expires after her next normal turn.
skill.hanasaka_warabi_weapon_step.name: Petal Crossing
skill.hanasaka_warabi_weapon_step.descri: 2 AP, 12 fatigue, 1-round cooldown. Move up to two tiles along a legal empty path and gain +6 melee and ranged defense until your next normal turn. Warabi moves up to three tiles and gains +10 instead, without stacking her movement defense. Shares sword movement limits; roots, occupancy, elevation and spearwalls apply.
skill.inaba_tsukuyo_weapon_flash.name: Crescent Flash
skill.inaba_tsukuyo_weapon_flash.descrip: 3 AP, 18 fatigue, 2-round cooldown. Strike an adjacent target for 100% weapon damage with +10 accuracy and +10 percentage points of armor penetration. Tsukuyo gains +15 percentage points instead.
tenka.legendary_tooltip: A legendary festival blade. Grants two weapon techniques in addition to its basic attack, usable by any player wielder, with extra resonance for its rightful master. Requires a usable main-hand sword and empty offhand.
tenka.festival_weapon_note: Weapon techniques do not grant character identity. Unequipping, breakage and disarm disable them; swapping does not reset cooldowns. Every attack rechecks life and target eligibility.
chapter.tenka_festival.returning.rin: Captain, this is the academy I protect. Today I stand as an examiner. Keep my company position in reserve, and show me what our travels have taught your blades.
chapter.tenka_festival.returning.mary: Captain, welcome to my western court. Friendship earns no favors in this trial. Keep my company position in reserve while I lead the academy side.
chapter.tenka_festival.returning.satori: I have watched your habits on the road. Leave my company position in reserve, Captain. This time I will read your next stroke from the other side.
chapter.tenka_festival.returning.warabi: At last, I can show you my practice stage! Keep my company position in reserve today, Captain. Knowing me is no excuse to leave your flank open.
chapter.tenka_festival.returning.tsukuyo: Familiar footsteps reveal new rhythms beneath the moon. Leave my company position in reserve, Captain, and meet me as your examiner. Do not hesitate at the final stroke.
chapter.tenka_festival.form.mary: Rose form: melee weapon attacks gain +10 accuracy and +10 percentage points of armor penetration. Guard your spacing against her fencing approach.
chapter.tenka_festival.form.warabi: Flower form: the first two melee weapon attacks this battle deal 30% more regular and armor damage. Misses consume uses. Bear assistance empowers attacks without spawning another unit.
chapter.tenka_festival.form.satori: Changing form: consecutive attacks on one target build up to two reads, each adding 15% regular and armor damage to later attacks. Misses count. Switching the defender breaks the sequence.
chapter.tenka_festival.form.rin: Aun form: melee weapon attacks deal 50% more damage on even global rounds, with an additional 20% armor-damage multiplier. Odd rounds offer a safer opening.
chapter.tenka_festival.form.tsukuyo: Moon form: the first melee weapon attack each global round gains 35% damage and +10 accuracy. A miss still consumes it; waiting and extra actions do not reset it.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.name: Ryza's Field Alchemy Journal
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.description: Rescue new companions and collect alchemy ingredients. Choose one of five expeditions; all share a three-day preparation period.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.rules: A living Ryza in the company unlocks all routes, including from reserve; she need not fight. Choose one expedition per cycle. Victory starts a shared 72-game-hour cooldown, with no stored charges. Ingredients are fixed completion rewards, with no additional random alchemy-material drops.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.location_descript: A site marked in Ryza's journal. Return to the chapter after victory to collect companions or ingredients. All five expeditions share a three-day cooldown.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.rescue.brief: Defeat the poachers and rescue a wolf that can be equipped or used in alchemy.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.hunt.brief: Track direwolves and hyenas for pelts, fur and adrenaline glands.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.silk.brief: Clear the spider-infested woods and collect silk and poison glands.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.giants.brief: Challenge the valley's unholds for advancement and augmentation ingredients.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.dragon.brief: Challenge lindwurms for bones and scales used in the highest-tier alchemy.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.dragon.enemies: 2 lindwurms (each with a head and tail)
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.available: Ready to depart. Choose one of the five expeditions.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.before_battle: You may switch before the first battle. Entry locks this expedition. Retreat preserves enemy losses and grants no reward.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.abandon_note: Abandoning after battle entry starts a shared 72-hour cooldown immediately and grants no reward.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.missing: This expedition's site is missing. Enemies will not be restored. You may abandon this cycle and depart again in three days.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.stash: Your stash is full. Make room to collect items in batches; remaining rewards are retained.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.opening.1: Ryza spreads a thick journal across the camp table. Maps from local hunters lie between its pages, marked with five colored routes.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.opening.2: Look, Captain! We can follow whichever route has what we need. New companions or ingredients first? You decide.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.opening.3: She packs empty bottles, bandages and a spare collar, then checks the hunters' reports once more.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.opening.4: After each trip we need to sort samples, tend wounds and ask the hunters for fresh tracks. Three days of preparation will keep everyone ready.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.guard.1: Ryza circles the chosen route. The expedition packs the containers and tools needed for this trip.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.guard.2: Clear the danger first, then gather the ingredients. If we find a captive wolf, give it time to trust us.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.ending.1: The workshop table is neatly arranged. Ryza records the expedition's finds in her journal and makes room for the next synthesis.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.ending.2: Every ingredient has a use. One trip at a time, we'll gather everything we need!
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.rescue_scene.1: Once the last poacher is gone, Ryza opens the cage. The grey wolf hesitates at the door, then lowers its nose to her outstretched hand.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.rescue_scene.2: There's nothing to fear. Come with us, if you like. You'll have somewhere safe to rest.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.repeat: The hunters have confirmed fresh tracks. Let's check the workshop and choose our next route!
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.delivery: These supplies are ready. I'll keep anything you cannot carry safely here.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.cg.journal: Ryza plans the gathering routes in the morning light. A new synthesis begins on the first page.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.cg.rescue: Beside an open cage, Ryza waits for a new companion to take its first step.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.cg.workshop: In the warmly lit workshop, Ryza sorts the discoveries brought home from the field.
chapter.ryza_fieldwork.error.reward: Reward delivery failed. Unclaimed rewards have been preserved. Please check the game log before trying again.
ryza.ext.no_candidates: No matching candidates. Check the required species, tier and equipped status.

skill.orbment_vitality.name: Vitality

skill.orbment_swiftness.name: Swiftness
skill.orbment_breathing.name: Breathing
skill.orbment_breathing.description: Recover 2 extra fatigue at each normal turn start.
skill.orbment_far_guard.name: Far Guard
skill.orbment_composure.name: Composure

skill.orbment_piercing.description: +15 percentage points of direct attack penetration; excess over 100% becomes damage.
skill.orbment_shatter.name: Shatter
skill.orbment_citadel.name: Citadel
skill.orbment_citadel.description: Take 10% less direct hitpoint damage, multiplicative with other reductions.
skill.orbment_circulation.name: Circulation
skill.orbment_insight.name: Insight
skill.orbment_unyielding.name: Unyielding
skill.orbment_battle_return.name: Battle Return
skill.orbment_battle_return.description: Recover 4 fatigue on a personal kill, once per round.
skill.orbment_stone_lance.name: Stone Lance
skill.orbment_stone_lance.description: 45–60 independent damage; 100% armor damage, 20% penetration. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
skill.orbment_healing_drop.name: Healing Drop
skill.orbment_healing_drop.description: Restore 25 allied hitpoints, twice per battle. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
skill.orbment_fire_bolt.name: Fire Bolt
skill.orbment_fire_bolt.description: 40–55 independent damage; 70% armor damage, 30% penetration. Cooldown: 1 rounds.
skill.orbment_wind_blade.name: Wind Blade
skill.orbment_wind_blade.description: 30–40 independent damage, +10 accuracy; 70% armor damage, 20% penetration. Cooldown: 1 rounds.
skill.orbment_temporal_boost.name: Temporal Boost
skill.orbment_temporal_boost.description: Restore 10 fatigue; +30 initiative until the end of the next normal turn. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_space_barrier.name: Space Barrier
skill.orbment_space_barrier.description: +10 melee and ranged defense until the end of the next normal turn. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
skill.orbment_phantom_noise.name: Phantom Noise
skill.orbment_phantom_noise.description: On hit: -15 melee and ranged skill until the end of the next normal turn. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
skill.orbment_rock_bulwark.name: Rock Bulwark
skill.orbment_rock_bulwark.description: Self and adjacent allies take 10% less direct hitpoint damage until their next normal turn ends; repeated applications multiply. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_spring_prayer.name: Spring Prayer
skill.orbment_spring_prayer.description: Restore 20 hitpoints and remove one bleed or poison layer from allies on the target and adjacent tiles; twice per battle. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_flame_gale.name: Flame Gale
skill.orbment_flame_gale.description: 40–55 independent damage to enemies on the target and adjacent tiles; 70% armor damage, 30% penetration. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_gale_slash.name: Gale Slash
skill.orbment_gale_slash.description: Melee weapon attack using weapon range and penetration, with +20% damage. Cooldown: 2 rounds.
skill.orbment_temporal_haste.name: Temporal Haste
skill.orbment_temporal_haste.description: Grant 2 temporary AP next normal turn; each target can benefit once per battle. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_warp.name: Warp
skill.orbment_warp.description: Move to a visible empty tile within 3 without triggering disengagement attacks; once per battle. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
skill.orbment_phantom_veil.name: Phantom Veil
skill.orbment_phantom_veil.description: Roll separately for each enemy in the area; on hit, -15 melee skill, ranged skill and resolve until the next normal turn ends. Cooldown: 3 rounds.
orbment.socket_bonus.desc: Base bonuses of the physically socketed quartz.
skill.tio_orbal_pulse.name: Orbal Pulse
skill.tio_orbal_pulse.description: Ranged orbal attack: 50–70 + 0.4R damage, 100% armor damage, 25% penetration. Cooldown: 0 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_analyzer.name: Analyzer
skill.tio_analyzer.description: Apply one analysis stack for 3 rounds: allied attacks gain +5 accuracy, +5 percentage points penetration and +10% armor damage per stack. Stacks and refreshes without a cap. Cooldown: 1 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_beam_zanber.name: Beam Zanber
skill.tio_beam_zanber.description: Straight hex line up to 3 tiles: 65–85 + 0.5R damage, 130% armor damage, 30% penetration; ignores allies. Cooldown: 2 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_absolute_zero.name: Absolute Zero
skill.tio_absolute_zero.description: Target and adjacent enemies: 55–75 + 0.4R damage, 80% armor damage, 30% penetration. Hits apply stacking chill for 2 rounds: -25 initiative and +1 movement AP. Cooldown: 3 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_ether_buster.name: Ether Buster
skill.tio_ether_buster.description: Straight hex line up to 6 tiles: 110–150 + 0.8R damage, 160% armor damage, 40% penetration. +10% damage per target analysis stack without consuming it. Cooldown: 4 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_zero_field.name: Zero Field
skill.tio_zero_field.description: Self and allies within 3 gain 2 stacking barrier charges for 3 rounds. One charge blocks all direct hitpoint and armor damage from one attack action. Misses and zero damage do not consume charges; damage over time and control bypass it. Cooldown: 4 rounds. R is own ranged skill.
skill.tio_aion_sense.name: Aion Sense
skill.tio_aion_sense.description: +10 ranged skill and defense; analysis is shared with allies.
skill.tio_septium_attunement.name: Septium Attunement
skill.tio_septium_attunement.description: Per physical socket element point: earth +1 melee defense, water +2% healing, fire +2% orbal damage, wind +2 initiative, time +2 fatigue capacity, space +1 ranged defense, mirage +2 resolve. Center quartz counts once.
valkyrie.tio.name: Tio Plato
valkyrie.tio.background.name: Orbal Staff Tester
valkyrie.tio.background.description: After investigating the Septium Workshop, Tio joins the company to study orbal phenomena in this unfamiliar world.
valkyrie.tio.trait.name: Eyes of Aion
valkyrie.tio.trait.description: A quiet observer who supports the company with analysis, an orbal staff and protective fields.
valkyrie.tio.trait.tooltip: Chapter recruit; innate abilities do not require an orbment or a specific weapon.
skin.tio_skin.name: Special Support Section Uniform
skin.tio_skin.description: Pale blue hair, sensory headgear and her dark blue uniform.
orbment.recruit_hint: Complete the Septium Workshop chapter to recruit Tio. Unavailable for summoning.
chapter.septium.stage1.line1: A faint blue light repeats a distress signal inside the abandoned workshop.
chapter.septium.stage1.line2: I am Tio, a tester from the Epstein Foundation. This device is feeding septium energy into the mine.
chapter.septium.stage1.line3: Please leave the core alone for now. We should follow the transport records.
chapter.septium.brief1: Visit An unfamiliar frequency, inspect the records, then submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage2.line1: The convoy is gone. Its raiders have kept the crystals as trophies.
chapter.septium.stage2.line2: I found the records. Sequential crystal identifiers, but no pairing checks.
chapter.septium.stage2.line3: Someone forced an entire shipment into an old machine. We need the control room.
chapter.septium.brief2: Defeat the defenders at A severed supply route and submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage3.line1: Tio lays seven crystals on the table. Threads of light awaken inside the metal frame.
chapter.septium.stage3.line2: Each line computes independently. The center joins every line, but each crystal grants its base bonus only once.
chapter.septium.stage3.line3: I have saved the circuit records. Once the workshop is safe, you can configure these in your stash.
chapter.septium.brief3: Visit Seven circuits, inspect the records, then submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage4.line1: Mine sentries faithfully obey a corrupted order: admit nobody.
chapter.septium.stage4.line2: Watch the ranged units. Their front is solid, but they cannot cover both flanks.
chapter.septium.stage4.line3: Power is still flowing. The fault lies deeper in the relay network.
chapter.septium.brief4: Defeat the defenders at Guards in the mine and submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage5.line1: The recorder projects the outline of another city. Tio pauses, then tightens her grip on her staff.
chapter.septium.stage5.line2: People there are waiting for me. But the miners here need help now.
chapter.septium.stage5.line3: I will handle the control protocol. I am counting on you for the fighting ahead.
chapter.septium.brief5: Visit Memories of another world, inspect the records, then submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage6.line1: The relay broadcasts faulty orders. Guards gather beneath flashing warning lights.
chapter.septium.stage6.line2: Suppress the support units, then break the relay nodes. Do not let their formation settle.
chapter.septium.stage6.line3: Good. We can open the final isolation gate now.
chapter.septium.brief6: Defeat the defenders at The broken relay and submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage7.line1: The logs finally agree: the mine overseer has been interpreting distress signals as intrusions.
chapter.septium.stage7.line2: The restart needs a full cycle. I will connect the Star Reader to the main circuit.
chapter.septium.stage7.line3: The overseer reveals its aim while charging. Clear the marked area and deal with the relay guards protecting it.
chapter.septium.brief7: Visit Before the restart, inspect the records, then submit this stage.
chapter.septium.stage8.line1: The blue light steadies. The mine falls quiet, and the workshop lamps return.
chapter.septium.stage8.line2: Restart complete. I would like to join you and continue studying orbal phenomena here.
chapter.septium.stage8.line3: I will carry the Star Reader. The other three orbments are yours. We can refine quartz here, but cannot manufacture new cores.
chapter.septium.brief8: Defeat the defenders at Circuits rekindled and submit this stage.
chapter.septium.final_rewards: Final reward: Tio, four orbments including her equipped Star Reader, and 21 rank I quartz. Unclaimed items remain pending.
chapter.septium.workshop.name: The Orbal Workshop
chapter.septium.workshop.description: Trace an orbal distress signal and repair the mine with Tio. Complete the chapter to recruit her and recover a finite set of orbments.
chapter.septium.ending: The workshop is restored. Orbments cannot be crafted; quartz can be recovered from the Septium Mine.

chapter.septium.mine.guard.line: First battle entry locks the quartz allocation. Retreat gives no reward or cooldown and preserves enemy casualties.
