chapter.septium.mine.name: Septium Mine Survey
chapter.septium.mine.description: Unlocked by completing the workshop. Seven districts and three depths share a 72-hour cooldown after victory.
chapter.septium.mine.rules: Select a route and allocate quartz before entering battle. Claim quartz and dust after victory.

orbment.ui.title: ORBAL WORKSHOP
orbment.ui.help: Right-click in stash to configure; drag to equip. At most two quartz of each name across both ranks.
orbment.ui.center: The gold socket is the center. Each line meets recipes independently; base bonuses count once.
orbment.ui.processHelp: Complete all 8 stages of The Orbal Workshop to unlock upgrading and recycling. The cards above socket gems; the list below selects a gem for processing from your stash. Upgrade: 2 matching rank I gems + 10 crystal sand + 300 crowns produce 1 rank II gem. Recycle: consumes 1 gem for 2 sand (rank I) or 6 sand (rank II), with no crown cost. Save or reset any configuration changes first.
orbment.error.missing: This orbment is no longer in the stash.
orbment.error.stale: The item or stash changed. Close and reopen the workshop.
orbment.error.config: Circuit, duplicate quartz or preparation capacity rules are not met.
orbment.error.space: Not enough stash space. The original configuration and inventory are preserved.
orbment.error.quartz: Not enough of the selected quartz in the stash.

orbment.staff.name: Basic Orbal Staff
orbment.staff.description: Tio’s prototype staff. Fires short-range orbal pulses without ammunition.
orbment.staff.attack_description: Fire an orbal pulse dealing weapon damage.
orbment.enemy.status_description: Septium elements grant distinct combat protocols. The overseer marks its blast in advance. Each living relay multiplies its received direct damage by 0.8.
orbment.enemy.charging: The overseer is charging. Leave the marked area!
orbment.mine.allocation: Quartz allocation: quantity of the first type (remainder is the second)
orbment.mine.abandon: Abandoning clears this expedition without rewards. Only victory starts the cooldown.
orbment.item.configure: Right-click in the stash to configure; drag to equip. Cannot be changed during battle.
orbment.item.description: A seven-socket orbment. Prepare active and passive skills from circuit elements. Not craftable; obtained from chapters and the first acquisition of Trails characters.
orbment.limit: No uses remain in this battle.
orbment.quartz.description: Socket into an orbment. At most two of the same name across ranks I / II. Configure in the stash; swapping does not consume quartz.
orbment.status.description: Stacks have no additional cap. Analysis, Chill and Zero Field expire by natural rounds; other effects last through the target’s next normal turn.
orbment.status.name: Orbal effects
skill.renne_genius_executor.name: Genius Executor
skill.renne_genius_executor.description: Innate attacks and offensive orbment arts use the higher of current melee and ranged skill for accuracy, retaining the original defense type, terrain and other modifiers. Orbment active skills cost 15% less fatigue while an orbment is equipped.
skill.renne_annihilation_mark.name: Annihilation Mark
skill.renne_annihilation_mark.descriptio: Calamity Projection and offensive orbment arts add one mark on hit, up to 3, lasting 3 natural rounds. Innate scythe hits consume this Renne's marks for +15% damage per stack (+25% for Annihilation Angel). Each action applies or detonates marks once per target; misses preserve marks.
skill.alisa_orbal_bow_expert.name: Orbal Bow Expert
skill.alisa_orbal_bow_expert.description: Attacks with the signature orbal bow gain +10 accuracy, require no arrows and can be fired while engaged. Other range, terrain, defense and accuracy modifiers still apply.
skill.alisa_radiant_resonance.name: Radiant Resonance
skill.alisa_radiant_resonance.descriptio: Successful active healing, fatigue recovery or support buffs on another ally grant Radiance (maximum 1), including orbment support arts. The next orbal bow attack action gains +25% damage and +10 percentage points armor penetration for its entire area; even an all-miss action consumes it. Self support and regeneration ticks do not trigger it.
skill.renne_calamity_projection.name: Calamity Projection
skill.renne_calamity_projection.descript: 4 AP, 16 fatigue, 0 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–4. Ranged orbal attack; applies a mark on hit. Damage 45–60 + 0.35 × max(current melee, ranged skill); armor multiplier 0.8, penetration 30%.
skill.renne_death_scythe.name: Death Scythe
skill.renne_death_scythe.description: 4 AP, 18 fatigue, 0 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–2. Melee scythe attack; detonates marks on hit. Killing a target bearing your marks restores 10 fatigue. Damage 60–80 + 0.4 × max(current melee, ranged skill); armor multiplier 1.2, penetration 30%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.
skill.renne_shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
skill.renne_shadow_step.description: 2 AP, 12 fatigue, 2 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–3. Teleport to a visible empty standable tile within one elevation, without disengagement attacks. Gain +10 melee defense until the end of your next normal turn. Cannot be used while rooted.
skill.renne_calamity_waltz.name: Calamity Waltz
skill.renne_calamity_waltz.description: 6 AP, 30 fatigue, 2 natural rounds cooldown. Range 0–0. Strike all adjacent enemies, with independent hit rolls and mark detonations. Does not harm allies. Damage 55–75 + 0.35 × max(current melee, ranged skill); armor multiplier 1.2, penetration 25%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.
skill.renne_annihilation_angel.name: S-Craft: Annihilation Angel
skill.renne_annihilation_angel.descripti: 8 AP, 45 fatigue, 4 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–2. Strike an enemy and all adjacent enemies. Each detonated mark adds 25% damage. Damage 110–145 + 0.7 × max(current melee, ranged skill); armor multiplier 1.5, penetration 40%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.
skill.alisa_flame_arrow.name: Flame Arrow
skill.alisa_flame_arrow.description: 4 AP, 15 fatigue, 0 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–6. Orbal bow attack. Hits burn the target for 8 HP at the start of its next 2 normal turns. Refreshes without stacking; fire and debuff immunity apply. Damage 45–65 + 0.4 × current ranged skill; armor multiplier 0.9, penetration 30%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.
skill.alisa_molten_arrow_rain.name: Molten Arrow Rain
skill.alisa_molten_arrow_rain.descriptio: 6 AP, 28 fatigue, 2 natural rounds cooldown. Range 2–5. Attack enemies on and adjacent to the selected tile, applying the same burn as Flame Arrow on hit. Does not harm allies. Damage 40–55 + 0.3 × current ranged skill; armor multiplier 1.2, penetration 20%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.
skill.alisa_holy_blessing.name: Holy Blessing
skill.alisa_holy_blessing.description: 4 AP, 24 fatigue, 2 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–4. Restore 25 HP and 18 fatigue to another ally and remove one bleed or poison effect, prioritizing bleeding. Cannot revive. Radiance requires actual recovery or cleansing.
skill.alisa_heavens_gift.name: Heaven's Gift
skill.alisa_heavens_gift.description: 5 AP, 32 fatigue, 3 natural rounds cooldown. Range 1–4. Bless the target and adjacent allies, excluding Alisa. At the start of their next 2 normal turns, restore 10 HP and 6 fatigue. Gain +8 melee and ranged defense until the second turn ends. Reapplication refreshes the duration.
skill.alisa_celestial_blazing_wings.name: S-Craft: Celestial Blazing Wings
skill.alisa_celestial_blazing_wings.desc: 8 AP, 42 fatigue, 4 natural rounds cooldown. Range 2–6. Attack enemies on and adjacent to the selected tile. When Radiance is consumed, restore 12 fatigue once to other allies within 3 tiles after the entire attack. Damage 95–125 + 0.65 × current ranged skill; armor multiplier 1.4, penetration 35%. Requires the intact signature weapon. Damage replaces weapon base values; applicable perks and orbment bonuses remain.

Renne's black-and-gold great scythe, enabling her innate scythe skills. Ordinary attacks use the weapon's own damage.
trails.weapon.alisa_orbal_bow.name: Blazing Wing Orbal Bow
trails.weapon.alisa_orbal_bow.descriptio: An orbal bow that needs no physical arrows and can fire while engaged. Enables Alisa's innate arrow skills.
trails.bow_shot.name: Orbal Shot
trails.bow_shot.description: Fire one ordinary orbal bow shot. 4 AP, 8 fatigue, range 1–6, no arrow consumption.
skill.aemeath_voyage.name: Voyage Together
skill.aemeath_voyage.description: Starts in Digital Ghost form with 2 Synchronization (cap 6). From round two, recover 1 at the first normal turn each round. An active attack that damages health or armor restores 1 per whole action. Each damaged target gains 1 Syntony in Ghost form or 1 Fusion in Mech form, once per target per action, at the attack's legal range without propagation. The ultimate only restores Synchronization. Reactions, damage over time and bonus damage do not trigger this. Each transformation skill grants 1 Resonance (cap 6); each point adds 5 percentage points of armor penetration.
skill.aemeath_interference.name: Syntony Interference
skill.aemeath_interference.description: Digital Ghost only. Enemies with Syntony suffer -10 accuracy per stack when attacking Aemeath, capped at -30. Aemeath gains +20 accuracy against targets with Syntony. Normal hit-chance limits apply.
skill.aemeath_trajectory.name: Fusion Trajectory
skill.aemeath_trajectory.description: Voyage Mech only. Add 5 base weapon damage per Fusion stack present at action start, up to 30, on the first damaging strike against each target per action. Armor and damage reduction apply. The ultimate and reactions do not trigger this.
skill.aemeath_starlight.name: Starlight Descends
skill.aemeath_starlight.description: Digital Ghost; melee weapon; 6 AP, 18 Fatigue, 1 Synchronization. Strike one enemy within 1 tile for 80% weapon damage and apply 2 Syntony. If the first strike damages a target that had Fusion before casting, consume 1 Fusion for one independent 80% follow-up. The follow-up does not repeat the explicit marks; up to 3 Syntony including Voyage Together.
skill.aemeath_armament.name: Coordinated Thrust: Armament Fusion
skill.aemeath_armament.description: Digital Ghost; melee weapon; 6 AP, 18 Fatigue, 2 Synchronization. Strike a primary enemy and up to two adjacent enemies, all within 2 tiles, for 70% weapon damage each. Damaged targets gain 1 Fusion and 1 Syntony from Voyage Together. Then change in place to Voyage Mech and gain 1 Resonance, even if all attacks miss. No friendly fire.
skill.aemeath_melody.name: Melody Across the Sky
skill.aemeath_melody.description: Voyage Mech; melee weapon; 6 AP, 18 Fatigue, 1 Synchronization. Strike a visible enemy and up to two adjacent enemies, all within 3 tiles, for 90% weapon damage and 2 Fusion each. A target damaged by the first strike that had Syntony before casting loses 1 Syntony and receives one independent 90% follow-up. Up to 3 Fusion per target including Voyage Together. No friendly fire.
skill.aemeath_dawn.name: Coordinated Thrust: Dawn Chorus
skill.aemeath_dawn.description: Voyage Mech; melee weapon; 6 AP, 18 Fatigue, 2 Synchronization. Project a thrust at one visible enemy within 3 tiles for 100% weapon damage and 1 Syntony, plus 1 Fusion from Voyage Together. Then return in place to Digital Ghost and gain 1 Resonance, even on a miss. Does not move Aemeath.
skill.aemeath_ultimate.name: Starlight Beyond the Boundary
skill.aemeath_ultimate.description: Both forms; melee weapon; 8 AP, 0 Fatigue, 4 Resonance. Strike a visible enemy within 7 tiles for 250% weapon damage + 10 per mark; adjacent enemies take 125% weapon damage + 5 per mark, with independent hit and defense rolls. Snapshot Aemeath's marks on living enemies, capped at 20, without consuming them. Uses pre-spend penetration. No form marks or Fusion bonus damage. Returns to Digital Ghost without granting Resonance. No friendly fire.
valkyrie.aemeath.name: Aemeath
valkyrie.aemeath.background.name: Exostrider Synchronist
valkyrie.aemeath.background.description: A digital ghost from Startorch Academy, bringing starlight and the power of her Voyage Mech to this battlefield.
valkyrie.aemeath.trait.name: Starlight of the Voyage / Synchronist
valkyrie.aemeath.trait.description: Alternate between Digital Ghost and Voyage Mech, weaving Syntony and Fusion into a voyage among the stars.
valkyrie.aemeath.trait.tooltip: +20 Melee Skill, +20 Resolve, +15 Initiative and +5 AP. See Voyage Together for Synchronization and Resonance.
aemeath.combat_required: Available only during Aemeath's combat actions.
aemeath.syntony.description: +10% armor damage received per stack, up to 6. Lasts until consumed or combat ends.
aemeath.fusion.description: At the first normal turn each round, take 5 fire health damage per stack, ignoring armor but subject to applicable damage reduction. Cap 6; lasts until consumed or combat ends.
skin.aemeath_skin.name: Unseen Starlight
skin.aemeath_skin.description: The white-and-blue pilot attire of the Digital Ghost.
skin.aemeath_mech_skin.name: Voyage Mech
skin.aemeath_mech_skin.description: White-and-blue armor manifested by Armament Fusion; a temporary combat appearance.
valkyrie.si.name: Si
valkyrie.si.background.name: Painter of Living Worlds
valkyrie.si.background.description: A mysterious painter affiliated with Hongshan Academy of Sciences. She binds enemies within one painting, conducts damage through ink souls, and shelters allies with painted lotus waters.
valkyrie.si.trait.name: Beast Proxy
valkyrie.si.trait.description: Mountains and rivers answer her brush. Specializes in linked focus fire, brief roots, and protective ink barriers.
valkyrie.si.trait.tooltip: Combat abilities belong to Si’s identity. Ink and paintings exist only for the current battle.
skin.si_skin.name: Rain over Lotus Waters
skin.si_skin.description: Silver-sage hair, black-and-gold horns, and ink-patterned robes inspired by a rainy lotus pond.
skill.si_myriad.name: Myriad Forms in Ink
skill.si_myriad.description: Maximum 6 Ink; starts at 2. Gain 1 at each normal turn start, plus 1 once per round when another roster ally directly damages a painted enemy’s HP. Up to 3 enemies remain painted until Si’s second subsequent normal turn. Share 30% of one direct action’s total HP damage to painted enemies with the other painted enemies, capped at 40 each. Enemies already hit by that action are excluded. Follow-ups, opportunity attacks, counters, damage over time and the dragon do not trigger sharing. Ink echoes neither recurse nor receive further amplification.
skill.si_brush.name: Winter Brushstroke
skill.si_brush.description: 3 AP, 12 Fatigue; range 1–5. Ranged accuracy +15. Deals 70–90 base damage, 100% armor damage and 30% penetration. A hit paints the enemy; repeated hits refresh the mark, and a fourth replaces the oldest. Uses independent skill damage, not weapon base damage.
skill.si_landscape.name: Shared Landscape
skill.si_landscape.description: 4 AP, 20 Fatigue, 1 Ink; range 1–5, cooldown 2 rounds. Replace the painting with the target and up to two adjacent enemies, prioritizing higher remaining HP. Root the primary target until its next normal action ends; it can still attack or cast. No damage or accuracy roll. Root immunity does not prevent painting.
skill.si_sanctuary.name: Sanctuary in the Margin
skill.si_sanctuary.description: 3 AP, 18 Fatigue, 2 Ink; range 0–4, cooldown 3 rounds. Target and adjacent roster allies gain a 40-point barrier against post-armor HP damage; armor is not protected. While the barrier remains, gain +10 melee and ranged defense until Si’s second subsequent normal turn. Defense ends immediately when depleted. Reapplication refreshes without stacking. Shared fixed HP damage bypasses barriers.
skill.si_dragon.name: No One Spoils the Fun
skill.si_dragon.description: 6 AP, 32 Fatigue, 5 Ink; select a painted enemy at range 1–5; cooldown 4 rounds. Guaranteed hit: 180–220 base damage to the primary target and 120–160 to other painted enemies even beyond range; 125% armor damage and 40% penetration. Does not trigger ink echoes. Clears the painting. Si and roster allies within 3 tiles gain Reverberation: +20% damage for their next direct attack action, including all segments, expiring at Si’s next normal turn start.
si.unavailable.owner: Requires Si’s identity and an active battle.
si.dragon.target: Requires a visible painted enemy within range.
si.effect.mark.description: Linked to the other enemies in the same painting for ink echo damage; at most 3 enemies per painting.
si.effect.root.description: Cannot move, but can attack and use skills. Expires at the end of this actor’s next normal action.
si.effect.ward.description: Absorbs ordinary post-armor HP damage. +10 melee and ranged defense while any barrier remains.
si.effect.echo.description: +20% damage for the entire next direct attack action. Follow-ups and counters do not consume it.
ui.hub.guide.si.summary: Mid/backline painter: linked focus fire, brief control and barriers, followed by an ink-dragon finisher.
ui.hub.guide.si.analysis: No signature weapon required; prioritize ranged accuracy and stamina. Ink echoes need real HP damage, so break heavy armor first. Barriers and the finisher compete for Ink. Ratings are source-level estimates, not in-game balance results.
valkyrie.saber.bond.name: The King at Rest
valkyrie.saber.bond.description: From a supper kept warm to an evening shared together, Artoria is learning to make a place for coming home in her vows. Gain 4 Bond after a victory she participates in and survives. Clear each of five challenges to earn permanent upgrades.
event.saber_bond.title: The King at Rest, an Oath with You
event.saber_bond.claimed_item: Excalibur has been placed in the stash.
event.saber_bond.claimed_skill: Mana Release is unlocked and Royal Bunny is equipped. You can switch skins in the detail page.
event.saber_bond.claimed: This stage's permanent upgrade and supplies have been claimed.
event.saber_bond.pending_space: The stash is full. Your sword entitlement is saved and delivery will retry when space is available.
event.saber_bond.pending: Challenge progress is saved. Reward delivery is pending and will retry during a later event check.
event.saber_bond.challenge_rules: The camp will remain revealed and highlighted. Artoria must participate and survive the victory; retreat does not complete the stage.
event.saber_bond.spawn_failed: There is no suitable nearby land for the challenge camp. Progress is preserved; travel a little and try again.
event.saber_bond.20.name: A Supper Kept Warm
event.saber_bond.20.title: A Supper Kept Warm
event.saber_bond.20.text:
It is late when Artoria returns from her final patrol. She pauses outside the tent, as though stepping inside might leave some danger unattended. You move the covered pot nearer the fire and tell her the next watch has already begun.

She asks whether the wounded have eaten before accepting the bread and soup kept for her. Her sword remains within reach.

“Only a short rest,” she says. Yet after the first spoonful, her shoulders finally ease.
event.saber_bond.20.reveal:
A rescued merchant brings you a gold chip stamped with a lion. The raiders took old relics and provisions, leaving ordinary silver behind. Artoria feels a faint drain of mana when the chip approaches her sword.

She starts to rise. You put the remaining bread back into her hand. “Finish eating. We will go together.”

This time she does not object. Together you mark the camp holding the wagon.
event.saber_bond.20.victory:
The provisions are loaded onto the wagon again. Artoria entrusts the chip to you, and the disturbance in her mana settles. At supper she carries two bowls to the fire and leaves a place beside her.

“Let us eat here tomorrow as well.”
event.saber_bond.20.challenge_option: Travel with Artoria to The Stolen Provision Wagon.
location.saber_bond.20.name: The Stolen Provision Wagon
location.saber_bond.20.description: Artoria Bond challenge: A Supper Kept Warm. She must participate and survive the victory.
event.saber_bond.40.name: The King Does Not Cheat
event.saber_bond.40.title: The King Does Not Cheat
event.saber_bond.40.text:
To approach the travelling casino buying relics, you teach Artoria a card game in a tavern. She remembers every card played and even weighs the pauses between your moves.

After your fourth loss, you deliberately leave an opening. She lays down her cards and looks at you.

“If this is something we are meant to enjoy together, please take my opponent seriously.” She pauses. “That would be yourself.”
event.saber_bond.40.reveal:
The counting house holds the truth: anyone signing a debt contract loses a little strength with every wager. Stolen relics merely fuel the mechanism. Artoria spreads out the map, preparing to cover every exit herself.

You take one corner and claim responsibility for the ledger and rear door. After a pause, she releases her hold on that part of the map.

“Then I leave my back to you.”
event.saber_bond.40.victory:
The final debt contract curls in the fire. The wind around the holy sword steadies, and Artoria can feel her mana gathering naturally again. She sets the recovered cards on the table.

“Another game tonight. And this time, no letting me win.”
event.saber_bond.40.reward: From round 2, restore 1 Mana at the first normal turn start each round. Also receive 1,000 crowns and 30 tools.
event.saber_bond.40.challenge_option: Travel with Artoria to The Gilded Counting House.
location.saber_bond.40.name: The Gilded Counting House
location.saber_bond.40.description: Artoria Bond challenge: The King Does Not Cheat. She must participate and survive the victory.
event.saber_bond.60.name: The Sword Entrusted to You
event.saber_bond.60.title: The Sword Entrusted to You
event.saber_bond.60.text:
That night she dreams again of an empty battlefield. The sword is heavy, and no footsteps follow her. On waking, Artoria does not immediately reach for her armour. Instead she calls to you as you pack.

“Could you stay a little longer?”

She places the sword, wrapped in blue cloth, between you and speaks of the weariness of carrying everything alone. You promise no easy victory. You simply take the hand resting beside it.
event.saber_bond.60.reveal:
The ledger leads to a forge turning relics into counterfeit holy swords. The copies siphon power from the true blade, repeatedly forcing her mana to begin from nothing.

Artoria will hold the forge at bay while you sever its supply. She brings the hilt closer, letting you feel the pulse of a stable circuit.

“This time, help me hear its full answer.”
event.saber_bond.60.victory:
As the forge cools, the holy sword shines with a clear and steady light. Artoria does not raise it to the heavens. First she holds it level between you.

“Excalibur,” she says softly. “And a promise that will bring me home.”

Together you secure the blade and prepare for the road back.
event.saber_bond.60.reward: Receive Excalibur: while equipped, the first successful ordinary active melee attack each round restores 1 additional Mana.
event.saber_bond.60.challenge_option: Travel with Artoria to The Counterfeit Holy Forge.
location.saber_bond.60.name: The Counterfeit Holy Forge
location.saber_bond.60.description: Artoria Bond challenge: The Sword Entrusted to You. She must participate and survive the victory.
event.saber_bond.80.name: A Special Invitation Tonight
event.saber_bond.80.title: A Special Invitation Tonight
event.saber_bond.80.text:
The last invitation demands that its guests arrive as a dealer and her partner. While you consider an excuse, Artoria has already chosen her outfit: long white bunny ears, a white-and-gold bodysuit, royal-blue tights, and a white fur stole, with a golden high ponytail flowing behind her.

She stands before the mirror, checking every detail as carefully as armor. Only when she notices your gaze does her hand pause at the small blue neck ornament.

"If we have decided to attend, we should prepare properly. Do you... think it suits me?"
event.saber_bond.80.reveal:
She turns over a freshly engraved lion chip and places it in your hand. It is bound to no contract; it identifies only her partner for tonight.

The private lounge is dark, and its guards are waiting. Artoria parts the wind around her sword. The pressure responds with newfound ease.

“Whatever rules they change, I will recognise you.”
event.saber_bond.80.victory:
Light returns to the private lounge. Sword in one hand, Artoria straightens a slightly crooked rabbit ear with the other and cannot quite suppress a smile.

“It seems this outfit does not hinder a battle.”

She slides the chip back toward you. “Keep it for me. Our evening has not begun yet.”
event.saber_bond.80.reward: Strike Air permanently costs 1 Mana on every cast. Also receive 1,500 crowns and 30 medicine.
event.saber_bond.80.challenge_option: Travel with Artoria to The Unlit Private Lounge.
location.saber_bond.80.name: The Unlit Private Lounge
location.saber_bond.80.description: Artoria Bond challenge: A Special Invitation Tonight. She must participate and survive the victory.
event.saber_bond.100.name: The King at Rest, an Oath with You
event.saber_bond.100.title: The King at Rest, an Oath with You
event.saber_bond.100.text:
The casino core unfolds one final mirror: an unbroken capital, lights that never went out, and a life that appears ready to begin again. It does not hurry her. It simply waits for Artoria to reach out.

She looks for a long time. You do not answer for her. At last she closes her hand around the lion chip and turns toward the real light beside you.

“I still remember them,” she says. “And I remember that someone is waiting for me to return.”
event.saber_bond.100.reveal:
The king in the mirror draws a sword. Artoria raises her own, golden mana flowing through the restored circuit. Her plans for the rest of the night are precise: destroy the core, release every stolen fragment of strength, and spend an evening with you without a mission.

“This is my own choice.”

She offers her hand and waits for you to take it before approaching the last dealer.
event.saber_bond.100.victory:
The last shard goes dark, and every contract is broken. Artoria arrives on time in the restored hall, still wearing her Royal Bunny attire. The holy sword rests safely beside her chair; it need not be drawn again tonight.

She places the lion chip on the table and slides it toward you.

“I have arranged the evening. No patrols, and no war council.”

She pauses, allowing her smile to show at last.

“All you need to do is stay with me.”
event.saber_bond.100.reward: Gain 1 more starting Mana and refund 1 Mana after Excalibur resolves. Unlock Mana Release: 0 AP, 0 Fatigue, twice per battle, no target required, instantly fill Mana; does not reset Excalibur uses. Permanently unlock and equip the Royal Bunny skin and portrait.

skill.saber_mana_release.description: Open the dragon furnace and let the holy sword answer your oath again. Instantly restore Mana to 4.
skill.saber_mana_release.rules: 0 AP, 0 Fatigue; twice per battle. Requires no target, weapon or existing Mana. Using at full Mana still spends a charge. Does not reset Excalibur uses.
skill.saber_mana_release.unavailable: Requires the final Bond challenge cleared, an active battle and a remaining use.
skill.saber_invisible_air.bond_regen: Dragon Furnace: from round 2, restore 1 Mana at the first normal turn start each round; waiting and extra turns cannot repeat this.
skill.saber_invisible_air.bond_full: An Oath with You: gain 1 more starting Mana and refund 1 Mana after Excalibur resolves.
skill.saber_excalibur.bond_refund: Full Bond: refund 1 Mana after this Noble Phantasm resolves.
item.saber_oath_excalibur.name: Excalibur
item.saber_oath_excalibur.description: The holy sword manifested through a restored mana circuit. Its blue-and-gold hilt is familiar, but its bearer has learned to entrust her road home to another.
item.saber_oath_excalibur.rules: Only Artoria can equip this sword. Holy Sword Resonance: the first successful ordinary active melee attack each round restores 1 extra Mana, for 2 total with Invisible Air. Multi-target attacks trigger once; counters, follow-ups and Noble Phantasms do not trigger it.

skin.saber_royal_bunny_skin.description: Royal Bunny attire based on Artoria Ruler's initial Saint Graph: white rabbit ears, a golden high ponytail, a white-and-gold bodysuit, royal-blue tights, and a white fur stole. Appearance does not change earned bond upgrades.
skin.saber_royal_bunny_skin.locked: Clear Artoria's 100 Bond challenge to unlock.
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.name: Fate T. Harlaown
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.background.name: Lightning Enforcer
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.background.descri: An enforcer of the Time-Space Administration Bureau. She brings golden lightning and her device Bardiche to this battlefield, choosing to use her strength to protect others.
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.trait.name: Gentle Lightning
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.trait.description: A mobile mage who builds lightning through movement and fights with close slashes and ranged lances.
valkyrie.fate_harlaown.trait.tooltip: Signature magic uses its own base damage, independent of held weapons. Sonic Form increases burst potential but also damage received.
skin.fate_harlaown_skin.name: White-Caped Lightning
skin.fate_harlaown_skin.description: Adult Fate with a white cape, black battle dress and restrained red ribbons. Appearance only.
skill.fate_lightning.name: Gentle Lightning
skill.fate_lightning.description: Gain +15 Initiative. Voluntarily move 2 tiles during a normal turn to charge the next signature damage skill: +10 hit chance and +20% damage for every strike of that action, consumed even on misses. Once per normal turn; forced movement and extra turns do not count. Charge expires at turn end.
skill.fate_scythe.name: Lightning Scythe
skill.fate_scythe.description: Strike an adjacent enemy for 65-85 damage, 120% armor damage and 25% armor penetration. Costs 4 AP and 15 fatigue.
skill.fate_move.name: Sonic Move
skill.fate_move.description: Move along a walkable route of up to 3 steps without attacks of opportunity. Cannot cross units, obstacles or adjacent elevation differences greater than 1; unavailable while rooted. Stops at the last valid tile if interrupted. Costs 2 AP (1 in Sonic Form) and 12 fatigue; 2 normal-turn cooldown.
skill.fate_lancer.name: Photon Lancer
skill.fate_lancer.description: Fire 3 lances at a visible enemy 2-5 tiles away. Each independently hits for 25-35 damage with +10 hit chance, 100% armor damage and 25% armor penetration. Stops if the target dies; cannot be used while engaged. Costs 4 AP and 22 fatigue; 1 normal-turn cooldown.
skill.fate_form.name: Sonic Form
skill.fate_form.description: Once per battle. Gain an additional 25 Initiative but take 25% more damage. Sonic Move costs 1 AP; Lightning Scythe becomes Twin Blades and Riot Zanber is unlocked. Lasts until the end of the next normal turn. Costs 2 AP and 20 fatigue.
skill.fate_blade.name: Twin Blades
skill.fate_blade.description: Sonic Form only. Strike an adjacent enemy twice for 40-50 damage per hit, 120% armor damage and 25% armor penetration. Stops immediately if either combatant dies. Costs 4 AP and 18 fatigue.
skill.fate_zanber.name: Riot Zanber
skill.fate_zanber.description: Sonic Form only. Slash a straight hex line up to 3 tiles, hitting each enemy once for 150-190 damage with +15 hit chance, 180% armor damage and 35% armor penetration. Allies, obstacles and impassable height changes block the line. Immediately ends the form even if all attacks miss. Costs 6 AP and 35 fatigue.
fate.rooted: Cannot use Sonic Move while rooted.
fate.engaged: Cannot cast Photon Lancer while engaged.
fate.used: Sonic Form has already been used this battle.
fate.form_required: This skill requires a different form.
fate.charged: Lightning charged: next signature damage action gains +10 hit chance and +20% damage.
fate.form_active: Sonic Form: +25 additional Initiative; +25% damage received.
ui.hub.guide.fate_harlaown.summary: Fast repositioning and a brief burst window; signature attacks require no weapon.
ui.hub.guide.fate_harlaown.analysis: Move 2 tiles to charge lightning, then spend it on lances or twin blades. Sonic Form increases incoming damage; check the line and allied positions before Riot Zanber. Movement follows a real walkable route. This assessment is based on source design; live balance remains unverified.
black_beast.feedback.wall: Requires a shield. Gain +30 Melee and Ranged Defense. Other allies within %d tiles take %d%% less damage from direct attacks (normally %d%%), affecting both hitpoints and armor, but not bleeding or poison. Lasts until your first normal turn in a later round; waiting or extra turns do not end it. Recasting does not stack. The allied damage reduction does not apply to the caster.
black_beast.feedback.cry: Once per round. Taunt eligible enemies within 5 tiles and activate Covering Shieldwall without paying its additional AP or fatigue cost.
black_beast.feedback.maia_aura.name: Maia's Cover
black_beast.feedback.prim_aura.name: Prim's Standard
black_beast.feedback.chloe_pursuit.name: Follow-up Assault
black_beast.feedback.alicia_stacks.name: Sword Momentum
black_beast.feedback.maia_aura: +%d Melee and Ranged Defense. Take %d%% less damage from direct attacks to both hitpoints and armor; bleeding, poison and other ongoing damage are unaffected.
black_beast.feedback.wall_active: Covering Shieldwall is currently strengthening this protection.
black_beast.feedback.immune_movement: Immune to knockback, pulls and other forced movement.
black_beast.feedback.aura_end: Ends when out of range or when the source dies, leaves battle or loses the required equipment. Multiple sources grant only the strongest bonus to each stat.
black_beast.feedback.prim_aura: +%d Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense and Ranged Defense, +%d Resolve and +%d Initiative. Recover an extra %d fatigue at the start of your first normal turn each round. Current direct attack damage bonus: %d%%.
black_beast.feedback.fortress: +40 Melee and Ranged Defense. Direct attacks deal 30% less damage to hitpoints and armor. Immune to forced movement.
black_beast.feedback.guard_end: Lasts until your first normal turn in a later round. Waiting or extra turns do not end it; recasting does not stack.
black_beast.feedback.battle_end: Lasts until the end of this battle.
black_beast.feedback.two_turns: Lasts until the target finishes two normal turns; waits and extra turns do not count.
black_beast.feedback.pursuit: While wielding a one-handed melee weapon and a shield, your next active weapon attack costs %d less AP and %d less fatigue (minimum 1 AP and 0 fatigue). Each strike gains %d percentage points of weapon damage. Consumed even on a miss; expires at the end of this round.
black_beast.feedback.counter: +20 Melee Defense. While holding a one-handed sword with an empty offhand, retaliate for free when an adjacent enemy misses an active single-target melee attack: %d%% weapon damage, +10 hit chance and +25 percentage points of armor penetration. Recover 5 fatigue per counterattack, with %d fatigue recovery remaining this round. Does not counter attacks of opportunity, ranged or area attacks. Cannot counter while rooted, stunned or disarmed.
black_beast.feedback.stacks: Current Sword Momentum: %d of %d stacks. While holding a one-handed sword with an empty offhand: +%d Melee Skill and Melee Defense, +%d%% weapon damage.
black_beast.feedback.stacks_end: Hitting with an active attack adds momentum and refreshes its duration. Without another refresh, it expires at the end of your turn two rounds later.
black_beast.feedback.divine_ready: Ready this round. The next direct attack deals 50% less damage to hitpoints and armor, including every strike of the same multi-hit attack. Bleeding, poison and other ongoing damage do not consume this protection.
black_beast.feedback.divine_spent: Triggered this round. Only further strikes of the attack that triggered it retain the reduction; subsequent attacks are not reduced. Refreshes next round for 50% damage reduction against one direct attack.
black_beast.feedback.seal: Divine Seal: -%d maximum AP, -%d%% direct attack damage, and -%d Melee and Ranged Defense.
black_beast.feedback.no_movement: Cannot use active movement skills such as Rotation, Footwork, Charge or Teleport.
black_beast.feedback.shatter: Siegebreaker Fracture: -%d Melee and Ranged Defense; take %d%% more armor damage.
black_beast.feedback.shatter_pierce: Attacks against this target gain 25 percentage points of armor penetration.
black_beast.feedback.blessing: +%d Melee Skill, Ranged Skill, Melee Defense and Ranged Defense; +%d Resolve and Initiative. Recasting refreshes duration without stacking.
black_beast.feedback.rally: Current effect: the caster and allies within %d tiles recover %d fatigue and gain %d morale levels, up to Confident.
black_beast.feedback.maia_passive: Requires a shield. Its Melee and Ranged Defense are multiplied by %s. Take %d%% less direct attack damage and become immune to forced movement. Other allies within %d tiles gain +%d Melee and Ranged Defense and %d%% direct attack damage reduction, increasing to %d%% during Covering Shieldwall. Recover %d extra fatigue at the start of your first normal turn each round.
black_beast.feedback.shield_full: The shield cannot be destroyed; immune to stun, daze and stagger.
black_beast.feedback.maia_ally_immunity: Other allies within the protection radius also become immune to forced movement.
olga.effect.control.description: Temporarily controlled by Olga until the end of your next normal turn. Retain AP, fatigue, ammunition and cooldowns; inventory access and retreat are disabled. Returns to its original side early if Olga dies, leaves battle, or no other enemies remain.
black_beast.feedback.control_details: Daze reduces damage, Initiative and maximum fatigue by 25%. Stagger reduces Initiative by 50%. Both last one normal turn; stun prevents acting.
black_beast.feedback.maia_self: Your own direct attack damage reduction is currently %d%%; activating Shieldwall does not increase it.
kanade.name: Kanade Tachibana
kanade.background.name: Angel
kanade.background.description: The quiet student council president from Angel Beats! turns her arms into sonic blades and shields her companions from arrows. She remembers a past farewell while learning to share tomorrow with new companions.
kanade.trait.name: Thanks for Tomorrow
kanade.trait.description: A quiet girl who meets her enemies with sonic blades and shields her companions behind a barrier. Holding unspoken thanks close to her heart, she hopes to share tomorrow with those beside her.
kanade.actives.description: Fight with three blade attacks, shield companions with projectile deflection, and support the battlefield with swift dashes and harmonic clones. Completing her bond story unlocks Sonic Rotation, usable twice per battle.
kanade.overdrive.name: Overdrive
kanade.overdrive.description: +25% melee damage and +20 initiative. After the first round, recover 8 extra fatigue at the first normal turn each round, increased to 12 after completing 'Say Who You Want to Protect'. Completing 'Save Her a Warm Meal', 'Every Voice of Mine' and 'A Seat for Tomorrow' each grants +1 maximum AP.
kanade.hand_sonic_slash.name: Hand Sonic: Slash
kanade.hand_sonic_slash.description: 3 AP, 10 fatigue. Adjacent attack: 130% weapon damage, +15 accuracy, 130% armor damage, 35% penetration.
kanade.hand_sonic_pierce.name: Hand Sonic: Pierce
kanade.hand_sonic_pierce.description: 4 AP, 15 fatigue. 110% weapon damage, +10 accuracy, ignores shield defense, 200% armor damage and 50% penetration (220%/55% with upgraded Hand Sonic).
kanade.hand_sonic_sweep.name: Hand Sonic: Sweep
kanade.hand_sonic_sweep.description: 4 AP, 18 fatigue. Strike enemies in a three-hex adjacent arc for 90% weapon damage, +5 accuracy, 130% armor damage and 35% penetration. Allies are excluded.
kanade.distortion.name: Distortion
kanade.distortion.description: 2 AP, 12 fatigue, 2-round cooldown. Nullify direct physical projectiles and their attached effects until the next normal turn or a committed active attack. Completing the stage 60 challenge 'Every Voice of Mine' also grants the caster +20 melee defense and 25% less damage received while the barrier is active; stacks with Delay. Angel Uniform also protects one selected adjacent ally against one otherwise successful projectile. The ally does not receive the defense or damage reduction.
kanade.delay.name: Delay
kanade.delay.description: 1 AP, 10 fatigue, once per round. Stay in place or dash up to 4 steps along a passable route, increased to 6 after completing 'Every Voice of Mine'. Ignore opportunity attacks, but still trigger terrain hazards. Gain +20 melee defense and evade 2 otherwise successful single-target melee attacks (3 with Quiet Feather equipped) until the next normal turn. After completing 'The Unsent Letter', killing an enemy with Kanade's own blade attack that costs AP grants an extra 3-step dash without renewing the defense bonus or evasions.
kanade.harmonics.name: Harmonics
kanade.harmonics.description: Requires Hand Sonic. 4 AP, 25 fatigue, 4-round cooldown. Summon up to 2 controllable clones in empty adjacent spaces (3 with Unsent Thanks equipped). Each has 6 AP and 60% of Kanade's maximum HP, current armor and damage at the time of summoning, plus three blade attacks and a 3-step dash. Clones are absorbed at the start of Kanade's second subsequent normal turn. Dead clones restore no fatigue.
kanade.absorb.name: Absorb
kanade.absorb.description: 2 AP, no fatigue. Absorb all living clones, recovering 8 fatigue each, increased to 12 after completing 'The Unsent Letter'. Does not restore HP or reset skill cooldowns.
kanade.howling.name: Howling
kanade.howling.description: 4 AP, 25 fatigue, 3-round cooldown (2 with Unsent Thanks equipped). Roll melee accuracy +20 against visible enemies within 2 hexes to stun for one turn. Stun-immune targets instead lose 20% damage and 20 initiative for one turn. Has no effect on enemies immune to sound or negative status effects.
kanade.sonic_rotation.name: Sonic Rotation
kanade.sonic_rotation.description: Unlocked by completing A Seat for Tomorrow. 6 AP, 35 fatigue, 4-round cooldown, twice per battle. Attack visible enemies within 2 tiles of Kanade regardless of elevation, excluding allies: 170% weapon damage, +15 accuracy, 180% armor damage and 40% penetration. Clones are optional; at least one valid enemy must be in range. Click to preview, then confirm to spend resources and cast. Each able clone may follow up once per round against one surviving enemy hit by Kanade and adjacent to that clone, prioritizing the lowest HP.
kanade.item.hand_sonic.name: Hand Sonic
kanade.item.feather_hairpiece.name: Quiet Feather
kanade.item.uniform_armor.name: Angel Uniform
kanade.item.unsent_thanks.name: Unsent Thanks
kanade.item.hand_sonic.description: Kanade arrives with these paired arm blades, classified as a two-handed sword. 85–105 damage, 130% armor damage, 35% penetration, 120 durability, -6 fatigue. Completing 'The Unsent Letter' increases damage to 105–125 and durability to 150; Hand Sonic: Pierce gains 220% armor damage and 55% penetration.
kanade.item.feather_hairpiece.descriptio: Kanade only. Earned by completing 'Every Voice of Mine'. 280 armor, -3 fatigue, +10 resolve, +10 initiative, no vision penalty. Grants 3 Delay evasions while equipped.
kanade.item.uniform_armor.description: Kanade only. Earned by completing 'Save Her a Warm Meal'. 360 armor, -8 fatigue, +5 melee defense. Allows Distortion to block one projectile for an adjacent ally while equipped.
kanade.item.unsent_thanks.description: Kanade only. Earned by completing 'Say Who You Want to Protect'. +30 HP and +10 resolve. Allows 3 clones and a 2-round Howling cooldown while equipped. Removing it leaves summoned clones and skill cooldowns already in progress unchanged.
kanade.guide.summary: A mobile melee protector who arrives with Hand Sonic and earns her other signature equipment through companion bonds.
kanade.guide.analysis: Starts with blade attacks, harmonic clones, Delay, Distortion and Howling. 'Save Her a Warm Meal' grants her armor, followed by the silver keepsake in 'Say Who You Want to Protect'. Later stories grant her headpiece and strengthen Hand Sonic, with maximum AP eventually reaching 12.

kanade.bond.20.text: Kanade is still standing by the cooking pot when supper is served a second time. You ask whether she dislikes the food. "There are no bowls left." Someone finds one. After trying the mapo tofu, she says seriously, "It could be spicier." When a spare blanket is placed beside her, she spreads it to shelter her neighbor too.
kanade.bond.20.reveal: The relief camp supply caravan has not returned. Kanade recognizes the driver who once saved his portion of tofu for her. This time she stops to ask who is coming and marks a rendezvous on the map. She covers her unfinished supper. "We can eat when we return. He needs a portion too."
kanade.bond.20.victory: The rescued tailor makes a short cape and travel skirt; the driver brings a scarf. "Everyone else has one. This is yours." Kanade accepts. Back at camp she finds her own seat. "Will it still be here tomorrow?" You place a bowl on the table. She nods. The rescued travelers give her protective armor as thanks.
kanade.bond.20.name: Save Her a Warm Meal
kanade.camp.20.name: The Interrupted Supper
kanade.camp.20.description: Defeat all hostiles; at least 2 of 3 supply carts must survive.
kanade.bond.20.reward: +1 maximum AP; receive Angel Uniform; Campfire outfit.
kanade.bond.40.text: Kanade blocks a recruit from pursuing an enemy. He thinks he has disappointed her, until you uncover a pitfall ahead. Later she finally explains, "There was a trap." You suggest saying it sooner next time. She practices the sentence, then asks the tailor for clothes that will not catch on branches during a rescue.
kanade.bond.40.reveal: Crossbowmen have trapped wounded soldiers and civilians at a checkpoint. Kanade studies their firing intervals and points out cover and evacuation routes. "I will stop the arrows. You bring them out." The recruit asks when to follow. "When I call you." Everyone understands the plan.
kanade.bond.40.victory: The tailor presents a light white battle dress. Kanade tests her arm movement and adjusts the bracers herself. She folds her travel clothes carefully. When the recruit thanks her, she says, "I do not want you to be hurt. Next time, I will say so first." As she raises her arms, the sonic blades take their full shape once more.
kanade.bond.40.name: Say Who You Want to Protect
kanade.camp.40.name: The Silent Checkpoint
kanade.camp.40.description: Defeat all hostiles to complete the challenge.
kanade.bond.40.reward: Receive Unsent Thanks; Overdrive recovers 12 fatigue; White Wing outfit.
kanade.bond.60.text: The copies disagree about tomorrow. One wants to scout, another worries about the wounded, a third thinks everyone needs rest. Kanade begins to absorb them, then realizes she agrees with all three. White and blue cloth lie side by side on the table. This time she lets the others share the work.
kanade.bond.60.reveal: A device in the nearby ruins is amplifying residual harmonics into hostile echoes. Kanade offers to shut it down alone. You bring scouting reports and a duty roster showing that each concern has been heard. She listens to the copies. "Together. First, let the wounded leave."
kanade.bond.60.victory: After absorbing the surviving copies, Kanade asks everyone to wait while she rests. She gives the tailor both white and blue cloth and begins braiding two cords together. "Keep both." Her new azure outfit retains a white lining. She no longer needs every thought to become a single voice.
kanade.bond.60.name: Every Voice of Mine
kanade.camp.60.name: Harmonic Corridor
kanade.camp.60.description: Destroy 3 nodes and all enemies. Each node spawns one guard per round, capped at two. Destroying all nodes summons an Overloaded Echo.
kanade.bond.60.reward: +1 maximum AP; receive Quiet Feather; 6-step dash; Distortion grants the caster +20 melee defense and 25% less damage received; Azure Harmonics outfit.
kanade.bond.80.text: Under a lamp, Kanade crosses out a sentence and writes it again. When you return the repaired silver box, she asks whether there is someone you have not seen for a long time. She speaks about Otonashi, the life she received, and the thanks she already expressed at graduation. You brighten the lamp. Beside her folded letter she leaves a new blank note.
kanade.bond.80.reveal: A medical convoy is trapped on a snowy road. Someone suggests taking only those who can walk. A badly wounded traveler silently gives a blanket to another. Kanade kneels and puts it back. "We will take you home." She asks her companions to secure a route and places her copies at separate junctions.
kanade.bond.80.victory: Her soaked battle clothes are sent for repair. The medics give her a dry cardigan and dark blue skirt. She looks toward the watch post, but the companion on duty waves her back inside. Under the lamp she writes to the people now beside her. The silver box holds two different memories. "I want to remember all of this."
kanade.bond.80.name: The Unsent Letter
kanade.camp.80.name: Heartbeats in the Snow
kanade.camp.80.description: Defeat all hostiles to complete the challenge.
kanade.bond.80.reward: Strengthen Hand Sonic; Absorb recovers 12 fatigue per clone; kill dash; Lamplight outfit.
kanade.bond.100.text: The rescued travelers are recovering and the caravan runs again. A tailor brings a white dress for a homecoming celebration. "Who is it for?" Kanade asks. "Someone who wants to join us. We hope you will." You hand her tomorrow's breakfast and duty plans. There is an ordinary day beyond this celebration. She promises to try the dress when she returns.
kanade.bond.100.reveal: The last abnormal terminal projects a sealed classroom. Everyone smiles and nobody leaves, but every conversation repeats the same answer. Kanade remembers real school life and knows what is missing. She recalls yesterday's complaints about bland food and the snowy road, and the dress waiting at camp. "Let us go back. Everyone is waiting."
kanade.bond.100.victory: Kanade returns in the White Feather dress and opens her silver box. Her note remembers a first bowl, a scarf, and a night someone else kept watch. She looks up instead of reading. "Thank you." The lamps stay lit; people are still discussing supper. She reaches toward the companion at the doorway and sets a bowl beside her. "Let us eat together tomorrow too."
kanade.bond.100.name: A Seat for Tomorrow
kanade.camp.100.name: The Classroom without Graduation
kanade.camp.100.description: Destroy 3 anchors and all enemies. Each anchor grants the terminal 25% damage reduction. The terminal summons 2 echoes every 3 rounds, up to 6 total.
kanade.bond.100.reward: +1 maximum AP; Sonic Rotation; White Feather dress.

es.name: Es
es.background.name: Guardian of the Azure Gate
es.background.description: A reserved swordswoman from BlazBlue who bears Murakumo. Once guardian of the Azure Gate, she now chooses whom to protect in an unfamiliar world.
es.trait.name: Guardian of the Azure
es.trait.description: Sword strikes and projectiles leave azure crests that burst on her next turn. Build Heat to unleash powerful arts and recover more techniques through her bond.
es.skin.name: Azure Guardian
es.skin.description: Es in her original outfit with Murakumo. Bond progression retains this appearance.
es.azure_guardian.name: Azure Guardian
es.azure_guardian.description:
Start combat with 20 Heat, up to 100. Attacks that cost no Heat grant 15 Heat; a successful parry grants 15. Each group of crests that hits an enemy grants 5 Heat, except Artorius crests, which grant none. Recover 5 extra Fatigue each turn.
All attacks leave crests that burst at the start of your next regular turn, harming enemies only. Crest damage is 100% of the art's total damage, plus 50% from Murakumo and 50% while enhanced, for up to 200%. Waiting and extra actions do not trigger crests early.
es.actives.name: Crest Swordsmanship
es.actives.description: Begin with Crest Arts, Breunor and Galahad. Complete bond challenges to unlock advancing strikes, a parry, heavy slashes, enhancements and the final art. A usable Murakumo is required.
es.weapon.name: Murakumo
es.weapon.description:
Es's two-handed sword. Damage 85–105, armor damage 130%, armor penetration 25%, durability 120, maximum Fatigue -8.
Adds 50% to the crest damage coefficient: from 100% to 150% of the art's total damage, or 200% while enhanced.
es.unavailable: Cannot act in the current state.
es.locked: Complete the corresponding bond challenge first.
es.moving: Wait for the current movement to finish.

es.crest.tile:
%s's crests: %d groups
Total damage: %d–%d if all hit, before hit location, armor and damage reduction. Burst at the start of the next regular turn; enemies only.
es.heat.name: Heat and Crests
es.heat.description: Start with 20 Heat, up to 100. Attacks with no Heat cost grant 15, successful parries grant 15, and each group of crests that hits an enemy grants 5. Artorius crests grant no Heat. Galahad and Percival cost 50; Artorius costs 100.
es.state.bors: Bors: the next attack or parry gains +50% to its crest damage coefficient. This charge is saved while Percival is active.
es.state.guard: Griflet: block the next adjacent melee weapon hit, counterattack and leave a crest. Lasts until your next regular turn.
es.state.guard_enhanced: Enhanced Griflet: block the next adjacent melee weapon hit and counterattack, leaving a crest with +50% damage coefficient. Lasts until your next regular turn.
es.state.percival: Percival: all attacks gain +50% to their crest damage coefficient. Expires after %d regular turn starts.

es.preview.normal_detail: 150% damage, accuracy +10, armor damage 170%, armor penetration 30%; leaves a crest extending 1 ring.
es.preview.charged_detail: 200% damage, accuracy +15, hits the head, armor damage 190%, armor penetration 35%; leaves a crest extending 1 ring.
es.preview.route: Advance %d tiles to the enemy, leaving crests along the route and at the target. Can disengage from enemies, but terrain hazards still apply.
es.preview.hint: Cancel without spending resources. Right-click or Esc to close.
es.bond.claimed: This stage has awarded its techniques, 1 freely assignable perk point, and any associated signature equipment. Equipment is delivered to the company stash.
