es.armor.name: Azure Gate Guardian Uniform
es.armor.description: A navy guardian uniform tailored for Es, with flexible protective layers beneath its white front and secure gold clasps. It leaves her free to turn with Murakumo. Awarded after completing the 40-bond challenge.
es.helmet.name: Azure Guardian Circlet
es.helmet.description: A light protective circlet shaped after Es's gold hair ornaments. A blue crystal and padded inner band protect her head without obstructing her sight. Awarded after completing the 60-bond challenge.
es.replace.title: Es Signature Equipment Replacements
es.replace.description: Previously awarded equipment can be replaced only when no copy from the same owner exists in any roster equipment, bags or company stash. Murakumo and the uniform cost 3000 crowns each; the circlet costs 2000. Each requires one stash slot. Repair damaged items normally. Initial rewards delayed by a full stash remain free.
es.replace.failed: Replacement failed: check crowns, stash space, reward eligibility, and whether an equipment copy from the same owner already exists.
es.crest_arts.name: Crest Arts
es.crest_arts.description:
Slash an adjacent enemy for 100% weapon damage. Accuracy +10, armor damage 130%, armor penetration 25%.
Leave a crest at the target's position, extending 1 ring around it. It bursts at the start of your next regular turn, harming enemies only, even if the slash misses.
es.breunor.name: Type: Shooter “Breunor”
es.breunor.description:
Fire a blade wave at an enemy 2–4 tiles away for 90% weapon damage. Accuracy +5, armor damage 110%, armor penetration 25%. Uses Melee Skill and requires line of sight; nearby enemies do not prevent firing.
Leave a crest at the target's position, extending 1 ring. It bursts at your next regular turn, harming enemies only.
es.galahad.name: Type: Slasher “Galahad”
es.galahad.description:
Advance to an enemy within 3 tiles and strike for 80% then 160% weapon damage. Each strike has +15 accuracy, 150% armor damage and 35% armor penetration. Missing the first strike ends the combo.
Leave crests along the advance and at the target, extending 1 ring. Crests use the full 240% art multiplier even if a strike misses, and burst at your next regular turn, harming enemies only.
es.mordred.name: Type: Slasher “Mordred”
es.mordred.description:
Advance to an enemy within 3 tiles and deal 90% weapon damage. Accuracy +5, armor damage 130%, armor penetration 25%. Can still strike adjacent enemies while rooted.
Leave crests along the advance and at the target, extending 1 ring. They burst at your next regular turn, harming enemies only.
es.bors.name: Type: Enchanter “Bors”
es.bors.description:
Enhance your next attack or parry with +50% to its crest damage coefficient. Together with Murakumo, this raises crest damage from 150% to 200% of the art's total damage.
The charge lasts until used and cannot stack. It is saved while Percival is active.
es.griflet.name: Type: Slasher “Griflet”
es.griflet.description:
Take a parrying stance. Block the next adjacent melee weapon hit, gain 15 Heat and counter for 110% weapon damage. Accuracy +15, armor damage 130%, armor penetration 25%.
The counter leaves a crest at the attacker's original position, extending 1 ring. It bursts at your next regular turn, harming enemies only. The stance lasts until that turn and can be used once per round; it does not block ranged attacks or ongoing damage.
es.gawain_charged.name: Type: Slasher “Charged Gawain”
es.gawain_charged.description:
Deliver a charged slash to an adjacent enemy's head for 200% weapon damage. Accuracy +15, armor damage 190%, armor penetration 35%.
Leave a crest at the target's position, extending 1 ring. It bursts at your next regular turn, harming enemies only. Crests do not guarantee head hits.
es.gawain.name: Type: Slasher “Normal Gawain”
es.gawain.description:
Deliver a heavy slash to an adjacent enemy for 150% weapon damage. Accuracy +10, armor damage 170%, armor penetration 30%.
Leave a crest at the target's position, extending 1 ring. It bursts at your next regular turn, harming enemies only.
es.percival.name: Type: Enchanter “Percival”
es.percival.description:
Enhance all attacks and parries with +50% to their crest damage coefficient. Together with Murakumo, this raises crest damage from 150% to 200% of the art's total damage.
Lasts until the start of the second subsequent regular turn; extra actions also benefit. Cannot be refreshed or stacked with Bors.
es.artorius.name: Type: Eradicator “Artorius”
es.artorius.description:
Unleash a finishing slash across the 3-tile fan ahead, striking each enemy for 100% then 200% weapon damage. Each strike has +15 accuracy, 180% armor damage and 40% armor penetration. Missing the first strike ends that target's combo.
Leave crests across the entire fan, extending 2 rings. They use the full 300% art multiplier and burst at your next regular turn, harming enemies only. Overlapping crests from this cast hit each enemy only once. Neither this art nor its crests grant Heat.
es.bond.prologue:
She waits at the edge of the firelight, holding her sword clear of the ground. “Please identify the entrance I am to guard.”

You spread a sketch of the camp on a crate. It shows wagon ruts, tethering posts and temporary watches, but no gate. “We move every day. For tonight, let this be a place to rest.”

Es studies you, then the people sharing supper. “…Understood. I will travel with you for now and assess this world.”
es.bond.20.name: A Guardian Without a Gate
es.bond.20.text:
When you take the night watch, Es is still standing at the road. Dew has gathered on her cloak. “No abnormal approach. The entrance is secure.”

You explain that the company will leave tomorrow and may never pass this road again. She studies the wheel ruts. “Then how should the area of protection be defined?”

You point toward the last lamp in camp. “Start where the people are. You can ask what they need, too.”

She is quiet. When the watch changes, she follows you back to the fire for the first time.
es.bond.20.reveal:
At dawn a wagon driver reaches camp alone, boots worn through and a broken rein in his hand. Bandits have stopped his caravan near a ruined bridge and kept the others as hostages.

Es looks at you. “Will we accept the commission?” Before you answer, she adds, “The people beyond the bridge cannot leave unaided. I believe we should go.”

For the first time she has offered her own judgment first. You turn the map toward her and ask how she would approach. Her finger rests on a narrow path. “Here. It will shorten their wait.”
es.bond.20.victory:
When the barricade falls, Es goes among the rescued travelers, checking that each can walk. A child asks whether she is the knight who lives at the bridge.

She shakes her head. “I was only passing through. Then I decided to stop.”

On the way back she practices the balance of her advance, adapting a familiar sword path to rough ground. An azure crest lights behind her and slowly sinks into the earth.
es.bond.20.continue: Come warm yourself by the fire.
es.bond.20.challenge: Take the narrow path to the bridge.
es.bond.20.reward: Mordred restored. Unlock the short advance slash and its Bors preparation. Gain 1 freely assignable perk point.
es.camp.20.name: Broken Bridge Barricade
es.camp.20.description: Es’s bond challenge at 20. Defeat every enemy with Es participating and surviving. Fixed defenders, no reinforcements.
es.bond.40.name: Memories Beyond Pudding
es.bond.40.text:
The cook puts a small bowl before Es and solemnly announces that this time it is dessert. She studies it before lifting her spoon. After the first bite, she pauses.

“Is something wrong with the taste?” you ask.

“It is different. But part of it… is very close.” Looking at the shallow mark in the pudding, she recalls another table. She cannot remember every word spoken there, but remembers someone waiting to hear whether she liked it.

You do not ask for their names. You simply shield the bowl from windblown ash.
es.bond.40.reveal:
Near dusk, an outpost sends for help. The defenders have withdrawn, but their attackers hold the road and intend to pursue the wounded.

Es hands her unfinished bowl to the cook and asks twice how many people are retreating. On hearing that one has difficulty walking, she turns to you. “Will he be at the back?”

You say someone will stay with him. She moves her sword to the outer side. “Then I will meet the first attack that reaches them. Please keep the rest of my portion for when we return.”
es.bond.40.victory:
When the final enemy falls, Es turns to count the company before lowering her sword. You ask whether she is still checking the assignment. She looks at a wounded traveler supported by a companion.

“I want to know whether they can all come back together.”

Her dessert is cold that evening, but she sits down and finishes it carefully. In later practice, she begins using the opening of her rising slash to meet close attacks, countering within sight of her companions.
es.bond.40.continue: Let her finish at her own pace.
es.bond.40.challenge: Clear the pursuers from the outpost.
es.bond.40.reward: Griflet restored. Unlock a single melee guard and rising counter. Gain 1 freely assignable perk point. Receive Azure Gate Guardian Uniform in the company stash.
es.camp.40.name: Ashen Outpost
es.camp.40.description: Es’s bond challenge at 40. Defeat every enemy with Es participating and surviving. Fixed defenders, no reinforcements.
es.bond.60.name: Who Decides Who Is Worthy?
es.bond.60.text:
A clerk stops you in the market. He claims that unknown stone fragments must be confiscated and asks Es to judge who is worthy to possess them.

That word makes her pause. He presents a red-sealed order and points to several families behind on their taxes, as though the two matters were one. Es reads the paper but does not accept the list.

“What is the basis for this judgment?”

The clerk says the seal is the basis. She looks again, expression unchanged, but her hand leaves the sword hilt.
es.bond.60.reveal:
The supposedly dangerous stones prove to be broken glass from a ruin. The clerk and a band of mercenaries have imprisoned people who cannot pay, demanding ransom under the guise of an investigation.

Es sets the sealed order beside the names supplied by the prisoners’ families. “If I only confirm that an order exists, I will help them do this.”

You ask what she intends to do. She pushes the order aside and keeps the names. “Open the prison. Then let them choose where to go.”
es.bond.60.victory:
The prison’s heavy bolt breaks under Es’s sword. She keeps the newly freed people clear of the flying iron. Someone asks whose order this was.

She steps aside from the doorway. “It was my judgment.”

In training she no longer seeks only the fastest stroke. She gives Gawain time to gather force, concentrating it on what truly needs to be cut.
es.bond.60.continue: Hear from the people on that list.
es.bond.60.reward: Gawain restored. Unlock Normal Gawain and Charged Gawain as two separate skills.
es.camp.60.name: Red-Seal Prison
es.camp.60.description: Es’s bond challenge at 60. Defeat every enemy with Es participating and surviving. Fixed defenders, no reinforcements.
es.bond.80.name: By Her Own Will
es.bond.80.text:
For several nights Es repeats the same sword forms outside camp. Whenever a crest drifts from its intended place, she begins again, until her wrist trembles.

You leave water on a stone within sight. She says her precision is still insufficient. “If I cannot fulfill the duty of protection, is my reason to stay still valid?”

You remind her of the child at the bridge, the unfinished pudding and the people who left the prison. None gave her a certificate of qualification. All knew she had come.

At last she lowers her sword and takes the water.
es.bond.80.reveal:
Researchers invite Es to activate an ancient mechanism beneath a ruined passage. Having heard of her azure crests, they promise she may find her lost purpose there.

At the entrance she recognizes that the inscriptions belong to a different system. Their promised answer is a guess, while the mechanism’s noise has already awakened the dead below.

They urge her to keep trying. She withdraws her hand and stands before those who have yet to escape. “I will not treat the unknown as an order. Let everyone leave first.”

She asks the company to clear the passage for them.
es.bond.80.victory:
After the passage falls silent, Es does not touch the mechanism again. In the sunlight she opens her hand and watches a crest settle along her blade.

“The answer I hoped for was not here.”

You ask whether she is disappointed. She considers it. “A little. But I know what I want to do next.”

This time she controls the rhythm of the power herself. Her crests can support a sustained sequence, rather than a single isolated stroke.
es.bond.80.continue: That is enough practice for tonight.
es.bond.80.reward: Percival restored. Unlock sustained crest enhancement. Gain 1 freely assignable perk point.
es.camp.80.name: Hollow-Oath Passage
es.camp.80.description: Es’s bond challenge at 80. Defeat every enemy with Es participating and surviving. Fixed defenders, no reinforcements.
es.bond.100.name: A Place to Return To
es.bond.100.text:
The company is moving camp again in the lingering spring cold. Es folds a map into her pack and asks where you will stop next.

You say it is not decided, and promise to help investigate if she ever finds a path home. She no longer asks which entrance to guard. Looking toward the people packing the dishes, she nods. “I will not forget the people from before.”

“You do not have to,” you answer.

Her fingers tighten a little around the map. “I will remember the people here as well.”
es.bond.100.reveal:
The researchers write again: another exit from the passage opens onto an old road near a settlement. Awakened dead are emerging, and supplies left by the first evacuees remain outside the gate.

Es does not wait for an assignment. She checks the route and numbers, then brings her request to the company. “I want to end the danger there. Will you come with me?”

When you agree, her shoulders relax. Before she leaves, the cook asks whether to save dessert.

“Please save one portion,” she says. “I will come back.”
es.bond.100.victory:
After the battle, the road beyond the gate is quiet. Es sheathes her sword without waiting for another command.

On the way back she speaks of the feeling before her final stroke. She once associated releasing all her power with a final judgment. Now she understands that it can end a present danger and let her companions pass safely.

“There are still things I must seek,” she says. “Until then, I wish to travel with you.”

A place waits beside the fire. She puts down her pack, rests the sword within reach and accepts the small bowl saved for her.
es.bond.100.continue: Mark the next road on the map.
es.bond.100.challenge: Stand with Es at the Gate of Return.
es.bond.100.reward: Artorius restored. Spend 100 Heat to unleash it, with no HP threshold. Gain 1 freely assignable perk point.
es.camp.100.name: Gate of Return
es.camp.100.description: Es’s bond challenge at 100. Defeat every enemy with Es participating and surviving. Fixed defenders, no reinforcements.
es.guide.summary: A mobile swordswoman whose every art leaves a crest. Stronger arts bring stronger delayed bursts.
es.guide.analysis: Build Heat with slashes and blade waves, then use Galahad or Artorius for powerful attacks and stronger crests. Bors enhances the next art; Percival provides sustained enhancement. Artorius crests extend an extra ring, making them effective against clustered foes. Crests burst on your next regular turn, so anticipate enemy positions.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.name: The Thirteenth Toll
chapter.thirteenth_bell.description: Enter a city trapped at dusk with Rachel and Es. Restore its citizens' names and let tomorrow return. Four preparations and four battles; both companions must fight and survive.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.ending: Morning reaches the clock tower at last. The tea is still warm.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.name: A Letter Twenty Years Late
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line1: A merchant brings a yellowed letter: take those still awake before the thirteenth toll. He insists he left the clock city yesterday.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line2: This raindrop has returned to the top of the envelope three times. Such careless concealment is irritating.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line3: Murakumo is reacting. A connection inside the city is tightening.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line4: The captain orders tools and medicine packed and follows the old road marked by the merchant.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line5: If we are going, pack the tea service properly. I have no intention of tolerating inferior tea.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.opening.line6: I will make sure there is a way back.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.name: Tea That Never Cools
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line1: The repaired sign points out of the city. Three residents tell the same story, with exactly the same pauses.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line2: The pudding has returned. The person who ate it no longer remembers its taste.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line3: Preserving the table while wearing away its guests. What appalling hospitality.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line4: A funeral procession carries an empty coffin. Pages rustle inside. At its sight, the tea seller forgets her name.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line5: They are not carrying bodies. I will retrieve what is in that coffin.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.line6: Do not rush into an encirclement. Let them enter the rain I have chosen first.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.name: The Procession in the Rain
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.line1: With the patrol defeated, the register stops turning its pages. Crossed-out names bear numbers from the old chapel.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.line2: Some names remain. There may be people alive in the chapel.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.line3: Then this rain must continue. Nago, cover her back.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.line4: Es holds the alley until the last mercenary passes with the register. Rachel keeps the umbrella over her.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.line6: Keep that book safe. That would be more useful than a belated observation.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.name: Guests Without Names
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line1: The register is matched to personal keepsakes. With their wounds treated, the residents can finally speak their names.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line2: The outer ring sustains the repetition. Sever it, and the tower can no longer draw memories from here.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line3: Their memories are still connected to that ring. If we cut it now, they will disappear with it.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line4: The longer we delay, the less stable the exit becomes. Do you understand that cost?
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line5: I do. I will hold the road. Please bring them out.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.line6: Rachel unfolds the map again and adds a detour to the chapel beside the straight line of attack.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.name: The Reversed Street
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line1: The bell officer's pendulum breaks. The side alleys open, and the company escorts the residents beyond the barricades.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line2: Your estimate missed two wounded people. Next time, include those who cannot walk.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line3: The wind you left carried them farther.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line4: Because I can revise my judgment too. You would do well to remember that.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line5: They review the evacuation map beside the chapel pew. This time, Rachel places the entire plan before Es.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.line6: There is a return route missing here.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.name: What the Lady Left Unsaid
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.line1: You have not said who remains inside the tower at the end.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.line2: Knowing too much is not always a good habit.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.line3: Then please choose a plan that needs no concealment.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.line4: The tools become temporary lightning frames. Es inscribes crests along them, allowing two anchors to hold the exit in turn.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.line5: There will be an instant when I cannot sustain the lightning curtain. That step is yours.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.name: The Observer's Empty Seat
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.line1: The faceless clockwork figures fall. The observer watched only its assigned places; the gatekeeper never left its partner.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.line2: They followed every duty precisely, yet never knew why. The keeper chose poor successors.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.line3: He chose us poorly too. I will not guard a door that imprisons people.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.line4: Rachel raises her umbrella toward the chamber. Es lifts her sword toward the other approach. Neither looks back to check.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.line5: Keep the key safe. Our guests have waited long enough.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.name: A Table for Tomorrow
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line1: The last resident reaches the refuge. The captain distributes medicine and assigns guards to the outer route.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line2: Break the outer clocks to weaken the curtain. Watch the floor marks before the toll, and do not stand where it assigns you.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line3: Once the outer clocks fall, the core will widen its strikes. I will approach through the clear passage.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line4: Rachel entrusts the tea service to Nago. Es leaves two unopened puddings on the table, safely away from the fire.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line5: You need not keep them forever. Boil the water when we return.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.line6: This time, there are places for both of us.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.name: The Thirteenth Toll
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line1: The last crest binding the clock breaks. Es crosses the fading lightning curtain and takes Rachel's hand. The company answers from outside.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line2: True morning falls over the ruins and the tea table. The residents remember yesterday and begin to discuss tomorrow.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line3: This pudding will not return to how it was.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line4: Then eat it before it spoils. Must I teach you something so simple?
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line6: ...A tea party must wait until its guests arrive.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.line7: The repaired tower rings once in the distance. Es looks at the other cup.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_accounts: All three accounts share the same pauses. You record their timing on the map.
The empty plate fills with pudding again, but its guest cannot recognize her spoon. You record the anomaly.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_signs.li: You mark damaged signs and the tools needed. The escape route will open when preparation supplies are submitted.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage1.brief: Compare accounts, examine the repeating tea, and spend 10 tools to repair evacuation signs.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.1: Complete preparation and advance the story.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage2.brief: Defeat 8 clock patrols and retrieve the register. Both companions must fight and survive.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.2: Unfinished Tea: first damaging active lightning grants 10 extra Heat.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_names.li: An old watch, a needle, and a wooden horse find their owners. Names become people again.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_patients: The wounded list reaches the captain. Medicine will be issued when this stage is submitted.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage3.brief: Match names to keepsakes and supply 5 medicine for the wounded.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.3: Complete preparation and advance the story.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage4.brief: Defeat the bell officer and guards, 10 enemies total. Pendulum strikes mark a three-tile line one round in advance.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.4: Homeward Crest: first successful crest batch grants 10 extra Heat.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_route.li: The final route allows only one person to return. Es lays the drawing before Rachel.
Both anchor positions are calibrated. The frames can be built once tools are submitted.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage5.brief: Inspect the return route, calibrate two anchors, and supply 15 tools for lightning frames.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.5: Complete preparation and advance the story.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage6.brief: Defeat the observer, gatekeeper, and 6 guards to obtain the inner key.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_evacuati: Every name in the register receives an answer. The last stretcher passes the gate.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.action.plan: Review outer clocks and toll warnings
chapter.thirteenth_bell.prepare_plan.lin: Outer clocks grant protection. Warnings stay on their marked tiles, so moving avoids them. Killing the caster cancels its pending toll.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage7.brief: Check the evacuation list and final plan; supply 5 medicine for the refuge.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.7: Complete preparation and advance the story.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.stage8.brief: Defeat the keeper and 3 outer clocks. Each clock grants 15% damage reduction. Ground warnings resolve on the caster's next normal round.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.reward.8: Unlock Dawn Tea and Homeward Watch outfits.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.evidence.registe: Recorded story evidence; takes no inventory space.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.evidence.anchors: Recorded story evidence; takes no inventory space.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.evidence.key.des: Recorded story evidence; takes no inventory space.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.rain.title: Before the Rain Stops
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.rain.caption: Her umbrella shelters the space behind the sword.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.judgment.capt: The map they revise together finally holds a way home for both.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.trust.title: I Trust You With My Back
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.trust.caption: Each faces a different approach. Neither needs to look back.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.dawn.title: Tomorrow's Tea
chapter.thirteenth_bell.cg.dawn.caption: The guests have arrived. Tomorrow can finally be awaited.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.enemy.strike_des: A melee clock-blade attack subject to armor and defense.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.enemy.controller: Tolls mark fixed tiles one normal round ahead: the keeper deals 28 HP damage, other casters 18. Move away or kill the caster to avoid them. Each living outer clock reduces the keeper's damage taken by 15%, up to 45%. The observer takes 35% less damage within 2 tiles of the gatekeeper.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.enemy.warning: marks the next toll. Leave the marked tiles to avoid it.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skill.tea.name: Unfinished Tea
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skill.tea.descri: Once per battle, the first Sword Iris or Baden-Baden Lily to damage enemy HP or armor grants 10 extra Heat, capped at 100. Multiple targets do not grant additional triggers.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skill.crest.name: Homeward Crest
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skill.crest.desc: Once per battle, the first delayed crest batch to damage enemy HP or armor grants 10 extra Heat, capped at 100. Counters and direct sword attacks do not trigger it.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skill.promise.de: Rachel's damaging active lightning leaves a Wind-Thunder Mark until her next normal action. Es's next direct sword hit consumes it for 15% more damage on that segment and restores 1 Wind to Rachel. Once per global round per Rachel; both must be alive, on the field, and hold this growth. Delayed crests and counters do not consume marks.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.mark.name: Wind-Thunder Mark
chapter.thirteenth_bell.mark.description: Es's next direct sword hit can consume this mark, strengthen that segment, and restore Wind to its Rachel owner. Expires at Rachel's next normal action; if this round's trigger is spent, it remains until expiry.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skin.rachel.name: Dawn Tea
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skin.es.name: Homeward Watch
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skin.rachel.desc: A black-and-ivory gothic tea dress with wine-red lining and a silver clock-rose brooch, commemorating a shared return. Appearance only.
chapter.thirteenth_bell.skin.es.descript: Blue-and-white travel attire with a short cape and silver clock-rose brooch. She has kept a place for herself tomorrow. Appearance only.
rachel.name: Rachel Alucard
rachel.background.name: Observer of Wind and Thunder
rachel.background.description: A noble visitor from another world, accompanied by Nago, Gii, and her own sharp judgment. She commands wind, lightning conduits, and familiars, and learns to trust companions with the way home.
rachel.trait.name: Lady of the Alucards
rachel.trait.description: Plant rods and call down lightning. George opens a lightning window, bats pursue isolated foes, and wind repositions Rachel and her familiars.
rachel.skin.name: Alucard Attire
rachel.skin.description: Rachel's black-and-crimson gothic attire. Appearance only.
rachel.guide.summary: Mid-range setup and lightning damage; conduits require preparation.
rachel.guide.analysis: Her full field-control loop is available on recruitment. Plant lightning rods, detonate them with Iris or Lily, and use Wind to reposition. Familiars control approaches and cover the flanks. A mid-game choice for area damage and control.
rachel.rod_required: Requires at least one lightning conduit.
rachel.ground_required: Requires at least one grounded lightning rod.
rachel.wind_select: Select yourself or a familiar, then select this skill again and a destination. Moving costs 1 Wind and 2 Fatigue; selecting is free.
rachel.wind_destination: Target selected. Select this skill again, then a destination; click its current tile to cancel. Costs 1 Wind and 2 Fatigue.
rachel.wind_used: Self movement already used this normal action.
rachel.astral_required: Select an enemy within 1–4 tiles and line of sight.
rachel.george.name: George XIII
rachel.slow.name: Thunderstruck
rachel.slow.description: Initiative -20. Iris and Lily from the Rachel who summoned George deal %d%% more damage until the end of your next turn.
rachel.nago_attack.name: Nago Attack
rachel.nago_attack.description: Select an enemy. Nago deals 45 damage. Gain 10 Heat when damage is dealt.
rachel.tiny_lobelia.name: Tiny Lobelia
rachel.tiny_lobelia.description: Fire a seed at an enemy or the ground, leaving a lightning rod. Detonate it with Iris or Lily.
rachel.sword_iris.name: Sword Iris
rachel.sword_iris.description: Detonate every source. Ground rods strike adjacent foes; attached bats strike only their host, with stronger lightning.
rachel.george_xiii.name: George XIII
rachel.george_xiii.description: Summon George on an adjacent empty tile. He discharges near enemies, making them vulnerable to Iris and Lily. Use wind to send him forward.
rachel.lotus_barrel.name: Lotus Barrel
rachel.lotus_barrel.description: Select an enemy to turn ground rods into tracking bats. On hit they attach; follow with Iris or Lily for focused damage.
rachel.ivy_blossom.name: Ivy Blossom
rachel.ivy_blossom.description: Place a bat cloud at your feet or nearby to erode enemy health. Moving it with wind deals extra damage, but cannot kill.
rachel.silpheed.name: Silpheed
rachel.silpheed.description: Move yourself, George or a flying bat up to 2 tiles, or Ivy 1 tile with extra erosion. Rachel can move once per turn without provoking attacks.
rachel.baden_baden_lily.name: Baden-Baden Lily
rachel.baden_baden_lily.description: Lightning strikes around Rachel and detonates every source. Prepare rods, or combine George and attached bats for a stronger burst.
rachel.tempest_dahlia.name: Tempest Dahlia
rachel.tempest_dahlia.description: Unleash a wide barrage in the chosen direction, then recover 2 Wind. Useful when there is no time to prepare rods.
rachel.elfried.name: Elfried — Overdrive
rachel.elfried.description: Recover 2 Wind and gain 30 Heat immediately, then strengthen Lily and Dahlia until the end of your next turn. Once per battle.
rachel.gerbera_lute.name: Gerbera Lute
rachel.gerbera_lute.description: During Overdrive, deal 120 damage and knock the enemy back 1 tile on hit. Ends Overdrive.
rachel.clownish_calendula.name: Clownish Calendula
rachel.clownish_calendula.description: Unleash a rose cross on one enemy within 1–4 tiles. Always hits for 1200 damage, increasing to 1600 at bond stage III and 2400 at stage V. 150% armor damage and 40% armor penetration. Once per battle.
rachel.need_heat: Not enough Heat. Build it with attacks or familiars.
rachel.need_rod: Requires a lightning rod or tracking bat.
rachel.need_wind: Requires 1 Wind and room for 2 Fatigue.
es.crest.tooltip: Crest damage: %d–%d (%.0f%% weapon damage). Accuracy +10, armor damage 130%%, armor penetration 25%%; before hit location, armor and damage reduction.
valkyrie.hu_tao.bond.name: A Road Home Together
valkyrie.hu_tao.bond.description: Gain 4 bond per surviving personal victory. Each of five stages at 20/40/60/80/100 has two story pages followed by a camp challenge. The finale celebrates companionship, protecting the living and returning together, with a commemorative dress.
event.hu_tao_bond.title: Hu Tao’s Bond
event.hu_tao_bond.challenge_rules: Hu Tao must participate and survive a victory. Stage 60 requires three released bindings; stage 80 nodes weaken the guardian; stage 100 requires both waves defeated and the lamp protected. Failure or retreat can be retried.
event.hu_tao_bond.spawn_failed: No suitable camp location is available. Your progress is retained; talk again later to retry.
hu_tao.name: Hu Tao
hu_tao.background.name: 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor
hu_tao.background.description: Hu Tao lightens camp with jokes and verse, but treats every farewell with care. She carries her spear through enemy lines and leaves a lamp burning for those returning alive.
hu_tao.trait.name: Guard the Living, Honor the Departed
hu_tao.trait.description: A mobile burst fighter who turns vitality into power. +25% maximum HP and stronger fire damage at half health. Enhanced dashes grant one 90% direct-hit reduction; Lingering Fragrance prevents one lethal hit per battle.
hu_tao.skin.name: Wangsheng Ceremonial Attire
hu_tao.skin.description: A black and red ceremonial coat, hexagram hat and plum blossoms accompany her between life and death.
hu_tao.dress.name: Plum Lantern Homecoming Dress
hu_tao.dress.description: A commemorative dress prepared by her companions, honoring the departed and celebrating those who return. Complete the fifth companion bond challenge to unlock.
hu_tao.actives.name: Guide to Afterlife / Wangsheng Dash / Spirit Soother
hu_tao.actives.description: Spend current HP to enter Paramita Papilio, dash into the rear line, withstand a key hit, then burst and heal with Spirit Soother before pursuing or withdrawing.
hu_tao.sanguine_rouge.name: Sanguine Rouge
hu_tao.sanguine_rouge.description: Maximum HP +25%. At 50% HP or less, own fire damage +33%. Once per battle, lethal damage leaves 1 HP, cleanses supported temporary debuffs and grants damage immunity until the end of the next full normal turn. +25 melee/ranged defense, +20 melee skill, +30 resolve and 80% debuff resistance last through the next two full normal turns. Completing bond challenges 20/60/100 grants +1 action point each. Returning Butterfly Flame: once battle falls silent, the flames that cross the boundary of life and death return to Hu Tao's living breath, replenishing her strength and mending her wounds. At the end of every battle, if Hu Tao survives, restore all HP, clear fatigue, heal all temporary and permanent injuries, and cleanse the temporary debuffs supported by this skill. Also applies after surviving a retreat and consumes no medical supplies. Does not resurrect the dead or repair equipment.
hu_tao.guide_to_afterlife.name: Guide to Afterlife
hu_tao.guide_to_afterlife.description: 1 AP, 5 fatigue, once per global round. Spend 30% current HP rounded up, retaining at least 1 HP; unusable at 1 HP. Refresh Paramita Papilio through this and the next normal turn. Snapshot 6% maximum HP as melee skill (cap 20) and 20% as flat spear damage (cap 80); +15% direct damage and 50% debuff resistance. Recover 5 extra fatigue on subsequent normal turns, upgraded to 8 at stage 40; direct damage becomes +25% at stage 80.
hu_tao.wangsheng_dash.name: Secret Spear of Wangsheng
hu_tao.wangsheng_dash.description: 4 AP, 16 fatigue. Dash up to 3 tiles along a straight hex direction to an empty destination. Strike each enemy crossed once for 100% weapon damage, 125% armor damage, 35% penetration and +10 accuracy. Paramita Papilio changes this to 2 AP, 8 fatigue and 4 tiles, applies Blood Blossom and grants Butterfly Guard on completion. Maximum 2 casts per global round. Stage 20 reduces enhanced fatigue to 6; stage 80 raises the enhanced weapon multiplier to 110%. No movement attacks of opportunity; ground hazards still apply.
hu_tao.basic_thrust.name: Wangsheng Thrust
hu_tao.basic_thrust.description: 3 AP, 8 fatigue, range 1–2. Deal 85% weapon damage, 100% armor damage, 25% penetration and +10 accuracy. Benefits from Paramita Papilio and low-health fire bonuses, but grants neither Blood Blossom nor Butterfly Guard. Requires an intact polearm.
hu_tao.spirit_soother.name: Spirit Soother
hu_tao.spirit_soother.description: 6 AP, 30 fatigue, cooldown 2 own normal turns. Attack visible enemies within 2 tiles and line of sight for 120–160 plus 25% maximum HP (flat bonus capped at 100), +20 accuracy, 100% armor damage and 35% penetration. At half health, deal another +20% damage. Heal 15% maximum HP for the first effective hit and +5% per additional target, capped at 35%; at half health use 20%–40%. Applies Blood Blossom during Paramita Papilio. Snapshot all bonuses before damage and heal once afterwards. Stage 80 raises base damage to 150–190.
hu_tao.paramita_papilio.name: Paramita Papilio
hu_tao.paramita_papilio.description: Health empowers spear attacks, melee skill, damage and debuff resistance. Recasting refreshes duration and the HP snapshot without resetting dash charges, guard uses or ultimate cooldown.
hu_tao.butterfly_guard.name: Butterfly Guard
hu_tao.butterfly_guard.description: Reduce the next enemy direct-hit segment HP and armor damage by 90%, expiring at the next own normal turn start. Can trigger only once per global round; another dash cannot replace a spent charge. Does not block damage over time, ground hazards or control effects.
hu_tao.lingering_fragrance.name: Lingering Fragrance
hu_tao.lingering_fragrance.description: The once-per-battle lethal safeguard has triggered. Protection does not waive active skill costs, movement costs or self-paid HP. Final bond also resets Spirit Soother cooldown and restores 15 fatigue when triggered.
hu_tao.blood_blossom.name: Blood Blossom
hu_tao.blood_blossom.description: Deal armor-ignoring fire damage at the end of two target normal turns. Snapshot 8 + 6% Hu Tao maximum HP (8% after stage 60), multiplied by 1.33 at half health, capped at 60 per tick. Refreshes without stacking; ends if Hu Tao dies or retreats.
hu_tao.blossom.tick: %.1f fire damage per tick; %d ticks remain
hu_tao.state.counts: Spirit Soother cooldown: %d turns; dashes remaining this round: %d
hu_tao.unavailable: Cannot act during a normal turn.
hu_tao.e_used: Guide to Afterlife was already used this round.
hu_tao.weapon_required: Requires an intact polearm and no disarm.
hu_tao.dash_used: Both dashes have been used this round.
hu_tao.staff_of_homa.name: Staff of Homa
hu_tao.staff_of_homa.description: Signature legendary polearm: 85–105 damage, 120 durability and 8 fatigue; stage 80 upgrades to 105–125 and 150 durability. Hu Tao gains +10% maximum HP (+15% final) while wielding her own intact staff. Start and finish a surviving victory with it to gain +2 permanent vitality, capped at 20/30/40/50/60 by bond progress. Growth is stored on the actor, survives replacement and does not heal immediately.
hu_tao.ceremonial_coat.name: Wangsheng Ceremonial Coat
hu_tao.ceremonial_coat.description: Legendary body armor: 120 armor, 8 fatigue. Stage 40: 260 armor, +10 HP, +5 melee defense, 25% less fatigue from hits. Stage 80: 320 armor, +20 HP, 50% less hit fatigue. Personal bonuses require Hu Tao wearing her own intact equipment.
hu_tao.hexagram_hat.name: Hexagram Hat
hu_tao.hexagram_hat.description: Legendary headgear: 80 armor, 3 fatigue, +5 resolve. Stage 60: 220 armor, +15 resolve, +5 ranged defense and +10 percentage points of stance/safeguard debuff resistance. Stage 80: 280 armor and +8 ranged defense. Personal bonuses require Hu Tao wearing her own intact equipment.
hu_tao.replace.title: Restore the Traveling Kit
hu_tao.replace.description: Replace a lost personal item at its currently unlocked tier for 3,000 crowns. An existing item anywhere in the roster or stash prevents duplication; Homa vitality is retained.
hu_tao.replace.failed: Not enough crowns, no stash space, or the item has already been recovered.
hu_tao.guide.summary: Low-health dashes with a single-hit guard and lethal safeguard; heal with the ultimate and leave danger.
hu_tao.guide.analysis: Starts with the full combat loop. Equipment and five companion bond challenges improve HP, AP and endurance. First-hit protection excludes damage over time and the ultimate cannot heal after death; reserve 6 AP and 30 fatigue.
hu_tao.bond.prologue: Hu Tao spreads a price list beside the campfire and announces a special offer. Then she turns it over: the back is covered with unclaimed battlefield names. "Business can wait. These names cannot." You make room beside the fire.
hu_tao.bond.prologue.close: Sit down. Have something warm first.
hu_tao.challenge.interact.name: Release the Binding
hu_tao.challenge.interact.description: Select this skill, then click an adjacent red Blood Blossom ground marker to release its binding or ritual node. Costs 2 AP and no Fatigue. Stage 60 requires all three bindings; each stage 80 node removes 50 temporary gatekeeper armor.
hu_tao.challenge.wave: The second wave will arrive near the marked lantern shadows next round.
hu_tao.bond.20.name: An Order at No Charge
hu_tao.bond.20.title: An Order at No Charge
hu_tao.bond.20.location_description: Hu Tao companion bond challenge. Complete the objectives and bring Hu Tao back alive.
hu_tao.bond.20.text: Hu Tao fills camp with jokes and improvised verse. After dark, you find her cleaning name tags from both sides of the battle. "When nobody remembers their names, they really are far away." You clean the final tag and offer to help return their belongings.
hu_tao.bond.20.reveal: Raiders block the road, charging villagers for fraudulent exorcism charms. Hu Tao puts away her smile and traces a side route, agreeing on support and withdrawal positions. On the back of her price list she writes: "No charge this time."
hu_tao.bond.20.victory: You read the names together as the belongings are returned. Hu Tao says she has already been paid: someone remembers them, and someone chose to walk beside her.
hu_tao.bond.20.challenge: Mark the camp and set out together.
hu_tao.bond.20.reward: +1 AP; enhanced dash fatigue 8→6; vitality cap 30.
hu_tao.bond.40.name: Even Night Watchers Need a Warm Meal
hu_tao.bond.40.title: Even Night Watchers Need a Warm Meal
hu_tao.bond.40.location: The Watch Lamp That Would Not Go Out
hu_tao.bond.40.location_description: Hu Tao companion bond challenge. Complete the objectives and bring Hu Tao back alive.
hu_tao.bond.40.text: Hu Tao keeps joking, but her dinner has gone cold again. You rearrange the watch while a companion stitches a lining into her coat. When she protests, you return the reheated bowl to her hands. "Tonight is our turn."
hu_tao.bond.40.reveal: The dead are rising in the old cemetery. Hu Tao identifies a necromancer and suggests slipping behind the front line while the others hold it. This time she agrees on a pursuit limit first. "Afterwards, we eat together."
hu_tao.bond.40.victory: The meal is still warm when you return. Wearing her repaired coat, Hu Tao finally hands the watch lamp to the next shift and sits down to finish dinner.
hu_tao.bond.40.challenge: Mark the camp and set out together.
hu_tao.bond.40.reward: Extra stance fatigue recovery 5→8; coat upgraded; vitality cap 40.
hu_tao.bond.60.name: The Plum Branch Remembers the Road
hu_tao.bond.60.title: The Plum Branch Remembers the Road
hu_tao.bond.60.location_description: Defeat the enemies and release all three bindings with Hu Tao participating and surviving. Move any company member next to a red Blood Blossom marker, select Unbind and click its tile (2 AP, no Fatigue). Defeating enemies alone does not complete this challenge.
hu_tao.bond.60.text: Children ask about Liyue. Hu Tao describes the harbor, plum blossoms and the wind at Wangsheng, then falls quiet. You retie her loose hat ribbon without promising a road you cannot find. She begins asking where each companion hopes to return.
hu_tao.bond.60.reveal: A false medium promises reunions while trapping spirits in an old house. Hu Tao refuses to comfort villagers with a lie. The company agrees to release three bindings and meet outside, returning the right to say goodbye to the living.
hu_tao.bond.60.victory: The last binding fades. Hu Tao asks the villagers to write what they never said and place it beside a plum branch. Touching her repaired hat ribbon, she says, "Remember where you came from, and watch the road ahead."
hu_tao.bond.60.challenge: Mark the camp and set out together.
hu_tao.bond.60.reward: +1 AP; Blood Blossom HP scaling 6%→8%; hat upgraded; vitality cap 50.
hu_tao.bond.80.name: A Gate Beyond, a Lamp Homeward
hu_tao.bond.80.title: A Gate Beyond, a Lamp Homeward
hu_tao.bond.80.location: The Gate That Demands a Price
hu_tao.bond.80.location_description: Defeat the gatekeeper and enemies with Hu Tao participating and surviving. Optionally use Unbind from an adjacent tile on each red Blood Blossom marker (2 AP, no Fatigue) to remove 50 temporary gatekeeper armor. Brute force is also allowed.
hu_tao.bond.80.text: Ruins offer a clue to another world. Hu Tao studies every record and admits she still wants to go home, but will not make her companions pay an unknown price. Together you choose to investigate rather than trust a stranger's promise.
hu_tao.bond.80.reveal: The gatekeeper demands a living soul for passage home. Hu Tao recognizes a lie built from longing and checks the withdrawal route with you. Three ritual nodes sustain the guardian's armor; breaking them will help the front line. She grips Homa. "Keep the lamp. I will return."
hu_tao.bond.80.victory: When the false gate fades, Hu Tao relights the lamp pointing to camp. Together you use the ritual's remaining embers to restore her equipment. She has not forgotten home; now there are people here waiting for her too.
hu_tao.bond.80.challenge: Mark the camp and set out together.
hu_tao.bond.80.reward: Stance damage +15%→+25%; enhanced spear multiplier 110%; ultimate base 150–190; all three signature items reach final tier; vitality cap 60.
hu_tao.bond.100.name: A Place Beside the Lamp
hu_tao.bond.100.title: A Place Beside the Lamp
hu_tao.bond.100.location_description: Hu Tao companion bond challenge. Complete the objectives and bring Hu Tao back alive.
hu_tao.bond.100.text: The company prepares a remembrance evening, honoring the departed and celebrating those who returned. A black, red and gold dress bears plum blossoms and lantern patterns. Hu Tao jokes about her appearance fee, though she has already written every lamp's dedication. You leave her a chair at the table.
hu_tao.bond.100.reveal: The hidden caster launches one final attack. Hu Tao arranges evacuation and support, identifies two defensive routes and warns of reinforcements. She no longer tries to carry every danger alone. "Keep the lamp burning. We go back together."
hu_tao.bond.100.victory: The lamp survives, and the celebration continues. Hu Tao changes into the dress her companions prepared and places the last lantern beside her chair. "This time we are not seeing anyone off. We are celebrating that we all came back!" The road is long, but you have promised to return together.
hu_tao.bond.100.challenge: Mark the camp and set out together.
hu_tao.bond.100.reward: +1 AP; lethal safeguard resets Spirit Soother cooldown and restores 15 fatigue; unlock the Plum Lantern Homecoming dress.
hu_tao.bond.claimed: This stage's growth and equipment upgrades are active. Lost equipment can be replaced through the recovery dialogue; the final stage unlocks the commemorative dress.
hu_tao.bond.pending: The challenge is complete, but some rewards are pending. Make room in the stash and speak again; completed growth is never granted twice.
rachel.tip.seed: Select an enemy or the ground. Deal %d damage and leave %d rod(s), even on a miss. At most 3 sources; new ones replace the oldest.
rachel.tip.iris: Detonate all sources for %d lightning damage each. Ground rods strike adjacent foes; attached bats hit only their host for %d%% more damage. Sources are consumed.
rachel.tip.george: Select an adjacent empty tile to summon George with %d health. He discharges near enemies for %d lightning damage, then disappears. Damaged foes lose 20 Initiative and take %d%% more damage from your Iris and Lily until their next turn ends.
rachel.tip.lotus: Select an enemy to turn all ground rods into tracking bats. Each deals %d damage on hit and attaches. Attached bats hit only their host; their Iris and Lily lightning deals %d%% more damage.
rachel.tip.ivy: Select your tile or an adjacent tile. The cloud covers adjacent tiles, eroding %d health per round and another %d each time wind moves it. Cannot reduce health below 1 or generate Heat.
rachel.tip.lily: Deal %s lightning damage around yourself and detonate all sources for %s each. Multiple sources can strike the same enemy.
rachel.tip.dahlia: Choose a direction. Deal %s damage in a 6-tile-long, 3-tile-wide barrage, then recover 2 Wind. No rods required.
rachel.tip.astral: Deal %d damage to one enemy within 1–4 tiles. Always hits, with 150%% armor damage and 40%% armor penetration. No low-health requirement or rod setup. Once per battle.
rachel.tip.od: Recover 2 Wind and gain 30 Heat now (up to 100). Until the end of your next turn, recover 2 Wind per turn and deal %d%% more damage with Lily and Dahlia. Once per battle.
rachel.tip.mastery: Start with 4 Wind; recover %d per turn. Heat caps at 100 and starts at %d. Damaging basic attacks grant 10 Heat; George or a batch of bats can each grant 10 once. Taking damage from an enemy attack grants 5 Heat.
rachel.tip.combo: After George: +%d%%. Attached bat: +%d%%. These bonuses add together.
rachel.tip.familiar: Lasts until your next turn ends. Taking attack damage removes George, Ivy and unattached bats.

valkyrie.rachel_alucard.bond.name: Tea at Our Table
valkyrie.rachel_alucard.bond.description: Rachel gains 4 bond when she takes part in a victory and survives. Stories unlock at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 bond. Win each story's challenge to permanently improve her techniques.
event.rachel_alucard_bond.title: Tea with Rachel
event.rachel_alucard_bond.challenge_rule: The challenge is marked on the world map. Rachel must fight, survive and defeat its defenders. You may retry after retreating.
event.rachel_alucard_bond.spawn_failed: There is no suitable battlefield nearby. Move to open land and continue from the bond menu. Your story progress is preserved.
rachel.bond.claimed: Her techniques have been permanently improved.
rachel.bond.pending: Your victory is recorded. Return to the bond menu to collect the improvement.
rachel.bond.20.name: Afternoon Tea at Camp
rachel.bond.20.text:
Rachel slides her cup away. Even Nago declines to defend the tea. She finds fault with the water, the chipped rim and the noise outside. You bring a steadier table and move the watch route away from the shade.

At last she takes a sip, then points her parasol behind the supply wagon. "One more pair of tracks than this morning." A stranger has been watching the grain sacks. She tells Gii to remember the path.
rachel.bond.20.reveal:
At dusk a driver reports bandits holding the supply trail. Rachel draws an arc on the map: advance along the slope, watch the exit, and leave her room to place lightning rods where the paths meet.

"Do not chase every fleeing fool. Drive them into the same wind." The company follows her timing. Take Rachel to defeat the defenders and reopen the supply line.
rachel.bond.20.victory:
The wagons return safely. Rachel finds her table waiting, with a clean spare cup beside it.

"Since you have finally learned to cooperate, there is no need to stand next time." She nudges the cup toward you. Lightning rods turn at her parasol's tip, settling into place more readily than before.
rachel.bond.20.camp.name: Blocked Supply Trail
rachel.bond.20.camp.description: Defeat the bandits and reopen the supply route. Rachel must take part and survive.
rachel.bond.40.name: After the Wind Falls
rachel.bond.40.text:
After days on the road, Nago holds the parasol a little lower and Gii answers every question first. Rachel blames the dull weather, though her tea has long gone cold.

You assign another watch and choose a sheltered campsite. She studies the changed roster with a quiet huff. Gii relaxes. That night, the wind around her parasol rests.
rachel.bond.40.reveal:
Armed raiders occupy the old forest watchpost, their bowmen watching your flank. Rachel starts toward the narrow approach alone. You show her the rotation plan.

Shieldbearers will cover her while another group pressures the archers. She can save her wind for the right moment. Take her to reclaim the post. Each companion will carry a share of the line.
rachel.bond.40.victory:
When the last archer falls, a fresh shieldbearer is already beside Rachel. She lowers her raised hand, letting someone else hold the line.

Tea is still warm when she returns. "Since someone remembers these small matters," she says, "I suppose they may occasionally be entrusted to you."
rachel.bond.40.reward: Wind recovery each turn 1→2; fatigue recovery +5; Iris fatigue 12→10.
rachel.bond.40.camp.name: Forest Watchpost
rachel.bond.40.camp.description: Reclaim the watchpost from its archers and raiders. Rachel must take part and survive.
rachel.bond.60.name: The Familiars' Little Expedition
rachel.bond.60.text:
Gii carries a stack of letters, determined to deliver them correctly this time. Nago shelters the cooks from rain. George waits beside the wounded, startling animals away from their biscuits.

Rachel calls them meddlesome, yet knows what each patient needs. You save three places by the fire. Gii nearly drops the letters into it with delight.
rachel.bond.60.reveal:
The wounded cannot cross the hills: bandits hold the junctions and archers occupy the heights. Clear their positions before the evacuation can continue.

Nago finds a sheltered approach. Gii carries it to the advance party. George waits beside Rachel. She asks you to assign the squads rather than leave every path to her familiars. "Do your part. Leave the rest to them."
rachel.bond.60.victory:
The road opens. Rachel counts the returning companions, then checks each familiar. George puffs up proudly while Gii recounts his delivery.

Their places beside the fire remain free. She leads them over and sits with them. A stronger spark gathers around George, answering the small celebration.
rachel.bond.60.reward: George: HP 30→60, damage 40→60, Thunder Echo bonus 25%→35%. Attached-source bonus 50%→60%. Bats 15→25; Ivy 10→15; opening Heat 0→20. Clownish Calendula damage increases to 1600.
rachel.bond.60.camp.name: Hillside Junction
rachel.bond.60.camp.description: Clear the scattered bandit positions to open an evacuation route. Rachel must take part and survive.
rachel.bond.80.name: The Observer's Choice
rachel.bond.80.text:
A scout brings an ash-stained map. Ancient soldiers have left the ruins, sealing the last road used by fleeing villagers. Your company could take another route. Rachel knows it.

She studies that thin line for a long time. Even Nago falls silent. You tell her the company is ready; she only needs to show you where to stand. She closes the map. "Then we must not be late."
rachel.bond.80.reveal:
Outside the ruins, heavy shields block the road and polearms advance behind them. Rachel steps forward and marks where the lightning rods must fall.

Your shields give her room to cast while the others contain the flanks. With her back guarded, she can place every bolt where it matters. Take her to break the garrison and open the road.
rachel.bond.80.victory:
As the villagers pass through the ruins, one turns to wave. Rachel meets the gesture. She does not pretend she merely happened to be passing.

"This was my choice." She closes her parasol and glances at the companions still guarding her flanks. "Though you were not entirely without use." The last thunder fades.
rachel.bond.80.reward: Both finishers: AP 6→5. Dahlia: fatigue 28→24, damage 90→120. Baden-Baden Lily: fatigue 30→25, body strike 80→100, source strike 60→80. Lightning armor damage 100%→150%.
rachel.bond.80.camp.name: Ruins Across the Road
rachel.bond.80.camp.description: Break the ancient shield and polearm formation to reopen the escape route. Rachel must take part and survive.
rachel.bond.100.name: Thunder for This Place
rachel.bond.100.text:
Before supper, Rachel asks after a late scout and sends Gii with hot water for the wounded. You put her cup in its usual place. It has been a long time since anyone asked how long she would stay.

Her eyes pass over the tents, the fire and familiar faces. "Leave a meal for him when he returns." The instruction is as ordinary as the evening breeze.
rachel.bond.100.reveal:
The scout returns with urgent news: a larger ancient host is forming at the road's end. Break its stronghold before the armored troops advance and cut the camp off from supplies and retreat.

Rachel places her plan in your hands and takes the vital flank. Rods, familiars and companions each have their part. "I leave my back to you." Take her through this final battle.
rachel.bond.100.victory:
When the thunder ends, Rachel stays to count the wounded and gather the scattered company. She leaves only when the last companion is on the road home.

At the little table, Nago folds her parasol. She returns her cup to its usual place. "Do not ruin tomorrow's tea." You nod. She has said enough.
rachel.bond.100.reward: Each Rod cast places 2 rods; the field still holds at most 3 sources. Rod and Iris damage 40→55. Overdrive bonus 25%→50%; Thunder Echo 35%→50%; attached sources 60%→75%. Clownish Calendula damage increases to 2400.
rachel.bond.100.camp.name: Ancient Muster Ground
rachel.bond.100.camp.description: Defeat the stronger ancient formation and secure the camp's route home. Rachel must take part and survive.

hu_tao.challenge.enemies_cleared: The enemies are defeated, but bindings remain. Keep moving and use Unbind on all three markers to complete the challenge.
hu_tao.spirit_soother.confirm: Select to preview the two-tile area, then click Hu Tao's own tile to confirm. Only enemies take damage. Click the skill icon again to cancel; previewing costs no AP or Fatigue.
valkyrie.the_herta.bond.name: The Exception I Choose
valkyrie.the_herta.bond.description: Gain 4 bond after each victory in which The Herta participates and survives. Complete the stories and challenges at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 in order to earn her weapons, abilities and bridal keepsakes.
event.the_herta_bond.title: The Herta: The Exception I Choose
event.the_herta_bond.claimed_item: Excalibur has been placed in the stash.
event.the_herta_bond.claimed_skill: Final ability and bridal skin unlocked. The Ring of Exception is in your stash.
event.the_herta_bond.claimed: This stage's perk point and ability upgrade have been granted. Wedding keepsakes follow the final story.
event.the_herta_bond.pending_space: Perk points and ability upgrades are not blocked by a full stash. Free a slot to receive the wedding ring.
event.the_herta_bond.pending: Challenge progress is saved. Reward delivery is pending and will retry during a later event check.
event.the_herta_bond.challenge_rules: The camp will remain revealed and highlighted. The Herta must participate and survive the victory; retreat does not complete the stage.
event.the_herta_bond.spawn_failed: There is no suitable nearby land for the challenge camp. Progress is preserved; travel a little and try again.
event.the_herta_bond.20.name: A Temporary Assistant
event.the_herta_bond.20.title: The Herta: A Temporary Assistant
event.the_herta_bond.20.text:
When you return to your tent, the map has been moved beside the bed. The Herta sits in your chair with seven crystal fragments before her, half a payroll sheet trapped beneath her teacup.

“Leave the third one alone,” she says without looking up. “If you must ask why, wait until I have secured it again.”

You put the cup on a wooden coaster and sort the samples by her numbers. The sixth came from a scout wounded last night. You add his name beside the number so his payment will not be forgotten.

“The number is enough to distinguish it.”

“His first question when he came back was whether he had broken your things.”

She stops writing, asks about his wounds, and retrieves a shard she had intended to discard. You trim the lampwick without questioning her.

The next morning, her new ledger still has neat numbers. Beside each is a small space for a name.

“To save my temporary assistant the trouble of keeping a second book.” She hands it over. “Now tell me where that missing wagon was last seen.”
event.the_herta_bond.20.reveal:
The wagon stands inside an abandoned toll station. The bandits have used the observation instrument’s mounting rings to reinforce a gate. You spread the map behind a ridge; The Herta holds down a corner caught by the wind.

She has already calculated the quickest route inside. Then she notices your mark on the shed where the driver is held.

“Here first?”

You nod. She redraws two lines, including the shed in the opening move. She does not explain how many minutes it will cost or ask you to justify the choice.

“Once the instrument is repaired, I can streamline the formulas in my staff. You have seen its power. This time, I am improving the margin it leaves us.”

You pack away her notebook. Leaving the ridge, she gives you one of the sample cases without checking its contents again.
event.the_herta_bond.20.victory: The driver harnesses the horses again, every mounting ring recovered. That evening The Herta fits Unending Inquiry with a new violet calibration crystal. Thin luminous lines join beneath her feet. “The same question can leave us more room to breathe.” She turns the shaft and pushes the ledger toward you. “Record the adjustment. Your seat is still here.”
event.the_herta_bond.20.reward: Gain 1 perk point. The staff recovers 5 instead of 3 Fatigue on its first Starlit Query hit each normal turn. Unlock the first astrolabe layer.
event.the_herta_bond.20.option: I will bring the map. You secure the third crystal.
event.the_herta_bond.20.challenge_option: Go to the Lost-Star Checkpoint and recover the driver and instrument.
event.the_herta_bond.40.name: An Extra Cup of Tea
event.the_herta_bond.40.title: The Herta: An Extra Cup of Tea
event.the_herta_bond.40.text:
Long after the appointed hour, The Herta sets down her pen. The other chair is empty; she has already reheated the tea once.

She finds you at the medical tent. Accounts of injuries, unpaid supplies and tomorrow’s watch fill the same sheet. You finish reading the last name to the quartermaster before noticing her.

“It seems my experiment requires an appointment.”

You apologize. She glances at your cold meal and closes a medicine bottle. “Finish this first. A wrong dose is more troublesome than making me wait.”

When you finally join her, both cups are warm. The other chair stands closer to the desk, its books cleared away.

You ask whether the second cup is an experiment too.

“It is for you.” She waits for you to accept the plain fact. “Next time, tell me when you have too much to do. I can change the time.”
event.the_herta_bond.40.reveal:
After only a few sips, the instrument rings again. Interference from the ruined platform makes the star paths overlap. The Herta puts her cup down.

Patrols have found goblins there. They have built towers from ancient metal panels, using reflected light and sound to lure caravans into ambushes. She recognizes the markings and the source of the interference.

You describe the road; she marks each displaced reflection on the map. You take turns speaking without interrupting.

“Switch it off first. Then we can finish our tea. No new subject tonight.”

You point out that the tea will be cold. She drinks the last half of her cup.

“Then we will make more. How much is left of the kind you brought last time?”
event.the_herta_bond.40.victory: The last reflector comes down, and the observation chart steadies. The Herta removes several redundant checks from her staff’s formula; False Premise becomes easier to cast. When you reach the tent, she has brewed fresh tea. “Sit here.” She points to the same chair.
event.the_herta_bond.40.reward: Gain 1 perk point. While wielding the staff, False Premise costs 15 instead of 20 base Fatigue.
event.the_herta_bond.40.option: Then keep this cup for me.
event.the_herta_bond.40.challenge_option: Visit the Echo Ruins and give tonight some quiet.
event.the_herta_bond.60.name: An Answer in Her Absence
event.the_herta_bond.60.title: The Herta: An Answer in Her Absence
event.the_herta_bond.60.text:
The star paths finally lead to an underground archive. Two passages beyond the entrance reach separate control rooms, and the stone walls swallow even raised voices.

The Herta divides her notes and gives you a page. You expect her to check it again, but she begins sorting her own tools.

“What if something is not on the page?”

“You decide.”

She says it naturally. When you keep looking, she turns the paper over and marks two genuine hazards.

“Avoid these. Otherwise, I trust you to know when to continue and when to come back.”

You fold the page into an inside pocket. As you leave, she calls you back.

“We can rewrite a lost page. Do not go back for it.”
event.the_herta_bond.60.reveal:
The outer lever has an old lock missing from the notes. You avoid forcing it and disconnect a rusted coupling, opening the door without releasing falling stones.

You meet in the hall. Before you finish saying “The outer room is—”, The Herta takes your wrist. Your torn sleeve reveals a shallow cut still bleeding.

She washes away the grit and bandages it before letting you finish.

“Today you did not ask about the data first.”

“I saw you bleeding.” She meets your eyes. “What is unclear about that?”

Metal scrapes across stone deeper inside. The guards still circle the core, and the inner door is only half open.

Her fingers rest a moment on the bandage before she lets go.

“We take the next part together. Your solution was sensible. Add it to the notes when we return.”
event.the_herta_bond.60.victory: The core rises from the stilled mechanism, reflected in Answer Foreordained. The Herta fits it into the spine, extending silver paths into a protective arc. “The answer stays. The defense can be steadier.” She leaves the sword suspended beside her and looks at your bandage. “We change that first tonight. The notes can wait.”
event.the_herta_bond.60.reward: Gain 1 perk point. The greatsword stance grants 20 instead of 15 Melee Defense. Its four actions are available from recruitment; full Ranged Skill still contributes to melee accuracy.
event.the_herta_bond.60.option: I will bring back an answer—and myself.
event.the_herta_bond.60.challenge_option: Enter the Twin-Gate Archive and finish the calculation.
event.the_herta_bond.80.name: The Evening She Stayed
event.the_herta_bond.80.title: The Herta: The Evening She Stayed
event.the_herta_bond.80.text:
With the final data filed, you ask about her next destination. Neatly stacked boxes make you think she is preparing to leave.

The Herta is shifting an empty shelf. You steady its other end and discover that the boxes contain a newly ordered tabletop and lamp stands.

“Where did you put your things?”

You point outside. She leaves a space beside the shelf.

“Bring them in. Going outside for a notebook every time is too far.”

You ask whether the research is not finished.

“This project is finished.” She places the lamp where both of you can reach it. “I want to stay here a while. I can choose how to spend my days.”

You place your old map in the empty space. She watches it unroll, then smooths its creased corner.
event.the_herta_bond.80.reveal:
The archive’s outer array still runs an earlier test model. It produces no new conclusions, but repeatedly orders the guards to seal the observation tower, attacking passing travelers.

The Herta reads the model once and closes her notebook.

“It is obsolete. We can simply shut it down.”

You tease her about the many answers she wrote into it herself. She packs the staff and checks the greatsword’s crystal edge.

“Of course I can change my answers. Did you think I would spend my life protecting an old notebook?”

She asks where you want the table when you return. By the window, you say, where morning light will not shine into her eyes.

“Fine.” She marks the route. “We will move it together. Let no one decide for us.”
event.the_herta_bond.80.victory: The last old inscription fades. For the first time, staff and sword shine along the same orbit. Back at camp, you move the table beside the window. She no longer calls your seat temporary. Under the lamp, the shadows of the two chairs touch.
event.the_herta_bond.80.reward: Gain 1 perk point. Once per battle, completing Answer Foreordained with either signature weapon refunds 1 Inspiration.
event.the_herta_bond.80.option: Then I will keep using this space.
event.the_herta_bond.80.challenge_option: Go to the Mirror Calculation Gallery and end the obsolete experiment.
event.the_herta_bond.100.name: The Exception I Choose
event.the_herta_bond.100.title: The Herta: The Exception I Choose
event.the_herta_bond.100.text:
She asks you to come at dusk and leave your notebook behind. When you lift the tent flap, you first notice fine silver stars along her hem.

The Herta wears a white wedding gown. Pale lilac lining shows as she turns, long hair falling beneath a translucent veil. An open box on the table holds two silver rings.

“Why stand there?” She asks you to straighten the veil behind her shoulder. “I spent quite some time choosing it. Come closer.”

She places one ring in your hand and keeps the other in her palm.

“Our research here will end, and our travels may change direction. I want to live with you. That sentence needs no other reason.”

You ask whether she has thought it through. She smiles without looking away.

“Of course. But I want to hear your answer from you.”

You accept, sliding the ring onto her left ring finger. She puts the other on yours and studies your joined hands.

“Good.” She leans close and kisses you lightly. “You may write one fewer record today. I will remember this one.”
event.the_herta_bond.100.reveal:
You climb the steps outside camp to a small observatory. She still wears her wedding gown; the evening breeze lifts her veil, and her ringed left hand stays in yours.

The main tower still shines in the distance. The last unmanaged array disturbs travelers on the mountain road. You have agreed to deal with it together tomorrow.

“There is no need to call tonight a farewell before battle. I chose today because I wanted to marry you today.”

You say that when you return, the new table needs a better chair.

She raises her left hand, letting the light on her ring meet the one on yours.

“And another lamp. You always pull yours too close when reading maps.”

Star lines awaken slowly beneath the stone platform. Staff and sword meet in the same silver-violet orbit, then settle, holding a direction for those who will return.

She squeezes your hand again.

“Tomorrow, we switch it off. Then we come back and keep living our lives.”
event.the_herta_bond.100.victory: The tower’s glare contracts, revealing the mountain road in morning light. The Herta checks that every companion is clear of the array before putting away her weapons. She turns the ring on her left hand, and a gentle, steady point remains in the star chart beneath her feet. “Some answers I am willing to keep for you.” Two lamps glow beside the new table when you return.
event.the_herta_bond.100.reward: Gain 1 perk point and unlock Answer Kept for You: 2 AP, 10 Fatigue, fill Inspiration to 4 once per battle. Also unlock the Starlit Vows wedding skin and Ring of Exception keepsake.
event.the_herta_bond.100.option: I do. We will decide our days together.
event.the_herta_bond.100.challenge_optio: Face the Last-Star Observatory together, then come home.

skill.the_herta_verdict_slash.descriptio: 6 AP, 20 fatigue. Strike one enemy within 1–2 tiles for 100% greatsword damage, against melee defense and shields. Adds your full effective ranged skill to melee accuracy.
skill.the_herta_star_step.name: Astral Step
skill.the_herta_star_step.description: 3 AP, 15 fatigue. Magically move to a visible empty tile within 3 tiles and one elevation level without attacks of opportunity. Once per normal turn; does not automatically attack.
skill.the_herta_orbit_cleave.name: Orbital Cleave
skill.the_herta_orbit_cleave.description: 6 AP, 28 fatigue. Sweep the three adjacent tiles facing your target. Each enemy receives a separate melee attack for 90% greatsword damage; allies are spared. Full ranged-skill accuracy applies to each hit; Inspiration remains limited to once per normal turn.
skill.the_herta_final_verdict.name: Final Verdict
skill.the_herta_final_verdict.descriptio: 6 AP, 25 fatigue. Strike one adjacent enemy for 135% weapon damage, with an additional 150% armor-damage multiplier. Normal accuracy, armor and shield rules; no fixed damage or follow-up attack.
skill.the_herta_weapon_mastery.name: Wielder of Question and Answer
skill.the_herta_weapon_mastery.descripti: Your signature weapons grant their fighting styles only while equipped in your main hand.
skill.the_herta_answer_kept_for_you.name: An Answer Kept for You
skill.the_herta_answer_kept_for_you.desc: 2 AP, 10 fatigue, once per battle. Fill Inspiration to 4; unavailable at full Inspiration. Does not reset ultimate benefits or grant an attack or action points.
skill.the_herta_weapon_mastery.sword: Foresight Verdict: melee accuracy uses effective melee skill plus full effective ranged skill, subject to normal hit caps. While wielding the sword, gain +15 melee defense and Verdict Slash, Astral Step, Orbital Cleave and Final Verdict. After stage 60, the Melee Defense bonus increases to 20.
skill.the_herta_weapon_mastery.staff: Unfinished Calculation: the first Starlit Query hit each normal turn restores 3 fatigue. After the stage-40 challenge, False Premise costs 15 base fatigue instead of 20. After stage 20, recovery increases to 5.
skill.the_herta_answer_kept_for_you.unav: Requires the final bond challenge, an active battle, an unused charge and fewer than 4 Inspiration.
item.the_herta_unending_inquiry.name: Unending Inquiry
item.the_herta_unending_inquiry.descript: She suspends an unfinished question in the crown of her staff. The crystal keeps turning; the chair beside hers has found its permanent place.
item.the_herta_answer_foreordained.name: Answer Foreordained
item.the_herta_answer_foreordained.descr: Countless corrections live in its spine; bringing it down requires only one choice. She lets you take part, and remembers to check your wounds first.
item.the_herta_ring_of_exception.name: Ring of Exception
item.the_herta_ring_of_exception.descrip: The silver and violet ring she placed on your hand. You are the exception she chooses to keep. A keepsake with no equipment slot or stat bonuses; it cannot be consumed, sold or discarded.
skin.the_herta_starlit_vows_skin.name: Starlit Vows
skin.the_herta_starlit_vows_skin.descrip: Silver stars trace a white wedding gown; pale lilac veils accompany her into a life you share. Changes appearance only.
skin.the_herta_starlit_vows_skin.locked: Complete The Herta’s stage-100 bond challenge to unlock.
settings.herta_astrolabe.description: After the stage-20 challenge, show the animated base. Off, simplified or full detail. Inspiration nodes reflect the actual resource.
rachel.equipment.parasol.name: Nago’s Afternoon Parasol
rachel.equipment.parasol.description: A grumbling black-cat parasol. A legendary item with fixed attributes. Rachel gains Nago’s Care: +20 Melee Defense, +30 Ranged Defense and 3 additional Fatigue recovery each turn, and can use Under the Parasol while it is equipped. Grants no ordinary weapon attack; Rachel’s own moves remain available without it.
rachel.equipment.dress.name: Alucard Crimson Night Dress
rachel.equipment.dress.description: Black satin, crimson panels and white frills befit the head of House Alucard. A legendary item with fixed attributes. Rachel gains 10 maximum Hitpoints while wearing it.
rachel.equipment.ribbons.name: Alucard Black Satin Ribbons
rachel.equipment.ribbons.description: Long black ribbons tied around golden twin tails, stirring gently in the wind. A legendary item with fixed attributes. Rachel gains 10 Resolve and 10 Initiative while wearing them, with no vision penalty.
rachel.equipment.guard.name: Under the Parasol
rachel.equipment.guard.description: Open Nago to shelter yourself until the start of your next normal turn. The next damaging direct enemy hit deals 50% less health and armor damage and does not dispel George, the pumpkin or unattached bats. Protection ends after that hit; only the first damaging hit of a multi-hit attack is protected. Skip one turn before using this again.
rachel.equipment.guard.cost: Costs 2 AP and 6 Fatigue. No Wind or Heat cost.
rachel.equipment.guard.status: Sheltered beneath Nago. The next damaging direct enemy hit deals 50% less health and armor damage and preserves George, the pumpkin and unattached bats. Ends after that hit or at the start of your next normal turn.
rachel.equipment.guard.active: Sheltered: the next damaging direct hit is protected.
rachel.equipment.guard.cooldown: Available after %d more normal turn starts.
item.the_herta_starweave_mantle.name: Starweave Mantle
item.the_herta_starweave_mantle.descript: Herta's own protective vestments. Silver star trails bind light armor plates, while amethyst clasps contain a defensive field suited to both staff calculations and close combat. Only Herta can equip it. 300 body armor, -10 maximum fatigue; preserves the selected skin.
item.the_herta_astrolabe_crown.name: Astrolabe Crown
item.the_herta_astrolabe_crown.descripti: A witch's hat reinforced by an astrolabe frame and a metal circlet beneath its violet-black brim. Full vision for precise observation, protection for personal intervention. Only Herta can equip it. 240 head armor, -5 maximum fatigue, no vision penalty; preserves the selected skin.
